## FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction: Finite-index reverse adjunction and the trace cap

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Fix a group \(U\). For \(X\le U\), write \(\C[X]\) for its complex group algebra.
If \(\cg{\alpha}{H}=\alpha H\alpha^{-1}\le G\), write
\(\alpha_*:\C[H]\to \C[G]\) for conjugation by \(\alpha\), extended linearly.
This map depends exactly on
\[
 \bar\alpha=\alpha C_U(H),\qquad
 C_U(H)=\{u\in U:uh=hu\text{ for all }h\in H\}.
\]
The centralizer in a strand label is taken for the source of its
embedding.

The up and down strands below denote
\[
 \I_{\co\alpha}^{G,H}={}_{\C[G]}(\C[G])_{\alpha_*,\C[H]},\qquad
 \D_{\co\alpha}^{H,G}={}_{\C[H],\alpha_*}(\C[G])_{\C[G]}.
\]
The actions are \(x\cdot h=x\alpha h\alpha^{-1}\) on \(\I\) and
\(h\cdot x=\alpha h\alpha^{-1}x\) on \(\D\). Tensoring on the right
gives induction and restriction, respectively. The target group
is on the left. Read horizontal composition as tensor product over
the middle group and vertical composition from bottom to top.

Suppress the embedding and group labels on \(\I,\D\).
Each tensor product is over the group algebra of the middle region.

Define the \(\C[H]\)-bimodule trace
\[
 E_\alpha(g)=
 \begin{cases}
 \alpha^{-1}g\alpha,&g\in\cg{\alpha}{H},\\
 0,&g\notin\cg{\alpha}{H},
 \end{cases}
 \qquad g\in G,
\]
and extend it linearly. When \([G:\cg{\alpha}{H}]<\infty\), choose
\(T\subseteq G\) with \(G=\bigsqcup_{t\in T}\cg{\alpha}{H}\,t\).
The reverse adjunction \(\Res_{\alpha_*}\dashv\Ind_{\alpha_*}\) has
unit and counit
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \tu &: \C[G]\longrightarrow \I\otimes_{\C[H]}\D,\qquad
           g\longmapsto \sum_{t\in T}g t^{-1}\otimes t
                      =\sum_{t\in T}t^{-1}\otimes t g,\\
 \tv &: \D\otimes_{\C[G]}\I\longrightarrow \C[H],\qquad
           x\otimes y\longmapsto E_\alpha(xy).
 \end{aligned}
\]
Replacing \(t\) by \(\alpha_*(h)t\) leaves the balanced tensor
\(t^{-1}\otimes t\) unchanged. Right multiplication by \(g\in G\)
permutes the cosets \(\cg{\alpha}{H}t\), which proves the displayed
equality for \(\tu\).

The trace cap is
defined at every index. The reverse unit displayed above is part of
the generating calculus at finite index.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 1.2, Cups and caps, pp. 3–4, https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte, and the project TikZ fixes the reverse cup at the empty G boundary and the trace cap at the empty H boundary. The defect report at https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects returned HTTP 404. The task context supplies no correction for this endpoint. The type uses complex group algebras and the conjugation embedding labelled by the source centralizer coset. The linear trace and its cap evaluation hold at every index. At finite index, each right coset S t has exactly one representative in a transversal, and both displayed sums give the evaluated reverse cup for every transversal. The module adjunction uses the same induction and restriction functors as InductionRestrictionAdjunction, with the reverse unit on module generators and the reverse counit given by the evaluated trace cap. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem FiniteIndexReverseAdjunction : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := a.toHom.range
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap (R := Complex) a)
  let pairDI := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex down.basis up.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let pairID := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex up.basis down.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let basisG := fun g : G => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)
  let E : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B A :=
    LinearMap.comp (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex a))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap)
  (∀ g : G, g ∈ S →
    ∃ h : H, (h : U) = α⁻¹ * (g : U) * α ∧ E (basisG g) = MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) ∧
  (∀ g : G, g ∉ S → E (basisG g) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (r s : A) (x : B), E (φ r * x * φ s) = r * E x * s) ∧
  (∀ x y : B, cap.toLinearMap (pairDI x y) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (E (x * y))) ∧
  (∀ finite : S.FiniteIndex,
    let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite)
    let IsTransversal := fun T : Finset G =>
      ∀ g : G, ∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S
    let toRep : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (Rep.{max u v} Complex H) :=
      Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra
    let Ind : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) :=
      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp toRep (Rep.indFunctor Complex a.toHom))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G))
    let Res : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) :=
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.toRingHom
    let pure := fun (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (b : B) (x : X) =>
      let ρ := Rep.ρ (toRep.obj X)
      show Ind.obj X from
        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind a.toHom ρ)).symm
          (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex
            (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk a.toHom ρ g⁻¹ x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff b))
    (∃ T : Finset G, IsTransversal T) ∧
    ∃ adj : CategoryTheory.Adjunction Res Ind,
      (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (x y : B) (z : X),
        ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.counit.app X) (show Res.obj (Ind.obj X) from pure X (x * y) z) =
          (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (cap.toLinearMap (pairDI x y)) : A) • z) ∧
      (∀ (T : Finset G), IsTransversal T →
        (∀ g : G,
          cup.toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (basisG g)) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t)) ∧
          cup.toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (basisG g)) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG t⁻¹) (basisG (t * g)))) ∧
        (∀ (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (g : G) (z : Y),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.unit.app Y) (basisG g • z) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t =>
              pure (Res.obj Y) (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t • z)))))
```

## ReverseTriangleIdentities: Dual-basis identities and reverse triangle identities

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Define the \(\C[H]\)-bimodule trace
\[
 E_\alpha(g)=
 \begin{cases}
 \alpha^{-1}g\alpha,&g\in\cg{\alpha}{H},\\
 0,&g\notin\cg{\alpha}{H},
 \end{cases}
 \qquad g\in G,
\]
and extend it linearly. When \([G:\cg{\alpha}{H}]<\infty\), choose
\(T\subseteq G\) with \(G=\bigsqcup_{t\in T}\cg{\alpha}{H}\,t\).
The reverse adjunction \(\Res_{\alpha_*}\dashv\Ind_{\alpha_*}\) has
unit and counit
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \tu &: \C[G]\longrightarrow \I\otimes_{\C[H]}\D,\qquad
           g\longmapsto \sum_{t\in T}g t^{-1}\otimes t
                      =\sum_{t\in T}t^{-1}\otimes t g,\\
 \tv &: \D\otimes_{\C[G]}\I\longrightarrow \C[H],\qquad
           x\otimes y\longmapsto E_\alpha(xy).
 \end{aligned}
\]

The dual-basis identities are
\[
 \sum_{t\in T}t^{-1}\alpha_*\bigl(E_\alpha(t x)\bigr)=x,
 \qquad
 \sum_{t\in T}\alpha_*\bigl(E_\alpha(x t^{-1})\bigr)t=x .
\]
For a basis element \(x\in G\), each identity has exactly one
nonzero term, by the decompositions using \(T\) and \(T^{-1}\).
They give the two reverse triangle identities. The trace cap is
defined at every index. The reverse unit displayed above is part of
the generating calculus at finite index.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 1.2, Cups and caps, p. 3](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem ReverseTriangleIdentities : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let B := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let traceCap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap (R := Complex) a
  let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval traceCap
  let pairDI := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex down.basis up.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let pairID := fun (x y : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex up.basis down.basis
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)
  let basisG := fun g : G => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)
  let E : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B A :=
    LinearMap.comp (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm.toLinearMap
      (LinearMap.comp
        (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex a))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).toLinearMap)
  (∀ g : G, g ∈ S →
    ∃ h : H, (h : U) = α⁻¹ * (g : U) * α ∧ E (basisG g) = MonoidAlgebra.single h 1) ∧
  (∀ g : G, g ∉ S → E (basisG g) = 0) ∧
  (∀ (r s : A) (x : B), E (φ r * x * φ s) = r * E x * s) ∧
  (∀ x y : B, cap.toLinearMap (pairDI x y) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (E (x * y))) ∧
  (∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    let reverseCup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup (R := Complex) a finite
    let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval reverseCup
    let IsTransversal := fun T : Finset G =>
      ∀ g : G, ∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, g * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S
    let toRep : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (Rep.{max u v} Complex H) :=
      Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra
    let Ind : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) :=
      CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp toRep (Rep.indFunctor Complex a.toHom))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G))
    let Res : CategoryTheory.Functor (ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) :=
      ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ.toRingHom
    let pure := fun (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (b : B) (x : X) =>
      let ρ := Rep.ρ (toRep.obj X)
      show Ind.obj X from
        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Representation.ind a.toHom ρ)).symm
          (MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex
            (fun g : G => Representation.IndV.mk a.toHom ρ g⁻¹ x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff b))
    (∃ T : Finset G, IsTransversal T) ∧
    (∀ (T : Finset G), IsTransversal T →
      let leftTerm := fun (t : G) (x : B) => basisG (t⁻¹) * φ (E (basisG t * x))
      let rightTerm := fun (t : G) (x : B) => φ (E (x * basisG (t⁻¹))) * basisG t
      (∀ x : B, Finset.sum T (fun t => leftTerm t x) = x ∧
        Finset.sum T (fun t => rightTerm t x) = x) ∧
      (∀ g : G,
        (∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, leftTerm t.val (basisG g) ≠ 0) ∧
        (∃! t : {t : G // t ∈ T}, rightTerm t.val (basisG g) ≠ 0))) ∧
    (let idUp := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) up
     let idDown := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) down
     let triangleDown :=
       MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit down)
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDown reverseCup)
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate down up down)
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal traceCap idDown)
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit down))))
     let triangleUp :=
       MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit up)
         (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal reverseCup idUp)
           (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate up down up)
             (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUp traceCap)
               (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit up))))
     MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval triangleDown = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idDown ∧
       MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval triangleUp = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idUp) ∧
    ∃ adj : CategoryTheory.Adjunction Res Ind,
      (∀ Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B,
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Res.map (adj.unit.app Y))
          (adj.counit.app (Res.obj Y)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (Res.obj Y)) ∧
      (∀ X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A,
        CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (adj.unit.app (Ind.obj X))
          (Ind.map (adj.counit.app X)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (Ind.obj X)) ∧
      (∀ (X : ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (x y : B) (z : X),
        ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.counit.app X) (show Res.obj (Ind.obj X) from pure X (x * y) z) =
          (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (cap.toLinearMap (pairDI x y)) : A) • z) ∧
      (∀ (T : Finset G), IsTransversal T →
        (∀ g : G,
          cup.toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (basisG g)) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t)) ∧
          cup.toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (basisG g)) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t => pairID (basisG (t⁻¹)) (basisG (t * g)))) ∧
        (∀ (Y : ModuleCat.{max u v} B) (g : G) (z : Y),
          ModuleCat.Hom.hom (adj.unit.app Y) (basisG g • z) =
            Finset.sum T (fun t =>
              pure (Res.obj Y) (basisG (g * t⁻¹)) (basisG t • z)))))
```

## InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits: Induction and restriction merge–split isomorphisms

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Fix a group \(U\). For \(X\le U\), write \(\C[X]\) for its complex group algebra.
If \(\cg{\alpha}{H}=\alpha H\alpha^{-1}\le G\), write
\(\alpha_*:\C[H]\to \C[G]\) for conjugation by \(\alpha\), extended linearly.
This map depends exactly on
\[
 \bar\alpha=\alpha C_U(H),\qquad
 C_U(H)=\{u\in U:uh=hu\text{ for all }h\in H\}.
\]
The centralizer in a strand label is taken for the source of its
embedding.

The up and down strands below denote
\[
 \I_{\co\alpha}^{G,H}={}_{\C[G]}(\C[G])_{\alpha_*,\C[H]},\qquad
 \D_{\co\alpha}^{H,G}={}_{\C[H],\alpha_*}(\C[G])_{\C[G]}.
\]
The actions are \(x\cdot h=x\alpha h\alpha^{-1}\) on \(\I\) and
\(h\cdot x=\alpha h\alpha^{-1}x\) on \(\D\). Tensoring on the right
gives induction and restriction, respectively. The target group
is on the left. Read horizontal composition as tensor product over
the middle group and vertical composition from bottom to top.

For \(\cg{\beta}{L}\le H\) and \(\cg{\alpha}{H}\le G\), the
induction merge is
\[
 \I_{\co\alpha}^{G,H}\otimes_{\C[H]}\I_{\co\beta}^{H,L}
 \ \xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\
 \I_{\overline{\alpha\beta}}^{G,L},
 \qquad x\otimes y\longmapsto x\,\alpha_*(y).
\]
The restriction merge has the reverse order of the two factors,
\[
 \D_{\co\beta}^{L,H}\otimes_{\C[H]}\D_{\co\alpha}^{H,G}
 \ \xrightarrow{\;\sim\;}\
 \D_{\overline{\alpha\beta}}^{L,G},
 \qquad y\otimes x\longmapsto\alpha_*(y)\,x.
\]
The splits are their inverses, \(z\mapsto z\otimes1\) and
\(z\mapsto1\otimes z\), respectively. Reflect the merge diagrams vertically
while keeping each strand type to draw the splits.

```lean
theorem InductionRestrictionMergesAndSplits : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (L H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ l : L, β * (l : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let ab := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let φ := MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom
  let upA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let upB := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
  let downA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let downB := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down b
  let upPair := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex upA.basis upB.basis
  let downPair := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex downB.basis downA.basis
  let upMerge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) a b
  let upSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) a b
  let downMerge := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown (R := Complex) a b
  let downSplit := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown (R := Complex) a b
  (∀ l : L, (ab.toHom l : U) = (α * β) * (l : U) * (α * β)⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ (x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (y : MonoidAlgebra Complex H),
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval upMerge).toLinearMap
      (upPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y)) =
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * φ y) ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval downMerge).toLinearMap
      (downPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff y) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x)) =
      MonoidAlgebra.coeff (φ y * x)) ∧
  (∀ z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval upSplit).toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z) =
      upPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)) ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval downSplit).toLinearMap (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z) =
      downPair (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical upMerge upSplit) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upA upB)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical upSplit upMerge) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ab)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical downMerge downSplit) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downB downA)) ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical downSplit downMerge) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ab))
```

## DiagrammaticFunctorCorrespondence: Correspondence with the diagram-generated functor category

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For fixed endpoints \(K,H\), the objects of \(\mathcal D_U(K,H)\)
are sequences of strands from \(H\) to \(K\), interpreted as tensor
products. When \(K=H\), the empty sequence gives the regular bimodule.
Maps are built from dots, cups, caps, merges, splits, identities,
and the associativity and unit maps for tensor products. We allow
tensor product, composition, and finite \(\C\)-linear combinations of
maps with the same source and target. Equal evaluated maps define
the same morphism. One may also include finite direct sums and
matrices of maps. Section~2 uses the full bimodule
category for arbitrary direct sums.

Eilenberg--Watts identifies \(\C[K]\)-\(\C[H]\) bimodules with equal
scalar actions with \(\C\)-linear, right-exact, coproduct-preserving
functors from \(\C[H]\Mod\) to \(\C[K]\Mod\). Bimodule maps
correspond to natural transformations.

The category \(\mathcal D_U(K,H)\) corresponds to composites of the
given inductions and restrictions. Its transformations are built
from the indicated maps by tensor product, composition, and finite
linear combination. For a transformation between two such tensor
functors, membership is determined by its component at \(\C[H]\),
using the tensor unit identifications. Finite direct sums and
matrices of maps correspond on both sides.

These composite functors are exact and preserve coproducts.
Restriction acts on the same vector spaces, and \(\C[G]\) is free as
a right \(\C[H]\)-module along each embedding. Allowing every bimodule
map would give the full subcategory on these functors.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 1.3, unnumbered, p. 4](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem DiagrammaticFunctorCorrespondence : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U],
  let Alg := fun H : Subgroup U => MonoidAlgebra Complex H
  let Mod := fun H : Subgroup U => ModuleCat.{max u v} (Alg H)
  let Fun := fun K H : Subgroup U => CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod H) (Mod K)
  let Bimod := fun K H : Subgroup U => Rep.{max u v} Complex (Prod K H)
  let V := fun {H : Subgroup U} (X : Mod H) =>
    (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).obj X
  let VMap := fun {H : Subgroup U} {X Y : Mod H} (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) =>
    (Rep.Hom.hom ((Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H)).map f)).toLinearMap
  let regular := fun H : Subgroup U => ModuleCat.of (Alg H) (ULift.{v} (Alg H))
  let left := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) (k : K) => B.ρ (k, 1)
  let right := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) (h : H) => B.ρ (1, h⁻¹)
  let leftAlg := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) (a : Alg K) (b : B) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (fun k : K => left B k b) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff a)
  let rightAlg := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) (b : B) (a : Alg H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (fun h : H => right B h b) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff a)
  let Word := fun K H : Subgroup U => MackeyDiagrams.Word K H
  let wordVec := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) =>
    Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p).carrier Complex
  let lower := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) =>
    (ULift.moduleEquiv : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) (ULift.{v} (wordVec p)) (wordVec p))
  let wordBimod := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) =>
    (Rep.of
      ({ toFun := fun g => (lower p).symm.toLinearMap.comp
            ((MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) g).comp
              (lower p).toLinearMap)
         map_one' := by
           ext x
           simp
         map_mul' := by
           intro g h
           have actMul :
               MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) (g * h) =
                 (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) g).comp
                 (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) h) := by
             apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
             intro i z
             simp [MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act]
           ext x
           simp [actMul] } :
        Representation Complex (Prod K H) (ULift.{v} (wordVec p))) : Bimod K H)
  let wordHom := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p q : Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis q)
  let allowedOrdinary := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rec (motive := fun _ _ _ => Prop)
      (fun _ => True)
      (fun _ => False) (fun _ => False)
      (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ _ => True)
      (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ => True)
      (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True)
      (fun _ _ _ => True) (fun _ _ _ => True)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ => False)
      (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b)
      (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) (fun _ _ a => a) d
  let drawing := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p q : Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q
  let allowed := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : drawing p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.rec (motive := fun _ _ _ => Prop)
      (fun d => allowedOrdinary d)
      (fun _ => True) (fun _ => True)
      (fun vertex => match MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.kind vertex with
        | MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentKind.mergeUp | MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentKind.splitUp
        | MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentKind.mergeDown | MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentKind.splitDown => True
        | _ => False)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False) (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False) (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False) (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False) (fun _ => False)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => False)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => False) (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ => False)
      (fun _ _ _ _ _ => False)
      (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) (fun _ _ a => a)
      (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) (fun _ _ a b => a ∧ b) d
  let drawingEval := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : drawing p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret d)
  let good := fun (K H : Subgroup U) (F : Fun K H) =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear Complex F ∧
    CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits F ∧
    ∀ I : Type (max u v),
      CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) F
  let goodFun := fun K H => CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (good K H)
  let Ind := fun {H G : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G) =>
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := H))
        (Rep.indFunctor Complex a.toHom))
      (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := G)) : Fun G H)
  let Res := fun {H G : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G) =>
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom).toRingHom :
      Fun H G)
  let conjugateMap := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (f : wordHom p q) =>
    (lower q).symm.toLinearMap.comp (f.toLinearMap.comp (lower p).toLinearMap)
  let wordMap := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (f : wordHom p q) =>
    (Rep.ofHom
      { toLinearMap := conjugateMap f
        isIntertwining' := by
          intro g
          apply LinearMap.ext
          intro x
          simpa [wordBimod, conjugateMap] using
            congrArg (fun y => (lower q).symm y)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.commutes f g (lower p x)) } :
      Quiver.Hom (wordBimod p) (wordBimod q))
  let Balanced := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) (X : Mod H) (Y : Mod K)
      (t : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B
        (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (V X) (V Y))) =>
    (∀ (a : Alg K) (b : B) (x : V X),
      let y : Y := t b x
      t (leftAlg B a b) x = a • y) ∧
    (∀ (a : Alg H) (b : B) (x : V X),
      let x' : X := x
      t (rightAlg B b a) x = t b (a • x'))
  let gen := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} =>
    {d : drawing p q // allowed d}
  let evalSetoid := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p q : Word K H) =>
    Setoid.ker (fun d : @gen K H p q => drawingEval d.val)
  let genHom := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p q : Word K H) => Quotient (evalSetoid p q)
  (∀ (H G : Subgroup U) (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
    letI : Module (MulOpposite (Alg H)) (Alg G) :=
      Module.compHom (Alg G) (RingHom.op
        (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex a.toHom).toRingHom)
    Module.Free (MulOpposite (Alg H)) (Alg G)) ∧
  ∃ E : ∀ K H : Subgroup U, CategoryTheory.Equivalence (Bimod K H) (goodFun K H),
  let transport := fun K H : Subgroup U =>
    CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (E K H).functor (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.ι (good K H))
  let tensor := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) => (transport K H).obj B
  let T := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K H) => tensor (wordBimod p)
  let liftMap := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (f : wordHom p q) =>
    (transport K H).map (wordMap f)
  let diagramMap := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H} (d : drawing p q) =>
    liftMap (drawingEval d)
  ∃ (pure : ∀ {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H) (X : Mod H),
        LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (V X) (V ((tensor B).obj X))))
    (unit : ∀ {K H : Subgroup U} (B : Bimod K H),
        LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) (V ((tensor B).obj (regular H))) B)
    (compIso : ∀ {K L H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K L) (q : Word L H),
        CategoryTheory.Iso (T (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor p q)) (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (T q) (T p)))
    (emptyIso : ∀ H : Subgroup U,
        CategoryTheory.Iso (T (MackeyDiagrams.Word.empty H)) (CategoryTheory.Functor.id (Mod H))),
  let onRegular := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
      (η : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (T p) (T q)) =>
    (unit (wordBimod q)).toLinearMap.comp
      ((VMap (η.app (regular H))).comp (unit (wordBimod p)).symm.toLinearMap)
  let inDiagram := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : Word K H}
      (η : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (T p) (T q)) =>
    ∃ d : @gen K H p q, onRegular η = conjugateMap (drawingEval d.val)
  let pair := fun {K L H : Subgroup U} (p : Word K L) (q : Word L H)
      (b : wordBimod p) (c : wordBimod q) =>
    (lower (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor p q)).symm
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis q) (lower p b) (lower q c))
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (B : Bimod K H) (z : Complex) (b : B),
    leftAlg B (algebraMap Complex (Alg K) z) b = z • b ∧
    rightAlg B b (algebraMap Complex (Alg H) z) = z • b) ∧
  (∀ K H : Subgroup U, CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear Complex (transport K H)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (I : Type (max u v)),
    CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.Discrete I) (transport K H)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (B : Bimod K H) (X : Mod H),
    Balanced B X ((tensor B).obj X) (pure B X) ∧
    ∀ (Y : Mod K) (t : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) B
        (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (V X) (V Y))),
      Balanced B X Y t →
      ∃! f : ModuleCat.Hom ((tensor B).obj X) Y,
        ∀ (b : B) (x : V X), VMap f (pure B X b x) = t b x) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (B : Bimod K H) (X Y : Mod H)
      (f : ModuleCat.Hom X Y) (b : B) (x : V X),
    VMap ((tensor B).map f) (pure B X b x) = pure B Y b (VMap f x)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (B C : Bimod K H) (f : Quiver.Hom B C)
      (X : Mod H) (b : B) (x : V X),
    VMap (((transport K H).map f).app X) (pure B X b x) =
      pure C X ((Rep.Hom.hom f).toLinearMap b) x) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (B : Bimod K H) (b : B) (x : V (regular H)),
    unit B (pure B (regular H) b x) = rightAlg B b (ULift.down x)) ∧
  (∀ (H : Subgroup U) (X : Mod H) (b : wordBimod (MackeyDiagrams.Word.empty H)) (x : V X),
    let p := MackeyDiagrams.Word.empty H
    let x' : X := x
    VMap ((emptyIso H).hom.app X) (pure (wordBimod p) X b x) =
      (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (lower p b) : Alg H) • x') ∧
  (∀ (H G : Subgroup U) (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
    Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (T (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)) (Ind a)) ∧
    Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (T (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)) (Res a))) ∧
  (∀ (K L H : Subgroup U) (p : Word K L) (q : Word L H) (X : Mod H)
      (b : wordBimod p) (c : wordBimod q) (x : V X),
    VMap ((compIso p q).hom.app X)
        (pure (wordBimod (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor p q)) X (pair p q b c) x) =
      pure (wordBimod p) ((T q).obj X) b (pure (wordBimod q) X c x)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (p : Word K H), CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits (T p)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (p q : Word K H),
    Function.Bijective (@liftMap K H p q) ∧
    (∀ f : wordHom p q, onRegular (liftMap f) = conjugateMap f) ∧
    ∃ e : Equiv (genHom p q) {η : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (T p) (T q) // inDiagram η},
      ∀ d : @gen K H p q,
        (e (Quotient.mk (evalSetoid p q) d)).val = diagramMap d.val) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (p : Word K H),
    diagramMap (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id (T p)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (p q r : Word K H)
      (d : drawing p q) (e : drawing q r),
    diagramMap (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical d e) =
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (diagramMap d) (diagramMap e)) ∧
  (∀ (K H : Subgroup U) (p q : Word K H) (d e : drawing p q) (z : Complex),
    diagramMap (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero p q)) = 0 ∧
    diagramMap (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add d e) = diagramMap d + diagramMap e ∧
    diagramMap (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale z d) = z • diagramMap d) ∧
  (∀ (K L H : Subgroup U) (p p' : Word K L) (q q' : Word L H)
      (d : drawing p p') (e : drawing q q'),
    CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
        (diagramMap (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal d e)) (compIso p' q').hom =
      CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (compIso p q).hom
        (CategoryTheory.NatTrans.hcomp (diagramMap e) (diagramMap d))) ∧
  (∀ K H : Subgroup U,
    letI : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts (Bimod K H) :=
      CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts
    letI : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts (Fun K H) :=
      CategoryTheory.Limits.HasFiniteBiproducts.of_hasFiniteProducts
    let bimodSum := fun {n : Nat} (p : Fin n → Word K H) =>
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct (fun i => wordBimod (p i))
    let funSum := fun {n : Nat} (p : Fin n → Word K H) =>
      CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct (fun i => T (p i))
    ∃ sumIso : ∀ {n : Nat} (p : Fin n → Word K H),
        CategoryTheory.Iso (tensor (bimodSum p)) (funSum p),
      ∀ {m n : Nat} (p : Fin m → Word K H) (q : Fin n → Word K H),
        (∀ f : ∀ i j, wordHom (p i) (q j),
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp
            ((transport K H).map (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.matrix
              (fun i j => wordMap (f i j)))) (sumIso q).hom =
          CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (sumIso p).hom
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.matrix (fun i j => liftMap (f i j)))) ∧
        (∀ η : CategoryTheory.NatTrans (funSum p) (funSum q),
          (∀ i j, inDiagram (CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.components
            (f := fun i => T (p i)) (g := fun j => T (q j)) η i j)) ↔
          ∃ d : ∀ i j, @gen K H (p i) (q j),
            η = CategoryTheory.Limits.biproduct.matrix (fun i j => diagramMap (d i j).val)))
```

## SurvivingCosetRepresentative: The surviving coset representative

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

For each \(j\), choose right coset representatives \(h_u\) indexed by
\(U_j\), so that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:H-cosets}
 H=\bigsqcup_{u\in U_j}(\cg{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}{L_j})h_u .
\end{equation}
For \(g\in G\), put
\[
 U'_j(g)=\{u\in U_j:
   \alpha^{-1}g\beta h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\alpha\in K\}.
\]

The set \(U'_j(g)\) has exactly one element if \(g\in j\) and is
empty otherwise.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Lemma 2.3 [lem:first-filter]; (2.4) [eq:H-cosets], p. 6](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Lemma 2.3 (The surviving coset representative), p. 6, with the right coset convention in (2.4) and the data in (2.1)–(2.2). The published PDF matches the project copy. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and the task context supplied no correction for this lemma. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem SurvivingCosetRepresentative : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  Kα ≤ G → Hβ ≤ G →
  let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
  let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let L := fun j : J =>
      Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
    let C := fun j : J =>
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
    ∀ (I : J → Type*) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
      (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! u : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
      (j : J) (g : G),
      let surviving : Set (I j) :=
        {u | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
      (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → ∃! u : I j, u ∈ surviving) ∧
        (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → surviving = ∅)
```

## MixedCrossingFiberMaps: Multiplication and projection as a basis map and its finite fiber sum

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Use \(J,\sigma_j,L_j,M,M_j\) from Section~2.2.
The two boundary strands of \(M\) point in opposite directions,
with \(G\) between them. To allow a different middle group, take
\(\cg{a}{L}\le K\), \(\cg{b}{L}\le H\) and
\(s=\alpha a(\beta b)^{-1}\in G\). Use \(s,s^{-1}\) as the two
crossing labels and put
\[
 M_L=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L]}\C[H],\qquad
 L_s=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\cap(\cg{s\beta}{H}),\qquad
 n=[L_s:\cg{\alpha a}{L}].
\]
The tensor product has basis \(K\times_L H\), the classes \([k,h]\)
of pairs under \([ka\ell a^{-1},h]=[k,b\ell b^{-1}h]\),
\(\ell\in L\). The relation identifies exactly the pairs equated
by balancing the tensor product.

Suppose \(n<\infty\). Let \(p_L:M\to M_L\) and \(\iota_L:M_L\to M\)
be the two crossings. Write
\(q([k,h])=\alpha k\alpha^{-1}s\beta h\beta^{-1}\).
If \(s\in j\), then
\[
 \iota_L\circ p_L=nP_j,\qquad
 p_L\circ\iota_L(z)=\sum_{q(w)=q(z)}w \quad(z\in K\times_L H),
\]
where \(P_j\) fixes the basis elements in \(j\) and sends the others
to zero. The second composite is the identity exactly when \(n=1\).
For \(n>1\), no scalar multiple of it is the identity.

Since \(s\beta b=\alpha a\), conjugation by \(s\) identifies the
two images of \(L\). Thus \(\cg{\alpha a}{L}\le L_s\) and \(q\)
respects the relation on pairs. The dot \(s\) and multiplication
cap give \(\iota_L([k,h])=q([k,h])\).

Choose \(T\) with \(H=\bigsqcup_{t\in T}(\cg{b}{L})t\).
The reverse cup supplies \(t^{-1}\otimes t\), the dot multiplies
the first factor by \(s^{-1}\), and the trace \(E_\alpha\) gives
\[
 p_L(g)=\sum_{t\in T}
 E_\alpha\bigl(g\beta t^{-1}\beta^{-1}s^{-1}\bigr)\otimes t .
\]
Each class has a unique representative \((k,t)\) with \(t\in T\).
The trace returns \(k\) exactly when \(q([k,t])=g\).
Hence \(p_L(g)=\sum_{q(w)=g}w\).

The action of \(K\times H\) is
\((k_0,h_0)[k,h]=[k_0k,hh_0^{-1}]\) and
\((k_0,h_0)g=\alpha k_0\alpha^{-1}g\beta h_0^{-1}\beta^{-1}\).
The balanced set is transitive and \(q\) is equivariant with image
\(j\). Sending \((k_0,h_0)\) to \(\alpha k_0\alpha^{-1}\)
identifies the stabilizers of \(s\) and \([1,1]\) with \(L_s\)
and \(\cg{\alpha a}{L}\), respectively. Their index gives \(n\)
preimages for each \(g\in j\). The sums are therefore finite
and define a bimodule map. Applying \(q\) to the sum gives \(ng\)
on \(j\). In the other order the result sums all preimages of
\(q(z)\). If \(n>1\), this includes a basis element besides \(z\).

The reverse cup is a map when \([H:\cg{b}{L}]<\infty\). At infinite
index the formula for \(p_L\) sums only the terms that survive the trace.
It still defines a map for finite \(n\). For infinite \(n\), the sum
on \(g\in j\) has infinite support.

```lean
theorem MixedCrossingFiberMaps : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
    (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
  let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
  let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (eα.comp ea) (eβ.comp eb) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs
  let s := d.element
  let A := eα.toHom.range
  let B := eβ.toHom.range
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B s
    let orbit := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    let Ls := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H
    let Limage := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (α * a))) L
    let finiteIndex := Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex Limage Ls
    let n := Subgroup.relIndex Limage Ls
    let X := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ea
    let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb
    let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
    let q := fun w : (X.tensor Y).carrier =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis w)
    let fiber := fun g : G => {w | q w = g}
    let ι := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d
    let finiteFibers := ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z}
    let traceArg := fun (g : G) (t : H) => g * (eβ.toHom t)⁻¹ * s⁻¹
    let survives := fun (T : Set H) (g : G) => {t | t ∈ T ∧ traceArg g t ∈ A}
    let rightTransversal := fun T : Set H =>
      ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H, t ∈ T ∧ h * t⁻¹ ∈ eb.toHom.range
    Limage ≤ Ls ∧
    (∀ (k : K) (h : H), q (X.pair Y k h) = eα.toHom k * s * eβ.toHom h) ∧
    (∀ w : (X.tensor Y).carrier,
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ι).toLinearMap (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q w)) 1) ∧
    Set.range q = orbit ∧
    (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → finiteIndex → Nat.card (fiber g) = n) ∧
    (finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex) ∧
    (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → ¬ finiteIndex → Set.Infinite (fiber g)) ∧
    ((∀ h : H, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCapBasis eb w = h}) ↔
      Subgroup.FiniteIndex eb.toHom.range) ∧
    (∀ (T : Set H), rightTransversal T → ∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit → ¬ finiteIndex →
      Set.Infinite (survives T g)) ∧
    (∀ hf : finiteFibers,
      let p := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) eα eβ ea eb d hf
      let evalOnBasis := fun g : G =>
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval p).toLinearMap
          (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1)
      (∀ g : G, evalOnBasis g = Finset.sum
        (hf (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)).toFinset
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Set H), rightTransversal T → ∀ g : G,
        ∃ ht : Set.Finite (survives T g), evalOnBasis g = Finset.sum ht.toFinset
          (fun t => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex X Y
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex eα (traceArg g t))
            (Finsupp.single t 1))))
```

## MackeyInclusionAndProjectionCrossings: Mackey inclusion and finite-support projection crossings

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

For each \(j\), choose right coset representatives \(h_u\) indexed by
\(U_j\), so that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:H-cosets}
 H=\bigsqcup_{u\in U_j}(\cg{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}{L_j})h_u .
\end{equation}
For \(g\in G\), put
\[
 U'_j(g)=\{u\in U_j:
   \alpha^{-1}g\beta h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\alpha\in K\}.
\]

The dot \(\sigma_j\) and the multiplication cap give
\[
 \iota_j(k\otimes h)=\alpha k\alpha^{-1}\sigma_j\beta h\beta^{-1}.
\]
This formula is balanced because
\(\alpha_*(\lambda_j(\ell))=\ell\) and
\(\sigma_j\beta_*(\mu_j(\ell))=\ell\sigma_j\) for \(\ell\in L_j\).
It commutes with the left \(K\)-action and the right \(H\)-action.

For the other crossing, the reverse cup supplies the coset terms,
the dot inserts \(\sigma_j^{-1}\), and the trace
\(E_\alpha:\C[G]\to\C[K]\) keeps only the indices in \(U'_j(g)\). Thus
\[
 p_j(g)=\sum_{u\in U'_j(g)}
   \alpha^{-1}g\beta h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\alpha\otimes h_u .
\]
Extend this formula linearly. If the coset index in (2.4)
is infinite, apply the trace term by term. Lemma~2.3
gives at most one term on each basis element.

```lean
theorem MackeyInclusionAndProjectionCrossings : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let C := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
      ∀ (I : J → Type v) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
        (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! i : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
        (j : J),
        let s := σ j
        let l := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
        let r := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r) :=
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let kg := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
        let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
        let kl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l
        let lh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r
        let leftMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (a.comp l)
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
        let Mj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kl lh
        let traceArg := fun (g : G) (i : I j) =>
          α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α
        let surviving := fun g : G => {i : I j | traceArg g i ∈ K}
        let inclusionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (a.comp l) (b.comp r)) := [(1, d)]
        let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r inclusionLabel
        let expandedInclusion : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a l))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh)))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate kg leftMiddle lh))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d 1))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp b r)))))
        let tracedTerm := fun (z : M.basis.carrier) (i : I j) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.term
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b l r d)
            z (MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.unitPair r (hRep j i))
        ∃ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite
            {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z})
          (hs : ∀ g, Set.Finite (surviving g)),
          let projectionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :=
            [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b l r projectionLabel
          let expandedProjection : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection a b l r projectionLabel
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.junction MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.junction
          let crossings : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι
          let expandedCrossings : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical expandedProjection expandedInclusion
          (∀ z : M.basis.carrier, Function.support (tracedTerm z) =
            surviving (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z)) ∧
          (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
            (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ι)).toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair kl.basis lh.basis k h) 1) =
            Finsupp.single
              (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b (a.toHom k * s * b.toHom h)) 1) ∧
          (∀ g : G, (hs g).toFinset.card ≤ 1 ∧
            (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret p)).toLinearMap
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g) 1) =
            Finset.sum (hs g).toFinset.attach (fun i =>
              Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair kl.basis lh.basis
                ⟨traceArg g i.val, (Set.Finite.mem_toFinset (hs g)).mp i.property⟩
                (hRep j i.val)) 1)) ∧
          (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ι) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret expandedInclusion)) ∧
          (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret crossings) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret expandedCrossings)) ∧
          (∀ hi : Subgroup.FiniteIndex r.toHom.range,
            let finiteProjection : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
              MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown b r hi)))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex)
                        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse d) 1))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate kg leftMiddle lh))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a l))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh)))))
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret crossings) =
              MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical finiteProjection expandedInclusion)))
```

## MackeyIdentityDiagram: Pointwise finite Mackey identity diagram

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

There are bimodule maps \(p_j:M\to M_j\) and \(\iota_j:M_j\to M\) such that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:split}
   \id_M=\sum_{j\in J}\iota_j\circ p_j,\qquad
   p_j\circ\iota_i=
   \begin{cases}
     \id_{M_i},&i=j,\\
     0,&i\ne j.
   \end{cases}
\end{equation}

By Lemma~2.3, this fixes \(g\) if \(g\in j\)
and sends it to zero otherwise. Each \(g\in G\) lies in exactly one
double coset. Summing over \(j\) gives \(\id_M\), and the sum is
finite on each input.

The straight strands are a horizontal identity pair and each summand is the typed projection followed by the typed inclusion at the same boundary. The sum ranges over the support on each input and permits arbitrary subgroup indices.
```lean
theorem MackeyIdentityDiagram : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let d := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (r j)) from
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      ∃ hf : ∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j) w = z},
        let inclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) (d j)
        let projection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection a b (l j) (r j) (d j) (hf j)
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up)
        let crossed : J → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (projection j) (inclusion j)
        let term := fun (x : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) (j : J) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (crossed j)) x
        (∃ finite : ∀ x, Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)),
          let sum : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex M M J :=
            ⟨fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (crossed j), finite⟩
          ∀ x, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight) x =
            sum.evalAt x) ∧
        (∀ j : J,
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion j) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (Mj j))) ∧
        (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion i) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j)))
```

## MackeySummandProjection: Composite on a double-coset summand

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

For each \(j\), choose right coset representatives \(h_u\) indexed by
\(U_j\), so that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:H-cosets}
 H=\bigsqcup_{u\in U_j}(\cg{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}{L_j})h_u .
\end{equation}
For \(g\in G\), put
\[
 U'_j(g)=\{u\in U_j:
   \alpha^{-1}g\beta h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\alpha\in K\}.
\]

The dot \(\sigma_j\) and the multiplication cap give
\[
 \iota_j(k\otimes h)=\alpha k\alpha^{-1}\sigma_j\beta h\beta^{-1}.
\]
This formula is balanced because
\(\alpha_*(\lambda_j(\ell))=\ell\) and
\(\sigma_j\beta_*(\mu_j(\ell))=\ell\sigma_j\) for \(\ell\in L_j\).
It commutes with the left \(K\)-action and the right \(H\)-action.

For the other crossing, the reverse cup supplies the coset terms,
the dot inserts \(\sigma_j^{-1}\), and the trace
\(E_\alpha:\C[G]\to\C[K]\) keeps only the indices in \(U'_j(g)\). Thus
\[
 p_j(g)=\sum_{u\in U'_j(g)}
   \alpha^{-1}g\beta h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\alpha\otimes h_u .
\]
Extend this formula linearly. If the coset index in (2.4)
is infinite, apply the trace term by term. Lemma~2.3
gives at most one term on each basis element.

Apply \(\iota_j\) to each surviving term. The dot \(\sigma_j\)
cancels \(\sigma_j^{-1}\), and \(h_u^{-1}h_u=1\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:first-chain}
 (\iota_j\circ p_j)(g)=|U'_j(g)|\,g .
\end{equation}
By Lemma~2.3, this fixes \(g\) if \(g\in j\)
and sends it to zero otherwise. Each \(g\in G\) lies in exactly one
double coset. Summing over \(j\) gives \(\id_M\), and the sum is
finite on each input.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 2.2, (2.5) [eq:first-chain] in the proof of Theorem 2.2, pp. 6–7](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem MackeySummandProjection : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let C := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
      ∀ (I : J → Type v) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
        (_ : ∀ (j : J) (h : H), ∃! i : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j)
        (j : J),
        let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
          (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
        let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
          (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
        let s := σ j
        let l := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
        let r := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change ((s : U) * β) * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b r) :=
          ⟨s, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
              (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let kg := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
        let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
        let kl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l
        let lh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r
        let middle := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l)
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
        let Mj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kl lh
        let surviving := fun (g : G) =>
          {i : I j | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j i : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
        ∃ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite
            {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b l r d w = z})
          (hs : ∀ g : G, Set.Finite (surviving g)),
          let projectionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b l r) :=
            [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
          let inclusionLabel : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b r)) :=
            [(1, d)]
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b l r projectionLabel
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b l r inclusionLabel
          let expandedProjection : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M Mj :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection a b l r projectionLabel
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.junction MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.junction
          let expandedInclusion : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex Mj M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                  (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a l))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh)))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate kg middle lh))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single d 1))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp b r)))))
          let composite : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι
          let expandedComposite : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical expandedProjection expandedInclusion
          let compositeEval := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret composite)
          compositeEval = MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret expandedComposite) ∧
          (∀ g : G,
            let z := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b g
            let image := compositeEval.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex))
            image = Finsupp.single z (Finset.card (Set.Finite.toFinset (hs g)) : Complex) ∧
              (DoubleCoset.mk A B g = j → image = Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) ∧
              (DoubleCoset.mk A B g ≠ j → image = 0))
```

## MackeyOrthogonalityDiagram: Mackey orthogonality and expanded reverse composite

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

There are bimodule maps \(p_j:M\to M_j\) and \(\iota_j:M_j\to M\) such that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:split}
   \id_M=\sum_{j\in J}\iota_j\circ p_j,\qquad
   p_j\circ\iota_i=
   \begin{cases}
     \id_{M_i},&i=j,\\
     0,&i\ne j.
   \end{cases}
\end{equation}

For each \(j\), choose right coset representatives \(h_u\) indexed by
\(U_j\), so that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:H-cosets}
 H=\bigsqcup_{u\in U_j}(\cg{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}{L_j})h_u .
\end{equation}
For \(g\in G\), put
\[
 U'_j(g)=\{u\in U_j:
   \alpha^{-1}g\beta h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\alpha\in K\}.
\]

In the reverse order, let \(g=\iota_i(k\otimes h)\). Then \(g\in i\),
so \(p_j(g)=0\) for \(i\ne j\). For \(i=j\) let \(u\) be the unique
element of \(U'_j(g)\). The lemma gives
\(\ell=\sigma_j\beta h h_u^{-1}\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\in L_j\).
Substituting into \(p_j\) and using the tensor relation gives
\begin{equation}\label{eq:second-chain}
 (p_j\circ\iota_j)(k\otimes h)
   =k\lambda_j(\ell)\otimes h_u
   =k\otimes\mu_j(\ell)h_u
   =k\otimes h .
\end{equation}
