Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 2.2, Theorem 2.2, equations (2.3) and (2.6), and the reverse-composite diagram below (2.6) on p. 7. The published PDF is byte-identical to the project copy. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash, so no correction for this endpoint could be verified. The 27 November 2026 owner clarification (request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the representation of the two fixed marks as coefficient-one labels in the shared finite complex dot language. It leaves the article statement unchanged. The expanded inclusion uses the two drawn trivalent vertices. The expanded projection records both junctions in the shared pointwise finite projection frame and uses the inverse label in its scoped evaluation. The ordinary trivalent presentation with a reverse cup retains the finite-index hypothesis. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem MackeyOrthogonalityDiagram : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let C := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))) (L j)
      ∀ (I : J → Type v) (hRep : ∀ j : J, I j → H)
        (_rightTransversal : ∀ (j : J) (h : H),
          ∃! u : I j, (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ ∈ C j),
        let l := fun j : J =>
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
            (by
              intro ℓ
              obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
              change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
              change k ∈ K at hk
              rw [← h]
              convert hk using 1
              group)
        let r := fun j : J =>
          let s := σ j
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
            (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
            (by
              intro ℓ
              obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
              change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
              change h ∈ H at hh
              rw [← e]
              convert hh using 1
              group)
        let d := fun j : J =>
          let s := σ j
          show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (r j)) from
            ⟨s, by
              intro ℓ
              apply Subtype.ext
              change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (s : U) =
                (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                  (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
              group⟩
        let kg := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
        let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
        let kl := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)
        let lh := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j)
        let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
        let Mj := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (kl j) (lh j)
        let elementaryTensor := fun (j : J) (k : K) (h : H) =>
          Finsupp.single
            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (kl j))
              (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (lh j)) k h) (1 : Complex)
        let surviving := fun (j : J) (g : G) =>
          {u : I j | α⁻¹ * (g : U) * β * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹ * α ∈ K}
        let leftMiddle := fun j : J =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
        let expandedInclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) M :=
          fun j =>
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                  (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a (l j)))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (lh j))))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate kg (leftMiddle j) (lh j)))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex) (Finsupp.single (d j) 1))
                      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (lh j)))))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp b (r j))))))
        let finiteProjection := fun (j : J)
            (hi : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (r j)).range) =>
          show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) from
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                  (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown b (r j) hi)))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (R := Complex)
                      (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse (d j)) 1))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (lh j)))))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate kg (leftMiddle j) (lh j)))
                  (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
                      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a (l j)))
                    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (lh j))))))
        let cupContribution := fun (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier)
            (u : I j) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.term
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjectionTail (R := Complex) a b (l j) (r j) (d j))
            z (MackeyDiagrams.RightCupTrace.unitPair (r j) (hRep j u))
        ∃ (hf : ∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
            Set.Finite {w |
              MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j) w = z})
          (transversalFinite : ∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
            Set.Finite (Function.support (cupContribution j z))),
          let inclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) M :=
            fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) [(1, d j)]
          let projectionLabel : ∀ j : J, List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b (l j) (r j)) :=
            fun j => [(1, ⟨d j, hf j⟩)]
          let projection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) :=
            fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b (l j) (r j) (projectionLabel j)
          let expandedProjection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) :=
            fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection a b (l j) (r j) (projectionLabel j)
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.junction MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.junction
          let reverseCrossings := fun i j : J =>
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (inclusion i) (projection j)
          let expandedReverse := fun i j : J =>
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (expandedInclusion i) (expandedProjection j)
          let evaluate := fun {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
              (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) =>
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret diagram)
          let term := fun (x : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) (j : J) =>
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
              (evaluate (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (projection j) (inclusion j))) x
          let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id M)
          (∃ finite : ∀ x, Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)),
            ∀ x, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate straight) x =
              Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finite x)) (term x)) ∧
          (∀ j : J, evaluate (reverseCrossings j j) =
            evaluate (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (Mj j)))) ∧
          (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
            evaluate (reverseCrossings i j) =
              evaluate (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j)))) ∧
          (∀ (i j : J), evaluate (reverseCrossings i j) = evaluate (expandedReverse i j)) ∧
          (∀ j : J, evaluate (projection j) = evaluate (expandedProjection j)) ∧
          (∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
            Function.support (cupContribution j z) =
              surviving j (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z) ∧
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate (expandedProjection j))
                (Finsupp.single z 1) =
              Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (transversalFinite j z)) (cupContribution j z)) ∧
          (∀ (i j : J)
              (hi : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (r j)).range),
            evaluate (reverseCrossings i j) = evaluate
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (expandedInclusion i) (finiteProjection j hi))) ∧
          (∀ (j : J) (k : K) (h : H),
            let s := σ j
            let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k * s *
              MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b h
            ∃ u : I j,
              let ellValue := (s : U) * β * (h : U) * (hRep j u : U)⁻¹ * β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹
              u ∈ surviving j g ∧ (∀ t ∈ surviving j g, t = u) ∧
              ∃ hℓ : ellValue ∈ L j,
                let ℓ : L j := ⟨ellValue, hℓ⟩
                let image := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
                  (evaluate (reverseCrossings j j)) (elementaryTensor j k h)
                image = elementaryTensor j (k * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (l j) ℓ) (hRep j u) ∧
                elementaryTensor j (k * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (l j) ℓ) (hRep j u) =
                  elementaryTensor j k (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (r j) ℓ * hRep j u) ∧
                elementaryTensor j k (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (r j) ℓ * hRep j u) = elementaryTensor j k h)
```

## GeneralizedMackeyDecomposition: Generalized Mackey decomposition

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

There are bimodule maps \(p_j:M\to M_j\) and \(\iota_j:M_j\to M\) such that
\begin{equation}\label{eq:split}
   \id_M=\sum_{j\in J}\iota_j\circ p_j,\qquad
   p_j\circ\iota_i=
   \begin{cases}
     \id_{M_i},&i=j,\\
     0,&i\ne j.
   \end{cases}
\end{equation}
The sum is pointwise finite and gives
\[
 M\cong\bigoplus_{j\in J}M_j,\qquad
 \Res_{\alpha_*}\,\Ind_{\beta_*}
   \cong\bigoplus_{j\in J}\Ind_{\lambda_j}\,\Res_{\mu_j}.
\]

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 2.2 [thm:mackey]; (2.1) [eq:conj-cosets], (2.2) [eq:alt-L], (2.3) [eq:split], p. 5](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 both with and without a trailing slash. No correction for Theorem 2.2 was available. The double-coset quotient and a section of its quotient map encode the chosen representatives. The conjugation embeddings label the typed boundary words under the project's centralizer-coset convention. The projection and inclusion are witnessed by typed diagrams and the splitting equations compare their evaluated bimodule maps. The bimodule isomorphism uses the dependent finitely supported direct sum, with the projections as its coordinates. The functor isomorphism uses the coproduct in the category of functors between the group-algebra module categories. The type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem GeneralizedMackeyDecomposition : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let Kα := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K
  let Hβ := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj β)) H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J =>
        Kα ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((σ j : U) * β))) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at h
            change k ∈ K at hk
            rw [← h]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        let s := σ j
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, e⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at e
            change h ∈ H at hh
            rw [← e]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      let W := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M
      let Wj := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (Mj j)
      let V := Finsupp W.carrier Complex
      let Vj := fun j : J => Finsupp (Wj j).carrier Complex
      let groupAlgebra := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
      let coordinates : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) V groupAlgebra :=
        LinearEquiv.trans
          (Finsupp.domLCongr (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv a b))
          (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm
      let groupAlgebraAction := fun (g : K × H) (x : groupAlgebra) =>
        MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g.1) * x *
          MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b g.2)⁻¹)
      let Mod := fun S : Subgroup U => ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
      let Res := fun {S T : Subgroup U} (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T) =>
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)).toRingHom :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod T) (Mod S))
      let Ind := fun {S T : Subgroup U} (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T) =>
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
          (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
            (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
            (Rep.indFunctor Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)))
          (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))
      let summand := fun j : J => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (r j)) (Ind (l j))
      (∀ (g : K × H) (x : V),
        coordinates (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex W g x) =
          groupAlgebraAction g (coordinates x)) ∧
      ∃ (projection : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (Mj j))
        (inclusion : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (Mj j) M),
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up)
        let term := fun (x : V) (j : J) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (projection j) (inclusion j))) x
        (∃ finite : ∀ x : V, Set.Finite (Function.support (term x)),
          ∀ x : V, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight) x =
            Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finite x)) (term x)) ∧
        (∀ j : J,
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion j) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (Mj j))) ∧
        (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (inclusion i) (projection j)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j))) ∧
        (∃ e : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) groupAlgebra (DFinsupp Vj),
          (∀ (x : V) (j : J),
            e (coordinates x) j = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (projection j)) x) ∧
          (∀ (g : K × H) (x : groupAlgebra) (j : J),
            e (groupAlgebraAction g x) j =
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex (Wj j) g (e x j))) ∧
        Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind b) (Res a))
          (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj summand))
```

## OrdinaryMackeyDecomposition: Ordinary Mackey decomposition [3]

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H\le G\) be subgroups with their given inclusions. Set
\(I=K\backslash G/H\), the set of double cosets
\(KgH=\{kgh:k\in K,\ h\in H\}\) for \(g\in G\).
Choose an indexed family \((\sigma_i)_{i\in I}\) in \(G\) with
\(\sigma_i\in i\) for each \(i\). Thus \(i=K\sigma_i H\) and
\[
 G=\bigsqcup_{i\in I}K\sigma_i H .
\]
For each \(i\in I\), set \(L_i=K\cap\sigma_i H\sigma_i^{-1}\).
Use the inclusion \(L_i\hookrightarrow K\) and the embedding
\(\mu_i:L_i\hookrightarrow H\) given by \(\ell\mapsto\sigma_i^{-1}\ell\sigma_i\).
Then there is a natural isomorphism
\[
 \Res_K^G\,\Ind_H^G
    \ \cong\ \bigoplus_{i\in I}\Ind_{L_i}^K\,\Res_{\mu_i}.
\]
At the bimodule level the map from the \(i\)-th summand
\(\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_i]}\C[H]\) to \(\C[G]\) takes
\(k\otimes h\) to \(k\sigma_i h\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 2.1 [thm:ordinary-mackey], p. 5](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 2.1 [thm:ordinary-mackey], p. 5. The published PDF matches the project copy, and the theorem agrees with the project TeX. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction for Theorem 2.1 was available. The double-coset quotient and its chosen section encode the disjoint partition for arbitrary groups. The coproduct is taken in the functor category over complex group-algebra modules. Mathlib induction uses a coinvariant model in which the ordinary first tensor factor is represented by its inverse. At the regular module, the comparison with the ambient group algebra respects the right action, and the inverse natural isomorphism sends each summand pure tensor to the stated product. The type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem OrdinaryMackeyDecomposition : ∀ {G : Type u} [Group G] (K H : Subgroup G),
  let I := DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : I → G) (_ : ∀ i : I, DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i) = i),
    let L := fun i : I => K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i))) H
    let incLK := fun i : I =>
      Subgroup.inclusion (show L i ≤ K from inf_le_left)
    let μ := fun i : I =>
      MonoidHom.codRestrict
        (MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (σ i)⁻¹)) (Subgroup.subtype (L i)))
        H (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨h, hh, he⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change σ i * h * (σ i)⁻¹ = (ℓ : G) at he
          change h ∈ H at hh
          change (σ i)⁻¹ * (ℓ : G) * ((σ i)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
          rw [← he]
          convert hh using 1
          group)
    let Mod := fun A : Type u => fun [Group A] => ModuleCat.{max u v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A)
    let Res := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B) =>
      (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
        CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod B) (Mod A))
    let Ind := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B) =>
      (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
          (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := A))
          (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
        (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := B)) :
          CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod A) (Mod B))
    let F := CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind (Subgroup.subtype H)) (Res (Subgroup.subtype K))
    let S := fun i : I => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (μ i)) (Ind (incLK i))
    let regular := fun (A : Type u) [Group A] =>
      ModuleCat.of (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (ULift.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex A))
    let regularH := regular H
    let regularG := regular G
    let rightMulH := fun a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H =>
      (ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{v, u} (MonoidAlgebra Complex H)).map
        (ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.mulRight (MonoidAlgebra Complex H) a))
    let tmul := fun {A B : Type u} [Group A] [Group B] (f : A →* B)
        (M : Mod A) (b : B) (m : ↥M) =>
      let N := (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := A)).obj M
      let x : ↥N := (RestrictScalars.addEquiv Complex (MonoidAlgebra Complex A) (↥M)).symm m
      let y : ↥(Rep.ind f N) := (Representation.IndV.mk f N.ρ b⁻¹) x
      (show ↥((Ind f).obj M) from
        (Representation.asModuleEquiv (Rep.ind f N).ρ).symm y)
    let targetBasis : G → ↥(F.obj regularH) := fun g =>
      tmul (Subgroup.subtype H) regularH g (ULift.up (1 : MonoidAlgebra Complex H))
    let summandTmul : ∀ i : I, K → H → ↥((S i).obj regularH) := fun i k h =>
      tmul (incLK i) ((Res (μ i)).obj regularH) k (ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex H h))
    ∃ (e : CategoryTheory.Iso F (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj S))
      (c : CategoryTheory.Iso (F.obj regularH) ((Res (Subgroup.subtype K)).obj regularG)),
      (∀ g : G, c.hom (targetBasis g) = ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G g)) ∧
      (∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H) (x : ↥(F.obj regularH)),
        c.hom ((F.map (rightMulH a)) x) =
          ULift.up (ULift.down (c.hom x) *
            MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.subtype H) a)) ∧
      (∀ (i : I) (k : K) (h : H),
        c.hom (e.inv.app regularH
          ((CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.ι S i).app regularH (summandTmul i k h))) =
            ULift.up (MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((k : G) * σ i * (h : G))))
```

## RightUpReidemeisterCurl: Right curl on an up-strand

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Use \(K\xrightarrow{\delta_*}H\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}G\).
The subscript on \(\id\) lists the groups on the left and right.

\[
\text{right curl on an up-strand}   =
       [H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\,\id_{G\cdot H}
\]

The \(K\)-loops require finite \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\).

```lean
theorem RightUpReidemeisterCurl : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (δ α : U)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)
  ∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    let curl := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d))
    let straight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
    let scaled := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (Subgroup.index S : Complex) straight
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret curl) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaled)
```

## RightCurlAndDotSlide: Right curl and dot slide

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

The right curl on \(\I_{\bar\alpha}^{G,H}\) uses the
reverse cup and multiplication cap for the embedding by \(\delta\)
of \(K\) into \(H\). It requires \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]<\infty\).
For the inclusion this index is \([H:K]\).

The curl multiplies by \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\).
For \(d=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in G\), the dot \(r_d(x)=xd\) changes
\(\bar\alpha\) to \(\bar\beta\). Using the same embedding of \(K\)
into \(H\), the dot below, inside, or above the curl gives
\(x\mapsto[H:\cg{\delta}{K}]xd\).

For the four identities below take \(\gamma,\gamma'\) for embeddings
of \(H\) into \(G\) and \(\alpha,\beta\) for embeddings of \(K\) into \(H\).
Set \(d=\gamma(\gamma')^{-1}\in G\) and \(e=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in H\).
Write \(m_{\gamma,\alpha}\) and \(m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha}\) for the
induction and restriction merges and \(\ell_a(x)=ax\).
The identities are in order for the induction merge, induction split,
restriction merge, and restriction split.
\begin{align}
 m_{\gamma',\beta}\circ(r_d\otimes r_e)
  &=r_{d\gamma'e(\gamma')^{-1}}\circ m_{\gamma,\alpha},
       \label{eq:two-leg-slide}\\
 (r_d\otimes r_e)\circ m_{\gamma,\alpha}^{-1}
  &=m_{\gamma',\beta}^{-1}\circ r_{d\gamma'e(\gamma')^{-1}},\\
 m^\downarrow_{\gamma',\beta}\circ(\ell_{e^{-1}}\otimes\ell_{d^{-1}})
  &=\ell_{\gamma'e^{-1}(\gamma')^{-1}d^{-1}}\circ
        m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha},\\
 (\ell_{e^{-1}}\otimes\ell_{d^{-1}})\circ(m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha})^{-1}
  &=(m^\downarrow_{\gamma',\beta})^{-1}\circ
        \ell_{\gamma'e^{-1}(\gamma')^{-1}d^{-1}} .
\end{align}

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 3.1 [prop:curl]; (3.1) [eq:two-leg-slide], (3.2)–(3.4), p. 7 (related source excerpts on pp. 7–8)](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.1, Proposition 3.1 [prop:curl], equations (3.1)–(3.4), pp. 7–8. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered diagram and project TikZ fix the two mixed trivalent junctions of the right-hand K-loop and the three dot positions. The same K-to-H embedding is used in every curl, its image has finite index in H, and for the inclusion the coefficient is [H:K]. The four merge and split identities hold at arbitrary index. The merged label uses d·γ′(e), with γ′(e) = γ′e(γ′)⁻¹, and its downward evaluation multiplies on the left by the inverse. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

```lean
theorem RightCurlAndDotSlide : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U),
  let liftOuterDot :=
    fun {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G}
      (inner : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) =>
      (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom inner k)⟩ :
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a inner)
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b inner))
  (∀ (δ α : U)
      (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let loop := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom loop)
    ∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
      let lower := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown p loop finite)
      let upper := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp p loop)
      let curl := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lower p) (upper p)
      let straight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
      let scaledStraight :=
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (Subgroup.index S : Complex) straight
      ((∀ k : K, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom loop k : U) = (k : U)) →
        Subgroup.index S = Subgroup.index (Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype H) K)) ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (curl a)) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledStraight) ∧
      (∀ (β : U)
          (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
          (hd : α * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
        let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
        let dot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))
        let loopIdentity := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down loop))
        let insideDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
          (Finsupp.single (liftOuterDot loop d) (1 : Complex))
        let below := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical dot (curl b)
        let inside := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lower a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal insideDot loopIdentity) (upper b))
        let above := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (curl a) dot
        let scaledDot := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (Subgroup.index S : Complex) dot
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret below) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret inside) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret above) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot))) ∧
  (∀ (γ γ' α β : U)
      (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G) (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
    let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical (liftOuterDot a d)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let dLabel := Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex)
    let eLabel := Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex)
    let mergedLabel := Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex)
    let legDotsUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing dLabel) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing eLabel)
    let legDotsDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing eLabel) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing dLabel)
    let mergedUp := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing mergedLabel
    let mergedDown := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing mergedLabel
    let upMergeL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical legDotsUp
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp g' b))
    let upMergeR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp g a)) mergedUp
    let upSplitL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp g a)) legDotsUp
    let upSplitR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical mergedUp
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp g' b))
    let downMergeL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical legDotsDown
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g' b))
    let downMergeR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g a)) mergedDown
    let downSplitL := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g a)) legDotsDown
    let downSplitR := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical mergedDown
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g' b))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upMergeL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upMergeR) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upSplitL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret upSplitR) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downMergeL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downMergeR) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downSplitL) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret downSplitR))
```

## InductionMergeDotSlide: Induction merge dot slide

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For the four identities below take \(\gamma,\gamma'\) for embeddings
of \(H\) into \(G\) and \(\alpha,\beta\) for embeddings of \(K\) into \(H\).
Set \(d=\gamma(\gamma')^{-1}\in G\) and \(e=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in H\).

induction and restriction merges and \(\ell_a(x)=ax\).

restriction merge, and restriction split.

m_{\gamma',\beta}\circ(r_d\otimes r_e)
  =r_{d\gamma'e(\gamma')^{-1}}\circ m_{\gamma,\alpha},

```lean
theorem InductionMergeDotSlide : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (γ α β : U)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let rightDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex))
  let merge := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp g a)
  (∀ (γ' : U)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=
      ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k)⟩
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical lifted (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))) rightDot)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp g' b))
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical merge
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex)))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right)) ∧
  (let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up g))) rightDot)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp g b))
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical merge
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) (1 : Complex)))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right))
```

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 3.1, equation (3.2), and the induction-split diagram in § 3.2, pp. 8–9. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. Equation (3.2) compares the split followed by the two leg dots with the merged dot of element dγ′e(γ′)⁻¹ followed by the split. The rendered diagram and project TikZ show the bottom-to-top d = 1 case with an unmarked left leg. Both equalities compare evaluations of typed drawings over ℂ. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) is reflected in the coefficient-one singleton complex labels for the specified group-element dots and the shared trivalent split vertices. The article’s embedding and membership hypotheses are preserved.

The designated defect report returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no corrected statement for this endpoint. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem InductionSplitDotSlide : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (γ α β : U)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let rightDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex))
  let split := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp g a)
  (∀ (γ' : U)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=
      ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k)⟩
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical lifted (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical split
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))) rightDot)
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp g' b))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right)) ∧
  (let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical split
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up g))) rightDot)
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) (1 : Complex)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp g b))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right))
```

## RestrictionMergeDotSlide: Restriction merge dot slide

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For the four identities below take \(\gamma,\gamma'\) for embeddings
of \(H\) into \(G\) and \(\alpha,\beta\) for embeddings of \(K\) into \(H\).
Set \(d=\gamma(\gamma')^{-1}\in G\) and \(e=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in H\).
Write \(m_{\gamma,\alpha}\) and \(m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha}\) for the
induction and restriction merges and \(\ell_a(x)=ax\).
The identities are in order for the induction merge, induction split,
restriction merge, and restriction split.

\[
m^\downarrow_{\gamma',\beta}\circ(\ell_{e^{-1}}\otimes\ell_{d^{-1}})
  =\ell_{\gamma'e^{-1}(\gamma')^{-1}d^{-1}}\circ
        m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha},
\]

Proposition~3.1. Read from bottom to top.

```lean
theorem RestrictionMergeDotSlide : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (γ α β : U)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let innerDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex))
  let merge := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g a)
  (∀ (γ' : U)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=
      ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k)⟩
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical lifted (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal innerDot
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g' b))
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical merge
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex)))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right)) ∧
  (let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal innerDot
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down g))))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown g b))
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical merge
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) (1 : Complex)))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right))
```

```lean
theorem RestrictionSplitDotSlide : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (γ α β : U)
    (hγ : ∀ h : H, γ * (h : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (he : α * β⁻¹ ∈ H),
  let g := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) he
  let legDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single e (1 : Complex))
  let split := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g a)
  (∀ (γ' : U)
      (hγ' : ∀ h : H, γ' * (h : U) * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hd : γ * (γ')⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let g' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ' hγ'
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot g g' :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives γ γ' (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
    let lifted : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g' a) :=
      ⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d,
        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a k)⟩
    let merged := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical lifted (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g' e)
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical split
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal legDot
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))))
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (Finsupp.single merged (1 : Complex)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g' b))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right)) ∧
  (let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical split
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal legDot
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down g))))
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.whisker g e) (1 : Complex)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown g b))
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret left) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret right))
```

## DotBelowInsideAboveRightCurl: Dot below, inside, or above the right curl

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

The right curl on \(\I_{\bar\alpha}^{G,H}\) uses the
reverse cup and multiplication cap for the embedding by \(\delta\)
of \(K\) into \(H\). It requires \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]<\infty\).
For the inclusion this index is \([H:K]\).

The curl multiplies by \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\).
For \(d=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in G\), the dot \(r_d(x)=xd\) changes
\(\bar\alpha\) to \(\bar\beta\). Using the same embedding of \(K\)
into \(H\), the dot below, inside, or above the curl gives
\(x\mapsto[H:\cg{\delta}{K}]xd\).

```lean
theorem DotBelowInsideAboveRightCurl : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U),
  let liftOuterDot :=
    fun {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G}
      (inner : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) =>

        fun k => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.intertwines d
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom inner k)⟩ :
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a inner)
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b inner))
  (∀ (δ α : U)
      (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let loop := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom loop)
    ∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
      let lower := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown p loop finite)
      let upper := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp p loop)
      let curl := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lower p) (upper p)
      let straight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
      let scaledStraight :=
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (Subgroup.index S : Complex) straight
      ((∀ k : K, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom loop k : U) = (k : U)) →
        Subgroup.index S = Subgroup.index (Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype H) K)) ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (curl a)) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledStraight) ∧
      (∀ (β : U)
          (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
          (hd : α * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
        let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
        let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives α β (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) hd
        let dot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex))
        let loopIdentity := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down loop))
        let insideDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing
          (Finsupp.single (liftOuterDot loop d) (1 : Complex))
        let below := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical dot (curl b)
        let inside := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lower a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal insideDot loopIdentity) (upper b))
        let above := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (curl a) dot
        let scaledDot := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (Subgroup.index S : Complex) dot
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret below) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret inside) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret above) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret scaledDot)))
```

## CurlWithCentralizingDot: Curl with a dot centralizing the internal group

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

The right curl on \(\I_{\bar\alpha}^{G,H}\) uses the
reverse cup and multiplication cap for the embedding by \(\delta\)
of \(K\) into \(H\). It requires \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]<\infty\).
For the inclusion this index is \([H:K]\).

Choose \(T\) with \(H=\bigsqcup_{t\in T}(\cg{\delta}{K})t\).

A curl with a dot \(a\in \C[H]\) commuting with \(\C[\cg{\delta}{K}]\)
on its induction factor acts by right multiplication by
\[
 \alpha_*\!\left(\sum_{t\in T}t^{-1}at\right).
\]
This follows by inserting \(a\) between \(t^{-1}\) and \(t\).
Replacing \(t\) by \(\ell t\), \(\ell\in\cg{\delta}{K}\), leaves
the summand unchanged. Right multiplication permutes the cosets,
so the sum is central in \(\C[H]\). A dot between the \(\alpha_*\)
and \(\beta_*\) strands intertwines their images of this sum.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.1, unnumbered, p. 8](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) gives the sliding mark a finite complex DotLabel with termwise intertwining. The article’s arbitrary centralizing input and its coset trace use whole-algebra intertwiners in the shared scoped syntax. That syntax retains the full curl with the original reverse cup and multiplication cap, the straight trace, and both orders of composition with the sliding mark at their typed boundaries.

```lean
theorem CurlWithCentralizingDot : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (δ α : U)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let inner := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let outer := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom inner)
  let lift := fun {A B : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom p)
  let basis := fun {A : Subgroup U} (g : A) => MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : Complex)
  ∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    ((∀ k : K, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom inner k : U) = (k : U)) →
      Subgroup.index S = Subgroup.index (Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype H) K)) ∧
    ∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H)
      (ha : ∀ y : MonoidAlgebra Complex K, Commute (lift inner y) a),
      let middle : MackeyDiagrams.AlgebraUpDot Complex inner inner :=
        ⟨a, fun k => by
          have h := (ha (basis k)).eq
          change MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom inner)
            (basis k) * a = a * MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom inner) (basis k) at h
          simpa only [basis, MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain_single] using h⟩
      let curl := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.rightCurlUp
        (MackeyDiagrams.RightCurlLabel.algebraDot outer middle) finite
      let transversal := fun T : Finset H =>
        ∀ h : H, ∃! t : {t : H // t ∈ T}, h * t.val⁻¹ ∈ S
      let summand := fun t : H => basis t⁻¹ * a * basis t
      ∀ (T : Finset H), transversal T →
        let trace := Finset.sum T summand
        ∃ central : ∀ y : MonoidAlgebra Complex H, Commute y trace,
          let traceLabel : MackeyDiagrams.AlgebraUpDot Complex
              (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id H) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id H) :=
            ⟨trace, fun h => (central (basis h)).eq⟩
          let straight := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G) =>
            show MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram Complex
              (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up p) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up p) from
              MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.algebraUpDot
                (MackeyDiagrams.AlgebraUpDot.whisker p traceLabel)
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval curl =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (straight outer) ∧
          (∀ x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval curl)
              (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x) = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (x * lift outer trace)) ∧
          (∀ (t : H) (ℓ : S), summand ((ℓ : H) * t) = summand t) ∧
          (∀ (β : U) (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
            let outer' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
            ∀ d : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex outer outer',
              let dot := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing d)
              let slideBelow := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.vertical dot (straight outer')
              let slideAbove := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.vertical (straight outer) dot
              MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval slideBelow =
                MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval slideAbove)
```

## MovingMergeDotBackToBranch: Moving a merged dot to an input branch

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For the four identities below take \(\gamma,\gamma'\) for embeddings
of \(H\) into \(G\) and \(\alpha,\beta\) for embeddings of \(K\) into \(H\).
Set \(d=\gamma(\gamma')^{-1}\in G\) and \(e=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in H\).
Write \(m_{\gamma,\alpha}\) and \(m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha}\) for the
induction and restriction merges and \(\ell_a(x)=ax\).
The identities are in order for the induction merge, induction split,
restriction merge, and restriction split.

Fix the incoming labels of a merge. A dot \(D\in G\) on its merged
strand can move to the right input exactly when \(D\in\cg{\gamma}{H}\).
Necessity follows from (3.1) with \(d=1\).
For sufficiency take \(e=\gamma^{-1}D\gamma\in H\) and
\(\beta=e^{-1}\alpha\). This embeds \(K\) into \(H\) and gives the
same output embedding, since both conjugate \((\gamma\alpha)_*\)
by \(D^{-1}\). A dot can always move to the left input by taking
\(\gamma'=D^{-1}\gamma\) and \(e=1\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.2, Moving a dot back to a branch, p. 9](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte, and the author’s article page reproduces the paragraph. The incoming and outgoing embeddings are fixed.
```lean
theorem MovingMergeDotBackToBranch : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H)
    (target : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G)
    (D : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α) target),
  let singleton := fun {A B : Subgroup U} {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B}
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) =>
    (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex) : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex a b)
  let upInput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α)
  let downInput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ)
  let mergedUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp γ α))
    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (singleton D))
  let mergedDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown γ α))
    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton D))
  let matchesUp := fun {out : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (h : out = target)
      (branch : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex upInput (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up out)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
        (show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex upInput (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up target)
          from h ▸ branch)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret mergedUp)
  let matchesDown := fun {out : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (h : out = target)
      (branch : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex downInput (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down out)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
        (show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex downInput (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down target)
          from h ▸ branch)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret mergedDown)
  let inImage := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element D ∈
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom γ)
  ((∃ (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot α β)
        (h : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ β = target),
      matchesUp h (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ)))
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (singleton e)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp γ β)))) ↔ inImage) ∧
  ((∃ (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot α β)
        (h : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ β = target),
      matchesDown h (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton e))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ))))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown γ β)))) ↔ inImage) ∧
  (∃ (γ' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G) (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot γ γ')
      (h : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ' α = target),
    matchesUp h (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (singleton d))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α))))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp γ' α))) ∧
    matchesDown h (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton d)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown γ' α))))
```

## MovingSplitDotToOutputBranch: Moving a split dot to an output branch

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For the four identities below take \(\gamma,\gamma'\) for embeddings
of \(H\) into \(G\) and \(\alpha,\beta\) for embeddings of \(K\) into \(H\).
Set \(d=\gamma(\gamma')^{-1}\in G\) and \(e=\alpha\beta^{-1}\in H\).
Write \(m_{\gamma,\alpha}\) and \(m^\downarrow_{\gamma,\alpha}\) for the
induction and restriction merges and \(\ell_a(x)=ax\).
The identities are in order for the induction merge, induction split,
restriction merge, and restriction split.

For a split with left label \(\bar\alpha\), moving a dot to the
right output requires \(D\in\cg{\alpha}{H}\). To move it to the
left output, factor the given input representative \(b\) as
\((b\gamma^{-1})\gamma\). Since
\(D=b(\alpha\gamma)^{-1}\), the left representative
\(b\gamma^{-1}=D\alpha\) embeds \(H\) into \(G\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.2, Moving a dot back to a branch, p. 9](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.2, “Moving a dot back to a branch,” p. 9, split paragraph. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The split paragraph uses α for H into G and γ for K into H. The statement retains the specified incoming element D = b(αγ)⁻¹, the necessary right-output condition D ∈ αHα⁻¹, and the left-output construction with representative bγ⁻¹ = Dα. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in input.request (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the label convention. The right-output condition ranges over every eligible finite complex DotLabel. The article’s input and constructed left-output marks use coefficient-one singleton labels. Both orientations compare evaluations of typed LabelledDrawings with TrivalentVertex splits at the same boundary. The restriction drawing reverses the branch order and uses the inverse of each group element in its dot evaluation. The statement elaborated through the shared Lean compilation slot.

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction for this endpoint was available in the task context. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem MovingSplitDotToOutputBranch : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α γ b : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hγ : ∀ k : K, γ * (k : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hb : ∀ k : K, b * (k : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hD : b * (α * γ)⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let D : G := ⟨b * (α * γ)⁻¹, hD⟩
  let outer := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let inner := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let input := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
  let merged := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp outer inner
  let inputDot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot input merged :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives b (α * γ) (fun _ => rfl)
      (fun k => congrArg (fun c : MulAut U => c (k : U))
        (Eq.symm (map_mul (MulAut.conj (G := U)) α γ))) hD
  let singleton := fun {A B : Subgroup U} {a c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B}
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a c) =>
    (Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex) : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex a c)
  let upTop := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up outer) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up inner)
  let downTop := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down inner) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down outer)
  let dotThenSplitUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (singleton inputDot))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp outer inner))
  let dotThenSplitDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton inputDot))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown outer inner))
  let evalUpAtInput := fun {p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (hp : p = input)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up p) upTop) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
      (show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up input) upTop
        from hp ▸ d))
  let evalDownAtInput := fun {p : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (hp : p = input)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down p) downTop) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
      (show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down input) downTop
        from hp ▸ d))
  (∀ (newInner : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H)
      (sameInput : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp outer newInner = input)
      (rightLabel : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex newInner inner),
    let splitThenRightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp outer newInner))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up outer)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing rightLabel))
    let splitThenRightDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown outer newInner))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing rightLabel)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down outer))))
    (evalUpAtInput (Eq.refl input) dotThenSplitUp =
        evalUpAtInput sameInput splitThenRightUp ∨
      evalDownAtInput (Eq.refl input) dotThenSplitDown =
        evalDownAtInput sameInput splitThenRightDown) →
      D ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom outer)) ∧
  (let leftRepresentative := b * γ⁻¹
   b = leftRepresentative * γ ∧
   leftRepresentative = (D : U) * α ∧
   ∃ hLeft : ∀ h : H, leftRepresentative * (h : U) * leftRepresentative⁻¹ ∈ G,
     let newOuter := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator leftRepresentative hLeft
     ∃ (sameInput : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp newOuter inner = input)
       (leftDot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot newOuter outer),
       MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element leftDot = D ∧
       (let splitThenLeftUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
            (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp newOuter inner))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (singleton leftDot))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up inner))))
        let splitThenLeftDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
            (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown newOuter inner))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down inner)))
            (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton leftDot)))
        evalUpAtInput (Eq.refl input) dotThenSplitUp =
          evalUpAtInput sameInput splitThenLeftUp ∧
        evalDownAtInput (Eq.refl input) dotThenSplitDown =
          evalDownAtInput sameInput splitThenLeftDown))
```
