### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.5, Proposition 3.4, Reverse-cup bend, p. 12. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The source TikZ gives the bottom word G–H and the top word G–K–H. The two typed composites are evaluated over the complex group algebras. The finite index of the composite image in G supplies the finite-index witness for the smaller reverse cup. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no correction for this endpoint. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ReverseCupBend : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
  let composite := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α
  ∀ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom composite)),
  let alphaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α
  let gammaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom γ
  let finiteAlpha : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range alphaHom) := by
    let _ := finite
    have finitePreimage : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
        (Subgroup.comap gammaHom (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom composite))) :=
      inferInstance
    change Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.comap gammaHom
      (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom))) at finitePreimage
    rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.injective γ)] at finitePreimage
    exact finitePreimage
  let upAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α
  let downAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α
  let upGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ
  let downGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ
  let upComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up composite
  let downComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down composite
  let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
  let idUpGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upGamma
  let left : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma output :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup α finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id downAlpha))))
  let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma) downAlpha :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α) idUpGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id downAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit downAlpha)))
  let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma output :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup composite finite)
          idUpGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id upComposite)
            rightBranch)))
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
```

## TrivalentBendIdentities: Bend identities

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}H\xrightarrow{\gamma_*}G\)
be conjugation embeddings. The two diagrams in each pair below
give the same bimodule map. The multiplication-cap and ordinary-cup
identities hold at all indices. The trace-cap identity holds when
\([H:\cg{\alpha}{K}]<\infty\), and the reverse-cup identity holds when
\([G:\cg{\gamma\alpha}{K}]<\infty\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 3.4 [prop:trivalent-bends]; four unnumbered diagrams, p. 12](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.5, Proposition 3.4 (prop:trivalent-bends), p. 12. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The four conjuncts compare the evaluations of the original typed diagram pairs over the complex group algebras. Multiplication cap and ordinary cup hold at arbitrary index. Trace cap assumes finite index of the image of α in H, and reverse cup assumes finite index of the composite image in G. The smaller reverse cup in the latter pair gets its index witness by pullback along γ. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, including with a trailing slash. No correction for Proposition 3.4 was available. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The shared-slot Lean check elaborated the exact type and checked its assembly from the four reviewed prerequisite statements supplied as local hypotheses. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem TrivalentBendIdentities : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
  let composite := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α
  let alphaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α
  let gammaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom γ
  let alphaIndex := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range alphaHom)
  let compositeIndex :=
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom composite))
  let upAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α
  let downAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α
  let upGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ
  let downGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ
  let upComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up composite
  let downComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down composite
  let idUpAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upAlpha
  let idDownAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downAlpha
  let idUpGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upGamma
  let idDownGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downGamma
  let idUpComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upComposite
  let idDownComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downComposite
  let multiplicationCapBend : Prop :=
    let input := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
    let left : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp γ α) idDownAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit upGamma)))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex downAlpha
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit downAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown γ α) idUpGamma)))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex input upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite rightBranch)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap composite) idUpGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit upGamma)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  let ordinaryCupBend : Prop :=
    let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downGamma upComposite
    let left : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ) idUpAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downGamma upGamma upAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownGamma (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α))))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upAlpha downComposite) downGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downAlpha downGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α) idDownGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downGamma)))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup composite))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downComposite upComposite)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal rightBranch idUpComposite)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  let traceInput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma
  let reverseOutput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
  let traceLeft : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α) idUpGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit downAlpha)))
  let reverseLeft (finiteAlpha : alphaIndex) :
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup α finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α) idDownAlpha)))
  let traceCapBend : Prop := ∀ finiteAlpha : alphaIndex,
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownComposite (reverseLeft finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downComposite upComposite downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap composite)
              idDownAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downAlpha)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval traceLeft = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  let reverseCupBend : Prop := ∀ finiteComposite : compositeIndex,
    let finiteAlpha : alphaIndex := by
      let _ : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom)) :=
        finiteComposite
      have finitePreimage : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
          (Subgroup.comap gammaHom (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom))) :=
        inferInstance
      rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.injective γ)] at finitePreimage
      exact finitePreimage
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup composite finiteComposite) idUpGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite traceLeft)))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (reverseLeft finiteAlpha) = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right
  multiplicationCapBend ∧ ordinaryCupBend ∧ traceCapBend ∧ reverseCupBend
```

## StraightMixedTrivalentVertices: Straight-segment form of the mixed trivalent vertices

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}H\xrightarrow{\gamma_*}G\)
be conjugation embeddings. The two diagrams in each pair below
give the same bimodule map. The multiplication-cap and ordinary-cup
identities hold at all indices. The trace-cap identity holds when
\([H:\cg{\alpha}{K}]<\infty\), and the reverse-cup identity holds when
\([G:\cg{\gamma\alpha}{K}]<\infty\).

The equations let us draw the vertices with three straight segments.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 3.5, the straight-segment figure after the proof of Proposition 3.4, p. 13. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. In figure order, the four clauses compare each single typed junction with both bent presentations by equality of evaluated complex bimodule maps. Multiplication cap and ordinary cup hold at all indices. Trace cap assumes finite index of the image of α in H. Reverse cup assumes finite index of the image of γα in G. The smaller reverse cup gets its index witness by pullback along γ. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner’s 27 November 2026 clarification (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) preserves the ordered orientations of these unmarked junctions. All four junctions and their expansions are dot-free.

```lean
theorem StraightMixedTrivalentVertices : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K H) (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G),
  let composite := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp γ α
  let alphaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α
  let gammaHom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom γ
  let alphaIndex := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range alphaHom)
  let compositeIndex :=
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom composite))
  let upAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up α
  let downAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down α
  let upGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up γ
  let downGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down γ
  let upComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up composite
  let downComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down composite
  let idUpAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upAlpha
  let idDownAlpha := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downAlpha
  let idUpGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upGamma
  let idDownGamma := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downGamma
  let idUpComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upComposite
  let idDownComposite := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downComposite
  let multiplicationCapVertex : Prop :=
    let boundary := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
    let firstBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex boundary upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp γ α) idDownAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit upGamma)))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex downAlpha
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit downAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeDown γ α) idUpGamma)))
    let secondBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex boundary upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite rightBranch)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap composite) idUpGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit upGamma)))
    let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex boundary upGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp γ α)
    let straightMap := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret straight)
    straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval firstBend ∧
      straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval secondBend
  let traceInput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downComposite upGamma
  let reverseOutput := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upComposite downAlpha
  let traceCapFirstBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α) idUpGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downAlpha downGamma upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap γ))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit downAlpha)))
  let reverseCupFirstBend (finiteAlpha : alphaIndex) :
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upGamma)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpGamma
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup α finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upGamma upAlpha downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α) idDownAlpha)))
  let traceCapVertex : Prop := ∀ finiteAlpha : alphaIndex,
    let secondBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownComposite (reverseCupFirstBend finiteAlpha))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downComposite upComposite downAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap composite)
              idDownAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downAlpha)))
    let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex traceInput downAlpha :=
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToDown γ α)
    let straightMap := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret straight)
    straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval traceCapFirstBend ∧
      straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval secondBend
  let ordinaryCupVertex : Prop :=
    let output := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor downGamma upComposite
    let firstBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup γ) idUpAlpha)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downGamma upGamma upAlpha)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDownGamma (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp γ α))))
    let rightBranch : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor upAlpha downComposite) downGamma :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitDown γ α))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downAlpha downGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap α) idDownGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downGamma)))
    let secondBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upAlpha)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpAlpha
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup composite))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upAlpha downComposite upComposite)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal rightBranch idUpComposite)))
    let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex upAlpha output :=
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp γ α)
    let straightMap := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret straight)
    straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval firstBend ∧
      straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval secondBend
  let reverseCupVertex : Prop := ∀ finiteComposite : compositeIndex,
    let finiteAlpha : alphaIndex := by
      let _ : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom)) :=
        finiteComposite
      have finitePreimage : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
          (Subgroup.comap gammaHom (MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp gammaHom alphaHom))) :=
        inferInstance
      rw [MonoidHom.range_comp, Subgroup.comap_map_eq_self_of_injective
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.injective γ)] at finitePreimage
      exact finitePreimage
    let secondBend : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upGamma)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup composite finiteComposite) idUpGamma)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upComposite downComposite upGamma)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUpComposite traceCapFirstBend)))
    let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex upGamma reverseOutput :=
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown γ α finiteAlpha)
    let straightMap := MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret straight)
    straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (reverseCupFirstBend finiteAlpha) ∧
      straightMap = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval secondBend
  multiplicationCapVertex ∧ traceCapVertex ∧ ordinaryCupVertex ∧ reverseCupVertex
```

```lean
theorem RightDownReidemeisterCurl : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (δ α : U)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let curl := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToDownUp a d))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToDown a d))
  let straight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d))
  MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret curl) =
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret straight)
```

```lean
theorem LeftUpReidemeisterCurl : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (δ α : U)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d
  let loopDown := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let loopUp := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let straight := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) up
  let cup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup a) straight
  let middle := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id loopDown)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp a d)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp a d))
  let cap := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap a) straight
  let curl :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit up)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cup
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate loopDown loopUp up)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical middle
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate loopDown loopUp up)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical cap
                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit up))))))
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval curl = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight
```

## ReidemeisterOne: Reidemeister I

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Use \(K\xrightarrow{\delta_*}H\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}G\).
The subscript on \(\id\) lists the groups on the left and right.

The four curls shown below satisfy
\begin{align}
 \text{right curl on an up-strand}   &=
       [H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\,\id_{G\cdot H}, \label{eq:curl-right-up}\\
 \text{right curl on a down-strand} &=
       \id_{K\cdot H}, \label{eq:curl-right-down}\\
 \text{left curl on an up-strand}    &=
       \id_{H\cdot K}, \label{eq:curl-left-up}\\
 \text{left curl on a down-strand}   &=
       [H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\,\id_{H\cdot G}. \label{eq:curl-left-down}
\end{align}
The \(K\)-loops require finite \([H:\cg{\delta}{K}]\).
The \(G\)-loops hold at arbitrary index.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 4.1 [thm:reidemeister-one]; (4.1)–(4.4), p. 14](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

## TransportToMackeyRepresentative: Transport to the Mackey representative

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Use \(J,\sigma_j,L_j,M,M_j\) from Section~2.2.
The two boundary strands of \(M\) point in opposite directions,
with \(G\) between them. To allow a different middle group, take
\(\cg{a}{L}\le K\), \(\cg{b}{L}\le H\) and
\(s=\alpha a(\beta b)^{-1}\in G\). Use \(s,s^{-1}\) as the two
crossing labels and put
\[
 M_L=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L]}\C[H],\qquad
 L_s=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\cap(\cg{s\beta}{H}),\qquad
 n=[L_s:\cg{\alpha a}{L}].
\]
The tensor product has basis \(K\times_L H\), the classes \([k,h]\)
of pairs under \([ka\ell a^{-1},h]=[k,b\ell b^{-1}h]\),
\(\ell\in L\). The relation identifies exactly the pairs equated
by balancing the tensor product.

Let \(s=\alpha a(\beta b)^{-1}\in j\) and write
\[
 s=(\alpha k\alpha^{-1})\sigma_j(\beta h\beta^{-1}),
 \qquad k\in K,\quad h\in H.
\]
Then \(L'=\cg{\alpha k^{-1}a}{L}\le L_j\). Use the restrictions of
\(\lambda_j,\mu_j\) for the embeddings of \(L'\). The map
\[
 [x,y]_L\longmapsto[xk,hy]_{L'}
\]
is a bijection respecting the left \(K\)-action and right \(H\)-action.
Its linear extension intertwines the multiplication crossings with
labels \(s,\sigma_j\), and the projection crossings with labels
\(s^{-1},\sigma_j^{-1}\) when their fiber sums are finite.
Moreover, \([L_j:L']=[L_s:\cg{\alpha a}{L}]\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Lemma 5.2 [lem:mackey-transport], p. 16](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem TransportToMackeyRepresentative : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U),
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let Hβ := conjSubgroup β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G)
    (ha : conjSubgroup a L ≤ K) (hb : conjSubgroup b L ≤ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun x => hK ⟨(x : U), x.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun y => hH ⟨(y : U), y.property, rfl⟩)
    let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := K) a
      (fun ℓ => ha ⟨(ℓ : U), ℓ.property, rfl⟩)
    let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := H) b
      (fun ℓ => hb ⟨(ℓ : U), ℓ.property, rfl⟩)
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          group)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          group) hs
    let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ i : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ i) = i)
      (j : J) (_ : DoubleCoset.mk A B s = j) (k : K) (h : H)
      (_ : s = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα k * σ j *
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ h),
      let Lj := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let Ls := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
      let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
      let Lprime := conjSubgroup (α * (k : U)⁻¹ * a) L
      let leftJ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj) (G := K) α⁻¹
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨x, hx, he⟩ := ℓ.property.1
          change α * x * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at he
          rw [← he]
          change x ∈ K at hx
          convert hx using 1
          group)
      let rightJ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj) (G := H)
        (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change ((σ j : U) * β) * y * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at he
          rw [← he]
          change y ∈ H at hy
          convert hy using 1
          group)
      ∃ hSub : Lprime ≤ Lj,
        let leftPrime := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator
          (H := Lprime) (G := K) α⁻¹ (fun ℓ =>
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom leftJ ⟨(ℓ : U), hSub ℓ.property⟩).property)
        let rightPrime := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator
          (H := Lprime) (G := H) (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (fun ℓ =>
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom rightJ ⟨(ℓ : U), hSub ℓ.property⟩).property)
        let dprime : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα leftPrime)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ rightPrime) :=
          ⟨σ j, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
              (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
        let X := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ea
        let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction eb
        let Xprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction leftPrime
        let Yprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction rightPrime
        let W := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor X Y
        let Wprime := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor Xprime Yprime
        let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
        let qprime :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime dprime
        let ι := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex)
          eα eβ ea eb [(1, d)]
        let ιprime := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex)
          eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime [(1, dprime)]
        ∃ (e : W.carrier ≃ Wprime.carrier)
          (he : ∀ (g : K × H) (w : W.carrier),
            e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act W g w) = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Wprime g (e w)),
          let transport : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex W Wprime :=
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ofFunction e he
          (∀ (x : K) (y : H),
            e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair X Y x y) =
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair Xprime Yprime (x * k) (h * y)) ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical transport (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ιprime)) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret ι) ∧
          (∀ (hf : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z})
              (hfprime : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | qprime w = z}),
            let p := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex)
              eα eβ ea eb [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
            let pprime := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex)
              eα eβ leftPrime rightPrime [(1, ⟨dprime, hfprime⟩)]
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret p)) transport =
              MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret pprime)) ∧
          Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Subgroup.subgroupOf Lprime Lj))) =
            Cardinal.mk (Quotient (QuotientGroup.leftRel (Subgroup.subgroupOf Limage Ls)))
```

## MixedCrossingComposites: Two crossings with opposite orientations

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Use \(J,\sigma_j,L_j,M,M_j\) from Section~2.2.
The two boundary strands of \(M\) point in opposite directions,
with \(G\) between them. To allow a different middle group, take
\(\cg{a}{L}\le K\), \(\cg{b}{L}\le H\) and
\(s=\alpha a(\beta b)^{-1}\in G\). Use \(s,s^{-1}\) as the two
crossing labels and put
\[
 M_L=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L]}\C[H],\qquad
 L_s=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\cap(\cg{s\beta}{H}),\qquad
 n=[L_s:\cg{\alpha a}{L}].
\]
The tensor product has basis \(K\times_L H\), the classes \([k,h]\)
of pairs under \([ka\ell a^{-1},h]=[k,b\ell b^{-1}h]\),
\(\ell\in L\). The relation identifies exactly the pairs equated
by balancing the tensor product.

Suppose \(n<\infty\). Let \(p_L:M\to M_L\) and \(\iota_L:M_L\to M\)
be the two crossings. Write
\(q([k,h])=\alpha k\alpha^{-1}s\beta h\beta^{-1}\).
If \(s\in j\), then
\[
 \iota_L\circ p_L=nP_j,\qquad
 p_L\circ\iota_L(z)=\sum_{q(w)=q(z)}w \quad(z\in K\times_L H),
\]
where \(P_j\) fixes the basis elements in \(j\) and sends the others
to zero. The second composite is the identity exactly when \(n=1\).
For \(n>1\), no scalar multiple of it is the identity.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 5.1 [prop:r2-mixed-composition], p. 15](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 5.1 [prop:r2-mixed-composition], with the conventions of §§2.2 and 5.1. The archived original source/mackey-bimodules.pdf (SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2) contains the proposition on p. 15 and its proof on pp. 15–16. The revised published PDF (SHA-256 6d7e885955f23ae6d10d8e8394d3fe9252dfc2fa7ce7ec149ec190de766c978e, also saved under article-revision/) contains the same proposition on p. 17 and its proof on pp. 17–18. The rendered stacks under “Smaller internal groups and intersections” on archived p. 17 and published p. 19 confirm the two bottom-to-top orders and their respective boundaries. The construction uses the coefficient-one singleton at the eligible element s. The compact projection stores the forward element and its finite-fiber witness and implements the crossing with inverse trace label s⁻¹. The source proof and its following paragraph require finite relative index for the projection and use the surviving trace terms at infinite standalone cup index. The linked defect-report page returned HTTP 404. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#prop:r2-mixed-composition [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem MixedCrossingComposites :   ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U)
      (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
      (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
      (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
      (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
    let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
    let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
    let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
        (by
          intro ℓ
          change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
          simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs
    let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d
    let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
    let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
        Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
      let Lj := fun j : J => conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let leftJ := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := K) α⁻¹
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change k ∈ K at hk
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let rightJ := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change h ∈ H at hh
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let _Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (leftJ j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (rightJ j))
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ)
      let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ea) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eb)
      let Ls := conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
      let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
      let n := Subgroup.relIndex Limage Ls
      let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ea eb d
      let q := fun w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis w)
      Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex Limage Ls →
        ∃ hf : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
            Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z},
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex ML M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ ea eb [(1, d)]
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ ea eb [(1, ⟨d, hf⟩)]
          let pThenIota := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι
          let iotaThenP := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical ι p
          let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex ML ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ML)
          let evaluate := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
              (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
            MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
          let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
          let P := fun j : J =>
            show ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex]
                ((MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex) from by
              classical
              exact Finsupp.lsum Complex (fun z =>
                if MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ z ∈ orbit j
                then Finsupp.lsingle z else 0)
          let finiteQ := fun z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
            show Set.Finite {w | q w = q z} from
              Set.Finite.subset (hf (qBasis z)) (by
                intro w hw
                exact (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective hw)
          ∀ j : J, s ∈ orbit j →
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate pThenIota) =
              (n : Complex) • P j ∧
            (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate iotaThenP)
                  (Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)) =
                Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (finiteQ z))
                  (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex))) ∧
            (evaluate iotaThenP = evaluate straight ↔
              n = 1) ∧
            (1 < n → ∀ c : Complex,
              evaluate (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale c iotaThenP) ≠
                evaluate straight)
```

## MixedReidemeisterTwoMackeyCancellation: Mixed Reidemeister II cancellation through full Mackey groups

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Take \(L=L_j\), \(a=\alpha^{-1}\), \(b=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\).
Then \(s=\sigma_j\), \(n=1\), and the two orders give
\[
 p_j\circ\iota_i=
 \begin{cases}
   \id_{M_i},&i=j,\\
   0,&i\ne j,
 \end{cases}
 \qquad
 \sum_{j\in J}\iota_j\circ p_j=\id_M .
\]
Here \(q\) is a bijection onto \(j\).
For \(i\ne j\), \(p_j\) vanishes on the image of \(\iota_i\).
The projections sum to the identity because the double cosets
partition \(G\). Read the diagrams from bottom to top.

PointwiseIndexedDrawing.evalAt sums the evaluated summands directly over the finite support of each input.

```lean
theorem MixedReidemeisterTwoMackeyCancellation : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let Hβ := conjSubgroup β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
      let L := fun j : J => Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let a := α⁻¹
      let b := fun j : J => β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) a
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H) (b j)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let d : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (l j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (r j)) := fun j =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b j)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
            simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
          (by
            intro ℓ
            change β * (b j * (ℓ : U) * (b j)⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
            simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
          (by
            change (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ ∈ G
            have hs : (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ = (σ j : U) := by
              group
            rw [hs]
            exact (σ j).property)
      let n := fun j : J =>
        Subgroup.relIndex (conjSubgroup (α * a) (L j))
          (Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (d j) : U) * β) H)
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      let W := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M
      let Wj := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (Mj j)
      let V := Finsupp W.carrier Complex
      let groupAlgebra := MonoidAlgebra Complex G
      let coordinates : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) V groupAlgebra :=
        LinearEquiv.trans
          (Finsupp.domLCongr (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ))
          (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv Complex).symm
      let qBasis := fun j : J => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ (l j) (r j) (d j)
      let q := fun (j : J) (w : (Wj j).carrier) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis j w)
      (∀ (g : K × H) (x : V),
        coordinates (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex W g x) =
          MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα g.1) * coordinates x *
            MonoidAlgebra.of Complex G ((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ g.2)⁻¹)) ∧
      (∀ g : G, ∃! j : J, g ∈ orbit j) ∧
      (∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (d j) = σ j ∧ n j = 1 ∧
        Set.BijOn (q j) Set.univ (orbit j)) ∧
      ∃ hf : ∀ (j : J) (z : W.carrier), Set.Finite {w | qBasis j w = z},
        let ι : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ (l j) (r j) [(1, d j)]
        let p : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ (l j) (r j)
            [(1, ⟨d j, hf j⟩)]
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))
        let straightj : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j))))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))))
        let eval := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
            (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
        let summands : J → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (p j) (ι j)
        let finiteSupport := fun (drawings : J → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M) =>
          ∀ x : V, Set.Finite (Function.support
            (fun j => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval (drawings j)) x))
        (∀ j : J,
          eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (ι j) (p j)) = eval (straightj j)) ∧
        (∀ (i j : J), i ≠ j →
          eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (ι i) (p j)) =
            eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (Mj i) (Mj j)))) ∧
        (∃ finite : finiteSupport summands,
          let sum : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex M M J := ⟨summands, finite⟩
          sum.shape = ⟨fun j => (summands j).planarShape⟩ ∧
          ∀ x : V, sum.evalAt x = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval straight) x)
```

## MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup: Two mixed crossings through a smaller internal group

### Article

\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Restrict the embeddings of \(L_j\) to \(L\le L_j\), and write
\(p_{L,j},\iota_{L,j}\) for the resulting crossings. For finite
\([L_j:L]\), Proposition~5.1 gives
\(\iota_{L,j}\circ p_{L,j}=[L_j:L]\,(\iota_j\circ p_j)\).

In the rightmost diagram, \(q\) maps balanced pairs to the double coset \(j\).
\[
 q:K\times_L H\longrightarrow j,\qquad
 q([k,h]_L)=\alpha k\alpha^{-1}\sigma_j\beta h\beta^{-1}.
\]
The lower crossing \(\iota_{L,j}\) is the linear extension of \(q\).
The upper crossing \(p_{L,j}\) sends \(q(z)\) to the sum of its
\([L_j:L]\) preimages, so \(p_{L,j}\circ\iota_{L,j}\) is the
identity exactly when \(L=L_j\).

```lean
theorem MixedCrossingsThroughSmallerGroup : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
  let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j) (j : J),
    let s := σ j
    let orbit := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset s (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    let a := α⁻¹
    let b := β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹
    let Lj := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H
    let left := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) a (by
        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).1
        change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
        change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
        rw [← heq]
        change k ∈ K at hk
        convert hk using 1
        group)
    let right := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := H) b (by
        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2
        change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
        change (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
        rw [← heq]
        change h ∈ H at hh
        convert hh using 1
        group)
    let dot := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      show MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (left S hS))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (right S hS)) from
        ⟨s, by
          intro ℓ
          apply Subtype.ext
          change (α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹) * (s : U) =
            (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
              (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
          group⟩
    ∀ (L : Subgroup U) (hL : L ≤ Lj), Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex L Lj →
      let leftL := left L hL
      let rightL := right L hL
      let leftJ := left Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let rightJ := right Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let dL := dot L hL
      let dJ := dot Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ)
      let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftL) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightL)
      let MJ := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftJ) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightJ)
      let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftL rightL dL
      let qBasisJ := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ
      let q := fun z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis z)
      let fiber := fun g : G => {w | q w = g}
      let n := Subgroup.relIndex L Lj
      ∃ (hLFinite : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z})
        (hJFinite : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | qBasisJ w = z}),
        let hf := fun g : G => show Set.Finite (fiber g) from
          Set.Finite.subset (hLFinite (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)) (by
            intro w hw
            apply (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective
            change q w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ
              (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)
            rw [MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
            exact hw)
        let fiberSum := fun g : G =>
          Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hf g)) (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex))
        let iotaL : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex ML M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ leftL rightL dL
        let pL : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M ML :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftL rightL dL hLFinite
        let iotaJ : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex MJ M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ
        let pJ : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M MJ :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ hJFinite
        let outerL := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pL iotaL
        let outerJ := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pJ iotaJ
        let innerL := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical iotaL pL
        let straight := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) ML
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval outerL =
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (n : Complex) outerJ) ∧
        Set.range q = orbit ∧
        (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
          q (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction leftL)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction rightL) k h) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα k * s *
              MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ h) ∧
        (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval iotaL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) =
            Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q z)) 1) ∧
        (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit →
          Nat.card (fiber g) = n ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval pL)
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) = fiberSum g) ∧
        (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) = fiberSum (q z)) ∧
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight ↔ L = Lj)
```

## CommonMackeyIntersectionSum: Common internal intersection and normalized sum of Mackey projectors

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Restrict the embeddings of \(L_j\) to \(L\le L_j\), and write
\(p_{L,j},\iota_{L,j}\) for the resulting crossings. For finite
\([L_j:L]\), Proposition~5.1 gives
\(\iota_{L,j}\circ p_{L,j}=[L_j:L]\,(\iota_j\circ p_j)\).

For nonempty \(J_0\subseteq J\), the group \(L=\bigcap_{j\in J_0}L_j\)
can be used separately for each \(j\in J_0\). Use
\(\alpha^{-1}\) into \(K\) and \(\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\) into \(H\).
The right labels for \(i,j\) agree exactly when
\(\sigma_i\sigma_j^{-1}\in C_U(L)\).
If all \([L_j:L]\) are finite, termwise division gives
\[
 \sum_{j\in J_0}\frac{\iota_{L,j}\circ p_{L,j}}{[L_j:L]}
  = \sum_{j\in J_0}\iota_j\circ p_j .
\]
Also \(p_{L,j}\circ\iota_{L,i}=0\) for \(i\ne j\), since the double
cosets are disjoint. For infinite \(J_0\) the sum of maps is
pointwise finite, with one term on each basis element in the
selected cosets. A finite \(J_0\) gives a sum of diagrams when
the cups exist.

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, §5.1, “Smaller internal groups and intersections,” p. 17 of the archived original at source/mackey-bimodules.pdf (SHA-256 bc57d13777e7df145b6dfd84029e0e9539fedb33d22b2823e14c096e4c3c12f2) and p. 19 of the published 28 November revision fetched from the article URL (SHA-256 813c82da512e992a11a53aa044c3a79d199b2bef5295639084c1f6b789d27e61). Both copies give the normalized equality over the same nonempty J₀. The passage permits a pointwise-finite sum of maps for infinite J₀ and a finite sum of diagrams when the standalone cups exist. The revised convention on p. 6 identifies each displayed diagram identity with equality of evaluations at a common boundary. The project represents the scopes by PointwiseIndexedDrawing and IndexedDrawing. The finite relative indices, the two finite cup conditions, the selected cosets, the crossing order, the coefficients, and the disjoint-coset clause carry over from the reviewed statement. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem CommonMackeyIntersectionSum : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let conjugate := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  ∀ (hα : conjugate α K ≤ G) (hβ : conjugate β H ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hα ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hβ ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
    let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let Lj := fun j : J => conjugate α K ⊓ conjugate ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let left := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) α⁻¹ (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).1
          change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          rw [← heq]
          change k ∈ K at hk
          convert hk using 1
          group)
      let right := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := H) (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2
          change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          rw [← heq]
          change h ∈ H at hh
          convert hh using 1
          group)
      let dot := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (left j S hS))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (right j S hS)) from
          ⟨σ j, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
              (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
      let kg := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let gk := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
      let gh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kg gh
      let inner := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (left j S hS)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (right j S hS))
      let finiteFibers := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b
            (left j S hS) (right j S hS) (dot j S hS) w = z}
      let inclusion := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex (inner j S hS) M from
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS) (dot j S hS)
      let projection := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j)
          (hf : finiteFibers j S hS) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M (inner j S hS) from
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS) (dot j S hS) hf
      let outer := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j)
          (hf : finiteFibers j S hS) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (projection j S hS hf) (inclusion j S hS)
      let full := fun j : J => le_refl (Lj j)
      let cupProjection := fun {S : Subgroup U} (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S K)
          (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S H)
          (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b r))
          (hc : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom r))) =>
        let kl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up l
        let hl := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up r
        let lh := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down r
        let target := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor kl lh
        let insertCup := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit gh))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id gh) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup r hc)))
        let rebracket := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate gh hl lh)
        let insertDot := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp b r)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse d))
                (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp a l)))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id lh))
        let prepareTrace := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id kg) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gk kl lh))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate kg gk target)
        let trace := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap a) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id target))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit target)
        show MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M target from
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical insertCup (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical rebracket
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical insertDot (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical prepareTrace trace)))
      (∀ (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j), Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex S (Lj j) →
        ∃ (hf : finiteFibers j S hS) (hfJ : finiteFibers j (Lj j) (full j)),
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (outer j S hS hf) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (Subgroup.relIndex S (Lj j) : Complex)
              (outer j (Lj j) (full j) hfJ))) ∧
      (∀ (J₀ : Set J), Set.Nonempty J₀ →
        let I := {j : J // j ∈ J₀}
        let L := ⨅ j : I, Lj j.val
        let hL := fun j : I => iInf_le (fun i : I => Lj i.val) j
        (∀ i j : I, right i.val L (hL i) = right j.val L (hL j) ↔
          (σ i.val : U) * (σ j.val : U)⁻¹ ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (L : Set U)) ∧
        ((∀ j : I, Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex L (Lj j.val)) →
          ∃ (hfL : ∀ j : I, finiteFibers j.val L (hL j))
            (hfJ : ∀ j : I, finiteFibers j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val)),
            let n := fun j : I => (Subgroup.relIndex L (Lj j.val) : Complex)
            let restricted := fun j : I => outer j.val L (hL j) (hfL j)
            let usual := fun j : I => outer j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val) (hfJ j)
            let normalized := fun j : I => MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (n j)⁻¹ (restricted j)
            let V := (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier →₀ Complex
            let term := fun (diagrams : I → MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M) (x : V) (j : I) =>
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (diagrams j)) x
            (∀ j : I, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (normalized j) = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (usual j)) ∧
            (∀ (i j : I), i ≠ j →
              MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
                (inclusion i.val L (hL i)) (projection j.val L (hL j) (hfL j))) =
              MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero (inner i.val L (hL i)) (inner j.val L (hL j)))) ∧
            (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
              let basis := Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)
              let coset := DoubleCoset.mk A B (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a b z)
              let selected := {j : I | j.val = coset}
              Function.support (term normalized basis) = selected ∧
              Function.support (term usual basis) = selected) ∧
            (∃ (finiteL : ∀ x : V, Set.Finite (Function.support (term normalized x)))
              (finiteJ : ∀ x : V, Set.Finite (Function.support (term usual x))),
              let sumL : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
                ⟨fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (normalized j), finiteL⟩
              let sumJ : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
                ⟨fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (usual j), finiteJ⟩
              (∀ x : V, sumL.evalAt x = sumJ.evalAt x)) ∧
            (∀ (hJ₀ : Set.Finite J₀)
                (cupsL : ∀ j : I, Subgroup.FiniteIndex
                  (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (right j.val L (hL j)))))
                (cupsJ : ∀ j : I, Subgroup.FiniteIndex
                  (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (right j.val (Lj j.val) (full j.val))))),
              let indices :=
                letI : Fintype I := Set.Finite.fintype hJ₀
                (Finset.univ : Finset I)
              let withCupL := fun j : I =>
                MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (n j)⁻¹
                  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
                    (cupProjection (left j.val L (hL j)) (right j.val L (hL j))
                      (dot j.val L (hL j)) (cupsL j))
                    (inclusion j.val L (hL j)))
              let withCupJ := fun j : I =>
                let S := Lj j.val
                let hS := full j.val
                MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
                  (cupProjection (left j.val S hS) (right j.val S hS) (dot j.val S hS) (cupsJ j))
                  (inclusion j.val S hS)
              let sumL : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
                ⟨indices, fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (withCupL j)⟩
              let sumJ : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
                ⟨indices, fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (withCupJ j)⟩
              sumL.eval = sumJ.eval ∧
              (∀ j : I, MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (withCupL j) = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (normalized j) ∧
                MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (withCupJ j) = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (usual j)))))
```

## TwoMackeySummandsWithSameInternalLabels: Two Mackey summands with the same internal labels

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For \(G=S_3\times C_2\), use the inclusions of
\(K=H=\langle(12)\rangle\times C_2\). The double cosets have
representatives \(1,((13),1)\), with \(L_1=K\) and
\(L_2=\{1\}\times C_2\). Their common group \(L=L_2\) is central,
so both pairs use the same internal strand labels. The first
pair has index \(2\), the second index \(1\).

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 5.1 [ex:mixed-two-common-intersection], p. 17. The published PDF matches the project PDF byte for byte, and the project TeX fixes the order of the crossings. The Lean statement uses zero-based permutation points, so the swaps on points 0 and 1 and on points 0 and 2 represent (12) and (13), respectively. It models the cyclic factor by the additive group of ZMod 2 written multiplicatively. Both crossing pairs use the same left internal embedding, and the two specified right conjugators induce the same right internal embedding.
