```lean
theorem TwoMackeySummandsWithSameInternalLabels : let U := Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) × Multiplicative (ZMod 2)
let G : Subgroup U := ⊤
let K : Subgroup U :=
  Subgroup.prod (Subgroup.zpowers (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1)) ⊤
let L : Subgroup U :=
  Subgroup.prod (⊥ : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))) ⊤
let s : U := (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 2, 1)
let intersectionAt := fun t : U =>
  K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj t)) K
let L₁ := intersectionAt 1
let L₂ := intersectionAt s
let j₁ := DoubleCoset.mk K K (1 : U)
let j₂ := DoubleCoset.mk K K s
let hLK : L ≤ K := Subgroup.prod_mono bot_le le_rfl
let commutes : ∀ (t : U) (x : L), (x : U) * t = t * (x : U) := by
  intro t x
  have hx : (x : U).1 = 1 := Subgroup.mem_bot.mp x.property.1
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (x : U).1 * t.1 = t.1 * (x : U).1
    rw [hx, one_mul, mul_one]
  · exact mul_comm (x : U).2 t.2
let conjOnL : ∀ (t : U) (x : L), t * (x : U) * t⁻¹ = (x : U) := by
  intro t x
  rw [← commutes t x, mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one]
let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) (1 : U)
  (fun k => Subgroup.mem_top _)
let inner := fun t : U =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L) (G := K) t (by
    intro x
    rw [conjOnL t x]
    exact hLK x.property)
let l := inner 1
let dot := fun t : U =>
  show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a l)
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (inner t⁻¹)) from
  ⟨⟨t, Subgroup.mem_top _⟩, by
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (1 : U) * ((1 : U) * (x : U) * (1 : U)⁻¹) * (1 : U)⁻¹ * t =
      t * ((1 : U) * (t⁻¹ * (x : U) * (t⁻¹)⁻¹) * (1 : U)⁻¹)
    simp only [conjOnL, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]
    exact commutes t x⟩
let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)
let pair := fun t : U =>
  let r := inner t⁻¹
  let d := dot t
  letI : Finite U := inferInstanceAs (Finite (Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) × Multiplicative (ZMod 2)))
  letI : Finite K := Finite.of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective
  letI : Finite (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction l) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction r)).carrier := by
    change Finite (Quotient (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.balance
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction l) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction r)))
    infer_instance
  show MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M from
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection a a l r d (fun _ => Set.toFinite _))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication a a l r d)
let straight : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M M :=
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a))
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
j₁ ≠ j₂ ∧
  (∀ j : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set U) (K : Set U), j = j₁ ∨ j = j₂) ∧
  L₁ = K ∧ L₂ = L ∧ L = L₁ ⊓ L₂ ∧
  L ≤ Subgroup.center U ∧ inner ((1 : U)⁻¹) = inner s⁻¹ ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex L L₁ = 2 ∧ Subgroup.relIndex L L₂ = 1 ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight =
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.add
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale ((1 : Complex) / 2) (pair 1)) (pair s))
```

## SinglePairCannotProjectOntoSeveralDoubleCosets: A single pair of crossings

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Use \(J,\sigma_j,L_j,M,M_j\) from Section~2.2.
The two boundary strands of \(M\) point in opposite directions,
with \(G\) between them. To allow a different middle group, take
\(\cg{a}{L}\le K\), \(\cg{b}{L}\le H\) and
\(s=\alpha a(\beta b)^{-1}\in G\). Use \(s,s^{-1}\) as the two
crossing labels and put
\[
 M_L=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L]}\C[H],\qquad
 L_s=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\cap(\cg{s\beta}{H}),\qquad
 n=[L_s:\cg{\alpha a}{L}].
\]
The tensor product has basis \(K\times_L H\), the classes \([k,h]\)
of pairs under \([ka\ell a^{-1},h]=[k,b\ell b^{-1}h]\),
\(\ell\in L\). The relation identifies exactly the pairs equated
by balancing the tensor product.

A composite \(M\to M_L\to M\) cannot project onto two or more
double cosets, even with arbitrary bimodule maps at the crossings.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 5.3 [prop:r2-mixed-obstruction], p. 17](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no correction for this proposition. The two arbitrary complex bimodule maps use the typed strand boundaries and their vertical composition. The projection keeps precisely the basis vectors whose double-coset classes belong to the selected set, which may be infinite. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem SinglePairCannotProjectOntoSeveralDoubleCosets : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G L : Subgroup U) (α β a b : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (ha : ∀ ℓ : L, a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹ ∈ K)
    (hb : ∀ ℓ : L, b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hs : (α * a) * (β * b)⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let ea := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator a ha
  let eb := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator b hb
  let d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα ea)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ eb) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * a) (β * b)
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change α * (a * (ℓ : U) * a⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
      (by
        intro ℓ
        change β * (b * (ℓ : U) * b⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc]) hs
  let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d
  let _returnLabel := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse d
  let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
  let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
    let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
    let Lj := fun j : J => conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
    let leftJ := fun j : J =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := K) α⁻¹
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
          change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          rw [← heq]
          change k ∈ K at hk
          convert hk using 1
          group)
    let rightJ := fun j : J =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := Lj j) (G := H)
        (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)
        (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
          change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          rw [← heq]
          change h ∈ H at hh
          convert hh using 1
          group)
    let _Mj := fun j : J =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (leftJ j))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (rightJ j))
    let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ)
    let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ea) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eb)
    let Ls := conjSubgroup α K ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
    let Limage := conjSubgroup (α * a) L
    let _n := ENat.card (Ls ⧸ Subgroup.subgroupOf Limage Ls)
    let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M
    let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML
    let projection := fun (selected : Set J) =>
      show (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.carrier X →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex]
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.carrier X →₀ Complex) from by
        classical
        exact MackeyDiagrams.freeLift Complex (fun z =>
          if DoubleCoset.mk A B (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ z) ∈ selected
          then Finsupp.single z 1 else 0)
    ∀ (selected : Set J), (∃ i ∈ selected, ∃ j ∈ selected, i ≠ j) →
      ∀ (p : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y)
        (ι : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex Y X),
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical p ι) ≠
          projection selected
```

## SinglePairIdentityCriterion: A single mixed pair gives the identity exactly for one double coset

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

The reverse cup is a map when \([H:\cg{b}{L}]<\infty\). At infinite
index the formula for \(p_L\) sums only the terms that survive the trace.
It still defines a map for finite \(n\). For infinite \(n\), the sum
on \(g\in j\) has infinite support.

A single pair can give \(\id_M\) only when \(|J|=1\). In that case
use the full Mackey intersection, with the same convention for
infinite index as above.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 5.1, after Proposition 5.3, p. 18](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem SinglePairIdentityCriterion : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let Hβ := conjSubgroup β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
      let L := fun j : J => Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let a := α⁻¹
      let b := fun j : J => β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹
      let left := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) a
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
            change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change k ∈ K at hk
            change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
            rw [← heq]
            convert hk using 1
            group)
      let right := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H) (b j)
          (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let crossingDot := fun {S : Subgroup U} (c d : U)
          (hc : ∀ ℓ : S, c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹ ∈ K)
          (hd : ∀ ℓ : S, d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ H)
          (hs : (α * c) * (β * d)⁻¹ ∈ G) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator c hc))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hd)) from
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * c) (β * d)
            (by
              intro ℓ
              change α * (c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
            (by
              intro ℓ
              change β * (d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
            hs
      let dot := fun j : J =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (left j))
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (right j)) from
          crossingDot a (b j)
            (fun ℓ => (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (left j) ℓ).property)
            (fun ℓ => (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (right j) ℓ).property)
            (by
              change (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ ∈ G
              have hs : (α * α⁻¹) * (β * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹))⁻¹ = (σ j : U) := by
                group
              rw [hs]
              exact (σ j).property)
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (left j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (right j))
      let W := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M
      let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))
      let eval := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
          (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
      (∀ (S : Subgroup U) (ec : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S K)
          (ed : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S H),
        let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ec) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ed)
        let WL := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML
        ∀ (p : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex W WL)
          (ι : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex WL W),
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical p ι = eval straight →
            ∃ j₀ : J, ∀ i : J, i = j₀) ∧
      (∀ (S : Subgroup U) (c d : U)
          (hc : ∀ ℓ : S, c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹ ∈ K)
          (hd : ∀ ℓ : S, d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ H)
          (hs : (α * c) * (β * d)⁻¹ ∈ G),
        let ec := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator c hc
        let ed := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hd
        let δ := crossingDot c d hc hd hs
        let s := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element δ
        let replyDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse δ
        let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up ec) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down ed)
        let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B s
        let Ls := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
        let finiteIndex := Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex (conjSubgroup (α * c) S) Ls
        let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ec ed δ
        let finiteFibers := ∀ z : W.carrier, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
        let cupFinite := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ed))
        let isTransversal := fun T : Set H => ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H,
          t ∈ T ∧ h * t⁻¹ ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ed)
        let traceArg := fun (g : G) (t : H) =>
          g * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ t)⁻¹ *
            (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element replyDot)
        let survives := fun (T : Set H) (g : G) =>
          {t | t ∈ T ∧ traceArg g t ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)}
        ((∀ h : H, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.multiplicationCapBasis ed w = h}) ↔ cupFinite) ∧
        (finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex) ∧
        (∀ (T : Set H), isTransversal T → ∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit j → ¬ finiteIndex →
          Set.Infinite (survives T g)) ∧
        (∀ hf : finiteFibers,
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M ML :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection eα eβ ec ed
              [(1, ⟨δ, hf⟩)] MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.cupAndMerge
              MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.splitAndTrace
          ∀ (T : Set H), isTransversal T → ∀ g : G,
            ∃ ht : Set.Finite (survives T g),
              MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval p)
                  (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) =
                Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset ht) (fun t =>
                  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ec) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction ed)
                    (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex eα (traceArg g t))
                    (Finsupp.single t 1)))) ∧
      (∀ j : J, (∀ i : J, i = j) →
        ∃ hf : ∀ z : W.carrier,
            Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ
              (left j) (right j) (dot j) w = z},
          let p : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ (left j) (right j)
              [(1, ⟨dot j, hf⟩)]
          let ι : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) M :=
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ (left j) (right j)
              [(1, dot j)]
          eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical p ι) = eval straight)
```

## ParallelInductionProductDotAdmissibility: Admissibility of the product and return dots in parallel induction

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

The bottom, middle, and top chains through \(H,B,H'\) have
composite conjugators \(u=\alpha\beta\), \(v=\gamma\delta\),
and \(w=\alpha'\beta'\).

Two induction crossings labelled \(d,e\), read bottom to top, equal
a merge, a dot \(de\) from \(\bar u\) to \(\bar w\), and a split.
For \(de=1\) the merged labels agree and the dot disappears.
The remaining map is the identity if both boundary sequences agree.
Each group-element label \(d\) has an admissible return label \(d^{-1}\).

The three merges identify the tensor products with copies of
\(\C[G]\), with right actions through \(u_*,v_*,w_*\).
The split and merge on the middle product cancel, leaving
\(x\mapsto xd\mapsto xde\).
For group-element dots \(u^{-1}dv\) and \(v^{-1}ew\) centralize
\(K\), so their product \(u^{-1}de\,w\) does too. The same test
applies to each product of terms in linear labels.
If \(de=1\), then \(u^{-1}w\in C_U(K)\), so the merged strand
stays the same through the dot. If the boundaries agree, the
top split inverts the bottom merge.
Finally \(v^{-1}d^{-1}u=(u^{-1}dv)^{-1}\) proves admissibility
for the return dot. Both products of \(d,d^{-1}\) equal \(1\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 5.2, proof of Theorem 5.4, p. 18](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem ParallelInductionProductDotAdmissibility : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G K H B H' : Subgroup U)
    (α β γ δ α' β' : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hγ : ∀ b : B, γ * (b : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ B)
    (hα' : ∀ h : H', α' * (h : U) * (α')⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ k : K, β' * (k : U) * (β')⁻¹ ∈ H'),
  let u := α * β
  let v := γ * δ
  let w := α' * β'
  let bottom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα)
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ)
  let middle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ)
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ)
  let top := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α' hα')
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β' hβ')
  let C := Subgroup.centralizer (K : Set U)
  (∀ (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom middle) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot middle top),
    let de := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element e
    (∃ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom top, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p = de) ∧
    u⁻¹ * (de : U) * w ∈ C ∧
    (de = 1 → bottom = top)) ∧
  (∀ d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom middle,
    ∃ r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot middle bottom,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r = (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d)⁻¹ ∧
      v⁻¹ * (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r : U) * u ∈ C ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical d r = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id bottom ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical r d = MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id middle)
```

```lean
theorem ParallelReidemeisterTwoInduction : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G K H B H' : Subgroup U)
    (α β γ δ α' β' : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hγ : ∀ b : B, γ * (b : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ B)
    (hα' : ∀ h : H', α' * (h : U) * (α')⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ k : K, β' * (k : U) * (β')⁻¹ ∈ H'),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let c := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α' hα'
  let b' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β' hβ'
  let bottom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let middle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp c d
  let top := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'
  let bottomWord := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
  let middleWord := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d)
  let topWord := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a') (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
  let evalDrawing {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word G K}
      (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let singleton {p q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot p q) :
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex p q :=
    Finsupp.single dot (1 : Complex)
  let lowerCrossing (label : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom middle) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms label)
  let upperCrossing (label : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex middle top) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms label)
  let bottomMerge :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b)
  let topSplit :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a' b')
  let mergeSplit (strand : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up bottom) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up top)) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical bottomMerge strand) topSplit
  let unitCancellation (product : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom top) : Prop :=
    ∃ sameLabel : bottom = top,
      let straight := Eq.ndrec
        (motive := fun label => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up bottom) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up label))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up bottom)))
        sameLabel
      let dotFree := mergeSplit straight
      evalDrawing (mergeSplit (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing product)) = evalDrawing dotFree ∧
      ∀ sameBoundary : bottomWord = topWord,
        let identity := Eq.ndrec
          (motive := fun word => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottomWord word)
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id bottomWord)) sameBoundary
        evalDrawing dotFree = evalDrawing identity
  (∀ (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom middle) (y : MackeyDiagrams.Dot middle top),
    let product := singleton (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical x y)
    let twoCrossings := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (lowerCrossing (singleton x)) (upperCrossing (singleton y))
    evalDrawing twoCrossings = evalDrawing (mergeSplit (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing product)) ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y = 1 → unitCancellation product)) ∧
  (∀ (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom middle)
      (y : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex middle top),
    let product := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose x y
    let twoCrossings := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (lowerCrossing x) (upperCrossing y)
    evalDrawing twoCrossings = evalDrawing (mergeSplit (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing product)) ∧
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (a := bottom) (b := top)) product =
      Finsupp.single (1 : G) (1 : Complex) → unitCancellation product)) ∧
  (∀ x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottom middle,
    ∃ y : MackeyDiagrams.Dot middle bottom,
      let forward := lowerCrossing (singleton x)
      let backward : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex middleWord bottomWord :=
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a b
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms (singleton y))
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y = (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x)⁻¹ ∧
      evalDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical forward backward) =
        evalDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id bottomWord)) ∧
      evalDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical backward forward) =
        evalDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id middleWord)))
```

## ParallelReidemeisterTwoRestriction: Parallel Reidemeister II for restriction

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

The bottom, middle, and top chains through \(H,B,H'\) have
composite conjugators \(u=\alpha\beta\), \(v=\gamma\delta\),
and \(w=\alpha'\beta'\).

For two restriction strands, the group-element labels act on the
left, giving \(x\mapsto d^{-1}x\mapsto e^{-1}d^{-1}x=(de)^{-1}x\).
The product label is again \(de\), including for linear labels by
expansion in group elements.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 5.2, unnumbered, p. 18](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 5.2, unnumbered, p. 18. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered page and project TikZ give the bottom, middle, and top chains through H, B, and H′. The restriction paragraph gives the corresponding inverse left action and the ordered product de, extended termwise to linear labels. The article webpage reproduces the paragraph. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the drawing syntax. Two typed parallel restriction crossings carry one eligible finite complex label each, and the trivalent merge and split surround one marked product dot. The group-element case uses coefficient-one singleton labels. Lean elaborated the proposition and verified that erasure preserves both crossing marks and the product mark for arbitrary labels, including zero, through the shared compilation slot.

```lean
theorem ParallelReidemeisterTwoRestriction : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (K H B H' G : Subgroup U)
    (α β γ δ α' β' : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ k : K, β * (k : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hγ : ∀ b : B, γ * (b : U) * γ⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ B)
    (hα' : ∀ h : H', α' * (h : U) * (α')⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ k : K, β' * (k : U) * (β')⁻¹ ∈ H'),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let c := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator γ hγ
  let f := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α' hα'
  let b' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β' hβ'
  let u := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let v := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp c f
  let w := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'
  let evalDrawing {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K G}
      (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let singleton {p q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G} (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot p q) :
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex p q :=
    Finsupp.single d 1
  let twoCrossings (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u v)
      (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex v w) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown a b c f (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms D))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown c f a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms E))
  let mergeDotSplit (label : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u w) :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
        (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown a b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing label)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown a' b')))
  (∀ (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot u v) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot v w),
    let dNode := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton d)
    let eNode := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing (singleton e)
    let product := singleton (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical d e)
    evalDrawing (twoCrossings (singleton d) (singleton e)) = evalDrawing (mergeDotSplit product) ∧
    (∀ x : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
      let first := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evalDrawing dNode) (MonoidAlgebra.coeff x)
      let second := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evalDrawing eNode) first
      let dInv : MonoidAlgebra Complex G := MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d)⁻¹ 1
      let eInv : MonoidAlgebra Complex G := MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element e)⁻¹ 1
      first = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (dInv * x) ∧
      second = MonoidAlgebra.coeff (eInv * (dInv * x)) ∧
      second = MonoidAlgebra.coeff
        (MonoidAlgebra.single ((MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d) * (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element e))⁻¹ 1 * x))) ∧
  (∀ (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u v) (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex v w),
    evalDrawing (twoCrossings D E) =
      evalDrawing (mergeDotSplit (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose D E)))
```

## StandardSymmetricGroupBraidRelation: Three-upward-strand braid relation for standard symmetric-group inclusions

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For the standard inclusions \(S_n\subset S_{n+1}\), Khovanov obtains
the three-upward-strand braid relation from the relation for adjacent
transpositions [5, Prop.~7].

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.1, attributed to Khovanov [5, Prop. 7], p. 19](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.1, p. 19, citing Khovanov [5, Prop. 7]. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The endpoint compares the evaluations over ℂ of the two three-upward-strand composites on Sₙ ⊂ Sₙ₊₁ ⊂ Sₙ₊₂ ⊂ Sₙ₊₃. Each embedded subgroup fixes the points outside its initial segment. The crossings on the left and right pairs carry the respective adjacent-transposition dots sₙ₊₂ and sₙ₊₁, with bottom-to-top composition. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

Khovanov’s Proposition 7 and its figure specify these crossings. The natural-number index covers the symmetric-group chains, including S₀. Khovanov assigns zero to diagrams with a negative region label. https://arxiv.org/abs/1009.3295

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction for this endpoint was available. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The exact Lean proposition elaborated through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem StandardSymmetricGroupBraidRelation : ∀ n : Nat,
  let X := Fin (n + 3)
  let U := Equiv.Perm X
  let S := fun m : Nat => fixingSubgroup U {i : X | m ≤ i.val}
  let G : Subgroup U := ⊤
  let H := S (n + 2)
  let J := S (n + 1)
  let F := S n
  let nested : ∀ {m k : Nat}, m ≤ k → S m ≤ S k := fun h _ hp =>
    (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff U).mpr
      (fun i hi => (mem_fixingSubgroup_iff U).mp hp i (Nat.le_trans h hi))
  let inclusion : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, A ≤ B → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B :=
    fun h => ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩
  let a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G := inclusion le_top
  let b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J H := inclusion (nested (Nat.le_succ (n + 1)))
  let c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F J := inclusion (nested (Nat.le_succ n))
  let p := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let q := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
  let r := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c
  let word := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor p q) r
  let i : X := ⟨n, by omega⟩
  let j : X := ⟨n + 1, by omega⟩
  let k : X := ⟨n + 2, by omega⟩
  let leftSwap : U := Equiv.swap j k
  let rightSwap : U := Equiv.swap i j
  let ab := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
  let bc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c
  ∃ (leftDot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ab ab) (rightDot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc bc),
    (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element leftDot : U) = leftSwap ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element rightDot : U) = rightSwap ∧
    let cross := fun {A B C : Subgroup U}
        (upper : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
        (lower : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B)
        (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp upper lower)
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp upper lower)) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) upper lower)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot dot)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp upper lower))
    let leftCrossing : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex word word :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (cross a b leftDot) (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id r)
    let rightCrossing : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex word word :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p) (cross b c rightDot))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q r))
    let rightLeftRight :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical rightCrossing
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical leftCrossing rightCrossing)
    let leftRightLeft :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical leftCrossing
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical rightCrossing leftCrossing)
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval rightLeftRight = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval leftRightLeft
```

Let \(\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) be the admissible labellings of the left
and right shapes at this boundary. A labelling specifies the middle
group, the three interior strand cosets, and the three crossing
dots. Each crossing merges, applies its dot, and splits. A dot
can be a finite \(\C\)-linear combination of the group elements
allowed between the two merged strand labels.

Write \(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)\) for the resulting map from the
bottom tensor product to the top one. Within each shape let
\(\mathsf D\sim\mathsf E\) mean
\(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)=\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf E)\), and write
\([\mathsf D]\) for the equivalence class of \(\mathsf D\).

\paragraph{Multipliers.}
Choose boundary representatives and put
\[
 u=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 v=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
Merging the bottom and top products gives \(\C[G]\) with right
\(\C[F]\)-actions through \(u_*,v_*\). Every left \(\C[G]\)-linear map
is right multiplication by its value at \(1\), denoted \(m(\mathsf D)\).
At the fixed boundary, equality of these values is equality of maps.

For a single
\(p\in G\), the right \(\C[F]\)-linearity condition is
\[
 u f u^{-1}p=p v f v^{-1}\quad(f\in F)
 \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad u^{-1}pv\in C_U(F).
\]
At a crossing of the left pair, let \(\lambda_*,\mu_*\) be the
incoming and outgoing merged embeddings into \(G\), and let \(d\)
be the dot. Merging with the third strand after applying the dot
gives \(zd\mu_*(w)=z\lambda_*(w)d\), so the multiplier is \(d\).
At a crossing of the right pair, the left embedding \(\gamma_*\)
sends the dot to \(\gamma_*(d)\) because
\(z\gamma_*(wd)=z\gamma_*(w)\gamma_*(d)\). Hence the multipliers are
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 \text{left}\quad &x_1(\boxed{GB})_*(x_2)x_3,\\
 \text{right}\quad &(\boxed{GA})_*(y_1)y_2(\boxed{GC})_*(y_3).
 \end{aligned}
\]
Expand the three labels into group elements. Each triple gives a
bimodule map whose multiplier is a single group element \(p\).
Thus \(u^{-1}pv\in C_U(F)\) for every \(p\) in the support of \(m\),
the group elements with nonzero coefficient.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.1, proof of Lemma 6.1, pp. 19–20](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem ThreeInductionCrossingMultipliers : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF : U)
    (hGA : ∀ a : A, repGA * (a : U) * repGA⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hAD : ∀ d : D, repAD * (d : U) * repAD⁻¹ ∈ A)
    (hDF : ∀ f : F, repDF * (f : U) * repDF⁻¹ ∈ D)
    (hGC : ∀ c : C, repGC * (c : U) * repGC⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hCE : ∀ e : E, repCE * (e : U) * repCE⁻¹ ∈ C)
    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGA hGA
  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD
  let df := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repDF hDF
  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC
  let ce := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repCE hCE
  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF
  let u := repGA * repAD * repDF
  let v := repGC * repCE * repEF
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let bottomEmbedding := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bottomPair df
  let topEmbedding := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp topPair ef
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)
  let bottom := word ga ad df
  let top := word gc ce ef
  let straight := fun {P Q : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
  let merge := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b)
  let split := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a b)
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (split bottomPair df)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (split ga ad) (straight df))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (merge gc ce) (straight ef))
      (merge topPair ef)
  let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))
  let multiplier := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    mergedEvaluation drawing 1
  let along := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
  let dotValue := fun {H K : Subgroup U} {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K}
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex a b) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (a := a) (b := b)) weights)
  let allowed := fun p : G => u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (F : Set U)
  let realizes := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (formula : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    multiplier drawing = formula ∧
      ∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support (MonoidAlgebra.coeff (multiplier drawing)), allowed p
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (merge a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing weights)
        (split a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (straight c)
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (straight a)
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c'))))
  (∀ f : F,
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bottomEmbedding f : U) = u * (f : U) * u⁻¹ ∧
    (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom topEmbedding f : U) = v * (f : U) * v⁻¹) ∧
  (∀ (map : LinearMap (RingHom.id (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)) (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)
      (MonoidAlgebra Complex G)) (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G),
    map z = z * map 1) ∧
  (∀ (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G),
    mergedEvaluation drawing z = z * multiplier drawing) ∧
  (∀ d e : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top,
    evaluate d = evaluate e ↔ multiplier d = multiplier e) ∧
  (∀ p : G,
    let rightMul := fun z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G => z * MonoidAlgebra.single p 1
    let rightLinear := ∀ (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) (r : MonoidAlgebra Complex F),
      rightMul (z * along bottomEmbedding r) = rightMul z * along topEmbedding r
    let intertwines := ∀ f : F,
      (u * (f : U) * u⁻¹) * (p : U) = (p : U) * (v * (f : U) * v⁻¹)
    (rightLinear ↔ intertwines) ∧ (intertwines ↔ allowed p)) ∧
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
      (x₂ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef))
      (x₃ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair),
    let left := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂) (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
    realizes left (dotValue x₁ * along gb (dotValue x₂) * dotValue x₃)) ∧
  (∀ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (y₁ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f))
      (y₂ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab')
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb'))
      (y₃ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)),
    let right := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂) (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
    realizes right (along ga (dotValue y₁) * dotValue y₂ * along gc (dotValue y₃)))
```

Let \(\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) be the admissible labellings of the left
and right shapes at this boundary. A labelling specifies the middle
group, the three interior strand cosets, and the three crossing
dots. Each crossing merges, applies its dot, and splits. A dot
can be a finite \(\C\)-linear combination of the group elements
allowed between the two merged strand labels.

Write \(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)\) for the resulting map from the
bottom tensor product to the top one. Within each shape let
\(\mathsf D\sim\mathsf E\) mean
\(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)=\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf E)\), and write
\([\mathsf D]\) for the equivalence class of \(\mathsf D\).

\paragraph{Multipliers.}
Choose boundary representatives and put
\[
 u=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 v=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
Merging the bottom and top products gives \(\C[G]\) with right
\(\C[F]\)-actions through \(u_*,v_*\). Every left \(\C[G]\)-linear map
is right multiplication by its value at \(1\), denoted \(m(\mathsf D)\).
At the fixed boundary, equality of these values is equality of maps.

At the fixed boundary there are constructions \(\phi:\mathcal L\to\mathcal R\)
and \(\psi:\mathcal R\to\mathcal L\) preserving the multiplier of every
input diagram. Their two round trips satisfy
\[
 m(\psi(\phi(\mathsf D)))=m(\mathsf D)\quad(\mathsf D\in\mathcal L),
 \qquad
 m(\phi(\psi(\mathsf D)))=m(\mathsf D)\quad(\mathsf D\in\mathcal R).
\]

Given a left-hand diagram with multiplier \(m\), choose the right-hand
internal group \(B'=F\) and take
\[
 \boxed{B'F}=1,\qquad
 \boxed{AB'}=\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 \boxed{CB'}=\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
The outer vertices compare equal embeddings into \(A\) and \(C\),
so take \(y_1=y_3=1\). At the middle vertex, \(pv\) represents
\(\bar u\) for every \(p\) in the support of \(m\), since \(u^{-1}pv\in C_U(F)\).
Using \(v\) for the outgoing label gives the dot
\((pv)v^{-1}=p\). Thus \(y_2=m\) is allowed and gives multiplier \(m\).

Given a right-hand diagram with multiplier \(m\), choose the left-hand
internal group \(B=G\) and take
\[
 \boxed{GB}=1,\qquad
 \boxed{BD}=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD},\qquad
 \boxed{BE}=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}.
\]
The outer vertices compare equal embeddings of \(D\) and \(E\)
into \(G\), so take \(x_1=x_3=1\). The middle vertex compares
\(u_*,v_*\) into \(B=G\). The same representatives \(pv,v\)
allow \(x_2=m\). The left strand is the inclusion \(G\to G\),
so the multiplier is \(m\).

```lean
theorem MultipliersUnderRelabelling : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF : U)
    (hGA : ∀ a : A, repGA * (a : U) * repGA⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hAD : ∀ d : D, repAD * (d : U) * repAD⁻¹ ∈ A)
    (hDF : ∀ f : F, repDF * (f : U) * repDF⁻¹ ∈ D)
    (hGC : ∀ c : C, repGC * (c : U) * repGC⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hCE : ∀ e : E, repCE * (e : U) * repCE⁻¹ ∈ C)
    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGA hGA
  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD
  let df := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repDF hDF
  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC
  let ce := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repCE hCE
  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)
  let bottom := word ga ad df
  let top := word gc ce ef
  let straight := fun {P Q : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
  let merge := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b)
  let split := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a b)
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (split bottomPair df)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (split ga ad) (straight df))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (merge gc ce) (straight ef))
      (merge topPair ef)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))
  let multiplier := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    mergedEvaluation drawing 1
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (merge a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing weights)
        (split a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (straight c)
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (straight a)
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c'))))
  let LeftLabels :=
    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair
  let RightLabels :=
    Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab') (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb') ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)
  let leftDiagram : LeftLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂)
          (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
  let rightDiagram : RightLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
          (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
  let leftMultiplier := fun d : LeftLabels => multiplier (leftDiagram d)
  let rightMultiplier := fun d : RightLabels => multiplier (rightDiagram d)
  ∃ (φ : LeftLabels → RightLabels) (ψ : RightLabels → LeftLabels),
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, rightMultiplier (φ d) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ d : RightLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ d) = rightMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ (φ d)) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ d : RightLabels, rightMultiplier (φ (ψ d)) = rightMultiplier d)
```

## ThreeInductionReidemeisterThree: Reidemeister III

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

All strands point up. For adjacent groups \(X,Y\le U\),
\(\boxed{XY}\) represents the label \(\boxed{XY}C_U(Y)\).

Let \(\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) be the admissible labellings of the left
and right shapes at this boundary. A labelling specifies the middle
group, the three interior strand cosets, and the three crossing
dots. Each crossing merges, applies its dot, and splits. A dot
can be a finite \(\C\)-linear combination of the group elements
allowed between the two merged strand labels.

Write \(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)\) for the resulting map from the
bottom tensor product to the top one. Within each shape let
\(\mathsf D\sim\mathsf E\) mean
\(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)=\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf E)\), and write
\([\mathsf D]\) for the equivalence class of \(\mathsf D\).

\paragraph{Multipliers.}
Choose boundary representatives and put
\[
 u=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 v=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
Merging the bottom and top products gives \(\C[G]\) with right
\(\C[F]\)-actions through \(u_*,v_*\). Every left \(\C[G]\)-linear map
is right multiplication by its value at \(1\), denoted \(m(\mathsf D)\).
At the fixed boundary, equality of these values is equality of maps.

At the fixed boundary, the constructions of Lemma~6.1
induce mutually inverse bijections
\[
 \mathcal L/{\sim}\longrightarrow\mathcal R/{\sim},
 \quad [\mathsf D]\longmapsto[\phi(\mathsf D)],
 \qquad
 \mathcal R/{\sim}\longrightarrow\mathcal L/{\sim},
 \quad [\mathsf D]\longmapsto[\psi(\mathsf D)].
\]
The induced maps are independent of the internal labellings chosen
in any construction preserving the boundary and evaluated map.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 6.2 [thm:reidemeister-three], p. 20 (related source excerpts on pp. 19–20)](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.1, Theorem 6.2 [thm:reidemeister-three], p. 20, with the fixed boundary and two shapes on p. 19. The published PDF is byte-identical to the project copy. The six strand cosets are represented by their induced conjugation embeddings. The quotient relations use equality of evaluated maps, and the two independence clauses apply to every admissible replacement at the fixed boundary with the same evaluation. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=20

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the marked syntax. Each crossing uses a typed trivalent merge, one DotLabel.upDrawing with a finitely supported label on termwise eligible elements, and a typed trivalent split. Lean elaborated the exact proposition through the shared compilation slot and verified that the two composites have left–right–left and right–left–right crossing orders from bottom to top, with one mark per crossing for every label, including zero.

The designated defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no correction to Theorem 6.2. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ThreeInductionReidemeisterThree : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E : Subgroup U)
    (repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF : U)
    (hGA : ∀ a : A, repGA * (a : U) * repGA⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hAD : ∀ d : D, repAD * (d : U) * repAD⁻¹ ∈ A)
    (hDF : ∀ f : F, repDF * (f : U) * repDF⁻¹ ∈ D)
    (hGC : ∀ c : C, repGC * (c : U) * repGC⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hCE : ∀ e : E, repCE * (e : U) * repCE⁻¹ ∈ C)
    (hEF : ∀ f : F, repEF * (f : U) * repEF⁻¹ ∈ E),
  let ga := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGA hGA
  let ad := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repAD hAD
  let df := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repDF hDF
  let gc := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repGC hGC
  let ce := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repCE hCE
  let ef := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator repEF hEF
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)
  let bottom := word ga ad df
  let top := word gc ce ef
  let straight := fun {P Q : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
  let merge := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b)
  let split := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a b)
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (split bottomPair df)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (split ga ad) (straight df))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (merge gc ce) (straight ef))
      (merge topPair ef)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))
  let multiplier := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    mergedEvaluation drawing 1
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (merge a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing weights)
        (split a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (straight c)
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (straight a)
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c'))))
  let LeftLabels :=
    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair
  let RightLabels :=
    Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad df) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab') (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb') ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)
  let leftDiagram : LeftLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂)
          (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
  let rightDiagram : RightLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
          (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
  let leftMultiplier := fun d : LeftLabels => multiplier (leftDiagram d)
  let rightMultiplier := fun d : RightLabels => multiplier (rightDiagram d)
  let leftEval := fun d : LeftLabels => MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (leftDiagram d))
  let rightEval := fun d : RightLabels => MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (rightDiagram d))
  let leftSetoid := Setoid.ker leftEval
  let rightSetoid := Setoid.ker rightEval
  ∃ (φ : LeftLabels → RightLabels) (ψ : RightLabels → LeftLabels)
    (classes : Equiv (Quotient leftSetoid) (Quotient rightSetoid)),
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, rightMultiplier (φ d) = leftMultiplier d) ∧
    (∀ e : RightLabels, leftMultiplier (ψ e) = rightMultiplier e) ∧
    (∀ d : LeftLabels, classes (Quotient.mk leftSetoid d) = Quotient.mk rightSetoid (φ d)) ∧
    (∀ e : RightLabels,
      Equiv.symm classes (Quotient.mk rightSetoid e) = Quotient.mk leftSetoid (ψ e)) ∧
    (∀ (d : LeftLabels) (e : RightLabels), rightEval e = leftEval d →
      classes (Quotient.mk leftSetoid d) = Quotient.mk rightSetoid e) ∧
    (∀ (e : RightLabels) (d : LeftLabels), leftEval d = rightEval e →
      Equiv.symm classes (Quotient.mk rightSetoid e) = Quotient.mk leftSetoid d)
```

## ThreeInductionLabelsChangeOnRoundTrip: A round trip with different labels

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

All strands point up. For adjacent groups \(X,Y\le U\),
\(\boxed{XY}\) represents the label \(\boxed{XY}C_U(Y)\).
Fix the six outer groups and the six boundary strand labels shown
below.

```latex
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,decorations.markings}
```

Let \(\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) be the admissible labellings of the left
and right shapes at this boundary. A labelling specifies the middle
group, the three interior strand cosets, and the three crossing
dots. Each crossing merges, applies its dot, and splits. A dot
can be a finite \(\C\)-linear combination of the group elements
allowed between the two merged strand labels.

Write \(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)\) for the resulting map from the
bottom tensor product to the top one. Within each shape let
\(\mathsf D\sim\mathsf E\) mean
\(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)=\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf E)\), and write
\([\mathsf D]\) for the equivalence class of \(\mathsf D\).

\paragraph{Multipliers.}
Choose boundary representatives and put
\[
 u=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 v=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
Merging the bottom and top products gives \(\C[G]\) with right
\(\C[F]\)-actions through \(u_*,v_*\). Every left \(\C[G]\)-linear map
is right multiplication by its value at \(1\), denoted \(m(\mathsf D)\).
At the fixed boundary, equality of these values is equality of maps.

Take every group to be \(C_2=\{1,g\}\) and every strand to carry the
identity embedding. The left diagram \(\mathsf D\) with dots \((g,1,g)\)
has multiplier \(g^2=1\). Its round trip \(\mathsf D'=\psi(\phi(\mathsf D))\)
has dots \((1,1,1)\). Both diagrams give the identity bimodule map.
Since \(\phi\) uses only the multiplier at this boundary,
\(\phi(\mathsf D)=\phi(\mathsf D')\). One return rule cannot recover
both inputs. Starting on the right gives the same obstruction for \(\psi\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 6.1 [ex:induction-round-trip], p. 21 (related source excerpts on pp. 19, 21)](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 6.1 [ex:induction-round-trip], p. 21. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered diagrams on p. 19 and project TikZ give the left–right–left and right–left–right crossing orders from bottom to top. The proposition specializes the constructions of Lemma 6.1 to the fixed C₂ identity boundary. It retains the changed round-trip labels, equality to the identity bimodule map, and the obstruction to recovering both inputs in each direction. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=21

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the Lean representation. Each crossing has a typed trivalent merge, one DotLabel.upDrawing mark carrying a finite complex label of termwise eligible group elements, and a typed trivalent split. Both LabelledDrawing composites are interpreted to compare their evaluated maps. Lean checked the exact type and both planar crossing orders with arbitrary labels through the shared compilation slot.

The designated defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction for Example 6.1 was available. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ThreeInductionLabelsChangeOnRoundTrip : let U := Multiplicative (ZMod 2)
let G : Subgroup U := ⊤
let g : G := ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2), Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
let e := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id G
let ee := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp e e
let w := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up e
let boundary := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor w w) w
let Weights := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex a b
let LeftLabels :=
  Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
    (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B),
    Weights ee (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd) ×
    Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd e) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be e) ×
    Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) ee
let RightLabels :=
  Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' G)
    (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' G) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B'),
    Weights ee (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f) ×
    Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp e ab') (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp e cb') ×
    Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f) ee
let straight := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
let mergeUp := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b)
let splitUp := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
    (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a b)
let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
    (d : Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (mergeUp a b)
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing d)
      (splitUp a' b'))
let crossLeft := fun {Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
    (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' G) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G S)
    (d : Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' d)
    (straight c)
let crossRight := fun {Q S S' : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q G)
    (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G S)
    (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G S')
    (d : Weights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (straight a)
        (crossing b c b' c' d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b') (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c'))))
let leftDiagram : LeftLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex boundary boundary :=
  fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft e e gb bd e x₁)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd e be e x₂)
        (crossLeft gb be e e e x₃))
let rightDiagram : RightLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex boundary boundary :=
  fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight e e e ab' b'f y₁)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft e ab' e cb' b'f y₂)
        (crossRight e cb' b'f e e y₃))
let merge :=
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (mergeUp e e) (straight e))
    (mergeUp ee e)
let split :=
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (splitUp ee e)
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (splitUp e e) (straight e))
let evaluate := fun {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word G G}
    (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
let multiplier := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex boundary boundary) =>
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
    (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      (evaluate
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical split
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing merge)))
      (Finsupp.single (1 : G) 1))
let selfDot : G → MackeyDiagrams.Dot ee ee := fun p =>
  ⟨p, fun h => mul_comm (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ee h) p⟩
let oneDot : Weights ee ee := Finsupp.single (selfDot 1) 1
let gDot : Weights ee ee := Finsupp.single (selfDot g) 1
let middleDot := fun (m : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
  Finsupp.mapDomain selfDot (MonoidAlgebra.coeff m)
let φ : LeftLabels → RightLabels := fun d =>
  ⟨G, e, e, e, oneDot, middleDot (multiplier (leftDiagram d)), oneDot⟩
let ψ : RightLabels → LeftLabels := fun d =>
  ⟨G, e, e, e, oneDot, middleDot (multiplier (rightDiagram d)), oneDot⟩
let left : LeftLabels := ⟨G, e, e, e, gDot, oneDot, gDot⟩
let leftOne : LeftLabels := ⟨G, e, e, e, oneDot, oneDot, oneDot⟩
let right : RightLabels := ⟨G, e, e, e, gDot, oneDot, gDot⟩
let rightOne : RightLabels := ⟨G, e, e, e, oneDot, oneDot, oneDot⟩
let identity := evaluate (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
  (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) boundary))
g ≠ 1 ∧ g ^ 2 = 1 ∧
  multiplier (leftDiagram left) = 1 ∧
  ψ (φ left) = leftOne ∧ left ≠ leftOne ∧
  evaluate (leftDiagram left) = identity ∧
  evaluate (leftDiagram leftOne) = identity ∧
  φ left = φ leftOne ∧
  (∀ recover : RightLabels → LeftLabels,
    ¬ (recover (φ left) = left ∧ recover (φ leftOne) = leftOne)) ∧
  multiplier (rightDiagram right) = 1 ∧
  φ (ψ right) = rightOne ∧ right ≠ rightOne ∧
  evaluate (rightDiagram right) = identity ∧
  evaluate (rightDiagram rightOne) = identity ∧
  ψ right = ψ rightOne ∧
  (∀ recover : LeftLabels → RightLabels,
    ¬ (recover (ψ right) = right ∧ recover (ψ rightOne) = rightOne))
```
