## AlternativeThreeInductionInternalGroups: Other choices of internal group for three inductions

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

All strands point up. For adjacent groups \(X,Y\le U\),
\(\boxed{XY}\) represents the label \(\boxed{XY}C_U(Y)\).
Fix the six outer groups and the six boundary strand labels shown
below.

Let \(\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) be the admissible labellings of the left
and right shapes at this boundary. A labelling specifies the middle
group, the three interior strand cosets, and the three crossing
dots. Each crossing merges, applies its dot, and splits. A dot
can be a finite \(\C\)-linear combination of the group elements
allowed between the two merged strand labels.

Write \(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)\) for the resulting map from the
bottom tensor product to the top one. Within each shape let
\(\mathsf D\sim\mathsf E\) mean
\(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)=\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf E)\), and write
\([\mathsf D]\) for the equivalence class of \(\mathsf D\).

\paragraph{Multipliers.}
Choose boundary representatives and put
\[
 u=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 v=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
Merging the bottom and top products gives \(\C[G]\) with right
\(\C[F]\)-actions through \(u_*,v_*\). Every left \(\C[G]\)-linear map
is right multiplication by its value at \(1\), denoted \(m(\mathsf D)\).
At the fixed boundary, equality of these values is equality of maps.

For \(\psi\) one may use any \(B\le G\) containing
\(\cg{\boxed{GA}}{A}\), \(\cg{\boxed{GC}}{C}\), and all group elements
with nonzero coefficient in \(m\). The outer embeddings still agree
and the inclusion sends \(m\in \C[B]\) to the same multiplier.

For \(\phi\) with group-element labels, choose representatives at
each crossing. A representative \(\alpha\beta c\) of a composite
coset factors as \(\alpha(\beta c)\), so the choices can be made on
the strands themselves. This gives
\begin{align*}
 x_1&=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{BD}^{-1}\boxed{GB}^{-1},\\
 x_2&=\boxed{BD}'\boxed{DF}\boxed{EF}^{-1}\boxed{BE}^{-1},\\
 x_3&=\boxed{GB}'\boxed{BE}'\boxed{CE}^{-1}\boxed{GC}^{-1}.
\end{align*}
Primes denote other representatives of the same internal labels.
Each boundary strand meets one vertex, so use its chosen
representative in \(u,v\). Both \(\boxed{GB}\) and \(\boxed{GB}'\)
act the same way on \(B\). For
\(p=x_1\boxed{GB}x_2\boxed{GB}^{-1}x_3\), cancellation gives
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 u^{-1}pv={}&
 \bigl(\boxed{DF}^{-1}\boxed{BD}^{-1}\boxed{BD}'\boxed{DF}\bigr)\\
 &{}\cdot
 \bigl(\boxed{EF}^{-1}\boxed{BE}^{-1}\boxed{GB}^{-1}
       \boxed{GB}'\boxed{BE}'\boxed{EF}\bigr).
 \end{aligned}
\]
The first factor centralizes \(\cg{\boxed{DF}^{-1}}{D}\).
In the second, \(\boxed{GB}^{-1}\boxed{GB}'\) centralizes
\(B\), which contains \(\cg{\boxed{BE}}{E}\), and
\(\boxed{BE}^{-1}\boxed{BE}'\) centralizes \(E\). Thus the
second factor centralizes \(\cg{\boxed{EF}^{-1}}{E}\).
Both factors centralize
\[
 B''=\cg{\boxed{DF}^{-1}}{D}\cap\cg{\boxed{EF}^{-1}}{E}.
\]
It contains \(F\). Take \(B'=\cg{\tau}{B''}\) for any \(\tau\in U\)
and use
\[
 \boxed{B'F}=\tau,\qquad
 \boxed{AB'}=\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF}\tau^{-1},\qquad
 \boxed{CB'}=\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}\tau^{-1}.
\]
The inclusions in the definition of \(B''\) and \(F\le B''\)
give these three embeddings. The outer composites agree, so
\(y_1=y_3=1\). At the middle vertex
\((u\tau^{-1})^{-1}p(v\tau^{-1})=\tau(u^{-1}pv)\tau^{-1}\)
centralizes \(B'\), so \(y_2=p\) gives the original multiplier.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.1, Other choices of internal group, p. 21](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
    (ga : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (ad : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (df : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (gc : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (ce : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (ef : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>

  let split := fun {P Q S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>

  let mergeTop :=

  let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let mergedEvaluation := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G) =>
    MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom

        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z))

  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}

      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)

    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (merge a b)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing weights)
        (split a' b'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (crossing a b a' b' weights)
      (straight c)
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
      (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary

      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (straight a)
          (crossing b c b' c' weights))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c'))))
  let LeftLabels :=
    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      DotWeights bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd) ×

      DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair
  let RightLabels :=
    Σ (B' : Subgroup U) (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),

  let leftDiagram : LeftLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd df x₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd df be ef x₂)
          (crossLeft gb be gc ce ef x₃))
  let rightDiagram : RightLabels → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight ga ad df ab' b'f y₁)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
          (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
  let leftMultiplier := fun d : LeftLabels => multiplier (leftDiagram d)
  let rightMultiplier := fun d : RightLabels => multiplier (rightDiagram d)
  let represents := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (s : U) =>
    ∀ h : H, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a h : U) = s * (h : U) * s⁻¹
  let conjugate := fun (s : U) (H : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) H
  let singleDot := fun {H K : Subgroup U} {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K}
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) => Finsupp.single d (1 : Complex)
  let sameEvaluation := fun (left : LeftLabels) (right : RightLabels) =>
    evaluate (leftDiagram left) = evaluate (rightDiagram right)
  (∀ (right : RightLabels) (B : Subgroup U) (hBG : B ≤ G),
    let m := rightMultiplier right
    (∀ a : A, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ga a : U) ∈ B) →
    (∀ c : C, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom gc c : U) ∈ B) →
    (∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support (MonoidAlgebra.coeff m), (p : U) ∈ B) →
    ∃ (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
      (x₂ : DotWeights (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef))

      let left : LeftLabels := ⟨B, gb, bd, be, singleDot x₁, x₂, singleDot x₃⟩
      represents gb 1 ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd = bottomPair ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be = topPair ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₁ = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₃ = 1 ∧
      MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex (Subgroup.inclusion hBG)
        (MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff (Finsupp.mapDomain MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₂)) = m ∧
      leftMultiplier left = m ∧ sameEvaluation left right) ∧
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U) (gb : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (bd : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (be : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
      (x₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd df)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be ef))
      (x₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair),
    let left : LeftLabels := ⟨B, gb, bd, be, singleDot x₁, singleDot x₂, singleDot x₃⟩
    let p := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₁ *
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom gb (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₂) *
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₃
    ∃ repGA repAD repDF repGC repCE repEF repGB repBD repBE repGB' repBD' repBE' : U,
      represents ga repGA ∧ represents ad repAD ∧ represents df repDF ∧
      represents gc repGC ∧ represents ce repCE ∧ represents ef repEF ∧
      represents gb repGB ∧ represents bd repBD ∧ represents be repBE ∧
      represents gb repGB' ∧ represents bd repBD' ∧ represents be repBE' ∧
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₁ : U) = repGA * repAD * repBD⁻¹ * repGB⁻¹ ∧
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₂ : U) = repBD' * repDF * repEF⁻¹ * repBE⁻¹ ∧
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₃ : U) = repGB' * repBE' * repCE⁻¹ * repGC⁻¹ ∧
      ∀ τ : U,

        let B' := conjugate τ B''
        ∃ (ab' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C)
          (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')

            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f))
          (y₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab')
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb'))
          (y₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce ef)),
          let right : RightLabels := ⟨B', ab', cb', b'f, singleDot y₁, singleDot y₂, singleDot y₃⟩
          represents ab' (repAD * repDF * τ⁻¹) ∧ represents cb' (repCE * repEF * τ⁻¹) ∧
          represents b'f τ ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y₁ = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y₂ = p ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y₃ = 1 ∧
          rightMultiplier right = leftMultiplier left ∧ sameEvaluation left right)
```

## MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention: Mixed-crossing finite-fiber convention for the six directions

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Number the three positions from left to right at the bottom.
Read the diagrams from bottom to top. The crossing \(s_1\) exchanges
positions \(1\) and \(2\), and \(s_2\) exchanges positions \(2\) and \(3\).

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~5.1, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The owner clarification dated 27 November 2026 in `input.request` supplies the finite complex label convention. The supplied request has no separate ID. Each marked crossing vertex carries a finite complex linear combination of termwise eligible group elements, with a coefficient-one singleton for a group-element dot. The typed composites retain the fixed boundary embeddings and their centralizer cosets, the bottom-to-top crossing order, and the six numbered directions. Each supported projection term uses the inverse trace dot and requires finite fibers, including when the standalone cup has infinite index. The singleton multiplication formula is explicitly over `Complex`. Lean elaborated the complete type with the registered `MixedCrossingFiberMaps` prerequisite through the shared slot.
```lean
theorem MixedCrossingFiniteFiberConvention : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U],
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let plain := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
  let Stage := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    Σ D : Type u, Σ valid : D → Prop,
      (x : Finsupp D Complex) → (∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, valid d) →
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q
  let place := fun {A B K H : Subgroup U}
      {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word A B} {p' q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (stage : Stage p q)
      (frame : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q →
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p' q') =>
    (⟨stage.1, stage.2.1, fun x hx => frame (stage.2.2 x hx)⟩ : Stage p' q')
  let at₁ := fun {A B C : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word A B}
      (stage : Stage p q) (spectator : MackeyDiagrams.Word B C) =>
    place stage (fun d => juxtapose d (plain (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id spectator)))
  let at₂ := fun {A B C D C' : Subgroup U}
      (spectator : MackeyDiagrams.Word A B)
      {p₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Word B C} {p₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Word C D}
      {q₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Word B C'} {q₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Word C' D}
      (stage : Stage (tensor p₁ p₂) (tensor q₁ q₂)) =>
    place stage (fun d => stack (plain (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate spectator p₁ p₂))
      (stack (juxtapose (plain (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id spectator)) d)
        (plain (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate spectator q₁ q₂))))
  let parallel := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (a' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q') =>
    (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'), fun _ => True,
      fun x _ => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b a' b'
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x)⟩ :
      Stage (tensor (up a) (up b)) (tensor (up a') (up b')))
  let finiteFibers := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b)) =>
    ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (down α) (up β))).carrier,
      Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b d w = z}
  let multiply := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b), fun _ => True,
      fun x _ => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β a b
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x)⟩ :
      Stage (tensor (up a) (down b)) (tensor (down α) (up β)))
  let projectionTerms := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b))
      (hx : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, finiteFibers α β a b d) =>
    (Finset.toList (Finset.attach (Finsupp.support x))).map fun d =>
      (x d.val, (⟨d.val, hx d.val d.property⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β a b))
  let project := fun {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b), finiteFibers α β a b,
      fun x hx => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β a b
        (projectionTerms α β a b x hx)⟩ :
      Stage (tensor (down α) (up β)) (tensor (up a) (down b)))
  let eval := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret d)
  let planar := fun (bottom top : List Bool) (wiring : List MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent) =>
    (⟨bottom, top, Quotient.mk MackeyDiagrams.PlanarCode.setoid wiring⟩ :
      MackeyDiagrams.PlanarShape)
  let leftShape := fun (bottom top : List Bool) (a b c : MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind) =>
    planar bottom top
      [MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 0 a, MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 1 b,
        MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 0 c]
  let rightShape := fun (bottom top : List Bool) (a b c : MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind) =>
    planar bottom top
      [MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 1 a, MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 0 b,
        MackeyDiagrams.PlanarEvent.vertex 1 c]
  let realizes := fun {K H : Subgroup U}
      {bottom p q top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (first : Stage bottom p) (second : Stage p q) (third : Stage q top)
      (shape : MackeyDiagrams.PlanarShape) =>
    ∀ (x : Finsupp first.1 Complex) (y : Finsupp second.1 Complex)
      (z : Finsupp third.1 Complex)
      (hx : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, first.2.1 d)
      (hy : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support y, second.2.1 d)
      (hz : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support z, third.2.1 d),
      let d₁ := first.2.2 x hx
      let d₂ := second.2.2 y hy
      let d₃ := third.2.2 z hz
      let drawing := stack d₁ (stack d₂ d₃)
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape drawing = shape ∧
        eval drawing = MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (eval d₁)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.vertical (eval d₂) (eval d₃))
  (∀ {A B : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B) (p : U)
      (_ : ∀ x : A, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a x : U) = MulAut.conj p (x : U)),
    {q : U | ∀ x : A, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a x : U) = MulAut.conj q (x : U)} =
      {q : U | p⁻¹ * q ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (A : Set U)}) ∧
  (∀ {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b)),
    let inner := tensor (up a) (down b)
    let q := fun (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis inner).carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b d w)
    let traceDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse d
    let traceInput := fun (z : G) (t : H) =>
      z * (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β t)⁻¹ * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element traceDot
    let traceSurvivors := fun (T : Set H) (z : G) =>
      {t : H | t ∈ T ∧ traceInput z t ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α)}
    (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
      q (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b) k h) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α k * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β h) ∧
    (∀ w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis inner).carrier,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) α β a b d))
          (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β (q w)) 1) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element traceDot = (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element d)⁻¹ ∧
    (∀ hf : ∀ z : G, Set.Finite {w | q w = z},
      let diagram := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) α β a b d
        (fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hf (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β z))
          (fun _ hw => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α β) hw))
      let valueAt := fun z : G => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval diagram)
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β z) 1)
      (∀ z : G, valueAt z = Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hf z))
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) ∧
      (∀ (T : Set H)
          (_ : ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H, t ∈ T ∧
            h * t⁻¹ ∈ MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b))
          (z : G),
        ∃ hs : Set.Finite (traceSurvivors T z),
          valueAt z = Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset hs) (fun t =>
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.traceBasis Complex α (traceInput z t))
              (Finsupp.single t 1))))) ∧
  (∀ {K H G L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G)
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp α a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp β b)),
    (∀ w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (up a) (down b))).carrier,
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval ((multiply α β a b).2.2 x (fun _ _ => True.intro)))
          (Finsupp.single w 1) =
        List.sum (List.map (fun term =>
          term.1 • Finsupp.single
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b term.2 w) 1)
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))) ∧
    (∀ hx : ∀ d ∈ Finsupp.support x, finiteFibers α β a b d,
      let terms := projectionTerms α β a b x hx
      let drawing := (project α β a b).2.2 x hx
      eval drawing = eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection α β a b terms
        MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionOpening.cupAndMerge MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionClosing.splitAndTrace) ∧
      (∀ z : G,
        let basis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β z
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval drawing) (Finsupp.single basis 1) =
          List.sum (List.map (fun term =>
            term.1 • Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset
              (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite
                (multiplication := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β a b)
                term.2 basis)) (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1)) terms)))) ∧
  (∀ {G A D F C E B B' : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
      (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
      (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G) (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D)
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B) (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
    let left₁ := at₁ (project a b r s) (up c)
    let left₂ := at₂ (up r) (project s c t f)
    let left₃ := at₁ (parallel r t d e) (down f)
    let right₁ := at₂ (down a) (parallel b c u' w)
    let right₂ := at₁ (project a u' d v) (up w)
    let right₃ := at₂ (up d) (project v w e f)
    let left₁' := at₁ (parallel d e r t) (down f)
    let left₂' := at₂ (up r) (multiply s c t f)
    let left₃' := at₁ (multiply a b r s) (up c)
    let right₁' := at₂ (up d) (multiply v w e f)
    let right₂' := at₁ (multiply a u' d v) (up w)
    let right₃' := at₂ (down a) (parallel u' w b c)
    let projectLeft := realizes left₁ left₂ left₃
      (leftShape [false, true, true] [true, true, false]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp)
    let projectRight := realizes right₁ right₂ right₃
      (rightShape [false, true, true] [true, true, false]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection)
    let multiplyLeft := realizes left₁' left₂' left₃'
      (leftShape [true, true, false] [false, true, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication)
    let multiplyRight := realizes right₁' right₂' right₃'
      (rightShape [true, true, false] [false, true, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp)
    let cases : List (Nat × (Prop × Prop)) :=
      [(1, (projectLeft, projectRight)), (2, (projectRight, projectLeft)),
       (3, (multiplyLeft, multiplyRight)), (4, (multiplyRight, multiplyLeft))]
    ∀ direction ∈ cases, direction.2.1 ∧ direction.2.2) ∧
  (∀ {G A D F C E B B' : Subgroup U}
      (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
      (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
      (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B) (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F) (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
    let left₁ := at₁ (multiply u' v a b) (up d)
    let left₂ := at₂ (down u') (parallel v d w f)
    let left₃ := at₁ (project u' w c e) (up f)
    let right₁ := at₂ (up a) (project b d i j)
    let right₂ := at₁ (parallel a i c k) (down j)
    let right₃ := at₂ (up c) (multiply e f k j)
    let mixedLeft := realizes left₁ left₂ left₃
      (leftShape [true, false, true] [true, false, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection)
    let mixedRight := realizes right₁ right₂ right₃
      (rightShape [true, false, true] [true, false, true]
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedProjection MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.parallelUp
        MackeyDiagrams.VertexKind.mixedMultiplication)
    let cases : List (Nat × (Prop × Prop)) :=
      [(5, (mixedLeft, mixedRight)), (6, (mixedRight, mixedLeft))]
    ∀ direction ∈ cases, direction.2.1 ∧ direction.2.2)
```

## EvaluationForTwoProjections: Evaluation for two projections

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

With a group element at each vertex, either shape evaluates to
\(Q_p^!\), the sum over the fibers of
\[
 Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h),\qquad [g,h]\in G\times_E F,
\]
for a unique \(p\in A\). Its admissibility condition and fiber size over its image are
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-projection-index}
 \begin{gathered}
 (ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\qquad(v\in E),\\
 n_p=[a(G)\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)]<\infty .
 \end{gathered}
\end{equation}
A diagram with linear labels evaluates to a finite linear combination
of these \(Q_p^!\). Its coefficients are determined by the evaluated map.

On the left, write \(r:B\to G\), \(s:B\to D\), and \(t:E\to B\).
Use \(x,y\) for the first two mixed crossing elements and \(z\) for the upper
induction dot. Following the underlying set maps backwards gives
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 {[g,h]}&\longmapsto[gz^{-1},h]\longmapsto[gz^{-1},y c(h)]\\
      &\longmapsto a(gz^{-1})x\,b(yc(h)).
 \end{aligned}
\]
Thus \(p=a(z^{-1})x b(y)\). On the right use
\(u:B'\to A\), \(v:C\to B'\), and \(w:F\to B'\), with induction dot \(\ell\)
and mixed crossing elements \(m,n\). The set maps give
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 {[g,h]}&\longmapsto[g,nw(h)]\longmapsto a(g)m\,u(nw(h))\\
      &\longmapsto a(g)m\,u(nw(h))\ell^{-1}.
 \end{aligned}
\]
Thus \(p=m u(n)\ell^{-1}\). Taking inverse images twice gives the fiber of the composite.
These fibers are finite because each projection has finite fibers. Balancing gives the first condition in
(6.1). The stabilizer index calculation in
Proposition~5.1 gives \(n_p\).
Expanding the three labels proves the linear formula. The coefficient
of \([1,1]\) in \(Q_p^!(z)\) is \(1\) for \(z=p\) and \(0\) otherwise,
so the coefficient of each \(Q_p^!\) can be recovered.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Lemma 6.3 [lem:three-projections]; (6.1) [eq:three-projection-index], p. 22 (related source excerpts on pp. 22–23)](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.2.1, Lemma 6.3 (Evaluation for two projections), equation (6.1), p. 22. The published PDF matches the project PDF byte for byte. The rendered figure and project TikZ give the left crossing order s₁s₂s₁ and the right crossing order s₂s₁s₂ at the same fixed boundary embeddings. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no corrected statement for Lemma 6.3, so the article endpoint governs. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the drawing syntax. Each mark carries one finite complex label through LabelledDrawing.compactProjection or LabelledDrawing.parallelUp. Each supported projection parameter carries its own pointwise finite-fiber proof. The paper’s projection parameter is the inverse of its trace dot. The coefficient-one singleton gives the group-element case, and the empty label retains the same marked crossing. The type preserves the balancing and finite-index criterion, the fiber sum and its size over the image, and uniqueness of the group-element parameter and of the finite coefficient function. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem EvaluationForTwoProjections : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  let bcf := comp bc f
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
      (drawId (down f))
  let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
  let finiteFibers := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}
  let Parameter := MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f
  let Q := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a bc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a bc de f p w)
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f
        (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p)))
  let intersection := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) =>
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a) ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p)))
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc))
  let lower := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ade)
  let terms := fun {X : Type u} (label : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    List.map (fun x => (label x, x)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label))
  let evaluates := fun {X Y Z : Type u}
      (drawing : List (Complex × X) → List (Complex × Y) → List (Complex × Z) →
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    (∀ (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z), ∃! p : Parameter,
      eval (drawing [(1, x)] [(1, y)] [(1, z)]) = Qstar p) ∧
    (∀ (xs : Finsupp X Complex) (ys : Finsupp Y Complex) (zs : Finsupp Z Complex),
      ∃! coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
        eval (drawing (terms xs) (terms ys) (terms zs)) =
          Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p))
  (∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf,
    lower ≤ intersection p ∧
    (finiteFibers a bc de f p ↔ Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf lower (intersection p))) ∧
    (∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      Q p (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc h)) ∧
  (∀ (p : Parameter) (z : A),
    Qstar p (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z) 1) =
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z)))
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1) ∧
    (z ∈ Set.range (Q (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)) →
      Nat.card {w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier // Q (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) w = z} =
        Subgroup.relIndex lower (intersection (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)))) ∧
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
    evaluates (fun
      (xs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s))
      (ys : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f))
      (zs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de)) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s xs) (drawId (up c)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f ys))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e zs) (drawId (down f)))))) ∧
  (∀ {B' : Subgroup U} (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B'),
    evaluates (fun
      (ells : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u' w)))
      (ms : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a u' d v))
      (ns : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f)) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (atRight (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c u' w ells))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a u' d v ms) (drawId (up w)))
          (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection v w e f ns)))))
```

## CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction: Case 1 right projections with a join or a common internal group

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

With a group element at each vertex, either shape evaluates to
\(Q_p^!\), the sum over the fibers of
\[
 Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h),\qquad [g,h]\in G\times_E F,
\]
for a unique \(p\in A\). Its admissibility condition and fiber size over its image are
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-projection-index}
 \begin{gathered}
 (ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\qquad(v\in E),\\
 n_p=[a(G)\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)]<\infty .
 \end{gathered}
\end{equation}
A diagram with linear labels evaluates to a finite linear combination
of these \(Q_p^!\). Its coefficients are determined by the evaluated map.

For \(p\) satisfying (6.1), put
\(P_p=\langle (ad)(C),p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\rangle\le A\).

In Case~1, a finite sum of right diagrams gives the same map as
the left diagram exactly when each \(p\) with nonzero coefficient satisfies
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-middle-index}
 [a(G)\cap P_p:(ad)(C)]<\infty.
\end{equation}
Each such \(Q_p^!\) has a single right diagram.
If \([G:d(C)]<\infty\), one right diagram suffices for the whole sum.

For sufficiency take \(B'=P_p\), \(u\) the inclusion, \(v=ad\),
\(w=\operatorname{Ad}_p\circ bc\), and \((\ell,m,n)=(p^{-1},1,1)\).
The first vertex satisfies \(bc=\operatorname{Ad}_{p^{-1}}\circ uw\).
The middle fiber is finite by (6.2).
The upper vertex uses \(ve=wf\), and its index is at most \(n_p\)
because \((ad)(C)\le a(G)\). If \([G:d(C)]\) is finite, take a
common \(B'=A,\ u=\id,\ v=ad,\ w=bc\). Put the linear combination
of crossing elements on the upper mixed crossing and use \(1\) at the first two.
The middle fiber then has size \([G:d(C)]\), and the upper fiber
of each crossing element has size at most \(n_p\).

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered figure and project TikZ fix the left order s₁s₂s₁, the right order s₂s₁s₂ and the common strand cosets. The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the drawing syntax. Each parallel or compact projection crossing retains one mark for its entire finite complex label, including the empty label and coefficient-one singletons. Each supported projection parameter carries a pointwise finite-fiber proof, and its trace dot is its inverse. The finite replacement sum is formed from complete right drawings. The construction with group Pₚ uses a single right drawing for one parameter. With the common group A, a single right drawing carries the full label on its upper crossing. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem CaseOneRightProjectionConstruction : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let Drawing := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
      (drawId (down f))
  let eval := fun (drawing : Drawing) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
  let ProjectionLabel := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ
  let fiberSize := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : ProjectionLabel α β η θ) (z : P) =>
    Nat.card {w // MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ
      (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot x) w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair α β z}
  let Parameter := ProjectionLabel a bc de f
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f
        (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p)))
  let terms := fun {X : Type u} (label : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    List.map (fun x => (label x, x)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label))
  let left := fun {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (xs : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a b r s) Complex)
      (ys : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel s c t f) Complex)
      (zs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp r t) de) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s (terms xs)) (drawId (up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f (terms ys)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms zs))
          (drawId (down f))))
  let right := fun {B' : Subgroup U} (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ells : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp j w))
      (ms : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a j d v) Complex)
      (ns : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel v w e f) Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (atRight (down a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c j w (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ells)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a j d v (terms ms)) (drawId (up w)))
        (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection v w e f (terms ns))))
  let IsRight := fun (drawing : Drawing) =>
    ∃ (B' : Subgroup U) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ells : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp j w))
      (ms : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a j d v) Complex)
      (ns : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel v w e f) Complex),
      drawing = right j v w ells ms ns
  let sumDrawings := fun (ds : List Drawing) =>
    match ds with
    | [] => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero bottom top)
    | first :: rest => List.foldl MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add first rest
  let conjugatedImage := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p))))
      (MonoidHom.range (hom bc))
  let join := fun (p : Parameter) => MonoidHom.range (hom ad) ⊔ conjugatedImage p
  let middleFinite := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf (MonoidHom.range (hom ad))
      (MonoidHom.range (hom a) ⊓ join p))
  let nₚ := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.relIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom ade)) (MonoidHom.range (hom a) ⊓ conjugatedImage p)
  let expansion := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex) =>
    Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p)
  (∀ (p : Parameter), middleFinite p →
    let B' := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) (join p)
    let p₀ := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)
    ∃ (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j w))
      (m : ProjectionLabel a j d v) (n : ProjectionLabel v w e f),
      (∀ k : B', (hom j k : U) = (k : U)) ∧
      (∀ k : C, hom j (hom v k) = hom ad k) ∧
      (∀ k : F, hom j (hom w k) = (MulAut.conj p₀) (hom bc k)) ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ell = p₀⁻¹ ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot m) = 1 ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot n) = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : B', fiberSize v w e f n z ≤ nₚ p) ∧
      eval (right j v w (Finsupp.single ell 1) (Finsupp.single m 1) (Finsupp.single n 1)) =
        Qstar p) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom d)) →
    let j := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id A
    ∃ (ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j bc)) (m : ProjectionLabel a j d ad)
      (n : Parameter → ProjectionLabel ad bc e f),
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ell = 1 ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot m) = 1 ∧
      (∀ z : A, fiberSize a j d ad m z = Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range (hom d))) ∧
      (∀ (p : Parameter), MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot (n p)) =
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) ∧
          (∀ z : A, fiberSize ad bc e f (n p) z ≤ nₚ p)) ∧
      (∀ (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex),
        eval (right j ad bc (Finsupp.single ell 1) (Finsupp.single m 1)
          (Finsupp.mapDomain n coeff)) = expansion coeff)) ∧
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (xs : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a b r s) Complex)
      (ys : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel s c t f) Complex)
      (zs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp r t) de)
      (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex), eval (left r s t xs ys zs) = expansion coeff →
    ((∃ ds : List Drawing,
        (∀ drawing ∈ ds, IsRight drawing) ∧
        eval (sumDrawings ds) = eval (left r s t xs ys zs)) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support coeff, middleFinite p))
```

## CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstruction: Case 2 left projections with a full intersection or a common internal group

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

With a group element at each vertex, either shape evaluates to
\(Q_p^!\), the sum over the fibers of
\[
 Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h),\qquad [g,h]\in G\times_E F,
\]
for a unique \(p\in A\). Its admissibility condition and fiber size over its image are
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-projection-index}
 \begin{gathered}
 (ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\qquad(v\in E),\\
 n_p=[a(G)\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)]<\infty .
 \end{gathered}
\end{equation}
A diagram with linear labels evaluates to a finite linear combination
of these \(Q_p^!\). Its coefficients are determined by the evaluated map.

In Case~2, every right diagram has a replacement by a finite sum
of left diagrams. If \([G:(de)(E)]<\infty\), one left diagram suffices.

For Case~2 use the full intersection at the first crossing.
\[
 \begin{gathered}
 B=a^{-1}\bigl(a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\bigr),\qquad r=\mathrm{incl},\\
 s=b^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Ad}_{p^{-1}}\circ a\bigm|_B,\qquad t=de.
 \end{gathered}
\]
Use \((x,y,z)=(p,1,1)\). Equation~(6.1)
gives \(st=cf\). The first fiber has size \(1\) on its image.
Transporting the second intersection by \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\circ b\)
gives the index \(n_p\). This produces one left diagram per crossing element.
If \([G:(de)(E)]<\infty\), take a common \(B=E,\ r=de,\ s=cf,\ t=\id\)
and put the linear combination of crossing elements on the lower mixed crossing.
For each crossing element the first fiber size is bounded by \([G:(de)(E)]\),
and the second has size \(1\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.2.1, construction in the proof of Theorem 6.4, pp. 22–23](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The 27 November 2026 owner clarification, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the marked syntax. Each crossing carries one finite complex label with termwise eligibility. Each supported projection parameter has finite fibers and corresponds to the inverse of the trace dot. The single left replacement under [G:(de)(E)] < ∞ carries the full combination at its lower crossing. The finite sum in the general conclusion is formed from complete left drawings. Lean checked the exact proposition and both ordered lists of planar crossing events for arbitrary labels, including zero, through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem CaseTwoLeftProjectionConstruction : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let cf := comp c f
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
      (drawId (down f))
  let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
  let Parameter := MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a bc de f
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f
        (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p)))
  let combination := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex) =>
    Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p)
  let intersection := fun {K H P : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (p : P) =>
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α) ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj p))
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β))
  let adeRange := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp a de))
  let deRange := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom de)
  let n := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.relIndex adeRange (intersection a bc (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)))
  let basisMap := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot x)
  let hasFiberSize := fun {X Y : Type u} (q : X → Y) (size : Nat) =>
    ∀ z ∈ Set.range q, Nat.card {w : X // q w = z} = size
  let labelTerms := fun {X : Type u} (label : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    List.map (fun x => (label x, x)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label))
  let left := fun {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (xs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s))
      (ys : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f))
      (zs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s xs) (drawId (up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f ys))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e zs) (drawId (down f))))
  let right := fun {B' : Subgroup U} (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ells : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp u' w))
      (ms : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a u' d v) Complex)
      (ns : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f) Complex) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (atRight (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c u' w
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ells)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a u' d v (labelTerms ms))
          (drawId (up w)))
        (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection v w e f (labelTerms ns))))
  let fullIntersection := fun (p : Parameter)
      (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    let element := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)
    let B := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype G)
      (Subgroup.comap (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a) (intersection a b element))
    ∃ (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      (∀ v : B, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom r v : U) = (v : U)) ∧
      (∀ v : B,
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom s v) =
          element⁻¹ *
            MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom r v) *
            element) ∧
      comp r t = de ∧ comp s t = cf ∧
      ∃ (x : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b r s) (y : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed s c t f)
        (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de),
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot x) = element ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot y) = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧
        hasFiberSize (basisMap a b r s x) 1 ∧
        hasFiberSize (basisMap s c t f y) (n p) ∧
        diagram = left r s t [(1, x)] [(1, y)] [(1, z)]
  let commonGroup := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex)
      (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    let t := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id E
    ∃ (x : Parameter → MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a b de cf)
      (y : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed cf c t f)
      (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp de t) de),
      (∀ p : Parameter,
        MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot (x p)) =
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) ∧
        ∀ v, Nat.card {w // basisMap a b de cf (x p) w = v} ≤ Subgroup.index deRange) ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot y) = 1 ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧
      hasFiberSize (basisMap cf c t f y) 1 ∧
      drawing = left de cf t
        (List.map (fun term => (term.1, x term.2)) (labelTerms coeff)) [(1, y)] [(1, z)]
  let sumDrawings := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex)
      (terms : Parameter → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    List.foldr (fun term total => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale term.1 (terms term.2)) total)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero bottom top))
      (labelTerms coeff)
  (∀ p : Parameter, ∃ drawing, fullIntersection p drawing ∧ eval drawing = Qstar p) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex deRange →
    ∀ coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
      ∃ drawing, commonGroup coeff drawing ∧ eval drawing = combination coeff) ∧
  (∀ {B' : Subgroup U} (u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ells : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp u' w))
      (ms : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed a u' d v) Complex)
      (ns : Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed v w e f) Complex),
    let drawing := right u' v w ells ms ns
    ∃ (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex)
      (terms : Parameter → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top),
      (∀ p : Parameter, fullIntersection p (terms p) ∧ eval (terms p) = Qstar p) ∧
      eval drawing = combination coeff ∧
      (∀ other : Finsupp Parameter Complex, eval drawing = combination other → other = coeff) ∧
      eval (sumDrawings coeff terms) = eval drawing ∧
      (Subgroup.FiniteIndex deRange →
        ∃ replacement, commonGroup coeff replacement ∧ eval replacement = eval drawing))
```

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

With a group element at each vertex, either shape evaluates to
\(Q_p^!\), the sum over the fibers of
\[
 Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h),\qquad [g,h]\in G\times_E F,
\]
for a unique \(p\in A\). Its admissibility condition and fiber size over its image are
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-projection-index}
 \begin{gathered}
 (ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\qquad(v\in E),\\
 n_p=[a(G)\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)]<\infty .
 \end{gathered}
\end{equation}
A diagram with linear labels evaluates to a finite linear combination
of these \(Q_p^!\). Its coefficients are determined by the evaluated map.

For \(p\) satisfying (6.1), put
\(P_p=\langle (ad)(C),p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\rangle\le A\).
\begin{enumerate}
\item In Case~1, a finite sum of right diagrams gives the same map as
the left diagram exactly when each \(p\) with nonzero coefficient satisfies
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-middle-index}
 [a(G)\cap P_p:(ad)(C)]<\infty.
\end{equation}
Each such \(Q_p^!\) has a single right diagram.
If \([G:d(C)]<\infty\), one right diagram suffices for the whole sum.
\item In Case~2, every right diagram has a replacement by a finite sum
of left diagrams. If \([G:(de)(E)]<\infty\), one left diagram suffices.
\end{enumerate}
Under \([G:(de)(E)]<\infty\), in particular for finite groups, the
single-diagram replacements induce inverse bijections on the two
sets of classes modulo equality of evaluated maps.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 6.4 [thm:three-projections]; Cases 1 and 2; (6.2) [eq:three-middle-index], p. 23 (related source excerpts on pp. 22–23)](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)
