Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.2.1, Theorem 6.4 (thm:three-projections), p. 23, Cases 1 and 2 and (6.2), with the fixed-boundary evaluation and admissibility formula (6.1) on p. 22. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered figure and project TikZ confirm the crossing orders and fixed boundary strand cosets. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect report returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No corrected statement for Theorem 6.4 was available, so the article endpoint governs. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139 governs the drawing syntax. Each compact projection or parallel crossing retains one mark for its entire finite complex label, including zero and coefficient-one singletons. Each supported projection parameter has finite fibers, with the inverse parameter used as the trace dot. Diagram-level addition represents the finite sums of complete replacement diagrams. Lean checked the proposition, both crossing orders for arbitrary labels, and the equivalence between equality at the original boundary and equality after merging the parallel boundary strands. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ReplacementForTwoProjections : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  let bcf := comp bc f
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)
  let Drawing := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex mergedBottom bottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
      (drawId (down f))
  let eval := fun (drawing : Drawing) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let mergedEval := fun (drawing : Drawing) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
  let ProjectionLabel := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ
  let Parameter := ProjectionLabel a bc de f
  let Q := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct a bc
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a bc de f p w)
  let Qstar := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f
        (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p)))
  let intersection := fun (p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf) =>
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a) ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p)))
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc))
  let lower := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ade)
  let terms := fun {X : Type u} (label : Finsupp X Complex) =>
    List.map (fun x => (label x, x)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label))
  let finiteFibers := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α η) (comp β θ)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β η θ x w = z}
  let left := fun {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (xs : List (Complex × ProjectionLabel a b r s))
      (ys : List (Complex × ProjectionLabel s c t f))
      (zs : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s xs) (drawId (up c)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f ys))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e zs) (drawId (down f))))
  let right := fun {B' : Subgroup U} (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ells : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j w)))
      (ms : List (Complex × ProjectionLabel a j d v))
      (ns : List (Complex × ProjectionLabel v w e f)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (atRight (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c j w ells))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a j d v ms) (drawId (up w)))
        (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection v w e f ns)))
  let Left := Σ B : Subgroup U,
    Σ r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G,
    Σ s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D,
    Σ t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B,
      Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a b r s) Complex ×
      Finsupp (ProjectionLabel s c t f) Complex ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp r t) de
  let Right := Σ B' : Subgroup U,
    Σ j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A,
    Σ v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B',
    Σ w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B',
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp j w) ×
      Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a j d v) Complex ×
      Finsupp (ProjectionLabel v w e f) Complex
  let leftDrawing : Left → Drawing :=
    fun ⟨_, r, s, t, xs, ys, zs⟩ =>
      left r s t (terms xs) (terms ys) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms zs)
  let rightDrawing : Right → Drawing :=
    fun ⟨_, j, v, w, ells, ms, ns⟩ =>
      right j v w (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ells) (terms ms) (terms ns)
  let sumDrawings := fun (ds : List Drawing) =>
    match ds with
    | [] => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero bottom top)
    | first :: rest => List.foldl MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add first rest
  let conjugatedImage := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p))))
      (MonoidHom.range (hom bc))
  let join := fun (p : Parameter) => MonoidHom.range (hom ad) ⊔ conjugatedImage p
  let middleFinite := fun (p : Parameter) =>
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf (MonoidHom.range (hom ad))
      (MonoidHom.range (hom a) ⊓ join p))
  let expansion := fun (coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex) =>
    Finsupp.sum coeff (fun p weight => weight • Qstar p)
  let leftEval := fun l : Left => eval (leftDrawing l)
  let rightEval := fun r : Right => eval (rightDrawing r)
  let leftClasses := Setoid.ker leftEval
  let rightClasses := Setoid.ker rightEval
  (∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade bcf,
    lower ≤ intersection p ∧
    (finiteFibers a bc de f p ↔ Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf lower (intersection p))) ∧
    (∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      Q p (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc h)) ∧
  (∀ (p : Parameter) (z : A),
    Qstar p (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z) 1) =
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc z)))
        (fun w => Finsupp.single w 1) ∧
    (z ∈ Set.range (Q (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)) →
      Nat.card {w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mergedTop).carrier // Q (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) w = z} =
        Subgroup.relIndex lower (intersection (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p)))) ∧
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (x : ProjectionLabel a b r s) (y : ProjectionLabel s c t f)
      (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de),
    ∃! p : Parameter, mergedEval (left r s t [(1, x)] [(1, y)] [(1, z)]) = Qstar p) ∧
  (∀ {B' : Subgroup U} (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B') (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
      (ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j w)) (m : ProjectionLabel a j d v)
      (n : ProjectionLabel v w e f),
    ∃! p : Parameter, mergedEval (right j v w [(1, ell)] [(1, m)] [(1, n)]) = Qstar p) ∧
  (∀ l : Left, ∃ coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
    mergedEval (leftDrawing l) = expansion coeff ∧
    (∀ other : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
      mergedEval (leftDrawing l) = expansion other → other = coeff) ∧
    ((∃ ds : List Right, eval (sumDrawings (List.map rightDrawing ds)) = leftEval l) ↔
      ∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support coeff, middleFinite p)) ∧
  (∀ r : Right, ∃! coeff : Finsupp Parameter Complex,
    mergedEval (rightDrawing r) = expansion coeff) ∧
  (∀ p : Parameter, middleFinite p →
    ∃ r : Right, mergedEval (rightDrawing r) = Qstar p) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom d)) →
    ∀ l : Left, ∃ r : Right, rightEval r = leftEval l) ∧
  (∀ r : Right, ∃ ds : List Left, eval (sumDrawings (List.map leftDrawing ds)) = rightEval r) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom de)) →
    ∀ r : Right, ∃ l : Left, leftEval l = rightEval r) ∧
  (Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (hom de)) ∨ Finite G →
    ∃ (replaceCase1 : Left → Right) (replaceCase2 : Right → Left)
      (replacement : Quotient leftClasses ≃ Quotient rightClasses),
      (∀ l : Left, rightEval (replaceCase1 l) = leftEval l ∧
        replacement (Quotient.mk leftClasses l) = Quotient.mk rightClasses (replaceCase1 l)) ∧
      (∀ r : Right, leftEval (replaceCase2 r) = rightEval r ∧
        Equiv.symm replacement (Quotient.mk rightClasses r) =
          Quotient.mk leftClasses (replaceCase2 r)))
```

## CaseOneNoFiniteRightReplacement: A Case 1 diagram with no finite right replacement

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

Take \(U=A=\mathbb Z^2\rtimes C_2\), where \(C_2\) swaps the two
coordinate lines. Set \(G=\mathbb Z^2\), \(C=\mathbb Z\times\{0\}\),
\(D=F=C_2\), and \(B=E=1\). Use inclusions and unit labels on the left. Both
reverse cups have index \(2\), and \(Q_1^!(gh)=[g,h]\) for \(g\in G,\ h\in F\).
However \(P_1=\langle C,F\rangle=A\) because the swap conjugates \(C\) to the
other coordinate line. The index in (6.2) is
\([G:C]=\infty\).

```lean
theorem CaseOneNoFiniteRightReplacement : let caseOne := fun {U : Type} [Group U] (G C D : Subgroup U) (hCG : C ≤ G) =>
  let A : Subgroup U := ⊤
  let F : Subgroup U := D
  let B : Subgroup U := ⊥
  let E : Subgroup U := B
  let inclusion := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
    (⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun _ => by simp⟩⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
  let a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A := inclusion le_top
  let b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A := inclusion le_top
  let c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id D
  let d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G := inclusion hCG
  let e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C := inclusion bot_le
  let f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F := inclusion bot_le
  let r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G := inclusion bot_le
  let s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D := inclusion bot_le
  let t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id B
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _

  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _

  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let mergedBottom := tensor (down a) (up bc)
  let mergedTop := tensor (up de) (down f)

      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary

        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))

      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical

  let j := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id A

    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot y) = 1 ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) = 1 ∧
    mergedEval (left x y z) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f [(1, p)]))) ∧
    (∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      mergedEval (left x y z)
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc (hom a g * hom bc h)) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) 1) ∧
    ¬ (∃ ds : List RightAtBoundary,
      List.sum (List.map (fun drawing => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary.interpret drawing))) ds) =
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.atBoundary
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (left x y z))))))
let N := Fin 2 → Multiplicative Int
let swaps : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* MulAut N :=
  { toFun := fun σ =>
      { toFun := fun x i => x (Equiv.symm σ i)
        invFun := fun x i => x (σ i)
        left_inv := fun x => funext fun i => congrArg x (Equiv.symm_apply_apply σ i)
        right_inv := fun x => funext fun i => congrArg x (Equiv.apply_symm_apply σ i)
        map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
    map_one' := rfl
    map_mul' := fun _ _ => rfl }
let U := SemidirectProduct N (Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) swaps
let base : N →* U := SemidirectProduct.inl
let permutations : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2) →* U := SemidirectProduct.inr
let G := MonoidHom.range base
let C := Subgroup.map base (MonoidHom.ker (Pi.evalMonoidHom (fun _ : Fin 2 => Multiplicative Int) 1))
let D := MonoidHom.range permutations
caseOne G C D (by
  intro u hu
  obtain ⟨n, _, rfl⟩ := hu
  exact ⟨n, rfl⟩)
```

## CaseTwoRequiresSum: A Case 2 diagram requiring a sum

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

In the same semidirect product write \(\tau\) for the swap.
Set \(G=D=\mathbb Z\times\{0\}\) and \(C=E=F=B'=1\). Use inclusions on
the right, with dots \((1,1+\tau,1)\). Both right-hand reverse cups
have index \(1\). The resulting map \(Q_1^!+Q_\tau^!\) is nonzero on
both \(1\) and \(\tau\). A left replacement must use parameters at the
first crossing in both \(G\) and \(G\tau G\), since \(p=a(z^{-1})x b(y)\) is
in the same double coset as that crossing's crossing element \(x\). The
corresponding intersections are \(G\) and \(1\). The crossing element in
\(G\tau G\) forces \(B=1\), giving the crossing element in \(G\) infinite fibers.

```lean
theorem CaseTwoRequiresSum : let swap : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) := Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2)
let action : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) →* MulAut (Multiplicative Int × Multiplicative Int) :=
  let act := fun i : Multiplicative (ZMod 2) =>
    if i = 1 then 1 else (MulEquiv.prodComm : MulAut (Multiplicative Int × Multiplicative Int))
  { toFun := act
    map_one' := ite_eq_left rfl
    map_mul' := by
      have cases₂ : ∀ i : Multiplicative (ZMod 2), i = 1 ∨ i = swap := by
        intro i
        change (Multiplicative.toAdd i : Fin 2) = 0 ∨ Multiplicative.toAdd i = (1 : ZMod 2)
        exact (by decide : ∀ j : Fin 2, j = 0 ∨ j = 1) (Multiplicative.toAdd i)
      have hs : swap * swap = 1 := by decide
      have hn : swap ≠ 1 := by decide
      intro i j
      rcases cases₂ i with rfl | rfl <;> rcases cases₂ j with rfl | rfl <;>
        simp only [act, one_mul, mul_one, hs, ite_eq_left rfl, ite_eq_right hn]
      rfl }
let U := SemidirectProduct (Multiplicative Int × Multiplicative Int) (Multiplicative (ZMod 2)) action

let v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B' := incl le_rfl
let w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B' := incl le_rfl

let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _

    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top mergedTop :=

    (drawId (down f))
let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical drawing mergeTop))))
let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
    {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
    {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
    (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId p) crossing)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
let ProjectionLabel := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K P) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H P)
    (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ
let terms := fun {X : Type} (label : Finsupp X Complex) =>
  List.map (fun x => (label x, x)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label))
let Qstar := fun (p : ProjectionLabel a bc de f) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection (R := Complex) a bc de f
      (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p) (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.finite p)))
let left := fun {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
    (xs : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a b r s) Complex)
    (ys : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel s c t f) Complex)
    (zs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp r t) de) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b r s (terms xs)) (drawId (up c)))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (atRight (up r) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection s c t f (terms ys)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms zs))
        (drawId (down f))))
let right := fun
    (ells : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bc (comp u w))
    (ms : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a u d v) Complex)
    (ns : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel v w e f) Complex) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (atRight (down a)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c u w (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ells)))
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a u d v (terms ms)) (drawId (up w)))
      (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection v w e f (terms ns))))
let Drawing := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top
let IsLeftWith := fun (allowed : Set A) (drawing : Drawing) =>
  ∃ (B : Subgroup U) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D) (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
    (xs : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel a b r s) Complex)
    (ys : Finsupp (ProjectionLabel s c t f) Complex)
    (zs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp r t) de),
    (∀ x ∈ Finsupp.support xs,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot x) ∈ allowed) ∧
    drawing = left r s t xs ys zs
let leftShape := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape
  (left (B := T) d (incl bot_le) (incl le_rfl) 0 0 0)
let sumDrawings := fun (drawings : List Drawing) =>
  match drawings with
  | [] => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.zero bottom top)
  | first :: rest => List.foldl MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add first rest
let basisVector := fun p : A =>
  Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc p) (1 : Complex)
let line := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
let swapCoset := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset τ (line : Set A) (line : Set A)
let intersection := fun x : A => line ⊓
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj x)) line
Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom v)) = 1 ∧
Subgroup.index (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)) = 1 ∧
(∀ x : A, (x ∈ line → intersection x = line) ∧
  (x ∈ swapCoset → intersection x = ⊥)) ∧
(∀ {B : Subgroup U} (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G)
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D)
    (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a r) (comp b s)),
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x ∈ swapCoset →
    B = ⊥ ∧ ∀ y : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a r) (comp b s),
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y ∈ line →
      ¬ Set.Finite {j | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b r s y j =
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a b (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y)}) ∧
∃ (ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u w))
  (m₁ mτ : ProjectionLabel a u d v) (n : ProjectionLabel v w e f)
  (p₁ pτ : ProjectionLabel a bc de f),
  MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ell = 1 ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot m₁) = 1 ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot mτ) = τ ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot n) = 1 ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot p₁) = 1 ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot pτ) = τ ∧
  let rhs := right (Finsupp.single ell 1) (Finsupp.single m₁ 1 + Finsupp.single mτ 1)
    (Finsupp.single n 1)
  eval rhs = Qstar p₁ + Qstar pτ ∧
  eval rhs (basisVector 1) ≠ 0 ∧
  eval rhs (basisVector τ) ≠ 0 ∧
  (∀ (allowed : Set A) (drawings : List Drawing),
    (∀ drawing ∈ drawings, IsLeftWith allowed drawing) →
    eval (sumDrawings drawings) = eval rhs →
    (∃ x ∈ allowed, x ∈ line) ∧ (∃ x ∈ allowed, x ∈ swapCoset)) ∧
  (∃ l₁ lτ, IsLeftWith (line : Set A) l₁ ∧ IsLeftWith swapCoset lτ ∧
    eval l₁ = Qstar p₁ ∧ eval lτ = Qstar pτ ∧
    eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add l₁ lτ) = eval rhs) ∧
  (∀ replacement : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary Complex
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.boundary bottom) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.boundary top) leftShape,
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.PlanarAtBoundary.interpret replacement) ≠
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.atBoundary
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret rhs)))
```

## ReplacementForTwoMultiplications: Replacement for two multiplications

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

The boundary embeddings from Cases~1 and~2 exchange top and bottom.
The source basis is \(G\times_E F\) and the target basis is \(A\).

At arbitrary index, either shape evaluates to
\[
 [g,h]\longmapsto a(g)M(bc)(h),
\]
where \(M\in\C[A]\) is a finite complex linear combination of group elements \(p\) satisfying
\((ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\) for \(v\in E\).
Every such \(M\) is realized by a single diagram of either shape.
The two replacements induce inverse bijections on classes modulo
equality of evaluated maps.

In Case~3 take \(B'=A,\ u=\id,\ v=ad,\ w=bc\). Put the label \(M\)
at the bottom mixed crossing and \(1\) at the other two. For each term
\(p\) of \(M\) the first multiplication gives \([g,p(bc)(h)]\).
The next multiplication and the last merge and split give
\(a(g)p(bc)(h)\). In Case~4 take \(B=E,\ r=de,\ s=cf,\ t=\id\).
Put \(M\) at the top mixed crossing and \(1\) at the other two.
The first merge and split and the next multiplication give \([g,c(h)]\).
The last multiplication gives \(a(g)p b(c(h))\) for each term \(p\).
In both constructions the condition on \(p\) is exactly the condition
at its vertex. All mixed crossings are multiplication maps, so no
index condition enters.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 6.5 [thm:three-multiplications]; Cases 3 and 4; explicit replacements, p. 24 (related source excerpts on pp. 22, 24–25)](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.2.2, Theorem 6.5 (thm:three-multiplications), Cases 3 and 4, p. 24. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered page and source TikZ give the bottom-to-top crossing orders s₁s₂s₁ and s₂s₁s₂ at the fixed boundary. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The specified defect report returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No corrected statement was available for Theorem 6.5. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026, recorded in translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the representation of the marks. Each uses a single shared LabelledDrawing.parallelUp or LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication constructor with a finite, termwise eligible complex DotLabel. The shared compilation slot verified that the type elaborates and that planar erasure retains the same three positioned marks in each case for all labels, including zero. The boundary merge and split identify the bases for the formula, and the quotient classes use evaluation on the full fixed strand words. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ReplacementForTwoMultiplications : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
  let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let eval := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let bc := comp b c
  let de := comp d e
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let top := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let Left := Σ B : Subgroup U,
    Σ r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G,
    Σ s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B D,
    Σ t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B,
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex de (comp r t) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp s t) (comp c f) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a r) (comp b s)
  let Right := Σ B' : Subgroup U,
    Σ u' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A,
    Σ v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B',
    Σ w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B',
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp v e) (comp w f) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a d) (comp u' v) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp u' w) bc
  let onLastTwo := fun {K H J J' L : Subgroup U}
      (spectator : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J) (q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L)
      (p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J') (q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L)
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
    stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate spectator p q))
      (stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id spectator)) crossing)
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate spectator p' q')))
  let leftDrawing : Left → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ =>
      let first := juxtapose
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp d e r t (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f)))
      let second := onLastTwo (up r) (up t) (down f) (down s) (up c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication s c t f (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms y))
      let third := juxtapose
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b r s (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms z))
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up c)))
      stack first (stack second third)
  let rightDrawing : Right → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, u', v, w, x, y, z⟩ =>
      let first := onLastTwo (up d) (up e) (down f) (down v) (up w)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication v w e f (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))
      let second := juxtapose
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a u' d v (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms y))
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up w)))
      let third := onLastTwo (down a) (up u') (up w) (up b) (up c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp u' w b c (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms z))
      stack first (stack second third)
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor (up de) (down f)) bottom :=
    juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp d e))
      (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down f)))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top (tensor (down a) (up bc)) :=
    stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
      (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down a)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp b c)))
  let admissible := fun (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) =>
    ∀ p ∈ Finsupp.support (MonoidAlgebra.coeff M), ∀ v : E,
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp a de) v * p =
        p * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp bc f) v
  let evaluatesAs := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex A) =>
    ∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval (stack splitBottom (stack drawing mergeTop)))
        (Finsupp.single
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) 1) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc)
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff
          (MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a g) 1 *
            M * MonoidAlgebra.single (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc h) 1))
  let leftEval := fun l : Left => eval (leftDrawing l)
  let rightEval := fun r : Right => eval (rightDrawing r)
  let leftClasses := Setoid.ker leftEval
  let rightClasses := Setoid.ker rightEval
  (∀ l : Left, ∃ M, admissible M ∧ evaluatesAs (leftDrawing l) M) ∧
  (∀ r : Right, ∃ M, admissible M ∧ evaluatesAs (rightDrawing r) M) ∧
  (∀ M, admissible M →
    (∃ l : Left, evaluatesAs (leftDrawing l) M) ∧
    (∃ r : Right, evaluatesAs (rightDrawing r) M)) ∧
  (∃ (replaceCase3 : Left → Right) (replaceCase4 : Right → Left)
      (replacement : Quotient leftClasses ≃ Quotient rightClasses),
    (∀ l : Left, rightEval (replaceCase3 l) = leftEval l ∧
      replacement (Quotient.mk leftClasses l) = Quotient.mk rightClasses (replaceCase3 l)) ∧
    (∀ r : Right, leftEval (replaceCase4 r) = rightEval r ∧
      Equiv.symm replacement (Quotient.mk rightClasses r) = Quotient.mk leftClasses (replaceCase4 r)))
```

## MixedMultiplicationLabelsChangeOnRoundTrip: A round trip for two mixed multiplications

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

```lean
theorem MixedMultiplicationLabelsChangeOnRoundTrip : let U := Multiplicative (ZMod 2)
let K : Subgroup U := ⊤
let g : K := ⟨Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ZMod 2), Subgroup.mem_top _⟩
let i := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id K
let ii := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp i i
let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i
let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down i
let bottom := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor up up) down
let top := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up) up
let Weight := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex ii ii
let Labels := Weight × Weight × Weight
let Drawing := fun p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K K => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q
let ordinary := fun {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K K} (d : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex p q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary d
let straight := fun p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K K => ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
let mixed := fun w : Weight =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication i i i i (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms w)
let parallel := fun w : Weight =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp i i i i (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms w)
let onLastTwo := fun (spectator p q p' q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K K)
    (crossing : Drawing (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor p q) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor p' q')) =>
  stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate spectator p q))
    (stack (juxtapose (straight spectator) crossing)
      (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate spectator p' q')))
let leftDrawing : Labels → Drawing bottom top := fun (x₁, x₂, x₃) =>
  stack (juxtapose (parallel x₁) (straight down))
    (stack (onLastTwo up up down down up (mixed x₂))
      (juxtapose (mixed x₃) (straight up)))
let rightDrawing : Labels → Drawing bottom top := fun (y₁, y₂, y₃) =>
  stack (onLastTwo up up down down up (mixed y₁))
    (stack (juxtapose (mixed y₂) (straight up))
      (onLastTwo down up up up up (parallel y₃)))
let splitBottom :=
  juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp i i))
    (straight down)
let mergeTop :=
  stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate down up up))
    (juxtapose (straight down)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp i i)))
let eval := fun {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K K} (drawing : Drawing p q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
let multiplier := fun (drawing : Drawing bottom top) =>
  MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct i ii)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (eval (stack splitBottom (stack drawing mergeTop)))
        (Finsupp.single
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction ii)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction i) 1 1) 1)))
let selfDot : K → MackeyDiagrams.Dot ii ii :=
  fun p => ⟨p, fun v => mul_comm (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom ii v) p⟩
let unitWeight : Weight := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.identity ii
let gWeight : Weight := Finsupp.single (selfDot g) 1
let asWeight := fun (M : MonoidAlgebra Complex K) =>
  Finsupp.mapDomain selfDot (MonoidAlgebra.coeff M)
let replaceCase3 : Labels → Labels :=
  fun l => (asWeight (multiplier (leftDrawing l)), unitWeight, unitWeight)
let replaceCase4 : Labels → Labels :=
  fun r => (unitWeight, unitWeight, asWeight (multiplier (rightDrawing r)))
let original : Labels := (gWeight, unitWeight, gWeight)
let units : Labels := (unitWeight, unitWeight, unitWeight)
let roundTrip := replaceCase4 (replaceCase3 original)
g ≠ 1 ∧ g ^ 2 = 1 ∧
  multiplier (leftDrawing original) = 1 ∧
  roundTrip = units ∧ roundTrip ≠ original ∧
  eval (leftDrawing roundTrip) = eval (leftDrawing original)
```

## CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluation: Case 5 left shape with one projection

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is

 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].

By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

Write \(a:A\to G\), \(b:A\to D\), and \(d:F\to D\) for the lower
embeddings and \(c:C\to G\), \(e:C\to E\), and \(f:F\to E\) for the upper ones.
The source basis is \(G\times_A D\) and the target basis is \(G\times_C E\).

On the left use \(u:G\to B\), \(v:D\to B\), and \(w:E\to B\),
and labels \(r,t,s\) from bottom to top, with \(r,s\) the mixed crossing elements.
The map is
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-left-middle-restriction}
 [g,x]_A\longmapsto
 \sum_{\substack{[h,y]_C\\u(h)s w(y)=u(g)r v(x)t}}[h,y]_C .
\end{equation}

For linear labels, sum the formulas over the group-element triples.

On the left the vertex conditions are
\[
 \begin{gathered}
 ua=\operatorname{Ad}_r\circ vb,\qquad
 vd=\operatorname{Ad}_t\circ wf,\qquad
 uc=\operatorname{Ad}_s\circ we .
 \end{gathered}
\]
The lower multiplication gives \(u(g)r v(x)\), the induction dot
right-multiplies by \(t\), and the upper projection takes the displayed fiber.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.3, (6.3) [eq:three-left-middle-restriction] and left vertex conditions, pp. 22, 25–26](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.3, the left half of Lemma 6.6, equation (6.3), with the three left vertex conditions and the § 6.2 mixed-crossing convention on p. 22. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered diagram on p. 25 and the project TikZ give the crossing order. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 in input.request, recorded in evidence/language-audit-20261127/owner-clarification.json, applies to every mark. The request supplies no separate ID. The termwise eligibility conditions are encoded by the three Dot types. The shared LabelledDrawing constructors retain one marked crossing at each level, including for zero labels. The upper projection is parameterized by s, whose trace dot is s⁻¹. Every supported projection term has finite fibers of q_s over B. The group-element formula uses coefficient-one singleton labels, and the general formula uses the product of the three coefficients over the finite supports. The last induction factors use the unit representatives of the balanced source and target bases. Lean elaborated the exact proposition through the shared compilation slot and separately verified the three positioned marks at the fixed orientation boundary for arbitrary label lists.

```lean
theorem CaseFiveLeftShapeEvaluation : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
    (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let sourcePair := tensor (up a) (down b)
  let targetPair := tensor (up c) (down e)
  let targetBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis targetPair
  let bottom := tensor sourcePair (up d)
  let top := tensor targetPair (up f)
  let RDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α a) (comp β b)
  let TDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp β d) (comp γ f)
  let SDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α c) (comp γ e)
  let q := fun (s : SDot) (p : targetBasis.carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α γ c e s p)
  let finiteFibers := fun (s : SDot) => ∀ z : B, Set.Finite {p | q s p = z}
  let projectionDot := fun (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) =>
    (⟨s, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hs (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ z))
      (fun _ hz => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ) hz)⟩ :
        MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)
  let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
  let drawing := fun (rs : List (Complex × RDot)) (ts : List (Complex × TDot))
      (ss : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)) =>
    (stack
      (juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β a b rs)
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up d))))
      (stack
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down α) (up β) (up d)))
        (stack
          (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down α)))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp β d γ f ts))
          (stack
            (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down α) (up γ) (up f)))
            (juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α γ c e ss)
              (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up f))))))) :
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
  let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis sourcePair)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b) g x) 1
  let output := fun (p : targetBasis.carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair targetBasis (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction f) p 1
  let evaluates := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (g : G) (x : D) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret diagram))
      (Finsupp.single (input g x) 1)
  let fiberSum := fun (r : RDot) (t : TDot) (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D) =>
    Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hs
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r *
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β x * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)))
      (fun p => Finsupp.single (output p) (1 : Complex))
  (∀ (r : RDot) (t : TDot) (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D),
    evaluates (drawing [(1, r)] [(1, t)] [(1, projectionDot s hs)]) g x =
      fiberSum r t s hs g x) ∧
  (∀ (rs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp α a) (comp β b))
      (ts : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp β d) (comp γ f))
      (ss : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp α c) (comp γ e))
      (hs : ∀ s ∈ Finsupp.support ss, finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D),
    let supported := Finset.attach (Finsupp.support ss)
    let terms := List.map (fun s =>
      (ss (Subtype.val s), projectionDot (Subtype.val s) (hs (Subtype.val s) (Subtype.property s))))
      (Finset.toList supported)
    evaluates (drawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts) terms) g x =
      Finsupp.sum rs (fun r cr =>
        Finsupp.sum ts (fun t ct =>
          Finset.sum supported (fun s =>
            (cr * ct * ss (Subtype.val s)) •
              fiberSum r t (Subtype.val s) (hs (Subtype.val s) (Subtype.property s)) g x))))
```

## CaseSixRightShapeEvaluation: Case 6 right shape with one projection

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

Write \(a:A\to G\), \(b:A\to D\), and \(d:F\to D\) for the lower
embeddings and \(c:C\to G\), \(e:C\to E\), and \(f:F\to E\) for the upper ones.
The source basis is \(G\times_A D\) and the target basis is \(G\times_C E\).

On the right use \(i:B'\to A\), \(j:B'\to F\), and \(k:B'\to C\),
and write the labels in the same order as \(r,t,s\). The map is
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-right-middle-restriction}
 [g,x]_A\longmapsto
 \sum_{\substack{[\alpha,h]\in A\times_{B'}F\\ b(\alpha)r d(h)=x}}
       [ga(\alpha)t,\ s f(h)]_C .
\end{equation}
For linear labels, sum the formulas over the group-element triples.

On the right the conditions are
\[
 \begin{gathered}
 bi=\operatorname{Ad}_r\circ dj,\qquad
 ai=\operatorname{Ad}_t\circ ck,\qquad
 ek=\operatorname{Ad}_s\circ fj .
 \end{gathered}
\]
The lower projection sums factorizations of \(x\) as \(b(\alpha)r d(h)\).
The induction dot sends the first coordinate of the surviving pair
to \(ga(\alpha)t\), and the upper multiplication sends the second
to \(s f(h)\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.3, (6.4) [eq:three-right-middle-restriction] and right vertex conditions, pp. 22, 25–26](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.3, Lemma 6.6, right-hand equation (6.4), the Case 6 figure and the three right-hand vertex conditions on pp. 25–26, with the finite-fiber convention on p. 22. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The projection parameter r is the inverse of the trace dot. The formula sums over balanced classes and requires finite fibers for each supported lower projection term. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no correction to equation (6.4), so the article endpoint governs. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the drawing syntax. A compact projection, a parallel upward crossing, and a mixed multiplication each carry one finite complex label of termwise eligible group elements at the fixed boundary. The same drawing accepts coefficient-one singletons and empty labels. The products of the three label coefficients appear in the evaluation formula. Lean elaborated the exact proposition through the shared compilation slot and verified the right–left–right order of the three planar marks for arbitrary label lists. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem CaseSixRightShapeEvaluation : ∀ {U : Type*} [Group U] (G A D F C E B' : Subgroup U)
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
    (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
    (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let ga := up a
  let ad := down b
  let df := up d
  let ai := up i
  let fj := down j
  let gc := up c
  let ck := up k
  let ce := down e
  let ef := up f
  let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
  let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
  let LowerDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j)
  let MiddleDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
  let UpperDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
  let FiberWord := tensor ai fj
  let q := fun (r : LowerDot) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis FiberWord).carrier) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w)
  let finiteFibers := fun (r : LowerDot) => ∀ x : D, Set.Finite {w | q r w = x}
  let projectionTerm := fun (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r) =>
    (⟨r, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hr (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d z))
      (fun _ hw => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d) hw)⟩ :
        MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let rightDrawing := fun
      (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
      (middle : List (Complex × MiddleDot)) (upper : List (Complex × UpperDot)) =>
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k middle) (drawId fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc)
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper))))) :
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
  let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
      (g : G) (x : D) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
      (Finsupp.single
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g
          (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)) 1)
  let formula := fun (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r)
      (t : MiddleDot) (s : UpperDot) (g : G) (x : D) =>
    Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hr x)) (fun w =>
      let representative : A × F := Quotient.out w
      Finsupp.single
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef))
          (g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a representative.1 *
            MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f
            (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s *
              MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f representative.2))) (1 : Complex))
  (∀ (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r) (t : MiddleDot) (s : UpperDot) (g : G) (x : D),
    evaluate (rightDrawing [(1, projectionTerm r hr)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]) g x =
      formula r hr t s g x) ∧
  (∀ (R : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b i) (comp d j))
      (T : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
      (S : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j))
      (hR : ∀ r ∈ Finsupp.support R, finiteFibers r) (g : G) (x : D),
    let lowerSupport := Finset.attach (Finsupp.support R)
    let lowerTerms := List.map (fun r : {r // r ∈ Finsupp.support R} =>
      (R r.val, projectionTerm r.val (hR r.val r.property))) (Finset.toList lowerSupport)
    evaluate (rightDrawing lowerTerms (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms T)
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms S)) g x =
      Finset.sum lowerSupport (fun r =>
        Finset.sum (Finsupp.support T) (fun t =>
          Finset.sum (Finsupp.support S) (fun s =>
            (R r.val * T t * S s) • formula r.val (hR r.val r.property) t s g x))))
```

```lean
theorem EvaluationWithOneProjection : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] {G A D F C E : Subgroup U}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  (∀ {B : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
    let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
    let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
    let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
    let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
    let sourcePair := tensor (up a) (down b)
    let targetPair := tensor (up c) (down e)
    let targetBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis targetPair
    let bottom := tensor sourcePair (up d)
    let top := tensor targetPair (up f)
    let RDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α a) (comp β b)
    let TDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp β d) (comp γ f)
    let SDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α c) (comp γ e)
    let q := fun (s : SDot) (p : targetBasis.carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α γ c e s p)
    let finiteFibers := fun (s : SDot) => ∀ z : B, Set.Finite {p | q s p = z}
    let projectionDot := fun (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) =>
      (⟨s, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hs (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ z))
        (fun _ hz => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct α γ) hz)⟩ :
          MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)
    let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
    let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
    let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
    let drawing := fun (rs : List (Complex × RDot)) (ts : List (Complex × TDot))
        (ss : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α γ c e)) =>
      (stack
        (juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β a b rs)
          (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up d))))
        (stack
          (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down α) (up β) (up d)))
          (stack
            (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (down α)))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp β d γ f ts))
            (stack
              (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down α) (up γ) (up f)))
              (juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α γ c e ss)
                (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (up f))))))) :
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis sourcePair)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction d)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction b) g x) 1
    let output := fun (p : targetBasis.carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair targetBasis (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction f) p 1
    let evaluates := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
        (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret diagram))
        (Finsupp.single (input g x) 1)
    let fiberSum := fun (r : RDot) (t : TDot) (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D) =>
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hs
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom β x * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)))
        (fun p => Finsupp.single (output p) (1 : Complex))
    (∀ (r : RDot) (t : TDot) (s : SDot) (hs : finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D),
      evaluates (drawing [(1, r)] [(1, t)] [(1, projectionDot s hs)]) g x =
        fiberSum r t s hs g x) ∧
    (∀ (rs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp α a) (comp β b))
        (ts : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp β d) (comp γ f))
        (ss : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp α c) (comp γ e))
        (hs : ∀ s ∈ Finsupp.support ss, finiteFibers s) (g : G) (x : D),
      let supported := Finset.attach (Finsupp.support ss)
      let terms := List.map (fun s =>
        (ss (Subtype.val s), projectionDot (Subtype.val s) (hs (Subtype.val s) (Subtype.property s))))
        (Finset.toList supported)
      evaluates (drawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts) terms) g x =
        Finsupp.sum rs (fun r cr =>
          Finsupp.sum ts (fun t ct =>
            Finset.sum supported (fun s =>
              (cr * ct * ss (Subtype.val s)) •
                fiberSum r t (Subtype.val s) (hs (Subtype.val s) (Subtype.property s)) g x))))) ∧
  (∀ (B' : Subgroup U)
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
    let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
    let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
    let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
    let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
    let ga := up a
    let ad := down b
    let df := up d
    let ai := up i
    let fj := down j
    let gc := up c
    let ck := up k
    let ce := down e
    let ef := up f
    let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
    let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
    let LowerDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j)
    let MiddleDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
    let UpperDot := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
    let FiberWord := tensor ai fj
    let q := fun (r : LowerDot) (w : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis FiberWord).carrier) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d
        (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r w)
    let finiteFibers := fun (r : LowerDot) => ∀ x : D, Set.Finite {w | q r w = x}
    let projectionTerm := fun (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r) =>
      (⟨r, fun z => Set.Finite.subset (hr (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d z))
        (fun _ hw => congrArg (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct b d) hw)⟩ :
          MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
    let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
    let rightDrawing := fun
        (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
        (middle : List (Complex × MiddleDot)) (upper : List (Complex × UpperDot)) =>
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga)
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k middle) (drawId fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc)
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper))))) :
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
        (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
        (Finsupp.single
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)) 1)
    let formula := fun (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r)
        (t : MiddleDot) (s : UpperDot) (g : G) (x : D) =>
      Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hr x)) (fun w =>
        let representative : A × F := Quotient.out w
        Finsupp.single
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef))
            (g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a representative.1 *
              MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f
              (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s *
                MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f representative.2))) (1 : Complex))
    (∀ (r : LowerDot) (hr : finiteFibers r) (t : MiddleDot) (s : UpperDot) (g : G) (x : D),
      evaluate (rightDrawing [(1, projectionTerm r hr)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]) g x =
        formula r hr t s g x) ∧
    (∀ (R : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b i) (comp d j))
        (T : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
        (S : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j))
        (hR : ∀ r ∈ Finsupp.support R, finiteFibers r) (g : G) (x : D),
      let lowerSupport := Finset.attach (Finsupp.support R)
      let lowerTerms := List.map (fun r : {r // r ∈ Finsupp.support R} =>
        (R r.val, projectionTerm r.val (hR r.val r.property))) (Finset.toList lowerSupport)
      evaluate (rightDrawing lowerTerms (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms T)
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms S)) g x =
        Finset.sum lowerSupport (fun r =>
          Finset.sum (Finsupp.support T) (fun t =>
            Finset.sum (Finsupp.support S) (fun s =>
              (R r.val * T t * S s) • formula r.val (hR r.val r.property) t s g x)))))
```

## RightOrbitDiagramFromProjectedStabilizer: Orbit diagram from the projected pair stabilizer

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Write \(a:A\to G\), \(b:A\to D\), and \(d:F\to D\) for the lower
embeddings and \(c:C\to G\), \(e:C\to E\), and \(f:F\to E\) for the upper ones.
The source basis is \(G\times_A D\) and the target basis is \(G\times_C E\).

Let \(G\times F\) act on each basis by left multiplication by \(G\)
and right multiplication by the inverse of \(F\), using the boundary
embeddings. The action on input--output pairs acts on both coordinates.
A bimodule map has constant matrix coefficient on each orbit.

Choose a representative \(([1,r]_A,[t,s]_C)\) of an orbit.
Let \(P\le F\) be the image of its stabilizer in \(F\).
In detail, \(h\in P\) exactly when there exist \(i(h)\in A,\ k(h)\in C\)
satisfying
\[
 \begin{gathered}
 r d(h)r^{-1}=b(i(h)),\qquad
 s f(h)s^{-1}=e(k(h)),\\
 a(i(h))=t c(k(h))t^{-1}.
 \end{gathered}
\]
These equations describe the stabilizer as the graph
\(\{(a(i(h)),h):h\in P\}\). They also make \(i,k\) conjugation
embeddings. Take \(B'=P,\ j\) the inclusion, and labels \((r,t,s)\).
The displayed equations are the three vertex conditions.

The pairs in the orbit have the form
\[
 \bigl([g',r d(h)]_A,\ [g't,s f(h)]_C\bigr)
 \qquad(g'\in G,\ h\in F).
\]
The source in this pair equals \([g,x]_A\) exactly when
\(g'=ga(\alpha)\) and \(x=b(\alpha)r d(h)\) for some \(\alpha\in A\).
Two such choices give the same pair exactly when they are equivalent
in \(A\times_P F\), by the full stabilizer description.
Thus (6.4) sums each output in
the orbit once. If this orbit has nonzero coefficient in a bimodule
map, it has finitely many outputs over each input, so the lower
projection is defined.

Conversely, (6.4) shows that a
group-element triple contributes to at most one orbit, irrespective
of the chosen internal group. Finite sums and finite linear labels
therefore involve finitely many orbits. The construction gives one
diagram for each orbit of nonzero coefficient. At each input only
finitely many of these diagrams contribute, because an element of
the target has finite support. This gives the asserted expansion.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 6.3.1, construction in the proof of Theorem 6.7, pp. 25–26](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The diagonal action uses inverse right multiplication. The lower projection parameter r is the inverse of the trace dot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf
