## ProductParabolicsWithOneDoubleCoset: A product with one double coset

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For \(G=S_4\times S_4\), \(K=(S_2\times S_2)\times S_4\) and
\(H=S_4\times(S_2\times S_2)\), each ambient block contributes
one double coset. The representative is \(1\), and
\(K\cap H=S_2^4\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 7.6 [ex:product-two-factors], p. 31](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 7.6 (ex:product-two-factors), p. 31. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and no correction for this endpoint was available. Each Fin 4 factor uses zero-based labels for the four ordered points. The two Fin 2 summands embed as the first and last consecutive pairs in each factor. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ProductParabolicsWithOneDoubleCoset : let S₂ := Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)
let S₄ := Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)
let G := S₄ × S₄
let split : S₂ × S₂ →* S₄ :=
  MonoidHom.comp
    (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (Equiv.permCongrHom (finSumFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 2))))
    (Equiv.Perm.sumCongrHom (Fin 2) (Fin 2))
let P : Subgroup S₄ := MonoidHom.range split
let T : Subgroup S₄ := ⊤
let K : Subgroup G := Subgroup.prod P T
let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.prod T P
(∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (P : Set S₄) (T : Set S₄),
  q = DoubleCoset.mk P T (1 : S₄)) ∧
(∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (T : Set S₄) (P : Set S₄),
  q = DoubleCoset.mk T P (1 : S₄)) ∧
(∀ q : DoubleCoset.Quotient (K : Set G) (H : Set G),
  q = DoubleCoset.mk K H (1 : G)) ∧
K ⊓ H = Subgroup.prod P P ∧
Nonempty (↥(K ⊓ H) ≃* ((S₂ × S₂) × (S₂ × S₂)))
```

## ProductParabolicsWithThreeDoubleCosets: A product with three double cosets

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For \(G=S_4^3\) on three successive blocks,
\(K=(S_2\times S_2)\times S_4\times(S_2\times S_2)\) and
\(H=S_4\times(S_2\times S_2)\times(S_2\times S_2)\), the first
two blocks again contribute \(1\). In the last block choose
\(\sigma_0=1\), \(\sigma_1=(10\,11)\), and
\(\sigma_2=(9\,12)(10\,11)\). The Mackey groups are
\(L_0=L_2=S_2^6\) and \(L_1=S_2^4\). Conjugation by \(\sigma_2\)
exchanges the last two \(S_2\) factors of \(L_2\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 7.7 [ex:product-three-factors], p. 31](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 7.7 (ex:product-three-factors), p. 31. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte, and the article webpage gives the same statement. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash, and the task context supplies no correction for this example. The three symmetric groups act on the successive intervals 1–4, 5–8, and 9–12. Each half-block subgroup fixes its complement in the corresponding interval. The first two local double-coset spaces are singletons and the three global representatives have identity components there. The Mackey subgroup equalities specify the embedded factors, and the two conjugation equalities express their exchange in the last block. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#ex:product-three-factors https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ProductParabolicsWithThreeDoubleCosets : let X₀ := Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 4
let X₁ := Finset.Icc (5 : Nat) 8
let X₂ := Finset.Icc (9 : Nat) 12
let P₀ := Equiv.Perm ↥X₀
let P₁ := Equiv.Perm ↥X₁
let P₂ := Equiv.Perm ↥X₂
let G := P₀ × (P₁ × P₂)
let half := fun (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) (upper : Bool) =>
  let block := Finset.filter
    (fun x : ↥X => if upper then m < Subtype.val x else Subtype.val x ≤ m) Finset.univ
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ block))
let split := fun (X : Finset Nat) (m : Nat) => half X m false ⊔ half X m true
let A₀ := split X₀ 2
let A₁ := split X₁ 6
let A₂ := split X₂ 10
let K : Subgroup G := Subgroup.prod A₀ (Subgroup.prod ⊤ A₂)
let H : Subgroup G := Subgroup.prod ⊤ (Subgroup.prod A₁ A₂)
let σ₁ : P₂ := Equiv.swap
  ⟨10, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
  ⟨11, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
let σ₂ : P₂ := (Equiv.swap
  ⟨9, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
  ⟨12, Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩) * σ₁
let σ : Fin 3 → G := fun i => (1, 1, if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then σ₁ else σ₂)
let conj := fun g : G => MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)
let L := fun i : Fin 3 => K ⊓ Subgroup.map (conj (σ i)) H
let lastFactor := fun T : Subgroup P₂ =>
  (Subgroup.prod ⊥ (Subgroup.prod ⊥ T) : Subgroup G)
let F₀ := lastFactor (half X₂ 10 false)
let F₁ := lastFactor (half X₂ 10 true)
Subsingleton (DoubleCoset.Quotient (A₀ : Set P₀) (↑(⊤ : Subgroup P₀))) ∧
  Subsingleton (DoubleCoset.Quotient (↑(⊤ : Subgroup P₁)) (A₁ : Set P₁)) ∧
  Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk K H (σ i)) ∧
  L 0 = Subgroup.prod A₀ (Subgroup.prod A₁ A₂) ∧
  L 1 = Subgroup.prod A₀ (Subgroup.prod A₁ ⊥) ∧
  L 2 = L 0 ∧
  Subgroup.map (conj (σ 2)) F₀ = F₁ ∧
  Subgroup.map (conj (σ 2)) F₁ = F₀
```

## TwoBlockSplitGivesFourIntersections: A two-block split giving four intersections

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

The middle double coset of
\(S_2\times S_2\backslash S_4/(S_2\times S_2)\) has four
singleton blocks. Thus the family of binary refinements of \(G\)
with a prescribed split size need not contain the Mackey groups.

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte, and the article page gives the same statement. The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and no statement correction for Example 7.8 was available. The standard order in § 7.3 uses the identity, (2 3), and (1 4)(2 3) on labels 1 through 4, so (2 3) represents the middle class. The prescribed split size in this example is 2 + 2, and the family ranges over all partitions of the four labels with those sizes. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem TwoBlockSplitGivesFourIntersections : let X : Finset Nat := Finset.Icc 1 4
let G := Equiv.Perm ↥X
let interval := fun lo hi : Nat =>
  Finset.filter (fun x : ↥X => lo ≤ Subtype.val x ∧ Subtype.val x ≤ hi) Finset.univ
let blocks : Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun r =>
  if r = 0 then interval 1 2 else interval 3 4
let blockSym := fun S : Finset ↥X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : ↥X => x ∈ S))
let P : Subgroup G := iSup (fun r => blockSym (blocks r))
let point : Fin 4 → ↥X := fun i =>
  ⟨Fin.val i + 1, Iff.mpr Finset.mem_Icc
    ⟨Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le (Fin.val i)), Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Fin.isLt i)⟩⟩
let σ : G := Equiv.swap (point 1) (point 2)
let representative : Fin 3 → G := fun i =>
  if i = 0 then 1 else if i = 1 then σ else Equiv.swap (point 0) (point 3) * σ
let C : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → Finset ↥X := fun r c =>
  blocks r ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding σ) (blocks c)
let L : Subgroup G := P ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj σ)) P
let binaryRefinements : Set (Subgroup G) :=
  {Q | ∃ U : Finset ↥X, Finset.card U = 2 ∧
    Q = blockSym U ⊔ blockSym (Finset.univ \ U)}
Function.Bijective (fun i => DoubleCoset.mk P P (representative i)) ∧
  (∀ r c, Finset.card (C r c) = 1) ∧
  L = ⊥ ∧
  L ∉ binaryRefinements
```

## MackeyDecompositionWithParabolicRepresentatives: Mackey decomposition with explicit parabolic representatives

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(K,H,G\) be finite parabolics in \(S_\infty\), and let
\(\cg{\alpha}{K},\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\). Index the double cosets
\[
 J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad
 G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H})
\]
by the tuples of matrices for the blocks of \(G\), with
\(\sigma_j\) obtained by the ordered matching of
Proposition~7.3. Put
\[
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H},
 \qquad
 \lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha,\qquad
 \mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta .
\]
Then \(L_j\) is the product of the symmetric groups on the
corresponding block intersections, and there is a natural
isomorphism
\[
 \Res_{\alpha_*}\circ\Ind_{\beta_*}
   \cong\bigoplus_{j\in J}\Ind_{\lambda_j}\circ\Res_{\mu_j}.
\]
For inclusion boundary embeddings this is
\[
 \Res_K^G\circ\Ind_H^G
 \cong \bigoplus_{j\in K\backslash G/H}
   \Ind_{L_j}^K\circ c_{\sigma_j}\circ
   \Res_{\sigma_j^{-1}L_j\sigma_j}^{H},
\]
where \(c_{\sigma_j}\) gives \(\ell\in L_j\) the action of
\(\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Theorem 7.4 [thm:mackey-finite-parabolic], p. 32](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The supplied defect report returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The task context supplies no correction for Theorem 7.4. The common finite carrier and its ordered partitions encode singleton padding for the ambient group and the two conjugated subgroups. The rank equations apply the ordered matching of Proposition 7.3 on each ambient block, including blocks with a single double coset. The two natural isomorphisms use the same matrix-indexed representatives and intersections. In the inclusion formula the pullback along conjugation by the inverse representative is written as its own restriction functor. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem MackeyDecompositionWithParabolicRepresentatives : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let Finitary := Subgroup.closure {s : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s}
let conj := fun (s : P) => MulAut.conj s
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj s)) S
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let forward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : conjugate p S ≤ T) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
    (MonoidHom.subgroupMap (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj p)) S)
let backward := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (p : P) (hp : T ≤ conjugate p S) =>
  MonoidHom.comp (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulEquiv.subgroupMap (conj p) S).symm)
    (Subgroup.inclusion hp)
let Mod := fun S : Subgroup P => ModuleCat.{v} (MonoidAlgebra Complex S)
let Res := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainAlgHom Complex Complex f).toRingHom :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod T) (Mod S))
let Ind := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (f : S →* T) =>
  (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
      (Rep.ofModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := S))
      (Rep.indFunctor Complex f))
    (Rep.toModuleMonoidAlgebra (k := Complex) (G := T)) :
    CategoryTheory.Functor (Mod S) (Mod T))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup P) (α β : ↥Finitary)
  (X : Finset Nat) (g r c : Nat)
  (D : Fin g → Finset Nat) (A : Fin r → Finset Nat) (B : Fin c → Finset Nat),
  (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) →
  (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (A a)) →
  (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (B b)) →
  Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) →
  Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (A a) (A a')) →
  Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (B b) (B b')) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ A a) →
  (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ B b) →
  let Kα := conjugate (α : P) K
  let Hβ := conjugate (β : P) H
  G = iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i)) →
  Kα = iSup (fun a => blockSym (A a)) →
  Hβ = iSup (fun b => blockSym (B b)) →
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let left := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let right := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let Q := DoubleCoset.Quotient (left : Set G) (right : Set G)
    let rows := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun a : Fin r => A a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let cols := fun i : Fin g =>
      Finset.filter (fun b : Fin c => B b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let row := fun (i : Fin g) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (A ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val))
    let col := fun (i : Fin g) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
      Finset.subtype (fun n : Nat => n ∈ D i)
        (B ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val))
    let Mat := fun i : Fin g =>
      {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
        (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
        (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
    let J := ∀ i : Fin g, Mat i
    let rank := fun (i : Fin g) (S : Finset ↥(D i)) (x : ↥S) =>
      ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
    let αmap : K →* G := forward (α : P) hK
    let βmap : H →* G := forward (β : P) hH
    ∃ (split : G ≃* (∀ i : Fin g, Equiv.Perm ↥(D i))) (classify : Q ≃ J) (σ : J → G),
      (∀ (s : G) (i : Fin g) (x : ↥(D i)), (split s i x).val = (s : P) x.val) ∧
      (∀ (s : G) (i : Fin g) a b,
        (classify (DoubleCoset.mk left right s) i).val a b =
          Finset.card (row i a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (split s i)) (col i b))) ∧
      (∀ R : J, DoubleCoset.mk left right (σ R) = classify.symm R) ∧
      (∀ (R : J) (i : Fin g) a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        split (σ R) i y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin ((R i).val a b),
            rank i (row i a) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => (R i).val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank i (col i b) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => (R i).val a' b) + k.val) ∧
      let L := fun R : J => Kα ⊓ conjugate ((σ R : P) * (β : P)) H
      let lambdaMap : ∀ R : J, L R →* K := fun R =>
        backward (α : P) (show L R ≤ Kα from inf_le_left)
      let muMap : ∀ R : J, L R →* H := fun R =>
        backward ((σ R : P) * (β : P))
          (show L R ≤ conjugate ((σ R : P) * (β : P)) H from inf_le_right)
      (∀ R : J,
        L R = iSup (fun a => iSup (fun b =>
          blockSym (A a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (σ R : P)) (B b))))) ∧
      Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
        (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Ind βmap) (Res αmap))
        (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj
          (fun R : J => CategoryTheory.Functor.comp (Res (muMap R)) (Ind (lambdaMap R))))) ∧
      ((∀ k : K, (αmap k : P) = (k : P)) →
        (∀ h : H, (βmap h : P) = (h : P)) →
        let T := fun R : J => conjugate (σ R : P)⁻¹ (L R)
        let transport : ∀ R : J, L R →* T R := fun R =>
          MonoidHom.subgroupMap
            (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (conj (σ R : P)⁻¹)) (L R)
        ∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hHG : H ≤ G) (hLK : ∀ R : J, L R ≤ K) (hTH : ∀ R : J, T R ≤ H),
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso
            (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
              (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion hHG)) (Res (Subgroup.inclusion hKG)))
            (CategoryTheory.Limits.sigmaObj (fun R : J =>
              CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                (CategoryTheory.Functor.comp
                  (Res (Subgroup.inclusion (hTH R))) (Res (transport R)))
                (Ind (Subgroup.inclusion (hLK R)))))))
```

## FiniteParabolicBicategoryComposition: Explicit middle groups and embeddings for bicategory composition

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Finite parabolic subgroups of \(S_\infty\) form a bicategory with
1-morphisms \(H\to K\) the bimodules isomorphic to finite direct sums of
\[
 \C[K]\otimes_{\C[L]}\C[H],
 \qquad K\xleftarrow{a}L\xrightarrow{b}H,
\]
where \(L\) is finite parabolic and \(a,b\) are conjugation embeddings
in \(S_\infty\). The 2-morphisms are bimodule maps. Composition is
tensor product over the group algebra of the common group.

For composition with \(H\xleftarrow{c}M\xrightarrow{d}J\), apply
Theorem~7.4 to the middle factor
\(\C[H]\) with its actions through \(b\) and \(c\). For each
representative \(r\in H\) of a double coset in \(b(L)\backslash H/c(M)\),
the resulting summand has middle group
\[
 b(L)\cap r c(M)r^{-1}
\]
and embeddings \(x\mapsto a(b^{-1}(x))\) into \(K\) and
\(x\mapsto d(c^{-1}(r^{-1}xr))\) into \(J\). These are conjugation
embeddings, and the middle group is finite parabolic by
Proposition~7.1. Theorem~7.4
also gives explicit representatives \(r\) by ordered matching on
the blocks of \(H\). There are finitely many double cosets, and tensor
product distributes over finite direct sums. The associativity and
unit isomorphisms are those of bimodule tensor product.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 7.5, proof of Corollary 7.5, p. 32](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 7.5, Corollary 7.5 and its explicit composition formula, p. 32. The published PDF matches the project copy. The type models a complex group-algebra bimodule by a representation of the product of its two groups, with the right factor acting by inverse right multiplication. The two actions extend linearly to their group algebras. The admissible 1-morphisms are all such bimodules isomorphic to the indicated finite sums, and morphisms are all equivariant complex-linear maps between them. The bicategory data specify the regular bimodules, the balanced tensor universal property, functorial horizontal composition, the canonical natural associator and unitors, and the pentagon and triangle laws. The same tensor operation realizes the direct-sum formula for arbitrary bimodules with the specified presentations. The quotient sections use ordered matching with singleton padding, and the summands use the displayed intersections and both finitary conjugation embeddings. The exact type was checked in Lean through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

```lean
theorem FiniteParabolicBicategoryComposition : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let Finitary := Subgroup.closure {s : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s}
let blockSym := fun (D : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ D))
let blockProduct := fun {m : Nat} (D : Fin m → Finset Nat) =>
  iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i))
let Parabolic := fun (S : Subgroup P) =>
  ∃ (m : Nat) (D : Fin m → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) ∧
    S = blockProduct D
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) S
let embed := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (s : P) (h : conjugate s S ≤ T) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := T) s
    (fun x => h ⟨(x : P), x.property, rfl⟩)
let inverseEmbed := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (s : P) (h : T ≤ conjugate s S) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := T) (G := S) s⁻¹ (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h x.property
    change s * y * s⁻¹ = (x : P) at he
    rw [← he]
    have cancel : s⁻¹ * (s * y * s⁻¹) * (s⁻¹)⁻¹ = y := by group
    rw [cancel]
    exact hy)
let Span := fun (K H : Subgroup P) =>
  Σ L : {S : Subgroup P // Parabolic S},
    {α : ↥Finitary // conjugate (α : P) L.val ≤ K} ×
    {β : ↥Finitary // conjugate (β : P) L.val ≤ H}
let pairWord := fun {K H L : Subgroup P}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down b)
let spanBasis := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (S : Span K H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis
    (pairWord (embed (S.2.1.val : P) S.2.1.property) (embed (S.2.2.val : P) S.2.2.property))
let inside := fun (H A : Subgroup P) => Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype H) A
let Cosets := fun (H A B : Subgroup P) =>
  DoubleCoset.Quotient (inside H A : Set H) (inside H B : Set H)
let classOf := fun (H A B : Subgroup P) (r : H) => DoubleCoset.mk (inside H A) (inside H B) r
let OrderedSection := fun (H A B : Subgroup P) (r : Cosets H A B → H) =>
  ∃ (X : Finset Nat) (m p q : Nat)
    (D : Fin m → Finset Nat) (U : Fin p → Finset Nat) (V : Fin q → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) ∧
    (∀ a, Finset.Nonempty (U a)) ∧
    (∀ b, Finset.Nonempty (V b)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun a a' => Disjoint (U a) (U a')) ∧
    Pairwise (fun b b' => Disjoint (V b) (V b')) ∧
    (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, n ∈ D i) ∧
    (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ a, n ∈ U a) ∧
    (∀ n : Nat, n ∈ X ↔ ∃ b, n ∈ V b) ∧
    H = blockProduct D ∧ A = blockProduct U ∧ B = blockProduct V ∧
    (∀ a, ∃ i, U a ⊆ D i) ∧
    (∀ b, ∃ i, V b ⊆ D i) ∧
    let rows := fun i : Fin m => Finset.filter (fun a : Fin p => U a ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let cols := fun i : Fin m => Finset.filter (fun b : Fin q => V b ⊆ D i) Finset.univ
    let row := fun (i : Fin m) (a : Fin (Finset.card (rows i))) =>
      U (Finset.orderIsoOfFin (rows i) rfl a).val
    let col := fun (i : Fin m) (b : Fin (Finset.card (cols i))) =>
      V (Finset.orderIsoOfFin (cols i) rfl b).val
    let Mat := fun i : Fin m =>
      {R : Fin (Finset.card (rows i)) → Fin (Finset.card (cols i)) → Nat //
        (∀ a, Finset.sum Finset.univ (R a) = Finset.card (row i a)) ∧
        (∀ b, Finset.sum Finset.univ (fun a => R a b) = Finset.card (col i b))}
    let rank := fun (S : Finset Nat) (x : ↥S) =>
      ((Finset.orderIsoOfFin S rfl).symm x).val
    ∃ classify : Cosets H A B ≃ (∀ i : Fin m, Mat i),
      (∀ (s : H) (i : Fin m) a b,
        (classify (classOf H A B s) i).val a b =
          Finset.card (row i a ∩ Finset.map (Equiv.toEmbedding (s : P)) (col i b))) ∧
      (∀ j : Cosets H A B, classOf H A B (r j) = j) ∧
      ∀ (j : Cosets H A B) (i : Fin m) a b (x : ↥(row i a)) (y : ↥(col i b)),
        (r j : P) y.val = x.val ↔
          ∃ k : Fin ((classify j i).val a b),
            rank (row i a) x =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio b) (fun b' => (classify j i).val a b') + k.val ∧
            rank (col i b) y =
              Finset.sum (Finset.Iio a) (fun a' => (classify j i).val a' b) + k.val
let sumBasis := fun {K H : Subgroup P} {ι : Type} (Z : ι → MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  ({ carrier := Sigma (fun i => (Z i).carrier)
     act := fun g z => ⟨z.1, (Z z.1).act g z.2⟩
     one_act := fun z => Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ((Z z.1).one_act z.2))
     mul_act := fun g h z => Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ((Z z.1).mul_act g h z.2)) } :
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H)
let vectors := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (X : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  Finsupp X.carrier Complex
let Equivariant := fun {K H : Subgroup P} {X Y : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H}
    (e : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) (vectors X) (vectors Y)) =>
  ∀ g x, e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex X g x) =
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear Complex Y g (e x)
let Distributes := fun {K H J : Subgroup P} {ι κ : Type}
    (X : ι → MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) (Y : κ → MackeyDiagrams.Biset H J) =>
  let source := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor (sumBasis X) (sumBasis Y)
  let target := sumBasis (fun ij : ι × κ => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.tensor (X ij.1) (Y ij.2))
  ∃ e : LinearEquiv (RingHom.id Complex) (vectors source) (vectors target),
    Equivariant e ∧
    ∀ (i : ι) (j : κ) (x : (X i).carrier) (y : (Y j).carrier),
      e (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pairLinear Complex (sumBasis X) (sumBasis Y)
          (Finsupp.single ⟨i, x⟩ 1) (Finsupp.single ⟨j, y⟩ 1)) =
        Finsupp.single ⟨(i, j), MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (X i) (Y j) x y⟩ 1
let Object := {H : Subgroup P // Parabolic H}
let linearize := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (X : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  letI : MulAction (K × H) (ULift.{u} X.carrier) :=
    { smul := fun g x => ⟨X.act g x.down⟩
      one_smul := fun x => congrArg ULift.up (X.one_act x.down)
      mul_smul := fun g h x => congrArg ULift.up (X.mul_act g h x.down) }
  Rep.ofMulAction Complex (K × H) (ULift.{u} X.carrier)
let regular := fun (H : Object) => linearize (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H.val)
let Admissible := fun (K H : Object) (X : Rep.{u} Complex (K.val × H.val)) =>
  ∃ (m : Nat) (S : Fin m → Span K.val H.val),
    Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso X (linearize (sumBasis (fun i => spanBasis (S i)))))
let Mor := fun (K H : Object) => {X : Rep.{u} Complex (K.val × H.val) // Admissible K H X}
let Hom := fun {K H : Object} (X Y : Mor K H) => Rep.Hom X.val Y.val
let Iso := fun {K H : Object} (X Y : Mor K H) => CategoryTheory.Iso X.val Y.val
let idMap := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H) =>
  (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X.val : Hom X X)
let comp := fun {K H : Object} {X Y Z : Mor K H} (f : Hom X Y) (g : Hom Y Z) =>
  (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (X := X.val) (Y := Y.val) (Z := Z.val) f g : Hom X Z)
let leftAct := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H)
    (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex K.val) (x : X.val.V) =>
  Finsupp.sum a.coeff (fun k c => c • X.val.ρ (k, 1) x)
let rightAct := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H)
    (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H.val) (x : X.val.V) =>
  Finsupp.sum a.coeff (fun h c => c • X.val.ρ (1, h⁻¹) x)
let IsBalanced := fun {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J)
    (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module Complex V]
    (b : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) X.val.V
      (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) Y.val.V V)) =>
  ∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H.val) x y, b (rightAct X a x) y = b x (leftAct Y a y)
(∀ H : Object, H.val ≤ Finitary) ∧
(∀ H : Object, Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (regular H)
  (linearize (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis
    (pairWord (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id H.val)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id H.val)))))) ∧
∃ (unitAdmissible : ∀ H : Object, Admissible H H (regular H)),
  let unit := fun (H : Object) => (⟨regular H, unitAdmissible H⟩ : Mor H H)
  ∃ (tensor : ∀ {K H J : Object}, Mor K H → Mor H J → Mor K J)
    (tmul : ∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) X.val.V
        (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) Y.val.V (tensor X Y).val.V))
    (tensorMap : ∀ {K H J : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} {Y Y' : Mor H J},
      Hom X X' → Hom Y Y' → Hom (tensor X Y) (tensor X' Y'))
    (assoc : ∀ {K H J F : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J) (Z : Mor J F),
      Iso (tensor (tensor X Y) Z) (tensor X (tensor Y Z)))
    (leftUnit : ∀ {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H), Iso (tensor (unit K) X) X)
    (rightUnit : ∀ {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H), Iso (tensor X (unit H)) X),
    (∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      IsBalanced X Y (tensor X Y).val.V (tmul X Y) ∧
      (∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex K.val) (c : MonoidAlgebra Complex J.val) x y,
        tmul X Y (leftAct X a x) (rightAct Y c y) =
          leftAct (tensor X Y) a (rightAct (tensor X Y) c (tmul X Y x y))) ∧
      ∀ (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module Complex V]
        (b : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) X.val.V
          (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) Y.val.V V)),
        IsBalanced X Y V b →
        ∃! lift : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (tensor X Y).val.V V,
          ∀ x y, lift (tmul X Y x y) = b x y) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} {Y Y' : Mor H J}
        (f : Hom X X') (g : Hom Y Y') x y,
      (Rep.Hom.hom (tensorMap f g)) (tmul X Y x y) =
        tmul X' Y' ((Rep.Hom.hom f) x) ((Rep.Hom.hom g) y)) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      tensorMap (idMap X) (idMap Y) = idMap (tensor X Y)) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} {X X' X'' : Mor K H} {Y Y' Y'' : Mor H J}
        (f : Hom X X') (f' : Hom X' X'') (g : Hom Y Y') (g' : Hom Y' Y''),
      tensorMap (comp f f') (comp g g') = comp (tensorMap f g) (tensorMap f' g')) ∧
    (∀ {K H J F : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J) (Z : Mor J F) x y z,
      (Rep.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X Y Z)))
        (tmul (tensor X Y) Z (tmul X Y x y) z) =
        tmul X (tensor Y Z) x (tmul Y Z y z)) ∧
    (∀ {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H)
        (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex K.val) (b : MonoidAlgebra Complex H.val) x,
      (Rep.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit X)))
        (tmul (unit K) X (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain ULift.up a) x) = leftAct X a x ∧
      (Rep.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X)))
        (tmul X (unit H) x (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain ULift.up b)) = rightAct X b x) ∧
    (∀ {K H J F : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} {Y Y' : Mor H J} {Z Z' : Mor J F}
        (f : Hom X X') (g : Hom Y Y') (h : Hom Z Z'),
      comp (tensorMap (tensorMap f g) h) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X' Y' Z')) =
        comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X Y Z)) (tensorMap f (tensorMap g h))) ∧
    (∀ {K H : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} (f : Hom X X'),
      comp (tensorMap (idMap (unit K)) f) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit X')) =
        comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit X)) f ∧
      comp (tensorMap f (idMap (unit H))) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X')) =
        comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X)) f) ∧
    (∀ {K H J F E : Object} (W : Mor K H) (X : Mor H J) (Y : Mor J F) (Z : Mor F E),
      comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc (tensor W X) Y Z))
          (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc W X (tensor Y Z))) =
        comp (tensorMap (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc W X Y)) (idMap Z))
          (comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc W (tensor X Y) Z))
            (tensorMap (idMap W) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X Y Z))))) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X (unit H) Y))
          (tensorMap (idMap X) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit Y))) =
        tensorMap (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X)) (idMap Y)) ∧
    (∀ (K H J : Object) (m n : Nat) (S : Fin m → Span K.val H.val)
        (T : Fin n → Span H.val J.val),
      let A := fun i => conjugate ((S i).2.2.val : P) (S i).1.val
      let B := fun j => conjugate ((T j).2.1.val : P) (T j).1.val
      let Q := fun (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) => Cosets H.val (A i) (B j)
      (∀ i j, Finite (Q i j)) ∧
      (∀ i j, ∃ r : Q i j → H.val, OrderedSection H.val (A i) (B j) r) ∧
      ∀ (r : ∀ i j, Q i j → H.val)
        (_ : ∀ i j k, classOf H.val (A i) (B j) (r i j k) = k),
        let L := fun i j k => A i ⊓ conjugate (r i j k : P) (B j)
        let left := fun i j k =>
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
            (embed ((S i).2.1.val : P) (S i).2.1.property)
            (inverseEmbed ((S i).2.2.val : P) (show L i j k ≤ A i from inf_le_left))
        let right := fun i j k =>
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
            (embed ((T j).2.2.val : P) (T j).2.2.property)
            (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp
              (inverseEmbed ((T j).2.1.val : P) (show B j ≤ B j from le_rfl))
              (inverseEmbed (r i j k : P)
                (show L i j k ≤ conjugate (r i j k : P) (B j) from inf_le_right)))
        (∀ i j k, Parabolic (L i j k)) ∧
        (∀ i j k,
          ∃ R : Span K.val J.val,
            R.1.val = L i j k ∧
            (R.2.1.val : P) = ((S i).2.1.val : P) * ((S i).2.2.val : P)⁻¹ ∧
            (R.2.2.val : P) =
              ((T j).2.2.val : P) * ((T j).2.1.val : P)⁻¹ * (r i j k : P)⁻¹) ∧
        let result := fun (w : Σ i : Fin m, Σ j : Fin n, Q i j) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (pairWord (left w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) (right w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2))
        let X := fun i => spanBasis (S i)
        let Y := fun j => spanBasis (T j)
        Distributes X Y ∧
        ∀ (M : Mor K H) (N : Mor H J),
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso M.val (linearize (sumBasis X))) →
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso N.val (linearize (sumBasis Y))) →
          Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso (tensor M N).val (linearize (sumBasis result))))
```

## FiniteParabolicBimoduleBicategory: The finite-parabolic bimodule bicategory

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Finite parabolic subgroups of \(S_\infty\) form a bicategory with
1-morphisms \(H\to K\) the bimodules isomorphic to finite direct sums of
\[
 \C[K]\otimes_{\C[L]}\C[H],
 \qquad K\xleftarrow{a}L\xrightarrow{b}H,
\]
where \(L\) is finite parabolic and \(a,b\) are conjugation embeddings
in \(S_\infty\). The 2-morphisms are bimodule maps. Composition is
tensor product over the group algebra of the common group.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Corollary 7.5 [cor:parabolic-bicategory], p. 32](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Corollary 7.5 [cor:parabolic-bicategory], p. 32. The published PDF matches the project PDF. The object data are the disjoint finite block products in the group of finitely supported permutations of Nat. The two legs of each span are conjugation embeddings in that group. The shared induction–restriction word gives the balanced biset basis of each displayed complex group-algebra tensor, and its disjoint union over a finite family gives the direct sum. Product-group representations encode the two commuting actions, with inverse right action for the second factor. All bimodules isomorphic to these sums and all bimodule maps between them are included. The balanced universal property specifies composition, and the regular bimodules, canonical maps, and coherence laws specify the bicategory. Lean checked the proposition and its implication from the translated prerequisite FiniteParabolicBicategoryComposition. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction for Corollary 7.5 was available in the task context or the published article page. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem FiniteParabolicBimoduleBicategory : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let Finitary := Subgroup.closure {s : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s}
let blockSym := fun (D : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ D))
let blockProduct := fun {m : Nat} (D : Fin m → Finset Nat) =>
  iSup (fun i => blockSym (D i))
let Parabolic := fun (S : Subgroup P) =>
  ∃ (m : Nat) (D : Fin m → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (D i)) ∧ Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (D i) (D j)) ∧
    S = blockProduct D
let conjugate := fun (s : P) (S : Subgroup P) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) S
let embed := fun {S T : Subgroup P} (s : P) (h : conjugate s S ≤ T) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := T) s
    (fun x => h ⟨(x : P), x.property, rfl⟩)
let Span := fun (K H : Subgroup P) =>
  Σ L : {S : Subgroup P // Parabolic S},
    {α : ↥Finitary // conjugate (α : P) L.val ≤ K} ×
    {β : ↥Finitary // conjugate (β : P) L.val ≤ H}
let pairWord := fun {K H L : Subgroup P}
    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down b)
let spanBasis := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (S : Span K H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis
    (pairWord (embed (S.2.1.val : P) S.2.1.property) (embed (S.2.2.val : P) S.2.2.property))
let sumBasis := fun {K H : Subgroup P} {ι : Type} (Z : ι → MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  ({ carrier := Sigma (fun i => (Z i).carrier)
     act := fun g z => ⟨z.1, (Z z.1).act g z.2⟩
     one_act := fun z => Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ((Z z.1).one_act z.2))
     mul_act := fun g h z => Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ((Z z.1).mul_act g h z.2)) } :
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H)
let Object := {H : Subgroup P // Parabolic H}
let linearize := fun {K H : Subgroup P} (X : MackeyDiagrams.Biset K H) =>
  letI : MulAction (K × H) (ULift.{u} X.carrier) :=
    { smul := fun g x => ⟨X.act g x.down⟩
      one_smul := fun x => congrArg ULift.up (X.one_act x.down)
      mul_smul := fun g h x => congrArg ULift.up (X.mul_act g h x.down) }
  Rep.ofMulAction Complex (K × H) (ULift.{u} X.carrier)
let regular := fun (H : Object) => linearize (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.regular H.val)
let Admissible := fun (K H : Object) (X : Rep.{u} Complex (K.val × H.val)) =>
  ∃ (m : Nat) (S : Fin m → Span K.val H.val),
    Nonempty (CategoryTheory.Iso X (linearize (sumBasis (fun i => spanBasis (S i)))))
let Mor := fun (K H : Object) => {X : Rep.{u} Complex (K.val × H.val) // Admissible K H X}
let Hom := fun {K H : Object} (X Y : Mor K H) => Rep.Hom X.val Y.val
let Iso := fun {K H : Object} (X Y : Mor K H) => CategoryTheory.Iso X.val Y.val
let idMap := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H) =>
  (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.id X.val : Hom X X)
let comp := fun {K H : Object} {X Y Z : Mor K H} (f : Hom X Y) (g : Hom Y Z) =>
  (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (X := X.val) (Y := Y.val) (Z := Z.val) f g : Hom X Z)
let leftAct := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H)
    (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex K.val) (x : X.val.V) =>
  Finsupp.sum a.coeff (fun k c => c • X.val.ρ (k, 1) x)
let rightAct := fun {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H)
    (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H.val) (x : X.val.V) =>
  Finsupp.sum a.coeff (fun h c => c • X.val.ρ (1, h⁻¹) x)
let IsBalanced := fun {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J)
    (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module Complex V]
    (b : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) X.val.V
      (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) Y.val.V V)) =>
  ∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex H.val) x y, b (rightAct X a x) y = b x (leftAct Y a y)
(∀ H : Object, H.val ≤ Finitary) ∧
∃ (unitAdmissible : ∀ H : Object, Admissible H H (regular H)),
  let unit := fun (H : Object) => (⟨regular H, unitAdmissible H⟩ : Mor H H)
  ∃ (tensor : ∀ {K H J : Object}, Mor K H → Mor H J → Mor K J)
    (tmul : ∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) X.val.V
        (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) Y.val.V (tensor X Y).val.V))
    (tensorMap : ∀ {K H J : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} {Y Y' : Mor H J},
      Hom X X' → Hom Y Y' → Hom (tensor X Y) (tensor X' Y'))
    (assoc : ∀ {K H J F : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J) (Z : Mor J F),
      Iso (tensor (tensor X Y) Z) (tensor X (tensor Y Z)))
    (leftUnit : ∀ {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H), Iso (tensor (unit K) X) X)
    (rightUnit : ∀ {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H), Iso (tensor X (unit H)) X),
    (∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      IsBalanced X Y (tensor X Y).val.V (tmul X Y) ∧
      (∀ (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex K.val) (c : MonoidAlgebra Complex J.val) x y,
        tmul X Y (leftAct X a x) (rightAct Y c y) =
          leftAct (tensor X Y) a (rightAct (tensor X Y) c (tmul X Y x y))) ∧
      ∀ (V : Type u) [AddCommGroup V] [Module Complex V]
        (b : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) X.val.V
          (LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) Y.val.V V)),
        IsBalanced X Y V b →
        ∃! lift : LinearMap (RingHom.id Complex) (tensor X Y).val.V V,
          ∀ x y, lift (tmul X Y x y) = b x y) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} {Y Y' : Mor H J}
        (f : Hom X X') (g : Hom Y Y') x y,
      (Rep.Hom.hom (tensorMap f g)) (tmul X Y x y) =
        tmul X' Y' ((Rep.Hom.hom f) x) ((Rep.Hom.hom g) y)) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      tensorMap (idMap X) (idMap Y) = idMap (tensor X Y)) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} {X X' X'' : Mor K H} {Y Y' Y'' : Mor H J}
        (f : Hom X X') (f' : Hom X' X'') (g : Hom Y Y') (g' : Hom Y' Y''),
      tensorMap (comp f f') (comp g g') = comp (tensorMap f g) (tensorMap f' g')) ∧
    (∀ {K H J F : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J) (Z : Mor J F) x y z,
      (Rep.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X Y Z)))
        (tmul (tensor X Y) Z (tmul X Y x y) z) =
        tmul X (tensor Y Z) x (tmul Y Z y z)) ∧
    (∀ {K H : Object} (X : Mor K H)
        (a : MonoidAlgebra Complex K.val) (b : MonoidAlgebra Complex H.val) x,
      (Rep.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit X)))
        (tmul (unit K) X (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain ULift.up a) x) = leftAct X a x ∧
      (Rep.Hom.hom (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X)))
        (tmul X (unit H) x (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomain ULift.up b)) = rightAct X b x) ∧
    (∀ {K H J F : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} {Y Y' : Mor H J} {Z Z' : Mor J F}
        (f : Hom X X') (g : Hom Y Y') (h : Hom Z Z'),
      comp (tensorMap (tensorMap f g) h) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X' Y' Z')) =
        comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X Y Z)) (tensorMap f (tensorMap g h))) ∧
    (∀ {K H : Object} {X X' : Mor K H} (f : Hom X X'),
      comp (tensorMap (idMap (unit K)) f) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit X')) =
        comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit X)) f ∧
      comp (tensorMap f (idMap (unit H))) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X')) =
        comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X)) f) ∧
    (∀ {K H J F E : Object} (W : Mor K H) (X : Mor H J) (Y : Mor J F) (Z : Mor F E),
      comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc (tensor W X) Y Z))
          (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc W X (tensor Y Z))) =
        comp (tensorMap (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc W X Y)) (idMap Z))
          (comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc W (tensor X Y) Z))
            (tensorMap (idMap W) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X Y Z))))) ∧
    (∀ {K H J : Object} (X : Mor K H) (Y : Mor H J),
      comp (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (assoc X (unit H) Y))
          (tensorMap (idMap X) (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (leftUnit Y))) =
        tensorMap (CategoryTheory.Iso.hom (rightUnit X)) (idMap Y))
```

## FiniteParabolicJoinOfFamily: Least parabolic group containing a finite collection of parabolic images

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Proposition~7.1 also gives a least parabolic
group containing any finite collection of parabolic images. It is the
subgroup generated by their union, called their join. If all the
images lie in a prescribed group, so does their join.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 7.5, unnumbered, p. 33](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 7.5, unnumbered, p. 33. The published PDF matches the project copy. The defect-report URL returned HTTP 404, and the task context supplies no correction. The symmetric group of each block acts by fixing its complement. The join computed in Equiv.Perm Nat agrees with the join in the group of finitely supported permutations because every generator is finitely supported. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem FiniteParabolicJoinOfFamily : let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ S))
let parabolicOn : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) → Prop :=
  fun X H =>
    ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
      (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
      (∀ m : Nat, m ∈ X ↔ ∃ i, m ∈ blocks i) ∧
      H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let parabolic : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) → Prop :=
  fun H => ∃ X, parabolicOn X H
∀ {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (A : ι → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat)),
  (∀ i, parabolic (A i)) →
  let J := Subgroup.closure (Set.iUnion fun i => (A i : Set (Equiv.Perm Nat)))
  IsLeast {H : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) | parabolic H ∧ ∀ i, A i ≤ H} J ∧
    ∀ P : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat), (∀ i, A i ≤ P) → J ≤ P
```

## ParabolicCurlsFromBlockRefinements: Curls from block refinements

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use \(K\xrightarrow{\delta_*}H\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}G\).
The subscript on \(\id\) lists the groups on the left and right.

In Theorem~4.1, write
\(H=\prod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Sym}(X_i)\) and
\(\cg{\delta}{K}=\prod_{j\in J}\operatorname{Sym}(Y_j)\), using
singleton blocks to partition the same finite set. The right up-curl
and left down-curl have scalar
\[
 [H:\cg{\delta}{K}]
 =\prod_{i\in I}\frac{|X_i|!}{\prod_{j:Y_j\subseteq X_i}|Y_j|!}.
\]
Merging two blocks of sizes \(a,b\) gives a scalar
\(\binom{a+b}{a}\). A sequence of such merges factors the curl through
the intermediate parabolics, and the product of its scalars is
independent of the merge order. The other two curls have scalar \(1\).

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 8.1 (prop:parabolic-curls), p. 33. The published PDF is byte-identical to the project copy. The common finite block partitions admit singleton blocks. The finite index is expressed by the exact factorial quotient. The four drawings evaluate over Complex at their original ordered boundaries and coset labels. Each binary merge contributes its binomial index, and every legal merge sequence yields nested typed curls with total scalar equal to the original index. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner's 27 November 2026 clarification (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the drawing syntax. Each direct curl and each nested curl frame retains the two oriented mixed trivalent junctions. The four source drawings are unmarked, so the finite complex linear dot convention introduces no dot hypotheses.

The designated defect report returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The web edition repeats Proposition 8.1. No correction was available for this endpoint. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ParabolicCurlsFromBlockRefinements : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup U :=
  fun S => Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary)
    (MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)))
let blockGroup : Finset (Finset Nat) → Subgroup U :=
  fun P => iSup (fun S : ↥P => blockSym (S : Finset Nat))
let partition : Finset Nat → Finset (Finset Nat) → Prop :=
  fun T P =>
    (∀ S ∈ P, Finset.Nonempty S) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ P, ∀ B ∈ P, A ≠ B → Disjoint A B) ∧
    (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ S ∈ P, x ∈ S)
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun L => ∃ T P, partition T P ∧ L = blockGroup P
let merge : Finset (Finset Nat) → Finset Nat → Finset Nat → Finset (Finset Nat) :=
  fun P A B => insert (A ∪ B) (Finset.erase (Finset.erase P A) B)
let inclusion : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, A ≤ B → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B :=
  fun h => ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
let curlPair : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B → Type :=
  fun a =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) ×
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)
let straightPair : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B), curlPair a :=
  fun a =>
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)),
     MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)))
let indexedCurls :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)) →
      Option (curlPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a d)) → curlPair a :=
  fun a d finite inner =>
    let openRight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite)
    let closeRight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d)
    let openLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToUpDown a d finite)
    let closeLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToDown a d)
    let rightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical openRight
      (Option.elim inner closeRight (fun p =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (Prod.fst p) (Prod.snd (straightPair d)))
          closeRight))
    let leftDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical openLeft
      (Option.elim inner closeLeft (fun p =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (Prod.fst (straightPair d)) (Prod.snd p))
          closeLeft))
    (rightUp, leftDown)
let rightDownCurl :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d) :=
  fun a d =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToDownUp a d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToDown a d))
let leftUpCurl :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d) :=
  fun a d =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a d))
let nestedCurls :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (L : Nat → Subgroup U)
      (h : ∀ i, i < n → L i ≤ L (i + 1)),
      (∀ i (hi : i < n), Subgroup.FiniteIndex
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion (h i hi))))) →
      ∀ t, t ≤ n → ∀ {D : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (L t) D), curlPair a :=
  fun n L h finite =>
    Nat.rec
      (motive := fun t => t ≤ n → ∀ {D : Subgroup U}
        (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (L t) D), curlPair a)
      (fun _ {_} a => straightPair a)
      (fun i prev hi {_} a =>
        let e := inclusion (h i hi)
        indexedCurls a e (finite i hi) (Option.some
          (prev (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a e))))
let atBoundary :
    ∀ {B H G : Subgroup U}, B = H → ∀ a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G,
      (∀ b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G, curlPair b) → curlPair a :=
  fun {B H G} h a f =>
    Eq.rec (motive := fun J _ => ∀ b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J G, curlPair b) f h a
let path : Finset (Finset Nat) → Finset (Finset Nat) → Nat →
    (Nat → Finset (Finset Nat)) → (Nat → Finset Nat) → (Nat → Finset Nat) → Prop :=
  fun Y X n P A B =>
    P 0 = Y ∧ P n = X ∧
    ∀ i, i < n →
      A i ∈ P i ∧ B i ∈ P i ∧ A i ≠ B i ∧ P (i + 1) = merge (P i) (A i) (B i)
(∀ (T : Finset Nat) (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) (A B : Finset Nat),
    partition T P → A ∈ P → B ∈ P → A ≠ B →
    let merged := blockGroup (merge P A B)
    blockGroup P ≤ merged ∧
    Subgroup.relIndex (blockGroup P) merged =
      Nat.choose (Finset.card A + Finset.card B) (Finset.card A)) ∧
(∀ (K H G : Subgroup U) (δ α : U)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  parabolic K → parabolic G →
  ∀ (T : Finset Nat) (X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)),
  partition T X → partition T Y →
  ∀ (hH : H = blockGroup X),
  let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)
  blockGroup Y = Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype H) S →
  ∃ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    let index := Subgroup.index S
    let direct := indexedCurls a d finite Option.none
    let straight := straightPair a
    (index : Rat) =
      Finset.prod X (fun V =>
        (Nat.factorial (Finset.card V) : Rat) /
          Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun W => W ⊆ V) Y)
            (fun W => (Nat.factorial (Finset.card W) : Rat))) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.fst direct)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (index : Complex) (Prod.fst straight))) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (rightDownCurl a d)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.snd (straightPair d))) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (leftUpCurl a d)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.fst (straightPair d))) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.snd direct)) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (index : Complex) (Prod.snd straight))) ∧
    (∃ n P A B, path Y X n P A B) ∧
    (∀ n P A B (hPath : path Y X n P A B),
      let L := fun i => blockGroup (P i)
      (∀ i, i ≤ n → partition T (P i)) ∧
      Finset.prod (Finset.range n) (fun i =>
        Nat.choose (Finset.card (A i) + Finset.card (B i)) (Finset.card (A i))) = index ∧
      ∃ (h : ∀ i, i < n → L i ≤ L (i + 1))
        (f : ∀ i (hi : i < n), Subgroup.FiniteIndex
          (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion (h i hi))))),
        let hEnd : L n = H := Eq.trans (congrArg blockGroup hPath.2.1) hH.symm
        let nested := atBoundary hEnd a
          (fun b => nestedCurls n L h f n (Nat.le_refl n) b)
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.fst direct)) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.fst nested)) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.snd direct)) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (Prod.snd nested))))

## ParabolicCurlFactorization: Factorization of index-valued curls through intermediate parabolics

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use \(K\xrightarrow{\delta_*}H\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}G\).
The subscript on \(\id\) lists the groups on the left and right.

In Theorem~4.1, write
\(H=\prod_{i\in I}\operatorname{Sym}(X_i)\) and
\(\cg{\delta}{K}=\prod_{j\in J}\operatorname{Sym}(Y_j)\), using
singleton blocks to partition the same finite set. The right up-curl
and left down-curl have scalar
\[
 [H:\cg{\delta}{K}]
 =\prod_{i\in I}\frac{|X_i|!}{\prod_{j:Y_j\subseteq X_i}|Y_j|!}.
\]
Merging two blocks of sizes \(a,b\) gives a scalar
\(\binom{a+b}{a}\). A sequence of such merges factors the curl through
the intermediate parabolics, and the product of its scalars is
independent of the merge order. The other two curls have scalar \(1\).

For the factorization diagram use the image \(A=\cg{\delta}{K}\)
as the internal group and the inclusion into \(H\).
To factor the curl through an intermediate group
\(\cg{\delta}{K}\le B\le H\), choose representatives \(r\) of the right
cosets of \(\cg{\delta}{K}\) in \(B\) and \(t\) of the right cosets
of \(B\) in \(H\). The products \(rt\) represent the right cosets
of \(\cg{\delta}{K}\) in \(H\) exactly once. In the up-curl calculation
the cup and cap then contribute
\[
 \sum_t\sum_r x\,\alpha_*(t^{-1})\alpha_*(r^{-1})
                    \alpha_*(r)\alpha_*(t).
\]
The sum over \(r\) is the inner curl and contributes
\([B:\cg{\delta}{K}]\). The outer cup and cap contribute \([H:B]\).
In the down-curl the same product of factors acts on the left of \(x\).
Iterating gives the asserted factorization. Every sequence of binary
merges within the \(X_i\) has the same total index. The two curls
enclosing \(G\) are the identities of
Theorem~4.1.

theorem ParabolicCurlFactorization : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup U :=
  fun S => Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary)
    (MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)))
let blockGroup : Finset (Finset Nat) → Subgroup U :=
  fun P => iSup (fun S : ↥P => blockSym (S : Finset Nat))
let partition : Finset Nat → Finset (Finset Nat) → Prop :=
  fun T P =>
    (∀ S ∈ P, Finset.Nonempty S) ∧
    (∀ A ∈ P, ∀ B ∈ P, A ≠ B → Disjoint A B) ∧
    (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ S ∈ P, x ∈ S)
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun L => ∃ T P, partition T P ∧ L = blockGroup P
let merge : Finset (Finset Nat) → Finset Nat → Finset Nat → Finset (Finset Nat) :=
  fun P A B => insert (A ∪ B) (Finset.erase (Finset.erase P A) B)
let inclusion : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, A ≤ B → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B :=
  fun h => ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
let curlPair : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U}, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B → Type :=
  fun a =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) ×
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)
let straightPair : ∀ {A B : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B), curlPair a :=
  fun a =>
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a)),
     MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)))
let indexedCurls :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)) →
      Option (curlPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a d)) → curlPair a :=
  fun a d finite inner =>
    let openRight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite)
    let closeRight := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d)
    let openLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToUpDown a d finite)
    let closeLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
      (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToDown a d)
    let rightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical openRight
      (Option.elim inner closeRight (fun p =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (Prod.fst p) (Prod.snd (straightPair d)))
          closeRight))
    let leftDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical openLeft
      (Option.elim inner closeLeft (fun p =>
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (Prod.fst (straightPair d)) (Prod.snd p))
          closeLeft))
    (rightUp, leftDown)
let rightDownCurl :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down d) :=
  fun a d =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToDownUp a d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToDown a d))
let leftUpCurl :
    ∀ {A B C : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B C)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B),
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up d) :=
  fun a d =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToDownUp a d))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downUpToUp a d))
let nestedCurls :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (L : Nat → Subgroup U)
      (h : ∀ i, i < n → L i ≤ L (i + 1)),
      (∀ i (hi : i < n), Subgroup.FiniteIndex
        (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion (h i hi))))) →
      ∀ t, t ≤ n → ∀ {D : Subgroup U} (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (L t) D), curlPair a :=
  fun n L h finite =>
    Nat.rec
      (motive := fun t => t ≤ n → ∀ {D : Subgroup U}
        (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (L t) D), curlPair a)
      (fun _ {_} a => straightPair a)
      (fun i prev hi {_} a =>
        let e := inclusion (h i hi)
        indexedCurls a e (finite i hi) (Option.some
          (prev (Nat.le_of_succ_le hi) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a e))))
let atBoundary :
    ∀ {B H G : Subgroup U}, B = H → ∀ a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G,
      (∀ b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B G, curlPair b) → curlPair a :=
  fun {B H G} h a f =>
    Eq.rec (motive := fun J _ => ∀ b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J G, curlPair b) f h a
let path : Finset (Finset Nat) → Finset (Finset Nat) → Nat →
    (Nat → Finset (Finset Nat)) → (Nat → Finset Nat) → (Nat → Finset Nat) → Prop :=
  fun Y X n P A B =>
    P 0 = Y ∧ P n = X ∧
    ∀ i, i < n →
      A i ∈ P i ∧ B i ∈ P i ∧ A i ≠ B i ∧ P (i + 1) = merge (P i) (A i) (B i)
let evalDrawing :
    ∀ {A B : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word A B},
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q → MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis p) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis q) :=
  fun d => MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret d)
(∀ (T : Finset Nat) (P : Finset (Finset Nat)) (A B : Finset Nat),
    partition T P → A ∈ P → B ∈ P → A ≠ B →
    let merged := blockGroup (merge P A B)
    blockGroup P ≤ merged ∧
    Subgroup.relIndex (blockGroup P) merged =
      Nat.choose (Finset.card A + Finset.card B) (Finset.card A)) ∧
(∀ (K H G : Subgroup U) (δ α : U)
    (hδ : ∀ k : K, δ * (k : U) * δ⁻¹ ∈ H)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  parabolic K → parabolic G →
  ∀ (T : Finset Nat) (X Y : Finset (Finset Nat)),
  partition T X → partition T Y →
  ∀ (hH : H = blockGroup X),
  let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator δ hδ
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let S := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)
  let image := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype H) S
  blockGroup Y = image →
  ∃ finite : Subgroup.FiniteIndex S,
    let index := Subgroup.index S
    let direct := indexedCurls a d finite Option.none
    let straight := straightPair a
    (index : Rat) =
      Finset.prod X (fun V =>
        (Nat.factorial (Finset.card V) : Rat) /
          Finset.prod (Finset.filter (fun W => W ⊆ V) Y)
            (fun W => (Nat.factorial (Finset.card W) : Rat))) ∧
    evalDrawing (Prod.fst direct) =
      evalDrawing
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (index : Complex) (Prod.fst straight)) ∧
    evalDrawing (rightDownCurl a d) =
      evalDrawing (Prod.snd (straightPair d)) ∧
    evalDrawing (leftUpCurl a d) =
      evalDrawing (Prod.fst (straightPair d)) ∧
    evalDrawing (Prod.snd direct) =
      evalDrawing
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (index : Complex) (Prod.snd straight)) ∧
    (∀ (B : Subgroup U), parabolic B →
      ∀ (hAB : image ≤ B) (hBH : B ≤ H),
        let eAH := inclusion (le_trans hAB hBH)
        let eAB := inclusion hAB
        let eBH := inclusion hBH
        ∃ (finiteAH : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
              (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eAH)))
          (finiteAB : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
              (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eAB)))
          (finiteBH : Subgroup.FiniteIndex
              (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eBH))),
          let imageCurl := indexedCurls a eAH finiteAH Option.none
          let innerCurl := indexedCurls (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a eBH) eAB finiteAB Option.none
          let outerCurl := indexedCurls a eBH finiteBH (Option.some innerCurl)
          let towerScalar := Subgroup.relIndex B H * Subgroup.relIndex image B
          towerScalar = index ∧
          evalDrawing (Prod.fst imageCurl) =
            evalDrawing
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (towerScalar : Complex) (Prod.fst straight)) ∧
          evalDrawing (Prod.snd imageCurl) =
            evalDrawing
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (towerScalar : Complex) (Prod.snd straight)) ∧
          evalDrawing (Prod.fst imageCurl) =
            evalDrawing (Prod.fst outerCurl) ∧
          evalDrawing (Prod.snd imageCurl) =
            evalDrawing (Prod.snd outerCurl)) ∧
    (∃ n P A B, path Y X n P A B) ∧
    (∀ n P A B (hPath : path Y X n P A B),
      let L := fun i => blockGroup (P i)
      (∀ i, i ≤ n → partition T (P i)) ∧
      Finset.prod (Finset.range n) (fun i =>
        Nat.choose (Finset.card (A i) + Finset.card (B i)) (Finset.card (A i))) = index ∧
      ∃ (h : ∀ i, i < n → L i ≤ L (i + 1))
        (f : ∀ i (hi : i < n), Subgroup.FiniteIndex
          (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion (h i hi))))),
        let hEnd : L n = H := Eq.trans (congrArg blockGroup hPath.2.1) hH.symm
        let nested := atBoundary hEnd a
          (fun b => nestedCurls n L h f n (Nat.le_refl n) b)
        evalDrawing (Prod.fst direct) =
          evalDrawing (Prod.fst nested) ∧
        evalDrawing (Prod.snd direct) =
          evalDrawing (Prod.snd nested)))

## ParabolicCurlJoinIntersection: Curls for a join and an intersection

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use \(K\xrightarrow{\delta_*}H\xrightarrow{\alpha_*}G\).
The subscript on \(\id\) lists the groups on the left and right.

Fix either of the two index-valued curls on a strand and let \(c_A\)
denote that curl with internal group \(A\le H\), using inclusions into
\(H\). For finite parabolics \(A,B\le H\),
\[
 c_{A\cap B}\circ c_{\langle A\cup B\rangle}
  =\frac{|AB|}{|\langle A\cup B\rangle|}\,(c_A\circ c_B).
\]
The scalar is \(1\) exactly when, on each block of
\(\langle A\cup B\rangle\), at least one of the two original
partitions has that whole block.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Proposition 8.2 [prop:parabolic-curl-join], p. 34. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The diagrams displayed with Example 8.1 confirm both oriented forms of the proposition. Their stacks put the join below the intersection and B below A. The right up-curl at the G–H boundary uses upToUpDown and upDownToUp. The left down-curl at the H–G boundary uses downToUpDown and upDownToDown. The opening junctions retain finite-index evidence, and the scalar acts on the whole right-hand stack. The numerator counts the set of products ab, and the scalar-one criterion uses the join orbits on the common finite carrier with singleton padding. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in input.request (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) applies the shared finite complex linear label convention at every marked vertex. These curls are unmarked. Each overlined 1 gives the centralizer coset of the inclusion into H. This clarification governs the Lean syntax and leaves the article attribution intact.

theorem ParabolicCurlJoinIntersection : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup U :=
  fun S => Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary)
    (MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)))
let blockGroup : Finset (Finset Nat) → Subgroup U :=
  fun P => iSup (fun V : ↥P => blockSym (V : Finset Nat))
let partition : Finset Nat → Finset (Finset Nat) → Prop :=
  fun T P =>
    (∀ V ∈ P, Finset.Nonempty V) ∧
    (∀ V ∈ P, ∀ W ∈ P, V ≠ W → Disjoint V W) ∧
    (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ V ∈ P, x ∈ V)
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun L => ∃ T P, partition T P ∧ L = blockGroup P
let inclusion : ∀ {L H : Subgroup U}, L ≤ H → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H :=
  fun h => ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
∀ (H G : Subgroup U) (α : U) (hα : ∀ x : H, α * (x : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  parabolic H → parabolic G →
  ∀ (T : Finset Nat) (P Q : Finset (Finset Nat)),
    partition T P → partition T Q →
    let A := blockGroup P
    let B := blockGroup Q
    ∀ (hA : A ≤ H) (hB : B ≤ H),
      let I := A ⊓ B
      let J := A ⊔ B
      let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let finiteIndex : ∀ {L : Subgroup U}, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H → Prop :=
        fun d => Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d))
      let curls : ∀ {L : Subgroup U} (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H),
          finiteIndex d →
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex up up ×
            MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex down down :=
        fun d finite =>
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d)),
           MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToUpDown a d finite))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToDown a d)))
      let dA := inclusion hA
      let dB := inclusion hB
      let dI := inclusion (show I ≤ H from le_trans inf_le_left hA)
      let dJ := inclusion (show J ≤ H from sup_le hA hB)
      let AB : Set U := Set.image2 (fun x y : U => x * y) (A : Set U) (B : Set U)
      let scalar : Complex := (Nat.card ↥AB : Complex) / (Nat.card ↥J : Complex)
      let joinBlock : Nat → Set Nat :=
        fun x => {y | ∃ j : ↥J, ((j : U) : Equiv.Perm Nat) x = y}
      ∃ (fA : finiteIndex dA) (fB : finiteIndex dB)
        (fI : finiteIndex dI) (fJ : finiteIndex dJ),
        let cA := curls dA fA
        let cB := curls dB fB
        let cI := curls dI fI
        let cJ := curls dJ fJ
        let leftUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.fst cJ) (Prod.fst cI)
        let leftDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.snd cJ) (Prod.snd cI)
        let rightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale scalar
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.fst cB) (Prod.fst cA))
        let rightDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale scalar
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.snd cB) (Prod.snd cA))
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret leftUp) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret rightUp) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret leftDown) =
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret rightDown) ∧
        (scalar = 1 ↔ ∀ x ∈ T, ∃ V ∈ P ∪ Q, (V : Set Nat) = joinBlock x)
```

## UnequalParabolicCurlProducts: Unequal products of curls

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For \(H=\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,3\})\), \(A=\langle(12)\rangle\)
and \(B=\langle(23)\rangle\), the intersection is trivial and the
join is \(H\). Write \(J=\langle A\cup B\rangle\) in the diagram.
The two products of curls have scalars \(6\) and \(9\),
respectively.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.1, Example 8.1 [ex:curl-join-s3], p. 34. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered figure and project TikZ show a right up-curl at the G–H boundary and a left down-curl at the H–G boundary, each formed by two mixed trivalent junctions. Both rows place the join below the intersection and B below A. The outer strand retains α, the displayed ratio scales the entire right-hand stack, and the two stacks have complex scalars 6 and 9, respectively. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) requires the drawn orientations and wiring and finite complex linear labels at marked vertices. These curls have no marked vertices. Each overlined 1 gives the centralizer coset of the loop inclusion into H.

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction or portal endpoint for this example was available in the task context. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem UnequalParabolicCurlProducts : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup U :=
  fun S => Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary)
    (MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S)))
let S : Finset Nat := {1, 2, 3}
let H := blockSym S
let swap : ∀ (i j : ↥S), (i : Nat) ≠ (j : Nat) → U :=
  fun i j h => ⟨Equiv.swap (i : Nat) (j : Nat),
    Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨(i : Nat), (j : Nat), h, rfl⟩⟩
let hSwap : ∀ (i j : ↥S) (h : (i : Nat) ≠ (j : Nat)), swap i j h ∈ H :=
  fun i j _ => ⟨Equiv.swap i j, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq i j⟩
let p : ↥S := ⟨1, by decide⟩
let q : ↥S := ⟨2, by decide⟩
let r : ↥S := ⟨3, by decide⟩
let hpq : (p : Nat) ≠ (q : Nat) := by decide
let hqr : (q : Nat) ≠ (r : Nat) := by decide
let A := Subgroup.zpowers (swap p q hpq)
let B := Subgroup.zpowers (swap q r hqr)
let hA : A ≤ H := Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr (hSwap p q hpq)
let hB : B ≤ H := Subgroup.zpowers_le.mpr (hSwap q r hqr)
let I := A ⊓ B
let J := A ⊔ B
let inclusion : ∀ {L : Subgroup U}, L ≤ H → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H :=
  fun h => ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun L => ∃ (T : Finset Nat) (P : Finset (Finset Nat)),
    (∀ V ∈ P, Finset.Nonempty V) ∧
    (∀ V ∈ P, ∀ W ∈ P, V ≠ W → Disjoint V W) ∧
    (∀ x : Nat, x ∈ T ↔ ∃ V ∈ P, x ∈ V) ∧
    L = iSup (fun V : ↥P => blockSym (V : Finset Nat))
I = ⊥ ∧ J = H ∧
∀ (G : Subgroup U) (α : U) (hα : ∀ x : H, α * (x : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G),
  parabolic G →
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let straightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) up)
  let straightDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) down)
  let finiteIndex : ∀ {L : Subgroup U}, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H → Prop :=
    fun d => Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d))
  let curls : ∀ {L : Subgroup U} (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H),
      finiteIndex d →
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex up up ×
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex down down :=
    fun d finite =>
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upToUpDown a d finite))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToUp a d)),
       MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.downToUpDown a d finite))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent
          (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.upDownToDown a d)))
  let dA := inclusion hA
  let dB := inclusion hB
  let dI := inclusion (show I ≤ H from le_trans inf_le_left hA)
  let dJ := inclusion (show J ≤ H from sup_le hA hB)
  let AB : Set U := Set.image2 (fun x y : U => x * y) (A : Set U) (B : Set U)
  let ratio : Complex := (Nat.card ↥AB : Complex) / (Nat.card ↥J : Complex)
  ∃ (fA : finiteIndex dA) (fB : finiteIndex dB)
    (fI : finiteIndex dI) (fJ : finiteIndex dJ),
    let cA := curls dA fA
    let cB := curls dB fB
    let cI := curls dI fI
    let cJ := curls dJ fJ
    let joinIntersectionUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.fst cJ) (Prod.fst cI)
    let joinIntersectionDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.snd cJ) (Prod.snd cI)
    let originalUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.fst cB) (Prod.fst cA)
    let originalDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (Prod.snd cB) (Prod.snd cA)
    let evalUp := fun drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex up up =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    let evalDown := fun drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex down down =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    evalUp joinIntersectionUp =
      evalUp (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale ratio originalUp) ∧
    evalDown joinIntersectionDown =
      evalDown (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale ratio originalDown) ∧
    evalUp joinIntersectionUp =
      evalUp (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale 6 straightUp) ∧
    evalUp originalUp =
      evalUp (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale 9 straightUp) ∧
    evalDown joinIntersectionDown =
      evalDown (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale 6 straightDown) ∧
    evalDown originalDown =
      evalDown (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale 9 straightDown)
```
