## LargestCommonMixedCrossingParabolic: Largest common region for mixed crossings

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Fix a nonempty set \(J_0\) of Mackey summands in
Section~5 and keep their representatives
\(\sigma_j\) fixed. Use the internal strand labels
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}\) and \(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}\)
on a common group \(L\). Choose any \(j_0\in J_0\) and set
\[
 P=\left(\bigcap_{j\in J_0}L_j\right)
    \cap C_G\bigl(\{\sigma_{j_0}\sigma_j^{-1}:j\in J_0\}\bigr).
\]
The largest parabolic \(L\) for which both internal labels agree in
all selected summands is the subgroup generated by all transpositions
in \(P\). This choice simultaneously minimizes the indices in
\[
 \sum_{j\in J_0}\frac{\iota_{L,j}\circ p_{L,j}}{[L_j:L]}
   =\sum_{j\in J_0}\iota_j\circ p_j .
\]

```lean
theorem LargestCommonMixedCrossingParabolic : let U := ↥(Subgroup.closure {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap g})
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun X => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  parabolic K → parabolic H → parabolic G →
  let conjugate := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  ∀ (hα : conjugate α K ≤ G) (hβ : conjugate β H ≤ G),
    let a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K G :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α
        (fun k => hα ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H G :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β
        (fun h => hβ ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)
    let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let Lj := fun j : J => conjugate α K ⊓ conjugate ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let left := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) α⁻¹ (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).1
          change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          rw [← heq]
          change k ∈ K at hk
          convert hk using 1
          group)
      let right := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            rw [← heq]
            change h ∈ H at hh
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let dot := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (left j S hS))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (right j S hS)) from
          ⟨σ j, by
            intro ℓ
            apply Subtype.ext
            change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
              (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
                (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
            group⟩
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
      let finiteFibers := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j) =>
        ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b
            (left j S hS) (right j S hS) (dot j S hS) w = z}
      let outer := fun (j : J) (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj j)
          (hf : finiteFibers j S hS) =>
        show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M from
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS)
              [(1, ⟨dot j S hS, hf⟩)])
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b (left j S hS) (right j S hS)
              [(1, dot j S hS)])
      ∀ (J₀ : Set J),
        let I := {j : J // j ∈ J₀}
        ∀ (j₀ : I),
          let C := G ⊓ Subgroup.centralizer
            (Set.range (fun j : I => (σ j₀.val : U) * (σ j.val : U)⁻¹))
          let P := (iInf (fun j : I => Lj j.val)) ⊓ C
          let L := Subgroup.closure {g : U | g ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (Subtype.val g)}
          let hL : ∀ j : I, L ≤ Lj j.val := fun j =>
            le_trans ((Subgroup.closure_le P).mpr (fun _ hg => hg.1))
              (le_trans inf_le_left (iInf_le (fun i : I => Lj i.val) j))
          let admissible := fun S : Subgroup U =>
            parabolic S ∧
              ∃ hS : ∀ j : I, S ≤ Lj j.val,
                ∀ i j : I,
                  left i.val S (hS i) = left j.val S (hS j) ∧
                  right i.val S (hS i) = right j.val S (hS j)
          IsGreatest {S : Subgroup U | admissible S} L ∧
          (∀ S : Subgroup U, admissible S → ∀ j : I,
            Subgroup.relIndex L (Lj j.val) ≤ Subgroup.relIndex S (Lj j.val)) ∧
          (∃ (finite : Fintype I)
              (hfL : ∀ j : I, finiteFibers j.val L (hL j))
              (hfJ : ∀ j : I, finiteFibers j.val (Lj j.val) (le_refl (Lj j.val))),
            let indices : Finset I := @Finset.univ I finite
            let restricted := fun j : I => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale
              ((Subgroup.relIndex L (Lj j.val) : Complex)⁻¹) (outer j.val L (hL j) (hfL j))
            let usual := fun j : I => outer j.val (Lj j.val) (le_refl (Lj j.val)) (hfJ j)
            let restrictedSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
              MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.mk indices restricted
            let usualSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M I :=
              MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.mk indices usual
            MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval restrictedSum =
              MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval usualSum)
```

## ParabolicFullMackeyCancellation: Finite-parabolic full Mackey cancellation diagrams

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

When all double cosets are selected, the sum through the full
Mackey groups \(L_j\) is the identity on the boundary with middle
group \(G\). For a single full summand the reverse composite is
the identity on its balanced product.

```lean
theorem ParabolicFullMackeyCancellation : let U := ↥(Subgroup.closure {s : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s})
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U),
  parabolic K → parabolic H → parabolic G →
  let conjugate := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjugate α K
  let Hβ := conjugate β H
  ∀ (hK : Kα ≤ G) (hH : Hβ ≤ G),
    let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := G) α
      (fun k => hK ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)
    let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := G) β
      (fun h => hH ⟨(h : U), h.property, rfl⟩)
    let A := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Kα
    let B := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype G) Hβ
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let L := fun j : J => Kα ⊓ conjugate ((σ j : U) * β) H
      let l := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := K) α⁻¹ (by
          intro ℓ
          obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.1
          change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
          change k ∈ K at hk
          change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
          rw [← heq]
          convert hk using 1
          group)
      let r := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := L j) (G := H)
          (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) (by
            intro ℓ
            obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := ℓ.property.2
            change (σ j : U) * β * h * ((σ j : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
            change h ∈ H at hh
            change (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
            rw [← heq]
            convert hh using 1
            group)
      let d : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l j))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b (r j)) := fun j =>
        ⟨σ j, by
          intro ℓ
          apply Subtype.ext
          change α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹ * (σ j : U) =
            (σ j : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
              (β⁻¹ * (σ j : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
          group⟩
      let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
      let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
      let Mj := fun j : J =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j)) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))
      ∃ (finiteJ : Fintype J)
        (finiteFibers : ∀ (j : J) (z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier),
          Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a b (l j) (r j) (d j) w = z}),
        let ι : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b (l j) (r j) [(1, d j)]
        let p : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M (Mj j) := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b (l j) (r j)
            [(1, ⟨d j, finiteFibers j⟩)]
        let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))
        let straightj : ∀ j : J, MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (Mj j) (Mj j) :=
          fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up (l j))))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down (r j))))
        let eval := fun {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
            (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
        let indices : Finset J := @Finset.univ J finiteJ
        let summands : J → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M := fun j =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (p j) (ι j)
        let fullSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex M M J :=
          MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.mk indices summands
        MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.shape fullSum =
          MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.Shape.mk indices
            (fun j => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape (summands j)) ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval fullSum =
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval straight) ∧
        ∀ j : J,
          eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (ι j) (p j)) = eval (straightj j)
```

## ParabolicSmallerMackeyReverseComposite: Finite-parabolic reverse composite through a smaller internal group

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Let \(K,H,G\le U\) and \(\alpha,\beta\in U\) satisfy
\(\cg{\alpha}{K}\le G\) and \(\cg{\beta}{H}\le G\).
Let \(J=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\backslash G/(\cg{\beta}{H})\). Choose one
representative \(\sigma_j\in j\) for each \(j\in J\), so
\begin{equation}\label{eq:conj-cosets}
 j=(\cg{\alpha}{K})\sigma_j(\cg{\beta}{H}),
 \qquad G=\bigsqcup_{j\in J}j.
\end{equation}
For each \(j\), set
\begin{equation}\label{eq:alt-L}
 L_j=\cg{\alpha}{K}\cap\cg{\sigma_j\beta}{H} .
\end{equation}
The embeddings out of \(L_j\) are
\(\lambda_j(\ell)=\alpha^{-1}\ell\alpha\in K\) and
\(\mu_j(\ell)=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}\ell\sigma_j\beta\in H\).
The strand labels for these maps are
\(\overline{\alpha^{-1}}=\alpha^{-1}C_U(L_j)\) and
\(\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}=\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}C_U(L_j)\).

Write \(M={}_{\C[K]}(\C[G])_{\C[H]}\) with actions through \(\alpha_*,\beta_*\),
and \(M_j=\C[K]\otimes_{\C[L_j]}\C[H]\) with actions in the tensor product
through \(\lambda_j,\mu_j\). A boundary with middle region \(G\)
represents \(\D_{\bar\alpha}^{K,G}\otimes_{\C[G]}\I_{\bar\beta}^{G,H}\cong M\);
one with middle region \(L_j\) represents
\(\I_{\overline{\alpha^{-1}}}^{K,L_j}\otimes_{\C[L_j]}
 \D_{\overline{\beta^{-1}\sigma_j^{-1}}}^{L_j,H}\cong M_j\).

Restrict the embeddings of \(L_j\) to \(L\le L_j\), and write
\(p_{L,j},\iota_{L,j}\) for the resulting crossings. For finite
\([L_j:L]\), Proposition~5.1 gives
\(\iota_{L,j}\circ p_{L,j}=[L_j:L]\,(\iota_j\circ p_j)\).

In the rightmost diagram, \(q\) maps balanced pairs to the double coset \(j\).
\[
 q:K\times_L H\longrightarrow j,\qquad
 q([k,h]_L)=\alpha k\alpha^{-1}\sigma_j\beta h\beta^{-1}.
\]
The lower crossing \(\iota_{L,j}\) is the linear extension of \(q\).
The upper crossing \(p_{L,j}\) sends \(q(z)\) to the sum of its
\([L_j:L]\) preimages, so \(p_{L,j}\circ\iota_{L,j}\) is the
identity exactly when \(L=L_j\).

In the reverse order the composite \(p_{L,j}\circ\iota_{L,j}\)
sums the fiber through each basis vector, as in
Proposition~5.1.

```lean
theorem ParabolicSmallerMackeyReverseComposite : let U := ↥(Subgroup.closure {s : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap s})
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  parabolic K → parabolic H → parabolic G →
  let eα := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)
  let B := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ)
  let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
  ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j) (j : J),
    let s := σ j
    let orbit := DoubleCoset.doubleCoset s (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    let a := α⁻¹
    let b := β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹
    let Lj := Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj α)) K ⊓
      Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj ((s : U) * β))) H
    let left := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) a (by
        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).1
        change α * k * α⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
        change α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ K
        rw [← heq]
        change k ∈ K at hk
        convert hk using 1
        group)
    let right := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := H) b (by
        intro ℓ
        obtain ⟨h, hh, heq⟩ := (hS ℓ.property).2
        change (s : U) * β * h * ((s : U) * β)⁻¹ = (ℓ : U) at heq
        change (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) * (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹ ∈ H
        rw [← heq]
        change h ∈ H at hh
        convert hh using 1
        group)
    let dot := fun (S : Subgroup U) (hS : S ≤ Lj) =>
      show MackeyDiagrams.Dot
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eα (left S hS))
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (right S hS)) from
        ⟨s, by
          intro ℓ
          apply Subtype.ext
          change (α * (α⁻¹ * (ℓ : U) * (α⁻¹)⁻¹) * α⁻¹) * (s : U) =
            (s : U) * (β * ((β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹) * (ℓ : U) *
              (β⁻¹ * (s : U)⁻¹)⁻¹) * β⁻¹)
          group⟩
    ∀ (L : Subgroup U) (hL : L ≤ Lj),
      parabolic L → Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex L Lj →
      let leftL := left L hL
      let rightL := right L hL
      let leftJ := left Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let rightJ := right Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let dL := dot L hL
      let dJ := dot Lj (le_refl Lj)
      let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down eα) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up eβ)
      let ML := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftL) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightL)
      let MJ := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftJ) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightJ)
      let qBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftL rightL dL
      let qBasisJ := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ
      let q := fun z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier =>
        MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (qBasis z)
      let fiber := fun g : G => {w | q w = g}
      let n := Subgroup.relIndex L Lj
      ∃ (hLFinite : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | qBasis w = z})
        (hJFinite : ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
          Set.Finite {w | qBasisJ w = z}),
        let hf := fun g : G => show Set.Finite (fiber g) from
          Set.Finite.subset (hLFinite (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)) (by
            intro w hw
            apply (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).injective
            change q w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ
              (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g)
            rw [MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedProduct_mixedPair]
            exact hw)
        let fiberSum := fun g : G =>
          Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset (hf g)) (fun w => Finsupp.single w (1 : Complex))
        let iotaL : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex ML M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ leftL rightL dL
        let pL : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M ML :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftL rightL dL hLFinite
        let iotaJ : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex MJ M :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedMultiplication eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ
        let pJ : MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex M MJ :=
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mixedProjection eα eβ leftJ rightJ dJ hJFinite
        let outerL := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pL iotaL
        let outerJ := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical pJ iotaJ
        let innerL := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical iotaL pL
        let straight := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up leftL))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.down rightL))
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval outerL =
          MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.scale (n : Complex) outerJ) ∧
        Set.range q = orbit ∧
        (∀ (k : K) (h : H),
          q (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction leftL)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction rightL) k h) =
            MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eα k * s *
              MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ h) ∧
        (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval iotaL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) =
            Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ (q z)) 1) ∧
        (∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit →
          Nat.card (fiber g) = n ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval pL)
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) = fiberSum g) ∧
        (∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ML).carrier,
          MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL)
              (Finsupp.single z 1) = fiberSum (q z)) ∧
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval innerL = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval straight ↔ L = Lj)
```

## LargestCommonParabolicDependsOnRepresentatives: The common parabolic depends on the representatives

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let \(G=S_3\times S_5\) on the blocks \(\{1,2,3\}\) and
\(\{4,5,6,7,8\}\), with \(K=H=\langle(12)\rangle\times S_5\)
and inclusion labels. The two double cosets have representatives
\(1,(13)(456)\). Their Mackey groups intersect in the second
factor, but the common-label condition gives
\(P=\langle(456)\rangle\times\langle(78)\rangle\).
The largest common parabolic is \(\langle(78)\rangle\).
Choosing \(1,(13)\) instead gives the full second factor as the
largest common parabolic, with indices \(2\) and \(1\).

Its convention on p. 6 reads displayed diagram identities as equality of evaluated bimodule maps at the same source and target, with linear evaluation of weighted sums. The rendered rows and corresponding TikZ show a straight restriction strand beside a straight induction strand, and a binary sum of projection-then-inclusion stacks. The upper row scales its stacks by 1/120 and 1/60. The lower row scales only its first stack, by 1/2. Both rows keep the fixed inclusion boundary. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#ex:common-mackey-representatives https://getcurious.cc/assets/img/mackey-bimodules/diagram-34.png [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem LargestCommonParabolicDependsOnRepresentatives : let U := ↥(Subgroup.closure {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap g})
let blockPerm : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun S =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype _) S = iSup (fun i => blockPerm (blocks i))
let mackey := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K : Subgroup V) (s : V) =>
  K ⊓ Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj s)) K
let inclusion := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (S T : Subgroup V) (h : S ≤ T) =>
  show MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S T from
    ⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by
      change (x : V) = 1 * (x : V) * (1 : V)⁻¹
      simp⟩⟩
let left := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K : Subgroup V) (s : V)
    (S : Subgroup V) (h : S ≤ mackey K s) =>
  inclusion S K (le_trans h inf_le_left)
let right := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K : Subgroup V) (s : V)
    (S : Subgroup V) (h : S ≤ mackey K s) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := S) (G := K) s⁻¹ (by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨k, hk, heq⟩ := (h x.property).2
    change s * k * s⁻¹ = (x : V) at heq
    rw [← heq]
    change k ∈ K at hk
    convert hk using 1
    group)
let common := fun (K G : Subgroup U) (t : U) =>
  (mackey K 1 ⊓ mackey K t) ⊓ (G ⊓ Subgroup.centralizer ({(1 : U) * t⁻¹} : Set U))
let admissible := fun (K : Subgroup U) (t : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
  parabolic S ∧
    ∃ (h₁ : S ≤ mackey K 1) (h₂ : S ≤ mackey K t),
      left K 1 S h₁ = left K t S h₂ ∧ right K 1 S h₁ = right K t S h₂
let diagramIdentity := fun {V : Type} [Group V] (K G : Subgroup V)
    (hKG : K ≤ G) (s₁ s₂ : G) (L : Subgroup V) (c₁ : Complex)
    (c₂ : Option Complex) =>
  let a := inclusion K G hKG
  let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let M := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
  let l := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) => left K (s : V) L h
  let r := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) => right K (s : V) L h
  let dot := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) =>
    show MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (l s h))
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a (r s h)) from
      ⟨s, by
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (x : V) * (s : V) =
          (s : V) * ((s : V)⁻¹ * (x : V) * ((s : V)⁻¹)⁻¹)
        group⟩
  let finiteFibers := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) =>
    ∀ z : (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis M).carrier,
      Set.Finite {w | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis
        a a (l s h) (r s h) (dot s h) w = z}
  let outer := fun (s : G) (h : L ≤ mackey K (s : V)) (hf : finiteFibers s h) =>
    show MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M from
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a a (l s h) (r s h)
          [(1, ⟨dot s h, hf⟩)])
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a a (l s h) (r s h)
          [(1, dot s h)])
  let straight : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id down))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id up))
  ∃ (h₁ : L ≤ mackey K (s₁ : V)) (h₂ : L ≤ mackey K (s₂ : V))
      (hf₁ : finiteFibers s₁ h₁) (hf₂ : finiteFibers s₂ h₂),
    let first := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale c₁ (outer s₁ h₁ hf₁)
    let second := outer s₂ h₂ hf₂
    let weightedSecond := Option.elim c₂ second
      (fun c => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale c second)
    straight.interpret.eval =
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.add first weightedSecond).interpret.eval
let swap := fun (i j : Nat) =>
  show U from ⟨Equiv.swap i j, by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [Equiv.swap_self]
      exact Subgroup.one_mem _
    · exact Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩⟩
let blockSym := fun X : Finset Nat =>
  Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype (Subgroup.closure
    {g : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap g})) (blockPerm X)
let S₃ := blockSym (Finset.Icc 1 3)
let S₅ := blockSym (Finset.Icc 4 8)
let G := S₃ ⊔ S₅
let K := Subgroup.zpowers (swap 1 2) ⊔ S₅
let cycle := swap 4 5 * swap 5 6
let τ := swap 1 3
let σ := τ * cycle
let L := Subgroup.zpowers (swap 7 8)
∃ (hKG : K ≤ G) (hσ : σ ∈ G) (hτ : τ ∈ G),
  let A := MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (inclusion K G hKG))
  let e : G := 1
  let s : G := ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  let t : G := ⟨τ, hτ⟩
  let q := DoubleCoset.mk A A
  q e ≠ q s ∧ q t = q s ∧ (∀ j : DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (A : Set G),
    j = q e ∨ j = q s) ∧
  mackey K 1 ⊓ mackey K σ = S₅ ∧
  common K G σ = Subgroup.zpowers cycle ⊔ L ∧
  IsGreatest {S : Subgroup U | admissible K σ S} L ∧
  IsGreatest {S : Subgroup U | admissible K τ S} S₅ ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex L (mackey K 1) = 120 ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex L (mackey K σ) = 60 ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex S₅ (mackey K 1) = 2 ∧
  Subgroup.relIndex S₅ (mackey K τ) = 1 ∧
  diagramIdentity K G hKG e s L (1 / 120) (Option.some (1 / 60)) ∧
  diagramIdentity K G hKG e t S₅ (1 / 2) Option.none
```

## ParabolicSharedRegionParallelInduction: Shared parabolic region for parallel induction crossings

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

The bottom, middle, and top chains through \(H,B,H'\) have
composite conjugators \(u=\alpha\beta\), \(v=\gamma\delta\),
and \(w=\alpha'\beta'\).

Take a finite family of the parallel two-crossing diagrams of
Theorem~5.4, with the same outside groups \(G,K\)
and prescribed middle composite conjugators \(v_i\). With inclusion
as the middle embedding into \(G\), the least common middle group is
\[
 P=\left\langle\bigcup_i\cg{v_i}{K}\right\rangle.
\]
Each diagram keeps its dots and its evaluated map. In the diagram
\(B_i\) denotes the original middle group.

The middle group must contain every \(\cg{v_i}{K}\). Their join is
parabolic. Factor each embedding of \(K\) through this join by
conjugation by \(v_i\), followed by inclusion into \(G\). The
composite embeddings and the conditions on the dots are unchanged.
Theorem~5.4 therefore gives the same evaluated map,
for both induction and restriction.

```lean
theorem ParabolicSharedRegionParallelInduction : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun L =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) L = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (G K : Subgroup U) (H B H' : ι → Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic K →
  (∀ i, parabolic (H i)) → (∀ i, parabolic (B i)) → (∀ i, parabolic (H' i)) →
  ∀ (α β γ δ α' β' : ι → U)
    (hα : ∀ i (h : H i), α i * (h : U) * (α i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ i (k : K), β i * (k : U) * (β i)⁻¹ ∈ H i)
    (hγ : ∀ i (b : B i), γ i * (b : U) * (γ i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ i (k : K), δ i * (k : U) * (δ i)⁻¹ ∈ B i)
    (hα' : ∀ i (h : H' i), α' i * (h : U) * (α' i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ i (k : K), β' i * (k : U) * (β' i)⁻¹ ∈ H' i),
  let v := fun i => γ i * δ i
  let image := fun i => Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (v i))) K
  let P := Subgroup.closure (Set.iUnion fun i => (image i : Set U))
  IsLeast {Q : Subgroup U | Q ≤ G ∧ parabolic Q ∧ ∀ i, image i ≤ Q} P ∧
  ∃ hP : P ≤ G,
    let inclusion := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := P) (G := G)
      (1 : U) (fun p => by simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using hP p.property)
    let throughP := fun i =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := K) (G := P) (v i) (fun k => by
        apply Subgroup.subset_closure
        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, (show (MulAut.conj (v i)) (k : U) ∈ image i from
          ⟨(k : U), k.property, rfl⟩)⟩)
    let evalDrawing {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word G K}
        (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    ∀ i,
      let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (α i) (hα i)
      let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β i) (hβ i)
      let c := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (γ i) (hγ i)
      let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (δ i) (hδ i)
      let a' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (α' i) (hα' i)
      let b' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β' i) (hβ' i)
      let bottom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
      let middle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp c d
      let top := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'
      let newMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp inclusion (throughP i)
      ∃ sameMiddle : middle = newMiddle,
        ∀ (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom middle)
          (y : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex middle top),
          let newX := Eq.ndrec
            (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom m) x sameMiddle
          let newY := Eq.ndrec
            (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex m top) y sameMiddle
          let original := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms y))
          let shared := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b inclusion (throughP i)
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newX))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp inclusion (throughP i) a' b'
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newY))
          let merge := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
            (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b)
          let productDot := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose x y)
          let split := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
            (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a' b')
          let merged := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical merge productDot) split
          evalDrawing original = evalDrawing shared ∧
          evalDrawing shared = evalDrawing merged
```

## ParabolicSharedRegionParallelRestriction: Shared parabolic region for parallel restriction crossings

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

The bottom, middle, and top chains through \(H,B,H'\) have
composite conjugators \(u=\alpha\beta\), \(v=\gamma\delta\),
and \(w=\alpha'\beta'\).

Take a finite family of the parallel two-crossing diagrams of
Theorem~5.4, with the same outside groups \(G,K\)
and prescribed middle composite conjugators \(v_i\). With inclusion
as the middle embedding into \(G\), the least common middle group is
\[
 P=\left\langle\bigcup_i\cg{v_i}{K}\right\rangle.
\]
Each diagram keeps its dots and its evaluated map. In the diagram
\(B_i\) denotes the original middle group.

The middle group must contain every \(\cg{v_i}{K}\). Their join is
parabolic. Factor each embedding of \(K\) through this join by
conjugation by \(v_i\), followed by inclusion into \(G\). The
composite embeddings and the conditions on the dots are unchanged.
Theorem~5.4 therefore gives the same evaluated map,
for both induction and restriction.

```lean
theorem ParabolicSharedRegionParallelRestriction : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun S => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ S))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun L =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ j, Finset.Nonempty (blocks j)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun j k => Disjoint (blocks j) (blocks k)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) L = iSup (fun j => blockSym (blocks j))
∀ {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (G K : Subgroup U) (H B H' : ι → Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic K →
  (∀ i, parabolic (H i) ∧ parabolic (B i) ∧ parabolic (H' i)) →
  ∀ (α β γ δ α' β' : ι → U)
    (hα : ∀ i (h : H i), α i * (h : U) * (α i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ i (k : K), β i * (k : U) * (β i)⁻¹ ∈ H i)
    (hγ : ∀ i (b : B i), γ i * (b : U) * (γ i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ i (k : K), δ i * (k : U) * (δ i)⁻¹ ∈ B i)
    (hα' : ∀ i (h : H' i), α' i * (h : U) * (α' i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ i (k : K), β' i * (k : U) * (β' i)⁻¹ ∈ H' i),
    let v := fun i => γ i * δ i
    let image := fun i => Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (v i))) K
    let P := Subgroup.closure (Set.iUnion (fun i => (image i : Set U)))
    IsLeast {Q : Subgroup U | parabolic Q ∧ Q ≤ G ∧ ∀ i, image i ≤ Q} P ∧
    ∃ (hPG : P ≤ G) (hKP : ∀ i (k : K), v i * (k : U) * (v i)⁻¹ ∈ P),
      let a := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (α i) (hα i)
      let b := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β i) (hβ i)
      let c := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (γ i) (hγ i)
      let f := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (δ i) (hδ i)
      let a' := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (α' i) (hα' i)
      let b' := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β' i) (hβ' i)
      let incl : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P G :=
        ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hPG, ⟨1, fun x => by
          simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
      let toP := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (v i) (hKP i)
      ∀ i,
        let u := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp (a i) (b i)
        let oldMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp (c i) (f i)
        let newMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp incl (toP i)
        let w := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp (a' i) (b' i)
        let twoCrossings {M : Subgroup U}
            (g : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding M G)
            (q : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M)
            (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g q))
            (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp g q) w) :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown (a i) (b i) g q
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms D))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown g q (a' i) (b' i)
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms E))
        let mergeDotSplit (label : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u w) :=
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown (a i) (b i)))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing label)
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
                (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown (a' i) (b' i))))
        let evalDrawing {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K G}
            (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
          MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
        ∃ same : oldMiddle = newMiddle,
          let mapsAgree (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u oldMiddle)
              (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex oldMiddle w)
              (product : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u w) :=
            let D' := Eq.ndrec (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u m) D same
            let E' := Eq.ndrec (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex m w) E same
            let original := twoCrossings (c i) (f i) D E
            let replacement := twoCrossings incl (toP i) D' E'
            let merged := mergeDotSplit product
            evalDrawing original = evalDrawing replacement ∧
            evalDrawing replacement = evalDrawing merged
          (∀ (d : MackeyDiagrams.Dot u oldMiddle) (e : MackeyDiagrams.Dot oldMiddle w),
            mapsAgree (Finsupp.single d 1) (Finsupp.single e 1)
              (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.vertical d e) 1)) ∧
          (∀ (D : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex u oldMiddle)
             (E : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex oldMiddle w),
            mapsAgree D E (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose D E))
```

 P=\left\langle\bigcup_i\cg{v_i}{K}\right\rangle.

```lean
theorem SharedParabolicForParallelCrossings : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) := fun X =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop := fun L =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) L = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (G K : Subgroup U) (H B H' : ι → Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic K →
  (∀ i, parabolic (H i)) → (∀ i, parabolic (B i)) → (∀ i, parabolic (H' i)) →
  ∀ (α β γ δ α' β' : ι → U)
    (hα : ∀ i (h : H i), α i * (h : U) * (α i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ i (k : K), β i * (k : U) * (β i)⁻¹ ∈ H i)
    (hγ : ∀ i (b : B i), γ i * (b : U) * (γ i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hδ : ∀ i (k : K), δ i * (k : U) * (δ i)⁻¹ ∈ B i)
    (hα' : ∀ i (h : H' i), α' i * (h : U) * (α' i)⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ' : ∀ i (k : K), β' i * (k : U) * (β' i)⁻¹ ∈ H' i),
  let v := fun i => γ i * δ i
  let image := fun i => Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (v i))) K
  let P := Subgroup.closure (Set.iUnion fun i => (image i : Set U))
  IsLeast {Q : Subgroup U | Q ≤ G ∧ parabolic Q ∧ ∀ i, image i ≤ Q} P ∧
  ∃ (hPG : P ≤ G) (hKP : ∀ i (k : K), v i * (k : U) * (v i)⁻¹ ∈ P),
    let inclusion : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P G :=
      ⟨Subgroup.inclusion hPG, ⟨1, fun p => by
        simp only [Subgroup.coe_inclusion, one_mul, inv_one, mul_one]⟩⟩
    let throughP := fun i => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (v i) (hKP i)
    let evalDrawing {A C : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word A C}
        (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    ∀ i,
      let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (α i) (hα i)
      let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β i) (hβ i)
      let c := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (γ i) (hγ i)
      let d := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (δ i) (hδ i)
      let a' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (α' i) (hα' i)
      let b' := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (β' i) (hβ' i)
      let bottom := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a b
      let middle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp c d
      let top := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b'
      let newMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp inclusion (throughP i)
      ∃ sameMiddle : middle = newMiddle,
        ∀ (x : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom middle)
          (y : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex middle top),
          let newX := Eq.ndrec
            (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex bottom m) x sameMiddle
          let newY := Eq.ndrec
            (motive := fun m => MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex m top) y sameMiddle
          let product := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.compose x y
          let originalUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b c d (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp c d a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms y))
          let sharedUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b inclusion (throughP i)
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newX))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp inclusion (throughP i) a' b'
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newY))
          let mergedUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp a b))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing product)
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
                (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp a' b')))
          let originalDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown a b c d (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms x))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown c d a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms y))
          let sharedDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown a b inclusion (throughP i)
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newX))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelDown inclusion (throughP i) a' b'
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms newY))
          let mergedDown := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
              (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeDown a b))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing product)
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (R := Complex)
                (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitDown a' b')))
          (evalDrawing originalUp = evalDrawing sharedUp ∧
            evalDrawing sharedUp = evalDrawing mergedUp) ∧
          (evalDrawing originalDown = evalDrawing sharedDown ∧
            evalDrawing sharedDown = evalDrawing mergedDown)
```

## FiniteParabolicSingleDiagramReplacements: Restriction of single-diagram replacements to finite parabolics

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

For three induction strands, the constructions of
Lemma~6.1 use \(B'=F\) and \(B=G\).
Both are boundary groups, so the inverse bijections on evaluation
classes restrict to this category. In Cases~1--4 the usual
single-diagram replacements can use \(B'=A\) and \(B=E\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, unnumbered, p. 37](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, unnumbered result immediately preceding Proposition 8.5 on p. 37. The published PDF matches the project copy, and the portal mirrors the endpoint. The type uses the finite-parabolic bicategory of § 7.5 and fixes the boundary groups and strand cosets of the drawings on pp. 19, 22 and 24. Replacements preserve evaluation in both directions and induce inverse bijections on evaluation classes. For three induction strands the replacement regions are B′ = F and B = G. For Cases 1–4 they are B′ = A and B = E. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=37

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139 governs the dot syntax. Each crossing has a single mark carrying a finite complex linear combination of termwise eligible group elements, including zero and coefficient-one singletons. Each supported projection parameter satisfies the pointwise finite-fiber condition. The all-induction composites use the shared compact MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp crossings drawn in § 6.1. Lean elaborated the proposition and verified the positions, crossing kinds and ordered boundary orientations of all six composites for arbitrary labels through the shared compilation slot.

The designated defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No correction for this endpoint was available. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem FiniteParabolicSingleDiagramReplacements : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let Region := {H : Subgroup U // parabolic H}
let Embedding := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (U := U)
let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
let Drawing := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex p q
let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
let straight := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
  ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
let evaluate := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H} (drawing : Drawing p q) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
let onFirstTwo := fun {K H J J' L : Subgroup U}
    {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J H}
    {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' H}
    (crossing : Drawing (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) (r : MackeyDiagrams.Word H L) =>
  horizontal crossing (straight r)
let onLastTwo := fun {K H J J' L : Subgroup U}
    (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
    {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {r : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
    {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {r' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
    (crossing : Drawing (tensor q r) (tensor q' r')) =>
  vertical (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p q r))
    (vertical (horizontal (straight p) crossing)
      (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q' r')))
let stack := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {p q r s : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
    (first : Drawing p q) (second : Drawing q r) (third : Drawing r s) =>
  vertical first (vertical second third)
let DotWeights := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (a b : Embedding H K) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex a b
let parallel := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
    (a : Embedding Q P) (b : Embedding S Q) (a' : Embedding Q' P) (b' : Embedding S Q')
    (label : DotWeights (comp a b) (comp a' b')) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a b a' b' (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms label)
let ProjectionWeights := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (α : Embedding K P) (β : Embedding H P) (η : Embedding L K) (θ : Embedding L H) =>
  Finsupp (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ) Complex
let project := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (α : Embedding K P) (β : Embedding H P) (η : Embedding L K) (θ : Embedding L H)
    (label : ProjectionWeights α β η θ) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β η θ
    (List.map (fun term => (label term, term)) (Finset.toList (Finsupp.support label)))
let multiply := fun {K H P L : Subgroup U}
    (α : Embedding K P) (β : Embedding H P) (η : Embedding L K) (θ : Embedding L H)
    (label : DotWeights (comp α η) (comp β θ)) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β η θ (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms label)
let Replacements := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {bottom top : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
    {Left Right : Type} (leftDiagram : Left → Drawing bottom top)
    (rightDiagram : Right → Drawing bottom top)
    (leftRegion : Left → Subgroup U) (rightRegion : Right → Subgroup U)
    (B B' : Subgroup U) =>
  let leftEval := fun l => evaluate (leftDiagram l)
  let rightEval := fun r => evaluate (rightDiagram r)
  let leftClasses := Setoid.ker leftEval
  let rightClasses := Setoid.ker rightEval
  ∃ (toRight : Left → Right) (toLeft : Right → Left)
    (classes : Equiv (Quotient leftClasses) (Quotient rightClasses)),
    (∀ l : Left, rightRegion (toRight l) = B' ∧
      rightEval (toRight l) = leftEval l ∧
      classes (Quotient.mk leftClasses l) = Quotient.mk rightClasses (toRight l)) ∧
    (∀ r : Right, leftRegion (toLeft r) = B ∧
      leftEval (toLeft r) = rightEval r ∧
      Equiv.symm classes (Quotient.mk rightClasses r) = Quotient.mk leftClasses (toLeft r))
∀ (G A D F C E : Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  (∀ (ga : Embedding A G) (ad : Embedding D A) (df : Embedding F D)
      (gc : Embedding C G) (ce : Embedding E C) (ef : Embedding F E),
    let bottom := tensor (tensor (up ga) (up ad)) (up df)
    let top := tensor (tensor (up gc) (up ce)) (up ef)
    let Left := Σ B : Region,
      Σ gb : Embedding B.val G, Σ bd : Embedding D B.val, Σ be : Embedding E B.val,
        DotWeights (comp ga ad) (comp gb bd) ×
        DotWeights (comp bd df) (comp be ef) ×
        DotWeights (comp gb be) (comp gc ce)
    let Right := Σ B' : Region,
      Σ ab' : Embedding B'.val A, Σ cb' : Embedding B'.val C, Σ b'f : Embedding F B'.val,
        DotWeights (comp ad df) (comp ab' b'f) ×
        DotWeights (comp ga ab') (comp gc cb') ×
        DotWeights (comp cb' b'f) (comp ce ef)
    let leftDiagram : Left → Drawing bottom top :=
      fun ⟨_, gb, bd, be, x₁, x₂, x₃⟩ =>
        stack
          (onFirstTwo (parallel ga ad gb bd x₁) (up df))
          (onLastTwo (up gb) (parallel bd df be ef x₂))
          (onFirstTwo (parallel gb be gc ce x₃) (up ef))
    let rightDiagram : Right → Drawing bottom top :=
      fun ⟨_, ab', cb', b'f, y₁, y₂, y₃⟩ =>
        stack
          (onLastTwo (up ga) (parallel ad df ab' b'f y₁))
          (onFirstTwo (parallel ga ab' gc cb' y₂) (up b'f))
          (onLastTwo (up gc) (parallel cb' b'f ce ef y₃))
    Replacements leftDiagram rightDiagram
      (fun l => l.1.val) (fun r => r.1.val) G F) ∧
  (∀ (a : Embedding G A) (b : Embedding D A) (c : Embedding F D)
      (d : Embedding C G) (e : Embedding E C) (f : Embedding E F),
    let bc := comp b c
    let de := comp d e
    let lower := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
    let upper := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
    let LeftProjection := Σ B : Region,
      Σ r : Embedding B.val G, Σ s : Embedding B.val D, Σ t : Embedding E B.val,
        ProjectionWeights a b r s × ProjectionWeights s c t f ×
        DotWeights (comp r t) de
    let RightProjection := Σ B' : Region,
      Σ j : Embedding B'.val A, Σ v : Embedding C B'.val, Σ w : Embedding F B'.val,
        DotWeights bc (comp j w) ×
        ProjectionWeights a j d v × ProjectionWeights v w e f
    let leftProjection : LeftProjection → Drawing lower upper :=
      fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ =>
        stack
          (onFirstTwo (project a b r s x) (up c))
          (onLastTwo (up r) (project s c t f y))
          (onFirstTwo (parallel r t d e z) (down f))
    let rightProjection : RightProjection → Drawing lower upper :=
      fun ⟨_, j, v, w, ℓ, m, n⟩ =>
        stack
          (onLastTwo (down a) (parallel b c j w ℓ))
          (onFirstTwo (project a j d v m) (up w))
          (onLastTwo (up d) (project v w e f n))
    let LeftMultiplication := Σ B : Region,
      Σ r : Embedding B.val G, Σ s : Embedding B.val D, Σ t : Embedding E B.val,
        DotWeights de (comp r t) ×
        DotWeights (comp s t) (comp c f) ×
        DotWeights (comp a r) (comp b s)
    let RightMultiplication := Σ B' : Region,
      Σ j : Embedding B'.val A, Σ v : Embedding C B'.val, Σ w : Embedding F B'.val,
        DotWeights (comp v e) (comp w f) ×
        DotWeights (comp a d) (comp j v) ×
        DotWeights (comp j w) bc
    let leftMultiplication : LeftMultiplication → Drawing upper lower :=
      fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ =>
        stack
          (onFirstTwo (parallel d e r t x) (down f))
          (onLastTwo (up r) (multiply s c t f y))
          (onFirstTwo (multiply a b r s z) (up c))
    let rightMultiplication : RightMultiplication → Drawing upper lower :=
      fun ⟨_, j, v, w, x, y, z⟩ =>
        stack
          (onLastTwo (up d) (multiply v w e f x))
          (onFirstTwo (multiply a j d v y) (up w))
          (onLastTwo (down a) (parallel j w b c z))
    Replacements leftProjection rightProjection
      (fun l => l.1.val) (fun r => r.1.val) E A ∧
    Replacements leftMultiplication rightMultiplication
      (fun l => l.1.val) (fun r => r.1.val) E A)
```

## ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionRegions: Extremal regions for three induction strands

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

All strands point up. For adjacent groups \(X,Y\le U\),
\(\boxed{XY}\) represents the label \(\boxed{XY}C_U(Y)\).

below.

Let \(\mathcal L,\mathcal R\) be the admissible labellings of the left
and right shapes at this boundary. A labelling specifies the middle
group, the three interior strand cosets, and the three crossing
dots. Each crossing merges, applies its dot, and splits. A dot
can be a finite \(\C\)-linear combination of the group elements
allowed between the two merged strand labels.

Write \(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)\) for the resulting map from the
bottom tensor product to the top one. Within each shape let
\(\mathsf D\sim\mathsf E\) mean
\(\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf D)=\operatorname{ev}(\mathsf E)\), and write
\([\mathsf D]\) for the equivalence class of \(\mathsf D\).

\paragraph{Multipliers.}
Choose boundary representatives and put
\[
 u=\boxed{GA}\boxed{AD}\boxed{DF},\qquad
 v=\boxed{GC}\boxed{CE}\boxed{EF}.
\]
Merging the bottom and top products gives \(\C[G]\) with right
\(\C[F]\)-actions through \(u_*,v_*\). Every left \(\C[G]\)-linear map
is right multiplication by its value at \(1\), denoted \(m(\mathsf D)\).
At the fixed boundary, equality of these values is equality of maps.

Use the boundary labels of Section~6.
Write \(a=\boxed{GA}\), \(d=\boxed{AD}\), \(c=\boxed{GC}\), and
\(e=\boxed{CE}\). For an admissible group-element multiplier
\(p\in G\) and diagrams with group-element dots, the least
transported left region and the greatest
transported right region are, respectively,
\[
 B_{\min}=\left\langle\cg{ad}{D},\cg{pce}{E}\right\rangle,
 \qquad
 B'_{\max}=\cg{a}{A}\cap\cg{pc}{C}.
\]
With these regions, both diagrams evaluate to \(x\mapsto xp\).

```lean
theorem ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionRegions : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym := fun (X : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let conjugate := fun (r : U) (H : Subgroup U) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj r)) H
let embed := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (r : U) (h : conjugate r H ≤ K) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := K) r
    (fun x => h ⟨(x : U), x.property, rfl⟩)
∀ (G A D F C E : Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a d df c e ef : U)
    (ha : conjugate a A ≤ G) (hd : conjugate d D ≤ A) (hdf : conjugate df F ≤ D)
    (hc : conjugate c C ≤ G) (he : conjugate e E ≤ C) (hef : conjugate ef F ≤ E)
    (p : G),
  let u := a * d * df
  let v := c * e * ef
  u⁻¹ * (p : U) * v ∈ Subgroup.centralizer (F : Set U) →
  let ga := embed a ha
  let ad := embed d hd
  let dfEmbedding := embed df hdf
  let gc := embed c hc
  let ce := embed e he
  let efEmbedding := embed ef hef
  let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
  let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce
  let word := fun {P Q S T : Subgroup U}
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up j))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up k)
  let bottom := word ga ad dfEmbedding
  let top := word gc ce efEmbedding
  let splitBottom :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp (R := Complex) bottomPair dfEmbedding)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp ga ad)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up dfEmbedding)))
  let mergeTop :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) gc ce)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up efEmbedding)))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp topPair efEmbedding)
  let BoundaryDiagram := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram Complex bottom top
  let realizes := fun (diagram : BoundaryDiagram) =>
    ∀ z : MonoidAlgebra Complex G,
      MonoidAlgebra.ofCoeff
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical splitBottom
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical diagram mergeTop)))
          (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z)) = z * MonoidAlgebra.single p (1 : Complex)
  let crossing := fun {P Q Q' S : Subgroup U}
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (i' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (j' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp i j)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp i' j')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.mergeUp (R := Complex) i j)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.upDot dot)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.splitUp i' j'))
  let crossLeft := fun {P Q Q' S T : Subgroup U}
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (i' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q' P) (j' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q')
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp i j)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp i' j')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (crossing i j i' j' dot)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up k))
  let crossRight := fun {P Q S S' T : Subgroup U}
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
      (j' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (k' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
      (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp j k)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp j' k')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up j) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up k))
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i))
          (crossing j k j' k' dot))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up j') (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up k')))
  let leftLabelling := fun (B : Subgroup U) (rGB rBD rBE : U)
      (holds : U → U → U → BoundaryDiagram → Prop) =>
    parabolic B ∧
    ∃ (hGB : conjugate rGB B ≤ G) (hBD : conjugate rBD D ≤ B) (hBE : conjugate rBE E ≤ B),
      let gb := embed rGB hGB
      let bd := embed rBD hBD
      let be := embed rBE hBE
      ∃ (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
        (x₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd dfEmbedding)
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be efEmbedding))
        (x₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair),
        holds (x₁.element : U) (x₂.element : U) (x₃.element : U)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd dfEmbedding x₁)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight gb bd dfEmbedding be efEmbedding x₂)
              (crossLeft gb be gc ce efEmbedding x₃)))
  let rightLabelling := fun (B' : Subgroup U) (rAB' rCB' rB'F : U)
      (holds : U → U → U → BoundaryDiagram → Prop) =>
    parabolic B' ∧
    ∃ (hAB' : conjugate rAB' B' ≤ A) (hCB' : conjugate rCB' B' ≤ C)
      (hB'F : conjugate rB'F F ≤ B'),
      let ab' := embed rAB' hAB'
      let cb' := embed rCB' hCB'
      let b'f := embed rB'F hB'F
      ∃ (y₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad dfEmbedding)
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f))
        (y₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab')
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb'))
        (y₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
          (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce efEmbedding)),
        holds (y₁.element : U) (y₂.element : U) (y₃.element : U)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossRight ga ad dfEmbedding ab' b'f y₁)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
              (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce efEmbedding y₃)))
  let leftRegions : Set (Subgroup U) := {H |
    ∃ (B : Subgroup U) (rGB rBD rBE : U),
      leftLabelling B rGB rBD rBE (fun x₁ _ _ diagram =>
        H = conjugate (x₁ * rGB) B ∧ realizes diagram)}
  let rightRegions : Set (Subgroup U) := {H |
    ∃ (B' : Subgroup U) (rAB' rCB' rB'F : U),
      rightLabelling B' rAB' rCB' rB'F (fun y₁ _ _ diagram =>
        H = conjugate (a * y₁ * rAB') B' ∧ realizes diagram)}
  let Bmin := conjugate (a * d) D ⊔ conjugate ((p : U) * c * e) E
  let Bmax := conjugate a A ⊓ conjugate ((p : U) * c) C
  IsLeast leftRegions Bmin ∧ IsGreatest rightRegions Bmax ∧
    leftLabelling Bmin 1 (a * d) ((p : U) * c * e) (fun x₁ x₂ x₃ left =>
      x₁ = 1 ∧ x₂ = 1 ∧ x₃ = (p : U) ∧ realizes left ∧
      rightLabelling Bmax a⁻¹ (c⁻¹ * (p : U)⁻¹) u (fun y₁ y₂ y₃ right =>
        y₁ = 1 ∧ y₂ = (p : U) ∧ y₃ = 1 ∧ realizes right ∧
        MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval left = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval right))
```

## ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionExample: Extremal internal groups for three inductions

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

For inclusion labels with \(G=S_4\), \(A=D=\langle(12)\rangle\),
\(C=E=\langle(23)\rangle\), \(F=1\) and \(p=1\), the left minimum
is \(\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,3\})\) and the right maximum is \(1\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.3 [ex:three-induction-extrema], p. 38](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.3 [ex:three-induction-extrema], p. 38. The published PDF matches the project PDF byte for byte. The example and its rendered diagram agree with the project TeX. The type specializes the transported-region predicates of Proposition 8.5 (ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionRegions) to the six inclusion labels and p = 1. The symmetric groups on 1 through 4 and on 1 through 3 fix the complement pointwise in the ambient group of finitely supported permutations. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=38

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification, recorded in translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the dot syntax. Proposition 8.5 restricts these extrema to group-element dots, so each of the six marks is a coefficient-one singleton of eligible group elements in the shared finite complex label language. The two typed merge–dot–split composites realize right multiplication by p at the fixed boundary. The shared-slot Lean checks elaborated the proposition, verified the shape constraint for every labelling of each composite, and verified that the two planar shapes are distinct.

```lean
theorem ParabolicExtremalThreeInductionExample : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym := fun (X : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ X))
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let conjugate := fun (r : U) (H : Subgroup U) =>
  Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj r)) H
let embed := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (r : U) (h : conjugate r H ≤ K) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator (H := H) (G := K) r
    (fun x => h ⟨(x : U), Subtype.property x, rfl⟩)
let onBlock : Finset Nat → Subgroup U := fun S =>
  Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary) (blockSym S)
let four := Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 4
let G := onBlock four
let liftSwap := fun (i j : Nat) (hij : i ≠ j) =>
  (⟨Equiv.swap i j, Subgroup.subset_closure
      (show Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (Equiv.swap i j) from ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩)⟩ : U)
let s₁₂ := liftSwap 1 2 (by decide)
let s₂₃ := liftSwap 2 3 (by decide)
let A := Subgroup.closure ({s₁₂} : Set U)
let D := A
let C := Subgroup.closure ({s₂₃} : Set U)
let E := C
let F : Subgroup U := ⊥
let p : G := 1
let swapInFour : ∀ (i j : Nat) (hij : i ≠ j), i ∈ four → j ∈ four →
    liftSwap i j hij ∈ G := by
  intro i j hij hi hj
  change Equiv.swap i j ∈ blockSym four
  exact ⟨Equiv.swap (⟨i, hi⟩ : ↥four) ⟨j, hj⟩,
    Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq (⟨i, hi⟩ : ↥four) ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
let oneMem : 1 ∈ four := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩
let twoMem : 2 ∈ four := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩
let threeMem : 3 ∈ four := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩
let aLe : A ≤ G := (Subgroup.closure_le G).mpr
  (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (swapInFour 1 2 (by decide) oneMem twoMem))
let cLe : C ≤ G := (Subgroup.closure_le G).mpr
  (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (swapInFour 2 3 (by decide) twoMem threeMem))
let inclusion : ∀ {H K : Subgroup U}, H ≤ K → MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K :=
  fun {H K} h => embed 1 (show conjugate 1 H ≤ K from by
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    change (1 : U) * x * (1 : U)⁻¹ ∈ K
    simpa only [one_mul, inv_one, mul_one] using h hx)
let ga := inclusion aLe
let ad : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A := inclusion le_rfl
let dfEmbedding : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D := inclusion bot_le
let gc := inclusion cLe
let ce : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C := inclusion le_rfl
let efEmbedding : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E := inclusion bot_le
let bottomPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ad
let topPair := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc ce

    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up j))

let top := word gc ce efEmbedding

  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))

    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) =>

            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical splitBottom

        (MonoidAlgebra.coeff z)) = z * MonoidAlgebra.single p (1 : Complex)

    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q)

      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp a' b')) =>

    (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Q P)
    (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S Q) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S)
    (b' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding S' Q) (c' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T S')
    (weights : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b c)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp b' c')) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up c)))

        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b')

  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ad gb bd dfEmbedding x₁)
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight gb bd dfEmbedding be efEmbedding x₂)

    (cb' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (b'f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B')
    (y₁ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad dfEmbedding)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f))
    (y₂ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab')
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb'))
    (y₃ : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
      (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce efEmbedding)) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossRight ga ad dfEmbedding ab' b'f y₁)
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical (crossLeft ga ab' gc cb' b'f y₂)
      (crossRight gc cb' b'f ce efEmbedding y₃))
let shapeOf := fun (drawing : BoundaryDrawing) =>
  (⟨MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape drawing, G, F, bottom, top, drawing, rfl, rfl⟩ :
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.Shapes (U := U) Complex
      ([true, true, true], [true, true, true]))
let leftShape := shapeOf
  (leftDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id G) ga gc 0 0 0)
let rightShape := shapeOf
  (rightDrawing (inclusion bot_le) (inclusion bot_le) (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id F) 0 0 0)
let singleton := fun {H K : Subgroup U} {a b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K}
    (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot a b) => (Finsupp.single dot (1 : Complex) : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex a b)
let leftRegions : Set (Subgroup U) := {H |
  ∃ (B : Subgroup U) (rGB rBD rBE : U), parabolic B ∧
  ∃ (hGB : conjugate rGB B ≤ G) (hBD : conjugate rBD D ≤ B) (hBE : conjugate rBE E ≤ B),
    let gb := embed rGB hGB
    let bd := embed rBD hBD
    let be := embed rBE hBE
    ∃ (x₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bottomPair (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb bd))
      (x₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp bd dfEmbedding)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp be efEmbedding))
      (x₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gb be) topPair),
      let drawing := leftDrawing gb bd be (singleton x₁) (singleton x₂) (singleton x₃)
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape drawing = Subtype.val leftShape ∧
      H = conjugate ((↑(MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x₁ : G) : U) * rGB) B ∧ realizes drawing}
let rightRegions : Set (Subgroup U) := {H |
  ∃ (B' : Subgroup U) (rAB' rCB' rB'F : U), parabolic B' ∧
  ∃ (hAB' : conjugate rAB' B' ≤ A) (hCB' : conjugate rCB' B' ≤ C)
    (hB'F : conjugate rB'F F ≤ B'),
    let ab' := embed rAB' hAB'
    let cb' := embed rCB' hCB'
    let b'f := embed rB'F hB'F
    ∃ (y₁ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ad dfEmbedding)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ab' b'f))
      (y₂ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ga ab')
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp gc cb'))
      (y₃ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp cb' b'f)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp ce efEmbedding)),
      let drawing := rightDrawing ab' cb' b'f (singleton y₁) (singleton y₂) (singleton y₃)
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.planarShape drawing = Subtype.val rightShape ∧
      H = conjugate ((1 : U) * (↑(MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y₁ : A) : U) * rAB') B' ∧ realizes drawing}
IsLeast leftRegions (onBlock (Finset.Icc (1 : Nat) 3)) ∧
  IsGreatest rightRegions (⊥ : Subgroup U)
```
