## ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions: Extremal regions in Cases 1–4

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~5.1, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

The lower embeddings are \(a:G\to A\), \(b:D\to A\), and \(c:F\to D\).
The upper ones are \(d:C\to G\), \(e:E\to C\), and \(f:E\to F\).
After merging parallel strands, the bottom basis is \(A\), with actions
through \(a,bc\). The top basis is \(G\times_E F\), balanced using \(de,f\).

With a group element at each vertex, either shape evaluates to
\(Q_p^!\), the sum over the fibers of
\[
 Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h),\qquad [g,h]\in G\times_E F,
\]
for a unique \(p\in A\). Its admissibility condition and fiber size over its image are
\begin{equation}\label{eq:three-projection-index}
 \begin{gathered}
 (ade)(v)p=p(bcf)(v)\qquad(v\in E),\\
 n_p=[a(G)\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)]<\infty .
 \end{gathered}
\end{equation}
A diagram with linear labels evaluates to a finite linear combination
of these \(Q_p^!\). Its coefficients are determined by the evaluated map.

Use the embeddings \(a,b,c,d,e,f\) of Cases~1--4 and fix an
admissible group-element crossing element \(p\in A\).
For Cases~1 and~3 the least transported right region is
\[
 P_p=\left\langle (ad)(C),\,p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\right\rangle.
\]
For Cases~2 and~4 the greatest transported left region is
\(B_{\max}=a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\). More precisely, every parabolic \(B\)
in the interval
\[
 (ade)(E)\le B\le a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}
\]
is a possible transported left region. With the largest choice
in Case~2 the first projection has one preimage on its image.

```lean
theorem ParabolicExtremalOutsideRestrictionRegions : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun k : Nat => k ∈ blocks i)))
∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let image := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α)
  let conjugate := fun (h : A) (H : Subgroup A) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj h)) H
  ∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a de) (comp bc f),
  let element := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p
  let lower := image (comp a de)
  let maximum := image a ⊓ conjugate element (image b)
  let minimum := image ad ⊔ conjugate element (image bc)
  Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf lower (image a ⊓ conjugate element (image bc))) →
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let basisMap := @MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis U _
  let finiteFibers := fun {X Y : Type} (q : X → Y) => ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
  ∃ hp : finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p),
  let outside := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let inside := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let identity := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) w)
  let parallel := fun {H K J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L J)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp α β α' β' [((1 : Complex), x)]
  let project := fun {K H J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K J) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H J)
      (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α l) (comp β r))
      (h : finiteFibers (basisMap α β l r x)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β l r
      [((1 : Complex), (⟨x, h⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β l r))]
  let multiply := fun {K H J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K J) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H J)
      (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α l) (comp β r)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β l r [((1 : Complex), x)]
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {v : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {s : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {v' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {s' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor v s) (tensor v' s')) =>
    vertical (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate w v s))
      (vertical (horizontal (identity w) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate w v' s')))
  let Left := Σ B : {B : Subgroup U // parabolic B},
    Σ r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B.val G,
    Σ s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B.val D,
    Σ t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B.val,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a r) (comp b s) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp s t) (comp c f) × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de
  let Right := Σ B : {B : Subgroup U // parabolic B},
    Σ j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B.val A,
    Σ v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B.val,
    Σ w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B.val,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j w) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot ad (comp j v) × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v e) (comp w f)
  let transportLeft : Left → Subgroup A := fun ⟨_, r, _, _, _, _, z⟩ =>
    conjugate (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z)⁻¹)
      (image (comp a r))
  let transportRight : Right → Subgroup A := fun ⟨_, j, _, _, _, m, _⟩ =>
    conjugate (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element m) (image j)
  let leftFinite : Left → Prop := fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, _⟩ =>
    finiteFibers (basisMap a b r s x) ∧ finiteFibers (basisMap s c t f y)
  let rightFinite : Right → Prop := fun ⟨_, j, v, w, _, m, n⟩ =>
    finiteFibers (basisMap a j d v m) ∧ finiteFibers (basisMap v w e f n)
  let leftProject : (l : Left) → leftFinite l → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
    fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ h =>
      vertical
        (horizontal
          (project a b r s x h.1)
          (identity (up c)))
        (vertical (atRight (up r) (project s c t f y h.2))
          (horizontal (parallel r t d e z)
            (identity (down f))))
  let rightProject : (r : Right) → rightFinite r → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
    fun ⟨_, j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩ h =>
      vertical (atRight (down a) (parallel b c j w ell))
        (vertical
          (horizontal
            (project a j d v m h.1)
            (identity (up w)))
          (atRight (up d) (project v w e f n h.2)))
  let leftMultiply : Left → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex inside outside :=
    fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ =>
      vertical
        (horizontal (parallel d e r t (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse z))
          (identity (down f)))
        (vertical (atRight (up r) (multiply s c t f y))
          (horizontal
            (multiply a b r s x)
            (identity (up c))))
  let rightMultiply : Right → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex inside outside :=
    fun ⟨_, j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩ =>
      vertical (atRight (up d) (multiply v w e f n))
        (vertical
          (horizontal (multiply a j d v m)
            (identity (up w)))
          (atRight (down a) (parallel j w b c (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse ell))))
  let targetProject : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
    vertical
      (vertical (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
        (horizontal (identity (down a))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp b c))))
      (vertical (project a bc de f p hp)
        (horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp d e))
          (identity (down f))))
  let targetMultiply : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex inside outside :=
    vertical
      (horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp d e))
        (identity (down f)))
      (vertical (multiply a bc de f p)
        (vertical
          (horizontal (identity (down a))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp b c)))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down a) (up b) (up c)))))
  let evalProject := fun (q : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret q) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret targetProject)
  let evalMultiply := fun (q : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex inside outside) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret q) =
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret targetMultiply)
  let leftProjectRegions : Set (Subgroup A) :=
    {H | ∃ (l : Left) (h : leftFinite l), transportLeft l = H ∧ evalProject (leftProject l h)}
  let rightProjectRegions : Set (Subgroup A) :=
    {H | ∃ (r : Right) (h : rightFinite r), transportRight r = H ∧ evalProject (rightProject r h)}
  let leftMultiplyRegions : Set (Subgroup A) :=
    {H | ∃ l : Left, transportLeft l = H ∧ evalMultiply (leftMultiply l)}
  let rightMultiplyRegions : Set (Subgroup A) :=
    {H | ∃ r : Right, transportRight r = H ∧ evalMultiply (rightMultiply r)}
  let firstProjectionUnitFibers : Left → Prop := fun ⟨_, r, s, _, x, _, _⟩ =>
    let q := basisMap a b r s x
    ∀ z ∈ Set.range q, ∃! w, q w = z
  IsLeast rightProjectRegions minimum ∧ IsLeast rightMultiplyRegions minimum ∧
  IsGreatest leftProjectRegions maximum ∧ IsGreatest leftMultiplyRegions maximum ∧
  (∀ H : Subgroup A, parabolic (Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) H) →
    lower ≤ H → H ≤ maximum → H ∈ leftProjectRegions ∧ H ∈ leftMultiplyRegions) ∧
  (∀ (l : Left) (h : leftFinite l), evalProject (leftProject l h) →
    transportLeft l = maximum → firstProjectionUnitFibers l)
```

## ParabolicCaseTwoProjectionFiberIndices: The two projection fiber indices for transported intermediate groups

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use the embeddings \(a,b,c,d,e,f\) of Cases~1--4 and fix an
admissible group-element crossing element \(p\in A\).
For Cases~1 and~3 the least transported right region is
\[
 P_p=\left\langle (ad)(C),\,p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\right\rangle.
\]
For Cases~2 and~4 the greatest transported left region is
\(B_{\max}=a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\). More precisely, every parabolic \(B\)
in the interval
\[
 (ade)(E)\le B\le a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}
\]
is a possible transported left region. With the largest choice
in Case~2 the first projection has one preimage on its image.

In the left diagram, transport the image \(a r(B)\) by \(a(z^{-1})\)
using the notation of Lemma~6.3. It
contains \((ade)(E)\) by the upper vertex, is contained in \(a(G)\),
and is contained in \(p b(D)p^{-1}\) by the lower vertex and
\(p=a(z^{-1})x b(y)\). Conversely, for any \(B\) in the interval,
take \(r=a^{-1}|_B\),
\(s=b^{-1}\circ\operatorname{Ad}_{p^{-1}}|_B\), \(t=ade\),
and use \(x=p,\ y=z=1\). Here \(st=cf\) is the admissibility
condition on \(p\). In Case~2, transporting the two stabilizer
indices to \(A\) gives
\[
 [a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}:B],\qquad
 [B\cap p(bc)(F)p^{-1}:(ade)(E)].
\]
Both indices are finite because the ambient groups are finite.
The first is \(1\) at the maximum. Reversing the arrows gives
the corresponding choice in Case~4.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, proof of Proposition 8.6, p. 38](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem ParabolicCaseTwoProjectionFiberIndices : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun k : Nat => k ∈ blocks i)))
∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  let image := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom α)
  let conjugate := fun (g : A) (H : Subgroup A) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) H
  ∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade (comp bc f),
  let element := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p
  let lower := image ade
  let other := conjugate element (image bc)
  let maximum := image a ⊓ conjugate element (image b)
  let minimum := image ad ⊔ other
  let rightRegion := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) minimum
  let basisMap := @MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis U _
  let finiteFibers := fun {X Y : Type} (q : X → Y) => ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
  let fiberSize := fun {X Y : Type} (q : X → Y) (n : Nat) =>
    ∀ z ∈ Set.range q, Nat.card {w : X // q w = z} = n
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let outside := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let inside := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let identity := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) w)
  let parallel := fun {H K J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L J)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp α β α' β' [((1 : Complex), x)]
  let project := fun {K H J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K J) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H J)
      (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α l) (comp β r))
      (h : finiteFibers (basisMap α β l r x)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β l r
      [((1 : Complex), (⟨x, h⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β l r))]
  let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {v : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {s : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {v' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {s' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor v s) (tensor v' s')) =>
    vertical (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate w v s))
      (vertical (horizontal (identity w) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate w v' s')))
  let target : finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p) →
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside := fun hp =>
    vertical
      (vertical (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
        (horizontal (identity (down a))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp b c))))
      (vertical (project a bc de f p hp)
        (horizontal
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp d e))
          (identity (down f))))
  let Left := Σ B : {B : Subgroup U // parabolic B},
    Σ r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B.val G,
    Σ s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B.val D,
    Σ t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B.val,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a r) (comp b s) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp s t) (comp c f) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de
  let Right := Σ j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding rightRegion A,
    Σ v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C rightRegion,
    Σ w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F rightRegion,
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp j w) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot ad (comp j v) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v e) (comp w f)
  let transport : Left → Subgroup A := fun ⟨_, r, _, _, _, _, z⟩ =>
    conjugate (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z)⁻¹)
      (image (comp a r))
  let leftFinite : Left → Prop := fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, _⟩ =>
    finiteFibers (basisMap a b r s x) ∧ finiteFibers (basisMap s c t f y)
  let rightFinite : Right → Prop := fun ⟨j, v, w, _, m, n⟩ =>
    finiteFibers (basisMap a j d v m) ∧ finiteFibers (basisMap v w e f n)
  let rightLabels : Right → Prop := fun ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩ =>
    (∀ k : rightRegion, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j k : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    comp j v = ad ∧
    (∀ h : F, MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp j w) h =
      MulAut.conj element (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom bc h)) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ell = element⁻¹ ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element m = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element n = 1
  let left : (l : Left) → leftFinite l → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
    fun ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, z⟩ h =>
      vertical
        (horizontal (project a b r s x h.1) (identity (up c)))
        (vertical (atRight (up r) (project s c t f y h.2))
          (horizontal (parallel r t d e z) (identity (down f))))
  let right : (r : Right) → rightFinite r → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
    fun ⟨j, v, w, ell, m, n⟩ h =>
      vertical (atRight (down a) (parallel b c j w ell))
        (vertical
          (horizontal (project a j d v m h.1) (identity (up w)))
          (atRight (up d) (project v w e f n h.2)))
  let firstFiberIsSingleton : Left → Prop := fun ⟨_, r, s, _, x, _, _⟩ =>
    let q := basisMap a b r s x
    ∀ z ∈ Set.range q, ∃! w, q w = z
  let indices : Left → Prop := fun l =>
    let H := transport l
    let firstIndex := Subgroup.relIndex H maximum
    let secondIndex := Subgroup.relIndex lower (H ⊓ other)
    lower ≤ H ∧ H ≤ maximum ∧ lower ≤ H ⊓ other ∧
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf H maximum) ∧
    Subgroup.FiniteIndex (Subgroup.subgroupOf lower (H ⊓ other)) ∧
    (match l with
    | ⟨_, r, s, t, x, y, _⟩ =>
      fiberSize (basisMap a b r s x) firstIndex ∧
      fiberSize (basisMap s c t f y) secondIndex) ∧
    (H = maximum → firstIndex = 1 ∧ firstFiberIsSingleton l)
  let maximalLeftLabels : Left → Prop := fun ⟨_, _, _, _, x, y, z⟩ =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x = element ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1
  parabolic rightRegion ∧
  ∃ (hp : finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p)) (r : Right) (hr : rightFinite r),
    rightLabels r ∧
    evaluate (right r hr) = evaluate (target hp) ∧
    let realizes := fun (l : Left) (hl : leftFinite l) =>
      evaluate (left l hl) = evaluate (right r hr)
    (∀ (l : Left) (hl : leftFinite l), realizes l hl → indices l) ∧
    (∀ H : Subgroup A, parabolic (Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) H) →
      lower ≤ H → H ≤ maximum →
      ∃ (l : Left) (hl : leftFinite l), transport l = H ∧ realizes l hl) ∧
    (∃ (l : Left) (hl : leftFinite l),
      transport l = maximum ∧ maximalLeftLabels l ∧ realizes l hl ∧
      Subgroup.relIndex (transport l) maximum = 1 ∧ firstFiberIsSingleton l)
```

## ParabolicOutsideProjectionDiagram: Finite-parabolic projection diagrams through extremal regions

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use the embeddings \(a,b,c,d,e,f\) of Cases~1--4 and fix an
admissible group-element crossing element \(p\in A\).
For Cases~1 and~3 the least transported right region is
\[
 P_p=\left\langle (ad)(C),\,p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\right\rangle.
\]
For Cases~2 and~4 the greatest transported left region is
\(B_{\max}=a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\). More precisely, every parabolic \(B\)
in the interval
\[
 (ade)(E)\le B\le a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}
\]
is a possible transported left region. With the largest choice
in Case~2 the first projection has one preimage on its image.

The projection diagrams below map \(\C[A]\) to the complex span of
\(G\times_E F\). Both send \(z\) to the sum of the preimages of \(z\)
under \(Q_p([g,h])=a(g)p(bc)(h)\). The mixed crossing labelled \(p\)
on the left uses trace dot \(p^{-1}\). On the right, the lower
crossing is between parallel strands and carries dot \(p^{-1}\).

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, projection diagram identity after Proposition 8.6, pp. 38–39. The published PDF is byte-identical to the project copy. The two typed drawings use the displayed regions Bmax and Pp and the same ordered exterior boundary. The first left projection has singleton fibers on its image. Both evaluations agree with finite-fiber transfer along Q_p, with the boundary merge and split identifying the balanced products. Finite parabolicity supplies finiteness, and each compact projection carries its own finite-fiber witness. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=39

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No statement correction for this identity could be verified. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the syntax. Every marked crossing uses a coefficient-one singleton complex label on an eligible group element, as required for this fixed group-element identity. The lower left compact projection stores p as its crossing parameter, with trace dot p⁻¹. The lower right parallel crossing carries p⁻¹ and the upper left parallel crossing keeps its identity mark. Lean elaborated the proposition and checked the ordered positions and kinds of all three marked crossings in each drawing through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem ParabolicOutsideProjectionDiagram : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun k : Nat => k ∈ blocks i)))
∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let image := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (g : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    MonoidHom.range (hom g)
  let conjugate := fun (g : A) (H : Subgroup A) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj g)) H
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let ade := comp a de
  ∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ade (comp bc f),
  let element := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p
  let other := conjugate element (image bc)
  let maximum := image a ⊓ conjugate element (image b)
  let minimum := image ad ⊔ other
  let Bmax := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) maximum
  let Pp := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) minimum
  let basisMap := @MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis U _
  let finiteFibers := fun {X Y : Type} (q : X → Y) => ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let id := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (word : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) word)
  let projection := fun {K H J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K J) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H J)
      (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α l) (comp β r))
      (finite : finiteFibers (basisMap α β l r x)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection α β l r
      [((1 : Complex), (⟨x, finite⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β l r))]
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let top := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {v : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {s : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {v' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {s' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor v s) (tensor v' s')) =>
    vertical (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate w v s))
      (vertical (horizontal (id w) crossing)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate w v' s')))
  parabolic Bmax ∧ parabolic Pp ∧
  ∃ (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Bmax G)
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Bmax D)
    (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E Bmax)
    (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Pp A)
    (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C Pp)
    (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F Pp)
    (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a r) (comp b s))
    (y : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp s t) (comp c f))
    (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp r t) de)
    (ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u w))
    (m : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ad (comp u v))
    (n : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v e) (comp w f))
    (hx : finiteFibers (basisMap a b r s x))
    (hy : finiteFibers (basisMap s c t f y))
    (hm : finiteFibers (basisMap a u d v m))
    (hn : finiteFibers (basisMap v w e f n))
    (hp : finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p)),
    let left : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical (horizontal (projection a b r s x hx) (id (up c)))
        (vertical (atRight (up r) (projection s c t f y hy))
          (horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp r t d e [((1 : Complex), z)])
            (id (down f))))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical
        (atRight (down a)
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c u w [((1 : Complex), ell)]))
        (vertical (horizontal (projection a u d v m hm) (id (up w)))
          (atRight (up d) (projection v w e f n hn)))
    let fiberTransfer : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical
        (vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
          (horizontal (id (down a))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp b c))))
        (vertical (projection a bc de f p hp)
          (horizontal
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp d e))
            (id (down f))))
    let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    (∀ k : Bmax, (hom (comp a r) k : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : Bmax, (MulAut.conj element (hom (comp b s) k) : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : E, (hom t k : U) = (hom ade k : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : Pp, (hom u k : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    comp u v = ad ∧
    (∀ k : F, hom (comp u w) k = MulAut.conj element (hom bc k)) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x = element ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ell = element⁻¹ ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element m = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element n = 1 ∧
    (let q := basisMap a b r s x
     ∀ k ∈ Set.range q, ∃! j, q j = k) ∧
    eval left = eval right ∧
    eval left = eval fiberTransfer
```

## ParabolicOutsideMultiplicationDiagram: Finite-parabolic multiplication diagrams through extremal regions

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Use the embeddings \(a,b,c,d,e,f\) of Cases~1--4 and fix an
admissible group-element crossing element \(p\in A\).
For Cases~1 and~3 the least transported right region is
\[
 P_p=\left\langle (ad)(C),\,p(bc)(F)p^{-1}\right\rangle.
\]
For Cases~2 and~4 the greatest transported left region is
\(B_{\max}=a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}\). More precisely, every parabolic \(B\)
in the interval
\[
 (ade)(E)\le B\le a(G)\cap p b(D)p^{-1}
\]
is a possible transported left region. With the largest choice
in Case~2 the first projection has one preimage on its image.

The multiplication diagrams below have the opposite source and
target. Each sends \([g,h]\) to \(a(g)p(bc)(h)\).

```lean
theorem ParabolicOutsideMultiplicationDiagram : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun k : Nat => k ∈ blocks i)))
∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  ∀ p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a de) (comp bc f),
  let element := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p
  let conjugate := fun (k : A) (H : Subgroup A) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj k)) H
  let Bmax := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A)
    (MonoidHom.range (hom a) ⊓ conjugate element (MonoidHom.range (hom b)))
  let Pp := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A)
    (MonoidHom.range (hom ad) ⊔ conjugate element (MonoidHom.range (hom bc)))
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
  let identity := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id w)
  let eval := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {v w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex v w) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let bottom := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let top := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let parallel := fun {H K J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (α' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding J K) (β' : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L J)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α β) (comp α' β')) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp α β α' β' [((1 : Complex), x)]
  let multiply := fun {K H J L : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K J) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H J)
      (l : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L K) (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L H)
      (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α l) (comp β r)) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication α β l r [((1 : Complex), x)]
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (w : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {v : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {s : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {v' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {s' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor v s) (tensor v' s')) =>
    vertical (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate w v s))
      (vertical (horizontal (identity w) crossing)
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate w v' s')))
  let splitBottom : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor (up de) (down f)) bottom :=
    horizontal
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.splitUp d e))
      (identity (down f))
  let mergeTop : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex top (tensor (down a) (up bc)) :=
    vertical (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down a) (up b) (up c)))
      (horizontal (identity (down a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.trivalent (MackeyDiagrams.TrivalentVertex.mergeUp b c)))
  let evaluatesAsQp := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    ∀ (g : G) (h : F),
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (eval (vertical splitBottom (vertical diagram mergeTop)))
        (Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction de)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.restriction f) g h) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair a bc
        (hom a g * element * hom bc h)) 1
  parabolic Bmax ∧ parabolic Pp ∧
  ∃ (r : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Bmax G)
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Bmax D)
    (t : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E Bmax)
    (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding Pp A)
    (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C Pp)
    (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F Pp)
    (z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot de (comp r t))
    (y : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp s t) (comp c f))
    (x : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a r) (comp b s))
    (n : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v e) (comp w f))
    (m : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ad (comp u v))
    (ℓ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u w) bc),
    (∀ k : Bmax, ((hom a (hom r k) : A) : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : Bmax, ((element * hom b (hom s k) * element⁻¹ : A) : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : E, (hom t k : U) = ((hom (comp a de) k : A) : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : Pp, ((hom u k : A) : U) = (k : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : C, (hom v k : U) = ((hom ad k : A) : U)) ∧
    (∀ k : F, (hom w k : U) = ((element * hom bc k * element⁻¹ : A) : U)) ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element z = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element y = 1 ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element x = element ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element n = 1 ∧ MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element m = 1 ∧
    MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ℓ = element ∧
    let left : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical (horizontal (parallel d e r t z) (identity (down f)))
        (vertical (atRight (up r) (multiply s c t f y))
          (horizontal (multiply a b r s x)
            (identity (up c))))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical (atRight (up d) (multiply v w e f n))
        (vertical (horizontal (multiply a u d v m)
          (identity (up w)))
          (atRight (down a) (parallel u w b c ℓ)))
    eval left = eval right ∧ evaluatesAsQp left
```

## SmallerParabolicReducesProjectionFiber: A smaller internal group reduces a projection fiber

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

In Case~1 take \(A=S_4\), \(G=\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,4\})\),
\(C=\langle(12)\rangle\), \(D=F=\langle(23)\rangle\), \(E=1\)
and \(p=1\), with inclusions. The least right region is
\(\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,3\})\). Its intersection with \(G\) is
\(C\), so the middle projection has fiber size \(1\) on its image.
With the right region \(A\), that fiber size is \(3\).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.4 [ex:case-one-parabolic-index], p. 39](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.4 [ex:case-one-parabolic-index], p. 39. The published PDF matches the project PDF byte for byte, and the article webpage gives the same statement. The ambient permutations act on the points labelled 1 through 4. Fixing point 3 gives the boundary group G, and fixing point 4 gives the stated least region. The least-region condition uses the two subgroup containment bounds for Case 1 in Proposition 8.6. The fiber counts use the balanced basis map for the middle mixed projection with inclusion labels and identity dot. Both counts are taken on the image. The Lean type elaborated through the shared compilation slot. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No statement correction or owner amendment for Example 8.4 was available. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
theorem SmallerParabolicReducesProjectionFiber : let Point := ↥({1, 2, 3, 4} : Finset Nat)
let point1 : Point := ⟨1, by decide⟩
let point2 : Point := ⟨2, by decide⟩
let point3 : Point := ⟨3, by decide⟩
let point4 : Point := ⟨4, by decide⟩
let U := Equiv.Perm Point
let A : Subgroup U := ⊤
let G : Subgroup U := MulAction.stabilizer U point3
let C : Subgroup U := Subgroup.closure {Equiv.swap point1 point2}
let D : Subgroup U := Subgroup.closure {Equiv.swap point2 point3}
let F := D
let E : Subgroup U := ⊥
let P : Subgroup U := MulAction.stabilizer U point4
let incl := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
  ({ toHom := Subgroup.inclusion h
     hasRepresentative := ⟨1, fun x => by simp⟩ } : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
let a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A := incl le_top
let b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A := incl le_top
let c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D := incl le_rfl
let d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G := incl ((Subgroup.closure_le G).mpr
  (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (by decide) (by decide))))
let e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C := incl bot_le
let f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F := incl bot_le
let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let ad := comp a d
let bc := comp b c
let p : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp ad e) (comp bc f) :=
  { element := 1
    intertwines := fun x => by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (x : U) * 1 = 1 * (x : U)
      rw [mul_one, one_mul] }
let middleFiberSize := fun (B : Subgroup U) (hC : C ≤ B) (n : Nat) =>
  let j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B A := incl le_top
  let v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B := incl hC
  let m : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ad (comp j v) :=
    { element := 1
      intertwines := fun x => by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (x : U) * 1 = 1 * (x : U)
        rw [mul_one, one_mul] }
  let q := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis a j d v m
  ∀ z ∈ Set.range q, Nat.card {x // q x = z} = n
let hCP : C ≤ P := (Subgroup.closure_le P).mpr
  (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr (Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (by decide) (by decide)))
let conjugatedF := Subgroup.map
  (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p : U))) F
IsLeast {B : Subgroup U | C ≤ B ∧ conjugatedF ≤ B} P ∧
  G ⊓ P = C ∧ middleFiberSize P hCP 1 ∧ middleFiberSize A le_top 3
```

## ParabolicCommonRightRegionForLinearLabels: Least parabolic right region for a specified linear-label placement

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

The bounds are for one crossing element. For several crossing elements \(p\) with the
same two dots \(\ell=p_0^{-1}\) and \(m=1\) on the right, a single
diagram can put all coefficients at the third dot. The least
region for this placement is the smallest parabolic subgroup of
\(A\) containing
\[
 (ad)(C),\qquad p_0(bc)(F)p_0^{-1},\qquad pp_0^{-1}
 \quad\text{for every crossing element \(p\)}.
\]
Indeed, the third dot must contain \(pp_0^{-1}\) since
\(p=u(n)p_0\). Conversely, take the inclusion \(u\),
\(v=ad\), \(w=\operatorname{Ad}_{p_0}\circ bc\), and put the
coefficients on those elements \(n=pp_0^{-1}\).
Apply Lemma~7.2 to the subgroup
generated by the displayed elements and subgroups.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, after Example 8.4, p. 39](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem ParabolicCommonRightRegionForLinearLabels : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (k : Nat) (blocks : Fin k → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun x : Nat => x ∈ blocks i)))
∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F →
  parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G A) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D A)
    (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E C) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E F),
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let hom := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom U _
  let bc := comp b c
  let ad := comp a d
  let de := comp d e
  let cf := comp c f
  let idE := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id E
  let image := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) =>
    MonoidHom.range (hom i)
  ∀ (p₀ : A) (coeff : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a de) (comp bc f)),
  let Support := ↥(Finsupp.support coeff)
  let element := fun (p : Support) => MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element p.val
  let terms := fun {X : Type} (label : Support → X) =>
    List.map (fun p => (coeff p.val, label p))
      (Finset.toList (Finset.attach (Finsupp.support coeff)))
  let containing : Set (Subgroup A) := {H |
    parabolic (Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype A) H) ∧
    image ad ≤ H ∧
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj p₀)) (image bc) ≤ H ∧
    ∀ p : Support, element p * p₀⁻¹ ∈ H}
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let outside := tensor (tensor (down a) (up b)) (up c)
  let inside := tensor (tensor (up d) (up e)) (down f)
  let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let identity := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (x : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) x)
  let atRight := fun {K H J L J' : Subgroup U} (x : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H)
      {y : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J} {z : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {y' : MackeyDiagrams.Word H J'} {z' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (q : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor y z) (tensor y' z')) =>
    vertical (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate x y z))
      (vertical (horizontal (identity x) q)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate x y' z')))
  let eval := fun {K H : Subgroup U} {x y : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H}
      (q : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex x y) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret q)
  let basisMap := @MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis U _
  let finiteFibers := fun {X Y : Type} (q : X → Y) => ∀ z, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
  let x : Support → MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a de) (comp b cf) := fun p => p.val
  let y : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp cf idE) (comp c f) := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id cf
  let z : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp de idE) de := MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id de
  (∀ p : Support, finiteFibers (basisMap a bc de f p.val)) ∧
  ∃ (firstFinite : ∀ p : Support, finiteFibers (basisMap a b de cf (x p)))
    (secondFinite : finiteFibers (basisMap cf c idE f y)),
  let leftProject : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
    vertical
      (horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a b de cf
          (terms (fun p => ⟨x p, firstFinite p⟩)))
        (identity (up c)))
      (vertical
        (atRight (up de) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection cf c idE f
          [((1 : Complex), ⟨y, secondFinite⟩)]))
        (horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp de idE d e [((1 : Complex), z)])
          (identity (down f))))
  let leftMultiply : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex inside outside :=
    vertical
      (horizontal
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp d e de idE
          [((1 : Complex), MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse z)])
        (identity (down f)))
      (vertical
        (atRight (up de) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication cf c idE f
          [((1 : Complex), y)]))
        (horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a b de cf (terms x))
          (identity (up c))))
  let placed : Set (Subgroup A) := {H |
    ∃ (B : Subgroup U) (_ : parabolic B)
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B A)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F B)
      (ell : MackeyDiagrams.Dot bc (comp u w))
      (m : MackeyDiagrams.Dot ad (comp u v))
      (n : Support → MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v e) (comp w f)),
      image u = H ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element ell = p₀⁻¹ ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element m = 1 ∧
      (∀ p, element p = hom u (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (n p)) * p₀) ∧
      ∃ (middleFinite : finiteFibers (basisMap a u d v m))
        (thirdFinite : ∀ p, finiteFibers (basisMap v w e f (n p))),
      let rightProject : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex outside inside :=
        vertical
          (atRight (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp b c u w
            [((1 : Complex), ell)]))
          (vertical
            (horizontal
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection a u d v
                [((1 : Complex), ⟨m, middleFinite⟩)])
              (identity (up w)))
            (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection v w e f
              (terms (fun p => ⟨n p, thirdFinite p⟩)))))
      let rightMultiply : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex inside outside :=
        vertical
          (atRight (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication v w e f (terms n)))
          (vertical
            (horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication a u d v
              [((1 : Complex), m)]) (identity (up w)))
            (atRight (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp u w b c
              [((1 : Complex), MackeyDiagrams.Dot.inverse ell)])))
      eval rightProject = eval leftProject ∧ eval rightMultiply = eval leftMultiply}
  ∃ H : Subgroup A, IsLeast containing H ∧ IsLeast placed H
```

## SupportedLeftOrbitProjectedStabilizer: Projected pair stabilizer of an orbit supported by a left diagram

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Write \(a:A\to G\), \(b:A\to D\), and \(d:F\to D\) for the lower
embeddings and \(c:C\to G\), \(e:C\to E\), and \(f:F\to E\) for the upper ones.
The source basis is \(G\times_A D\) and the target basis is \(G\times_C E\).

In the notation of Lemma~6.6, the
left equation compares the two maps
\[
 [g,x]_A\longmapsto u(g)r v(x)t,\qquad
 [h,y]_C\longmapsto u(h)s w(y).
\]
Both are equivariant for the action of \(G\times F\) on \(B\)
given by \((q,k)\cdot z=u(q)z\,w(f(k))^{-1}\). This follows from
the three vertex equations, including
\(vd=\operatorname{Ad}_t\circ wf\).
A supported pair has the same image \(z\) under the two maps.
If \(k\in F\) lies in both individual stabilizer projections,
the corresponding \(G\)-components \(q_1,q_2\) satisfy
\[
 u(q_1)=z\,w(f(k))\,z^{-1}=u(q_2).
\]
Since \(u\) is injective, \(q_1=q_2\). Hence the projected pair
stabilizer is exactly the intersection of the two individual
projections. For a representative \(([1,x]_A,[h,y]_C)\), those
projections are \(d^{-1}(x^{-1}b(A)x)\) and
\(f^{-1}(y^{-1}e(C)y)\), with inverse images taken in \(F\).
They are finite parabolics by conjugation and intersection
closure. The orbit term in Theorem~6.7 can
therefore use the full stabilizer and counts each pair once.
Every left basis coefficient is \(1\) on a supported pair by
(6.3).

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, proof of Proposition 8.7, pp. 39–40](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
theorem SupportedLeftOrbitProjectedStabilizer : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ {G A D F C E B : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F →
  parabolic C → parabolic E → parabolic B →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
    (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
    (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  ∀ (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
    (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)),
  let upperProduct := MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s
  ∃ (leftFinite : ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | upperProduct p = z}),
    let ga := up a
    let ad := down b
    let df := up d
    let gc := up c
    let ce := down e
    let ef := up f
    let du := down u
    let uv := up v
    let uw := up w
    let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
    let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
    let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
    let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
    let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)
    let output := fun (h : G) (y : E) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) h (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f y)
    let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
    let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
    let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
    let first : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor (tensor ga ad) df) (tensor (tensor du uv) df) :=
      juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b [(1, r)])
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id df))
    let middle : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor uv df) (tensor uw ef) :=
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w f [(1, t)]
    let last : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor (tensor du uw) ef) (tensor (tensor gc ce) ef) :=
      juxtapose (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w c e [(1, ⟨s, leftFinite⟩)])
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ef))
    let leftDiagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ad df))
        (stack first
          (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate du uv df))
            (stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id du)) middle)
              (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate du uw ef))
                (stack last (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ce ef)))))))
    letI : MulAction (G × F) X.carrier :=
      { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X
        one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X
        mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X }
    letI : MulAction (G × F) Y.carrier :=
      { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y
        one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y
        mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y }
    let Pair := X.carrier × Y.carrier
    let orbit : Pair → Set Pair := MulAction.orbit (G × F)
    let stabilizer : Pair → Subgroup (G × F) := MulAction.stabilizer (G × F)
    let project := Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.snd G F)
    let inAmbient := Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype F)
    let projectedSource := fun (p : X.carrier) => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) p)
    let projectedTarget := fun (p : Y.carrier) => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) p)
    let projectedPair := fun (p : Pair) => project (stabilizer p)
    let coefficient := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) (z : Pair) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret diagram))
        (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)) z.2
    let actB := fun (q : G × F) (z : B) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom u q.1 * z *
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom w (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f q.2))⁻¹
    ∃ (sourceMap : X.carrier → B) (targetMap : Y.carrier → B),
      (∀ (g : G) (x : D), sourceMap (input g x) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom u g * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom v x * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t) ∧
      (∀ (h : G) (y : E), targetMap (output h y) =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom u h * MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s *
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom w y) ∧
      (∀ (q : G × F) (p : X.carrier),
        sourceMap (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q p) = actB q (sourceMap p)) ∧
      (∀ (q : G × F) (p : Y.carrier),
        targetMap (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q p) = actB q (targetMap p)) ∧
      (∀ z : Pair, coefficient leftDiagram z ≠ 0 ↔ sourceMap z.1 = targetMap z.2) ∧
      (∀ z : Pair, coefficient leftDiagram z ≠ 0 →
        projectedPair z = projectedSource z.1 ⊓ projectedTarget z.2 ∧
        parabolic (inAmbient (projectedSource z.1)) ∧
        parabolic (inAmbient (projectedTarget z.2)) ∧
        parabolic (inAmbient (projectedPair z)) ∧
        coefficient leftDiagram z = 1) ∧
      (∀ (x : D) (h : G) (y : E),
        let z₀ : Pair := (input 1 x, output h y)
        coefficient leftDiagram z₀ ≠ 0 →
        projectedSource z₀.1 =
          Subgroup.comap (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d)
            (Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj x⁻¹))
              (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b))) ∧
        projectedTarget z₀.2 =
          Subgroup.comap (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f)
            (Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj y⁻¹))
              (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom e))) ∧
        let P := inAmbient (projectedPair z₀)
        ∃ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P F)
          (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding P C)
          (r' : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j))
          (t' : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k))
          (s' : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)),
          (∀ p : P, (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j p : U) = (p : U)) ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r' = x ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t' = h ∧
          MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s' = y ∧
          ∃ (rightFinite : ∀ z, Set.Finite
            {p | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r' p = z}),
            let ai := up i
            let fj := down j
            let ck := up k
            let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j [(1, ⟨r', rightFinite⟩)]
            let center := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k [(1, t')]
            let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j [(1, s')]
            let rightDiagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
              stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ga)) lower)
                (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
                  (stack (juxtapose center (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id fj)))
                    (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
                      (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id gc)) upper))))
            ∀ z : Pair, coefficient rightDiagram z =
              @ite Complex (z ∈ orbit z₀) (Classical.propDecidable (z ∈ orbit z₀)) 1 0)
```

## ParabolicRightOrbitMultiplicity: Right orbit diagram and its index multiplicity

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

Let \(G\times F\) act on each basis by left multiplication by \(G\)
and right multiplication by the inverse of \(F\), using the boundary
embeddings. The action on input--output pairs acts on both coordinates.
A bimodule map has constant matrix coefficient on each orbit.

Choose a representative \(([1,r]_A,[t,s]_C)\) of an orbit.
Let \(P\le F\) be the image of its stabilizer in \(F\).
In detail, \(h\in P\) exactly when there exist \(i(h)\in A,\ k(h)\in C\)
satisfying
\[
 \begin{gathered}
 r d(h)r^{-1}=b(i(h)),\qquad
 s f(h)s^{-1}=e(k(h)),\\
 a(i(h))=t c(k(h))t^{-1}.
 \end{gathered}
\]
These equations describe the stabilizer as the graph
\(\{(a(i(h)),h):h\in P\}\). They also make \(i,k\) conjugation
embeddings. Take \(B'=P,\ j\) the inclusion, and labels \((r,t,s)\).
The displayed equations are the three vertex conditions.

A left diagram in Case~5 with group-element dots is a sum of
right diagrams, one for each supported orbit of input--output
pairs, each with coefficient \(1\). Write \(\mathcal S\) for this
set of orbits, \(P_{\mathcal O}\) for each projected stabilizer, and
\(T_{\mathcal O}\) for the matrix with coefficient \(1\) on \(\mathcal O\) and
\(0\) elsewhere.
For any orbit of input--output pairs, let \(P\le F\) be the
projection of its stabilizer. Among single right diagrams with
group-element dots realizing this orbit, the least multiplicity
is \([P:L]\), where \(L\) is generated by all transpositions in \(P\).
It equals \(1\) exactly when \(P\) is parabolic.

For an arbitrary right orbit, the vertex conditions require
\(j(B')\le P\). Conversely every parabolic subgroup of \(P\)
works by restricting the three embeddings. Replacing
\(A\times_P F\) by \(A\times_{j(B')}F\) gives
\([P:j(B')]\) classes over each original class, because the
balancing action is free. Thus each pair is counted exactly
that many times. The largest parabolic subgroup of \(P\) from
Lemma~7.2 minimizes the index. Stabilizers of other representatives
project to conjugate subgroups of \(F\), so the minimum is
independent of the representative.

```lean
theorem ParabolicRightOrbitMultiplicity : let Sinf : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥Sinf
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun X => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun H => ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ l, Finset.Nonempty (blocks l)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype Sinf) H = iSup (fun l => blockSym (blocks l))
∀ (G A D F C E : Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let ga := up a
  let ad := down b
  let df := up d
  let gc := up c
  let ce := down e
  let ef := up f
  let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
  let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
  let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
  let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
  let Pair := X.carrier × Y.carrier
  let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ga)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)
  let output := fun (g : G) (y : E) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis gc)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f y)
  let pair := fun (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) => (input 1 r, output t s)
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
      mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
  let orbit : Pair → Set Pair := MulAction.orbit (G × F)
  let stabilizer : Pair → Subgroup (G × F) := MulAction.stabilizer (G × F)
  let projected := fun z : Pair =>
    Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.subtype F) (MonoidHom.snd G F)) (stabilizer z)
  let swaps := fun P : Subgroup U =>
    Subgroup.closure {σ : U | σ ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)}
  let coefficient := fun (M : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (z : Pair) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)) z.2
  let matrix := fun (O : Set Pair) (n : Nat) (z : Pair) =>
    @ite Complex (z ∈ O) (Classical.propDecidable (z ∈ O)) (n : Complex) 0
  let RightData := fun B' : Subgroup U =>
    Σ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
  let labels : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → D × G × E :=
    fun ⟨_, _, _, r, t, s⟩ =>
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s)
  let representative := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    let (r, t, s) := labels data
    pair r t s
  let toA : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → (B' →* A) :=
    fun ⟨i, _, _, _, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom i
  let toF : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → (B' →* F) :=
    fun ⟨_, j, _, _, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j
  let toC : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → (B' →* C) :=
    fun ⟨_, _, k, _, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom k
  let restricts := fun {P K : Subgroup U}
      (term : RightData K) (full : RightData P) (hK : K ≤ P) =>
    labels term = labels full ∧
    toA term = MonoidHom.comp (toA full) (Subgroup.inclusion hK) ∧
    toF term = MonoidHom.comp (toF full) (Subgroup.inclusion hK) ∧
    toC term = MonoidHom.comp (toC full) (Subgroup.inclusion hK)
  let image := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.subtype F) (toF data))
  let isInclusion := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    ∀ h : B', (toF data h : U) = (h : U)
  let Fiber : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → Type :=
    fun ⟨i, j, _, _, _, _⟩ => (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (up i) (down j))).carrier
  let lowerMap : {B' : Subgroup U} → (data : RightData B') → Fiber data →
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)).carrier :=
    fun ⟨i, j, _, r, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r
  let finiteFibers := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w : Fiber data | lowerMap data w = z}
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let rightDiagram : {B' : Subgroup U} → (data : RightData B') → finiteFibers data →
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨i, j, k, r, t, s⟩ finite =>
      let ai := up i
      let fj := down j
      let ck := up k
      let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) b d i j [(1, ⟨r, finite⟩)]
      let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := Complex) a i c k [(1, t)]
      let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) e f k j [(1, s)]
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga) lower)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal middle (drawId fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc) upper))))
  let rightCount := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') (g : G) (x : D) (y : Y.carrier) =>
    let (_, t, s) := labels data
    Nat.card {w : Fiber data //
      lowerMap data w = MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x ∧
      (let v : A × F := Quotient.out w
       output (g * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a v.1 * t)
         (s * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f v.2)) = y}
  let realizes := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') (O : Set Pair) (n : Nat) =>
    orbit (representative data) = O ∧
      ∃ finite : finiteFibers data, ∀ z : Pair,
        coefficient (eval (rightDiagram data finite)) z = matrix O n z
  let LeftUpperFiber := fun {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s p = z}
  let leftDiagram := fun {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) (finite : LeftUpperFiber u w s) =>
    let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) u v a b [(1, r)]
    let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := Complex) v d w f [(1, t)]
    let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) u w c e [(1, ⟨s, finite⟩)]
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ad df))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal lower (drawId df))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down u) (up v) df))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down u)) middle)
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down u) (up w) ef))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal upper (drawId ef))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ce ef)))))))
  (∀ (M : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (z z' : Pair),
    z' ∈ orbit z → coefficient M z' = coefficient M z) ∧
  (∀ z : Pair, ∃ (r : D) (t : G) (s : E), z ∈ orbit (pair r t s)) ∧
  (∀ (r : D) (t : G) (s : E),
    let z := pair r t s
    let P := projected z
    let L := swaps P
    (∀ h : F, (h : U) ∈ P ↔ ∃ (α : A) (κ : C),
      r * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom d h * r⁻¹ = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b α ∧
      s * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom f h * s⁻¹ = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom e κ ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a α = t * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom c κ * t⁻¹) ∧
    (∃ full : RightData P,
      labels full = (r, t, s) ∧ isInclusion full ∧
      (∀ q : G × F, q ∈ stabilizer z ↔ ∃ h : P,
        q = (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a (toA full h), toF full h)) ∧
      (∀ (K : Subgroup U) (hK : K ≤ P), parabolic K →
        ∃ term : RightData K,
          restricts term full hK ∧ realizes term (orbit z) (Subgroup.relIndex K P)) ∧
      (∃ (hL : L ≤ P) (term : RightData L),
        parabolic L ∧ restricts term full hL ∧ isInclusion term ∧
        realizes term (orbit z) (Subgroup.relIndex L P)))) ∧
  (∀ (B' : Subgroup U), parabolic B' → ∀ data : RightData B',
    let z := representative data
    let P := projected z
    let K := image data
    let n := Subgroup.relIndex K P
    K ≤ P ∧ realizes data (orbit z) n ∧
      ∀ (g : G) (x : D) (y : Y.carrier),
        rightCount data g x y =
          @ite Nat ((input g x, y) ∈ orbit z)
            (Classical.propDecidable ((input g x, y) ∈ orbit z)) n 0) ∧
  (∀ z : Pair,
    let P := projected z
    let n := Subgroup.relIndex (swaps P) P
    IsLeast {m : Nat | ∃ (B' : Subgroup U) (term : RightData B'),
      parabolic B' ∧ realizes term (orbit z) m} n ∧
    (n = 1 ↔ parabolic P) ∧
    (∀ z' : Pair, z' ∈ orbit z → Subgroup.relIndex (swaps (projected z')) (projected z') = n)) ∧
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U), parabolic B →
    ∀ (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) (finite : LeftUpperFiber u w s),
    let M := eval (leftDiagram u v w r t s finite)
    let S : Set (Set Pair) := {O | ∃ z : Pair, O = orbit z ∧ coefficient M z ≠ 0}
    ∃ expansion : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top ↥S,
      (∀ O : ↥S, O ∈ MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.indices expansion) ∧
      (∀ O : ↥S,
        ∃ (r₀ : D) (t₀ : G) (s₀ : E),
          let z := pair r₀ t₀ s₀
          let P := projected z
          O.val = orbit z ∧ parabolic P ∧
          ∃ (data : RightData P) (fiberProof : finiteFibers data),
            labels data = (r₀, t₀, s₀) ∧ isInclusion data ∧
            MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.summand expansion O = rightDiagram data fiberProof ∧
            ∀ z' : Pair,
              coefficient (eval (MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.summand expansion O)) z' =
                matrix O.val 1 z') ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M = MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval expansion)
```

## ParabolicCaseFiveCoefficientOneExpansion: Coefficient-one expansion in Case 5

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.
