```lean
theorem ParabolicCaseFiveCoefficientOneExpansion : let Sinf : Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  Subgroup.closure {σ | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥Sinf
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=
  fun X => MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ X))
let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun H => ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ l, Finset.Nonempty (blocks l)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype Sinf) H = iSup (fun l => blockSym (blocks l))
∀ (G A D F C E : Subgroup U),
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let ga := up a
  let ad := down b
  let df := up d
  let gc := up c
  let ce := down e
  let ef := up f
  let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
  let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
  let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
  let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
  let Pair := X.carrier × Y.carrier
  let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ga)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)
  let output := fun (g : G) (y : E) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis gc)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f y)
  let pair := fun (r : D) (t : G) (s : E) => (input 1 r, output t s)
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
      mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
  let orbit : Pair → Set Pair := MulAction.orbit (G × F)
  let stabilizer : Pair → Subgroup (G × F) := MulAction.stabilizer (G × F)
  let projected := fun z : Pair =>
    Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.subtype F) (MonoidHom.snd G F)) (stabilizer z)
  let swaps := fun P : Subgroup U =>
    Subgroup.closure {σ : U | σ ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)}
  let coefficient := fun (M : MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (z : Pair) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)) z.2
  let matrix := fun (O : Set Pair) (n : Nat) (z : Pair) =>
    @ite Complex (z ∈ O) (Classical.propDecidable (z ∈ O)) (n : Complex) 0
  let RightData := fun B' : Subgroup U =>
    Σ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
  let labels : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → D × G × E :=
    fun ⟨_, _, _, r, t, s⟩ =>
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s)
  let representative := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    let (r, t, s) := labels data
    pair r t s
  let toF : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → (B' →* F) :=
    fun ⟨_, j, _, _, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j
  let isInclusion := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    ∀ h : B', (toF data h : U) = (h : U)
  let Fiber : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → Type :=
    fun ⟨i, j, _, _, _, _⟩ => (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (up i) (down j))).carrier
  let lowerMap : {B' : Subgroup U} → (data : RightData B') → Fiber data →
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)).carrier :=
    fun ⟨i, j, _, r, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r
  let finiteFibers := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w : Fiber data | lowerMap data w = z}
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) p)
  let eval := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  let rightDiagram : {B' : Subgroup U} → (data : RightData B') → finiteFibers data →
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨i, j, k, r, t, s⟩ finite =>
      let ai := up i
      let fj := down j
      let ck := up k
      let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) b d i j [(1, ⟨r, finite⟩)]
      let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := Complex) a i c k [(1, t)]
      let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) e f k j [(1, s)]
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId ga) lower)
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal middle (drawId fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId gc) upper))))
  let realizes := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') (O : Set Pair) (n : Nat) =>
    orbit (representative data) = O ∧
      ∃ finite : finiteFibers data, ∀ z : Pair,
        coefficient (eval (rightDiagram data finite)) z = matrix O n z
  let LeftUpperFiber := fun {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s p = z}
  let leftDiagram := fun {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) (finite : LeftUpperFiber u w s) =>
    let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := Complex) u v a b [(1, r)]
    let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := Complex) v d w f [(1, t)]
    let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := Complex) u w c e [(1, ⟨s, finite⟩)]
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ad df))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal lower (drawId df))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down u) (up v) df))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId (down u)) middle)
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down u) (up w) ef))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal upper (drawId ef))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ce ef)))))))
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U), parabolic B →
    ∀ (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) (finite : LeftUpperFiber u w s),
    let M := eval (leftDiagram u v w r t s finite)
    let S : Set (Set Pair) := {O | ∃ z : Pair, O = orbit z ∧ coefficient M z ≠ 0}
    ∃ expansion : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top ↥S,
      (∀ O : ↥S, O ∈ MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.indices expansion) ∧
      (∀ O : ↥S,
        ∃ (r₀ : D) (t₀ : G) (s₀ : E),
          let z := pair r₀ t₀ s₀
          let P := projected z
          O.val = orbit z ∧ parabolic P ∧
          ∃ (data : RightData P) (fiberProof : finiteFibers data),
            labels data = (r₀, t₀, s₀) ∧ isInclusion data ∧
            MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.summand expansion O = rightDiagram data fiberProof ∧
            ∀ z' : Pair,
              coefficient (eval (MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.summand expansion O)) z' =
                matrix O.val 1 z') ∧
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M = MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval expansion) ∧
  (∀ z : Pair,
    let P := projected z
    let n := Subgroup.relIndex (swaps P) P
    IsLeast {m : Nat | ∃ (B' : Subgroup U) (term : RightData B'),
      parabolic B' ∧ realizes term (orbit z) m} n ∧
    (n = 1 ↔ parabolic P))
```

## ParabolicRightDiagramSpanOverCommutativeRings: Right-diagram span over a commutative ring and its integral quotient

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

A left diagram in Case~5 with group-element dots is a sum of
right diagrams, one for each supported orbit of input--output
pairs, each with coefficient \(1\). Write \(\mathcal S\) for this
set of orbits, \(P_{\mathcal O}\) for each projected stabilizer, and
\(T_{\mathcal O}\) for the matrix with coefficient \(1\) on \(\mathcal O\) and
\(0\) elsewhere.
For any orbit of input--output pairs, let \(P\le F\) be the
projection of its stabilizer. Among single right diagrams with
group-element dots realizing this orbit, the least multiplicity
is \([P:L]\), where \(L\) is generated by all transpositions in \(P\).
It equals \(1\) exactly when \(P\) is parabolic.

For these two three-crossing shapes, the same basis formulas work
over any commutative ring \(R\) with identity. For each orbit
\(\mathcal O\) of input--output pairs, let \(L_{\mathcal O}\) be the
largest parabolic subgroup of \(P_{\mathcal O}\). The \(R\)-span of
right diagrams in the space of bimodule maps is
\[
 \bigoplus_{\mathcal O}
    \bigl([P_{\mathcal O}:L_{\mathcal O}]\,R\bigr)T_{\mathcal O}.
\]
Indeed, each multiplicity \([P_{\mathcal O}:j(B')]\) is divisible
by \([P_{\mathcal O}:L_{\mathcal O}]\), and taking
\(j(B')=L_{\mathcal O}\) realizes that index. The sum runs over all
orbits, including those on which no left diagram is nonzero. Over
\(\mathbb Z\), the quotient by this span is therefore the direct
sum of the groups \(\mathbb Z/[P_{\mathcal O}:L_{\mathcal O}]\mathbb Z\).
The coefficient-one expansion of a left diagram also holds over
\(R\), since the coefficient count uses only the basis sets.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, Other coefficient rings, p. 40](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

```lean
    Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.subtype F) (MonoidHom.snd G F)) (stabilizer z)
  let swaps := fun P : Subgroup U =>
    Subgroup.closure {σ : U | σ ∈ P ∧ Equiv.Perm.IsSwap (σ : Equiv.Perm Nat)}
  let RightData := fun B' : Subgroup U =>
    Σ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
  let labels : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → D × G × E :=
    fun ⟨_, _, _, r, t, s⟩ =>
      (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s)
  let representative := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    let (r, t, s) := labels data
    pair r t s
  let Fiber : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → Type :=
    fun ⟨i, j, _, _, _, _⟩ => (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (up i) (down j))).carrier
  let lowerMap : {B' : Subgroup U} → (data : RightData B') → Fiber data →
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)).carrier :=
    fun ⟨i, j, _, r, _, _⟩ => MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j r
  let finiteFibers := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {w : Fiber data | lowerMap data w = z}
  let RightTerm := {term : Σ B' : Subgroup U, RightData B' //
    parabolic term.1 ∧ finiteFibers term.2}
  let rightRepresentative := fun term : RightTerm => representative term.val.2
  let rightOrbit := fun term : RightTerm => orbit (rightRepresentative term)
  let image : {B' : Subgroup U} → RightData B' → Subgroup U :=
    fun ⟨_, j, _, _, _, _⟩ =>
      MonoidHom.range (MonoidHom.comp (Subgroup.subtype F)
        (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom j))
  let rightImage := fun term : RightTerm => image term.val.2
  let isInclusion := fun {B'} (data : RightData B') =>
    ∀ h : B', ((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom data.2.1) h : U) = (h : U)
  let drawId := fun (R : Type*) [CommRing R] {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := R) p)
  let rightDrawing := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] {B' : Subgroup U}
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C)
      (r : List (R × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
      (t : List (R × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)))
      (s : List (R × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j))) =>
    let ai := up i
    let fj := down j
    let ck := up k
    let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j r
    let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k t
    let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j s
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId R ga) lower)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal middle (drawId R fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId R gc) upper))))
  let rightDiagramOf (R : Type _) [CommRing R] : {B' : Subgroup U} →
      (data : RightData B') → finiteFibers data → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing R bottom top :=
    fun ⟨i, j, k, r, t, s⟩ finite =>
      rightDrawing R i j k [(1, ⟨r, finite⟩)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)]
  let rightDiagram := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (term : RightTerm) =>
    rightDiagramOf R term.val.2 term.property.2
  let RightLabels := fun (R : Type _) =>
    Σ (B' : Subgroup U)
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A)
      (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C),
      List (R × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) ×
      List (R × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)) ×
      List (R × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j))
  let fullRightDiagram (R : Type _) [CommRing R] :
      {data : RightLabels R // parabolic data.1} → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing R bottom top :=
    fun ⟨⟨_, i, j, k, r, t, s⟩, _⟩ => rightDrawing R i j k r t s
  let LeftUpperFiber := fun {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {p | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis u w c e s p = z}
  let leftDiagram := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) (finite : LeftUpperFiber u w s) =>
    let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication (R := R) u v a b [(1, r)]
    let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp (R := R) v d w f [(1, t)]
    let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection (R := R) u w c e [(1, ⟨s, finite⟩)]
    MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ad df))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal lower (drawId R df))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate (down u) (up v) df))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal (drawId R (down u)) middle)
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate (down u) (up w) ef))
              (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal upper (drawId R ef))
                (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ce ef)))))))
  let Orbits := ↥(Set.range orbit)
  let rep : Orbits → Pair := fun O => Classical.choose O.property
  let P : Orbits → Subgroup U := fun O => projected (rep O)
  let L : Orbits → Subgroup U := fun O => swaps (P O)
  let index : Orbits → Nat := fun O => Subgroup.relIndex (L O) (P O)
  let coefficient := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R]
      (M : (Finsupp X.carrier R) →ₗ[R] (Finsupp Y.carrier R)) (z : Pair) =>
    M (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : R)) z.2
  let entry := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] (O : Set Pair) (r : R) (z : Pair) =>
    @ite R (z ∈ O) (Classical.propDecidable (z ∈ O)) r 0
  let evaluate := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R]
      (T : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing R bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret T))
  let bimoduleMaps := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] =>
    ({ carrier := {m | ∀ (g : G × F) (x : Finsupp X.carrier R),
          m (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear R X g x) =
            MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear R Y g (m x)}
       zero_mem' := by simp
       add_mem' := by
         intro m n hm hn g x
         change (m + n) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear R X g x) =
           MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear R Y g ((m + n) x)
         simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, hm g x, hn g x]
       smul_mem' := by
         intro r m hm g x
         change (r • m) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear R X g x) =
           MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear R Y g ((r • m) x)
         simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, hm g x] } :
      Submodule R ((Finsupp X.carrier R) →ₗ[R] (Finsupp Y.carrier R)))
  let rightHom := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R]
      (data : {data : RightLabels R // parabolic data.1}) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret (fullRightDiagram R data))
  let rightSpan := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] =>
    Submodule.span R (Set.range fun data : {data : RightLabels R // parabolic data.1} =>
      let M := rightHom R data
      (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.commutes M⟩ :
        ↥(bimoduleMaps R)))
  let integerMaps :=
    ({ carrier := ↑(bimoduleMaps (ULift Int))
       zero_mem' := Submodule.zero_mem (bimoduleMaps (ULift Int))
       add_mem' := fun hm hn => Submodule.add_mem (bimoduleMaps (ULift Int)) hm hn
       neg_mem' := by
         intro m hm g x
         change (-m) (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear (ULift Int) X g x) =
           MackeyDiagrams.Biset.actLinear (ULift Int) Y g ((-m) x)
         simp only [LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, hm g x] } :
      AddSubgroup ((Finsupp X.carrier (ULift Int)) →ₗ[ULift Int]
        (Finsupp Y.carrier (ULift Int))))
  let integerRightSpan : AddSubgroup ↥integerMaps :=
    AddSubgroup.closure (Set.range fun data : {data : RightLabels (ULift Int) // parabolic data.1} =>
      let M := rightHom (ULift Int) data
      (⟨MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap M, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.commutes M⟩ : ↥integerMaps))
  (∀ O : Orbits,
    P O ≤ F ∧
    IsGreatest {K : Subgroup U | K ≤ P O ∧ parabolic K} (L O) ∧
    (∀ z ∈ O.val, Subgroup.relIndex (swaps (projected z)) (projected z) = index O) ∧
    IsLeast {n : Nat | ∃ T : RightTerm, rightOrbit T = O.val ∧
      ∀ z : Pair, coefficient (ULift Int) (evaluate (ULift Int) (rightDiagram (ULift Int) T)) z =
        entry (ULift Int) O.val (n : ULift Int) z} (index O) ∧
    (index O = 1 ↔ parabolic (P O))) ∧
  (∀ (R : Type _) [CommRing R],
    (∀ T : RightTerm,
      let P' := projected (rightRepresentative T)
      rightImage T ≤ P' ∧
      Subgroup.relIndex (swaps P') P' ∣ Subgroup.relIndex (rightImage T) P' ∧
      ∀ z : Pair, coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagram R T)) z =
        entry R (rightOrbit T) (Subgroup.relIndex (rightImage T) P' : R) z) ∧
    (∀ O : Orbits,
      ∃ (data : RightData (L O)) (finite : finiteFibers data),
        orbit (representative data) = O.val ∧
        projected (representative data) = P O ∧ isInclusion data ∧
        ∀ z : Pair, coefficient R (evaluate R (rightDiagramOf R data finite)) z =
          entry R O.val (index O : R) z) ∧
    ∃ T : Module.Basis Orbits R ↥(bimoduleMaps R),
      (∀ (O : Orbits) (z : Pair),
        coefficient R (T O).val z = entry R O.val 1 z) ∧
      (∀ M : ↥(bimoduleMaps R), M ∈ rightSpan R ↔
        ∀ O : Orbits, Module.Basis.repr T M O ∈ Ideal.span ({(index O : R)} : Set R))) ∧
  Nonempty ((↥integerMaps ⧸ integerRightSpan) ≃+
    DirectSum Orbits (fun O => ZMod (index O))) ∧
  (∀ (B : Subgroup U), parabolic B →
    ∀ (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (r : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b))
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e)) (finite : LeftUpperFiber u w s),
    let left := fun (R : Type _) [CommRing R] => leftDiagram R u v w r t s finite
    let S : Set Orbits :=
      {O | ∃ z ∈ O.val, coefficient (ULift Int) (evaluate (ULift Int) (left (ULift Int))) z ≠ 0}
    ∃ summand : ∀ O : ↥S, {data : RightData (P O.val) // finiteFibers data},
      (∀ O : ↥S,
        let data := (summand O).val
        parabolic (P O.val) ∧ orbit (representative data) = O.val.val ∧
        projected (representative data) = P O.val ∧ isInclusion data) ∧
      ∀ (R : Type _) [CommRing R],
        ∃ expansion : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing R bottom top ↥S,
          (∀ O : ↥S, O ∈ MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.indices expansion) ∧
          (∀ O : ↥S,
            MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.summand expansion O =
              rightDiagramOf R (summand O).val (summand O).property ∧
            ∀ z : Pair,
              coefficient R (evaluate R (MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.summand expansion O)) z =
                entry R O.val.val 1 z) ∧
          evaluate R (left R) = MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval expansion)

```

## ParabolicCaseFiveUnscaledDiagramIdentity: Coefficient-one Case 5 diagram expansion

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

A left diagram in Case~5 with group-element dots is a sum of
right diagrams, one for each supported orbit of input--output
pairs, each with coefficient \(1\). Write \(\mathcal S\) for this
set of orbits, \(P_{\mathcal O}\) for each projected stabilizer, and
\(T_{\mathcal O}\) for the matrix with coefficient \(1\) on \(\mathcal O\) and
\(0\) elsewhere.

The coefficient-one expansion of a left diagram also holds over
\(R\), since the coefficient count uses only the basis sets.

For linear left dots, expand into group-element triples and apply
the coefficient-one identity to each term. Any right orbit can
still be realized over \(\C\) with coefficient \(1\) by dividing
by its least multiplicity.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, coefficient-one Case 5 diagram identity after Proposition 8.7, p. 40. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered diagram and project TeX give the two crossing orders, the fixed boundary cosets, and the inclusion into F for each right summand. The selected text also extends the coefficient-one expansion to commutative rings with identity, expands linear left labels by group-element triples, and gives least-multiplicity normalization over Complex. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The configured defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. No statement correction for this endpoint could be verified. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 in translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139 governs the drawing syntax. Each crossing retains one mark carrying a finite termwise-eligible label, including when the support is empty. Each projection term carries its own finite-fiber witness for the multiplication parameter and uses the inverse parameter as the trace dot. The shared IndexedDrawing retains the single indexed sum over exactly the supported orbits, each with its coefficient-one matrix. The Lean type and both ordered planar crossing shapes passed checks through the shared compilation slot. [Defect report](https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects).

```lean
  Subgroup.closure {σ | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥Sinf
let blockSym : Finset Nat → Subgroup (Equiv.Perm Nat) :=

let parabolic : Subgroup U → Prop :=
  fun H => ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ l, Finset.Nonempty (blocks l)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun l m => Disjoint (blocks l) (blocks m)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype Sinf) H = iSup (fun l => blockSym (blocks l))
```

## ParabolicCaseSixStrictStabilizerObstruction: Case 6 no-replacement diagram under strict projected stabilizer inclusion

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

If the projected pair stabilizer of a right orbit is strictly
smaller than the intersection of its two individual stabilizer
projections, its orbit map has no left replacement, even by a
finite sum.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, Proposition 8.8 (prop:parabolic-three-case-six), first assertion and first diagram, p. 41. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The statement uses the fixed boundary and finite-fiber projection convention of Lemma 6.6 and the complex finite-parabolic setting of § 7.5. The orbit map has coefficient one on the simultaneous G × F orbit and zero elsewhere. The rendered first diagram has three compact marked crossings on each side and a single finite indexed sum of scaled left drawings. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in input.request applies finite, termwise-eligible complex labels to every mark. The group-element triple selects the orbit, and the inequality for arbitrary eligible linear right labels requires a nonzero evaluated coefficient on that orbit after cancellation. This clarification governs the Lean representation of the article endpoint.

```lean
let U := ↥finitary

    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let ga := up a
  let ad := down b
  let df := up d
  let gc := up c
  let ce := down e
  let ef := up f
  let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
  let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
  let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
  let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
  let Pair := X.carrier × Y.carrier
  let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ga)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)
  let output := fun (g : G) (y : E) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis gc)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f y)
  letI : MulAction (G × F) X.carrier :=
    { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X
      one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X
      mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X }
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Y.carrier :=
    { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y
      one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y
      mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y }
  letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
    { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
      one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
      mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
  let project := Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.snd G F)
  let projectedPair := fun z : Pair => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) z)
  let projectedSource := fun x : X.carrier => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) x)
  let projectedTarget := fun y : Y.carrier => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) y)
  let MatrixMap := (X.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (Y.carrier →₀ Complex)
  let coefficient := fun (M : MatrixMap) (z : Pair) =>
    M (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)) z.2
  let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
      (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
  let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
  let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let ProjectionLabel := fun {K L M H : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L M)
      (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H L) =>
    List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ)
  let LeftData :=
    Σ (B : Subgroup U) (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B)
      (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp u a) (comp v b) ×
      MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp v d) (comp w f) ×
      ProjectionLabel u w c e
  let leftDrawing : LeftData → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    fun ⟨_, u, v, w, r, t, s⟩ =>
      let du := down u
      let uv := up v
      let uw := up w
      let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms r)
      let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w f
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms t)
      let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w c e s
      stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ad df))
        (stack (juxtapose lower (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id df)))
          (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate du uv df))
            (stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id du)) middle)
              (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate du uw ef))
                (stack (juxtapose upper (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ef)))
                  (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ce ef)))))))
  let rightDrawing := fun {B' : Subgroup U}
      (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
      (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (r : ProjectionLabel b d i j)
      (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
      (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j)) =>
    let ai := up i
    let fj := down j
    let ck := up k
    let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j r
    let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms t)
    let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j
      (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms s)
    stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ga)) lower)
      (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
        (stack (juxtapose middle (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id fj)))
          (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
            (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id gc)) upper))))
  ∀ {B₀ : Subgroup U}, parabolic B₀ →
  ∀ (i₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B₀ A) (j₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B₀ F)
    (k₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B₀ C) (r₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i₀ j₀)
    (t₀ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i₀) (comp c k₀))
    (s₀ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k₀) (comp f j₀)),
  let z : Pair := (input 1 (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot r₀)),
    output (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t₀) (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s₀))
  let orbit := MulAction.orbit (G × F) z
  let orbitCoefficient := fun p : Pair =>
    @ite Complex (p ∈ orbit) (Classical.propDecidable (p ∈ orbit)) 1 0
  projectedPair z < projectedSource z.1 ⊓ projectedTarget z.2 →
  ∀ (N : Nat) (terms : Fin N → LeftData) (weights : Fin N → Complex),
    (∀ ν, parabolic (terms ν).1) →
    let leftSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top (Fin N) :=
      ⟨Finset.univ, fun ν => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (weights ν) (leftDrawing (terms ν))⟩
    (¬ ∀ p : Pair, coefficient (MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval leftSum) p = orbitCoefficient p) ∧
    (∀ {B' : Subgroup U}, parabolic B' →
      ∀ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
        (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (r : ProjectionLabel b d i j)
        (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
        (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j)),
      let rightMap := evaluate (rightDrawing i j k r t s)
      coefficient rightMap z ≠ 0 →
      rightMap ≠ MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval leftSum)
```

## ParabolicCaseSixReplacementThroughJoin: Case 6 single left replacement through a join

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

On the other hand, suppose \(F=1\), all boundary embeddings are
inclusions, \(GE\) is a subgroup, \(D\cap GE=A\), and
\(G\cap E=C\). Then every right diagram has a single left
replacement through the parabolic group
\(\langle G\cup D\cup E\rangle\).

For the second assertion, \(B'=1\) on the right since \(F=1\).
For right dots \((r,t,s)\), take the displayed join as \(B\) on
the left, the inclusion embeddings, and dots
\((1,r^{-1}ts,1)\). In the left formula an output exists exactly
when \(xr^{-1}\in GE\), because \(g,t,s\in GE\). As
\(xr^{-1}\in D\), this is \(xr^{-1}\in A\).
In that case the class \([g(xr^{-1})t,s]_C\) is the unique
output, because \(G\cap E=C\). The right formula gives the same class
under the same condition. For linear right dots with coefficients
\(c_r,c_t,c_s\) at the three vertices, put
\(\sum_{r,t,s}c_r c_t c_s r^{-1}ts\) at the middle left dot. Every term is admissible because \(F=1\).

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, second assertion and second diagram of Proposition 8.8 (prop:parabolic-three-case-six), p. 41, with the finite-parabolic setting of § 7.5 and the Case 6 crossing convention of Lemma 6.6. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The rendered diagram and project TikZ fix the ordered boundary, the inclusion cosets, and the three compact crossings on each side. The left diagram uses the parabolic join and labels 1, r⁻¹ts, 1 on singleton inputs, and the specified middle coefficient sum on general inputs. Finite-fiber certificates for the projections are supplied in the conclusion. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner’s 27 November 2026 clarification in input.request, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the drawing syntax. Each crossing carries a single marked finite complex-linear label of termwise eligible elements. The zero label retains its mark, and a group-element dot is the coefficient-one singleton. This is a formalization convention for the article endpoint.

```lean
theorem ParabolicCaseSixReplacementThroughJoin : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let F : Subgroup U := ⊥
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
      iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
        (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ blocks i)))
∀ {G A D C E : Subgroup U},
  parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic C → parabolic E →
  ∀ (GE : Subgroup U),
    (GE : Set U) = Set.image2 (fun g e : U => g * e) (G : Set U) (E : Set U) →
    ∀ (hA : D ⊓ GE = A) (hC : G ⊓ E = C) (hAG : A ≤ G),
  let B := (G ⊔ D) ⊔ E
  let incl := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
    (⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by simp⟩⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
  let a := incl hAG
  let b := incl (show A ≤ D by rw [← hA]; exact inf_le_left)
  let d := incl (show F ≤ D from bot_le)
  let c := incl (show C ≤ G by rw [← hC]; exact inf_le_left)
  let e := incl (show C ≤ E by rw [← hC]; exact inf_le_right)
  let f := incl (show F ≤ E from bot_le)
  let u := incl (show G ≤ B from le_trans le_sup_left le_sup_left)
  let v := incl (show D ≤ B from le_trans le_sup_right le_sup_left)
  let w := incl (show E ≤ B from le_sup_right)
  let i := incl (show F ≤ A from bot_le)
  let j := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id F
  let k := incl (show F ≤ C from bot_le)
  let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
  let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
  let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
  let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
  let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
  let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
  let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
  let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
    ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
  let bottom := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up d))
  let top := tensor (up c) (tensor (down e) (up f))
  let atLeft := fun {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
      {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
      {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
      (tail : MackeyDiagrams.Word L M)
      (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
    stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q tail))
      (stack (juxtapose crossing (drawId tail))
        (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p' q' tail)))
  let finiteFibers := fun {H K L M : Subgroup U}
      (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L M)
      (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (δ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H L)
      (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α γ) (comp β δ)) =>
    ∀ z, Set.Finite {y | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β γ δ dot y = z}
  let lowerOne : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b) :=
    ⟨1, fun x => by simpa only [mul_one, one_mul] using
      (show MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp u a) x =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp v b) x from rfl)⟩
  let upperOne : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e) :=
    ⟨1, fun x => by simpa only [mul_one, one_mul] using
      (show MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp u c) x =
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp w e) x from rfl)⟩
  let RightLower := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j)
  let RightMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
  let RightUpper := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
  let LeftMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f)
  let middleDot := fun (r : RightLower) (t : RightMiddle) (s : RightUpper) =>
    let z := (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom v (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r))⁻¹ *
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom u (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t) *
      MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom w (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s)
    (⟨z, fun x => by
      have hx : x = 1 := Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp x.property)
      simp [hx]⟩ : LeftMiddle)
  ∃ (hLeft : finiteFibers u w c e upperOne)
    (hRight : ∀ r : RightLower, finiteFibers b d i j r),
  let leftDrawing := fun (middle : List (Complex × LeftMiddle)) =>
    (stack
      (atLeft (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b [(1, lowerOne)]))
      (stack (juxtapose (drawId (down u)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w f middle))
        (atLeft (up f) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w c e
          [(1, ⟨upperOne, hLeft⟩)]))) :
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
  let rightDrawing := fun
      (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
      (middle : List (Complex × RightMiddle)) (upper : List (Complex × RightUpper)) =>
    (stack
      (juxtapose (drawId (up a)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
      (stack (atLeft (down j) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k middle))
        (juxtapose (drawId (up c)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper))) :
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
  let rightProjectionTerm := fun (r : RightLower) =>
    (⟨r, hRight r⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
  let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
  parabolic B ∧
    (∀ (r : RightLower) (t : RightMiddle) (s : RightUpper),
      evaluate (leftDrawing [(1, middleDot r t s)]) =
        evaluate (rightDrawing [(1, rightProjectionTerm r)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)])) ∧
    (∀ (rs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b i) (comp d j))
        (ts : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
        (ss : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j)),
      let middleLabel : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp v d) (comp w f) :=
        Finsupp.sum rs (fun r cr =>
          Finsupp.sum ts (fun t ct =>
            Finsupp.sum ss (fun s cs => Finsupp.single (middleDot r t s) (cr * ct * cs))))
      let lowerTerms := List.map (fun (term : Complex × RightLower) =>
        (Prod.fst term, rightProjectionTerm (Prod.snd term))) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs)
      evaluate (leftDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms middleLabel)) =
        evaluate (rightDrawing lowerTerms (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts)
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ss)))
```

## ParabolicCaseSixObstructionAndReplacementFamily: A Case 6 obstruction and a replacement family

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

In each pair below, the left shape is \(s_1s_2s_1\) and the right shape is
\(s_2s_1s_2\). The numbers identify the direction of replacement.
Fix the boundary groups and the boundary strand cosets in each pair.
Letters such as \(a\) denote conjugation embeddings, and \(\bar a\) is
the coset of a representative of \(a\). Write \(ad=a\circ d\).
Write \(\operatorname{Ad}_p\) for conjugation by \(p\).

A label \(s\) on a mixed crossing denotes the parameter in
\(q_s([k,h])=\alpha(k)s\beta(h)\). The multiplication crossing is
\(q_s\). The projection uses the trace dot \(s^{-1}\) and sends
\[
 z\longmapsto q_s^!(z)=\sum_{q_s([k,h])=z}[k,h].
\]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:r2-mixed-composition}, this formula applies
when the fibers of \(q_s\) are finite, even if the cup by itself
would have infinite index. In a composite with linear labels,
each projection must have finite fibers for every term used.

Write \(a:A\to G\), \(b:A\to D\), and \(d:F\to D\) for the lower
embeddings and \(c:C\to G\), \(e:C\to E\), and \(f:F\to E\) for the upper ones.
The source basis is \(G\times_A D\) and the target basis is \(G\times_C E\).

If the projected pair stabilizer of a right orbit is strictly
smaller than the intersection of its two individual stabilizer
projections, its orbit map has no left replacement, even by a
finite sum.

On the other hand, suppose \(F=1\), all boundary embeddings are
inclusions, \(GE\) is a subgroup, \(D\cap GE=A\), and
\(G\cap E=C\). Then every right diagram has a single left
replacement through the parabolic group
\(\langle G\cup D\cup E\rangle\).

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, § 8.3, Proposition 8.8 [prop:parabolic-three-case-six], p. 41. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. Both displayed identities retain the ordered Case 6 boundaries and the three compact marked crossings of each drawing. The obstruction compares the orbit matrix and any right evaluation with a nonzero coefficient on that orbit against a finite indexed sum of complete left drawings. The replacement uses one left drawing through the parabolic join, with the combined label at its middle mark. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf#page=41

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in input.request (translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139) governs the representation of every mark as a finite, termwise-eligible complex label. Zero labels retain their marks. Every projection term carries a finite-fiber certificate. The clarification applies to the formalization of the article endpoint.

```lean
theorem ParabolicCaseSixObstructionAndReplacementFamily : (
  let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
  let U := ↥finitary
  let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
    MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
  let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
    ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
      (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
      Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
  ∀ {G A D F C E : Subgroup U},
    parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic F → parabolic C → parabolic E →
    ∀ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
      (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
      (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E),
    let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
    let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
    let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
    let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
    let ga := up a
    let ad := down b
    let df := up d
    let gc := up c
    let ce := down e
    let ef := up f
    let bottom := tensor ga (tensor ad df)
    let top := tensor gc (tensor ce ef)
    let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
    let Y := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
    let Pair := X.carrier × Y.carrier
    let input := fun (g : G) (x : D) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis ga)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ad df)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)
    let output := fun (g : G) (y : E) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis gc)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor ce ef)) g (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f y)
    letI : MulAction (G × F) X.carrier :=
      { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X
        one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X
        mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X }
    letI : MulAction (G × F) Y.carrier :=
      { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y
        one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y
        mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y }
    letI : MulAction (G × F) Pair :=
      { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act Y q z.2)
        one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act Y z.2)
        mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act Y q q' z.2) }
    let project := Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.snd G F)
    let projectedPair := fun z : Pair => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) z)
    let projectedSource := fun x : X.carrier => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) x)
    let projectedTarget := fun y : Y.carrier => project (MulAction.stabilizer (G × F) y)
    let MatrixMap := (X.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (Y.carrier →₀ Complex)
    let coefficient := fun (M : MatrixMap) (z : Pair) =>
      M (Finsupp.single z.1 (1 : Complex)) z.2
    let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
        (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
    let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
    let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
    let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
    let ProjectionLabel := fun {K L M H : Subgroup U}
        (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L M)
        (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H L) =>
      List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ)
    let LeftData :=
      Σ (B : Subgroup U) (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B)
        (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B) (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B),
        MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp u a) (comp v b) ×
        MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp v d) (comp w f) ×
        ProjectionLabel u w c e
    let leftDrawing : LeftData → MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      fun ⟨_, u, v, w, r, t, s⟩ =>
        let du := down u
        let uv := up v
        let uw := up w
        let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms r)
        let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w f
          (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms t)
        let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w c e s
        stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ad df))
          (stack (juxtapose lower (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id df)))
            (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate du uv df))
              (stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id du)) middle)
                (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate du uw ef))
                  (stack (juxtapose upper (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ef)))
                    (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ce ef)))))))
    let rightDrawing := fun {B' : Subgroup U}
        (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
        (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (r : ProjectionLabel b d i j)
        (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
        (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j)) =>
      let ai := up i
      let fj := down j
      let ck := up k
      let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j r
      let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms t)
      let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j
        (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms s)
      stack (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id ga)) lower)
        (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate ga ai fj))
          (stack (juxtapose middle (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id fj)))
            (stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate gc ck fj))
              (juxtapose (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id gc)) upper))))
    ∀ {B₀ : Subgroup U}, parabolic B₀ →
    ∀ (i₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B₀ A) (j₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B₀ F)
      (k₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B₀ C) (r₀ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i₀ j₀)
      (t₀ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i₀) (comp c k₀))
      (s₀ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k₀) (comp f j₀)),
    let z : Pair := (input 1 (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot r₀)),
      output (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t₀) (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s₀))
    let orbit := MulAction.orbit (G × F) z
    let orbitCoefficient := fun p : Pair =>
      @ite Complex (p ∈ orbit) (Classical.propDecidable (p ∈ orbit)) 1 0
    projectedPair z < projectedSource z.1 ⊓ projectedTarget z.2 →
    ∀ (N : Nat) (terms : Fin N → LeftData) (weights : Fin N → Complex),
      (∀ ν, parabolic (terms ν).1) →
      let leftSum : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex bottom top (Fin N) :=
        ⟨Finset.univ, fun ν => MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (weights ν) (leftDrawing (terms ν))⟩
      (¬ ∀ p : Pair, coefficient (MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval leftSum) p = orbitCoefficient p) ∧
      (∀ {B' : Subgroup U}, parabolic B' →
        ∀ (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
          (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C) (r : ProjectionLabel b d i j)
          (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
          (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j)),
        let rightMap := evaluate (rightDrawing i j k r t s)
        coefficient rightMap z ≠ 0 →
        rightMap ≠ MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval leftSum)
)
∧
(
  let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
  let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
  let U := ↥finitary
  let F : Subgroup U := ⊥
  let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
    ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
      (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
      Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
      Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H =
        iSup (fun i => MonoidHom.range
          (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun m : Nat => m ∈ blocks i)))
  ∀ {G A D C E : Subgroup U},
    parabolic G → parabolic A → parabolic D → parabolic C → parabolic E →
    ∀ (GE : Subgroup U),
      (GE : Set U) = Set.image2 (fun g e : U => g * e) (G : Set U) (E : Set U) →
      ∀ (hA : D ⊓ GE = A) (hC : G ⊓ E = C) (hAG : A ≤ G),
    let B := (G ⊔ D) ⊔ E
    let incl := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
      (⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by simp⟩⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
    let a := incl hAG
    let b := incl (show A ≤ D by rw [← hA]; exact inf_le_left)
    let d := incl (show F ≤ D from bot_le)
    let c := incl (show C ≤ G by rw [← hC]; exact inf_le_left)
    let e := incl (show C ≤ E by rw [← hC]; exact inf_le_right)
    let f := incl (show F ≤ E from bot_le)
    let u := incl (show G ≤ B from le_trans le_sup_left le_sup_left)
    let v := incl (show D ≤ B from le_trans le_sup_right le_sup_left)
    let w := incl (show E ≤ B from le_sup_right)
    let i := incl (show F ≤ A from bot_le)
    let j := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id F
    let k := incl (show F ≤ C from bot_le)
    let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
    let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
    let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
    let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
    let stack := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
    let juxtapose := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
    let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
    let drawId := fun {K H : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K H) =>
      ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
    let bottom := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up d))
    let top := tensor (up c) (tensor (down e) (up f))
    let atLeft := fun {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
        {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
        {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
        (tail : MackeyDiagrams.Word L M)
        (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
      stack (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q tail))
        (stack (juxtapose crossing (drawId tail))
          (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p' q' tail)))
    let finiteFibers := fun {H K L M : Subgroup U}
        (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L M)
        (γ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (δ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H L)
        (dot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp α γ) (comp β δ)) =>
      ∀ z, Set.Finite {y | MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis α β γ δ dot y = z}
    let lowerOne : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b) :=
      ⟨1, fun x => by simpa only [mul_one, one_mul] using
        (show MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp u a) x =
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp v b) x from rfl)⟩
    let upperOne : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u c) (comp w e) :=
      ⟨1, fun x => by simpa only [mul_one, one_mul] using
        (show MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp u c) x =
          MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom (comp w e) x from rfl)⟩
    let RightLower := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j)
    let RightMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k)
    let RightUpper := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)
    let LeftMiddle := MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f)
    let middleDot := fun (r : RightLower) (t : RightMiddle) (s : RightUpper) =>
      let z := (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom v (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element r))⁻¹ *
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom u (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t) *
        MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom w (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s)
      (⟨z, fun x => by
        have hx : x = 1 := Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp x.property)
        simp [hx]⟩ : LeftMiddle)
    ∃ (hLeft : finiteFibers u w c e upperOne)
      (hRight : ∀ r : RightLower, finiteFibers b d i j r),
    let leftDrawing := fun (middle : List (Complex × LeftMiddle)) =>
      (stack
        (atLeft (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b [(1, lowerOne)]))
        (stack (juxtapose (drawId (down u)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w f middle))
          (atLeft (up f) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w c e
            [(1, ⟨upperOne, hLeft⟩)]))) :
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    let rightDrawing := fun
        (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
        (middle : List (Complex × RightMiddle)) (upper : List (Complex × RightUpper)) =>
      (stack
        (juxtapose (drawId (up a)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
        (stack (atLeft (down j) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k middle))
          (juxtapose (drawId (up c)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j upper))) :
        MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top)
    let rightProjectionTerm := fun (r : RightLower) =>
      (⟨r, hRight r⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j)
    let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    parabolic B ∧
      (∀ (r : RightLower) (t : RightMiddle) (s : RightUpper),
        evaluate (leftDrawing [(1, middleDot r t s)]) =
          evaluate (rightDrawing [(1, rightProjectionTerm r)] [(1, t)] [(1, s)])) ∧
      (∀ (rs : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp b i) (comp d j))
          (ts : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp a i) (comp c k))
          (ss : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp e k) (comp f j)),
        let middleLabel : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel Complex (comp v d) (comp w f) :=
          Finsupp.sum rs (fun r cr =>
            Finsupp.sum ts (fun t ct =>
              Finsupp.sum ss (fun s cs => Finsupp.single (middleDot r t s) (cr * ct * cs))))
        let lowerTerms := List.map (fun (term : Complex × RightLower) =>
          (Prod.fst term, rightProjectionTerm (Prod.snd term))) (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms rs)
        evaluate (leftDrawing (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms middleLabel)) =
          evaluate (rightDrawing lowerTerms (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ts)
            (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms ss)))
)
```

## ParabolicCaseSixOrbitCoefficientVanishesInCharacteristicThree: An orbit coefficient vanishing in characteristic three

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Take all six boundary groups equal to
\(S_3\), the identity embeddings, and right dots \((1,(123),1)\)
with \(B'=1\). The individual projections are both \(S_3\),
while the pair stabilizer projects to \(\langle(123)\rangle\).
On the two bases identified with \(S_3\), the map sends
\(x\) to \(3x((123)+(132))\), since each conjugate of \((123)\)
is counted three times. Over a ring of characteristic \(3\), every
right diagram has zero coefficient on this orbit.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.5 [ex:case-six-characteristic-three], p. 42](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.5 (ex:case-six-characteristic-three), p. 42. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The statement uses the symmetric group on the block {1, 2, 3} inside the finitary symmetric group and the simultaneous action on input and output basis elements. The rendered Case 6 diagram and Lemma 6.6 fix the order and orientations of the three crossings. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The supplied defect-report URL returned HTTP 404 with and without a trailing slash. The portal reproduces Example 8.5, and no correction for it was available. https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams#ex:case-six-characteristic-three https://getcurious.cc/articles/math-bimodule-string-diagrams/prerequisite-omissions-and-potential-defects

Each compact crossing retains one mark for every eligible DotLabel, including zero. The labels of the displayed example are coefficient-one singletons. Every lower projection term has finite fibers because its balanced source basis is finite. The revised statement elaborated in the shared compilation slot. theorem ParabolicCaseSixOrbitCoefficientVanishesInCharacteristicThree : let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : Equiv.Perm Nat | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
```lean
let U := ↥finitary
let extendBlock := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S)
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) => MonoidHom.range (extendBlock S)
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),

    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let points : Finset Nat := {1, 2, 3}
let S₃ := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary) (blockSym points)
let extend : Equiv.Perm ↥points → S₃ := fun σ =>
  ⟨⟨extendBlock points σ, by
      apply _root_.mem_closure_isSwap'.2
      apply (Finset.finite_toSet points).subset
      intro n moved
      by_contra outside
      exact moved (MulAction.mem_fixedBy.mpr (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_apply_of_not_mem σ outside))
    ⟩, ⟨σ, rfl⟩⟩
letI : Finite S₃ := Finite.of_surjective extend (by
  intro ⟨⟨σ, hσ⟩, h⟩
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := h
  exact ⟨ρ, Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext hρ)⟩)
let label₁ : ↥points := ⟨1, by decide⟩
let label₂ : ↥points := ⟨2, by decide⟩
let label₃ : ↥points := ⟨3, by decide⟩
let cycle := extend (Equiv.swap label₁ label₂ * Equiv.swap label₂ label₃)
let boundary := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id S₃
let up := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up boundary
let down := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down boundary
let mixed := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor down up
let word := MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor up mixed
let X := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis word
let basis : S₃ → X.carrier := fun x =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis up)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis mixed) x
    (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair boundary boundary 1)
letI : MulAction (S₃ × S₃) X.carrier :=
  { smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X
    one_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X
    mul_smul := MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X }
letI : MulAction (S₃ × S₃) (X.carrier × X.carrier) :=
  { smul := fun q z => (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.1, MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act X q z.2)
    one_smul := fun z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.1)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.one_act X z.2)
    mul_smul := fun q q' z => Prod.ext (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.1)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.mul_act X q q' z.2) }
let project := Subgroup.map (MonoidHom.snd S₃ S₃)
let representative := (basis 1, basis cycle)
let orbit := MulAction.orbit (S₃ × S₃) representative
let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let trivialEmbedding : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding (⊥ : Subgroup U) S₃ :=
  MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator 1 (fun h => by
    have hh : (h : U) = 1 := h.property
    simp [hh])
let trivialDot := fun z : S₃ =>
  (⟨z, fun h => by
    have hh : h = 1 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hh]
    simp⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp boundary trivialEmbedding) (comp boundary trivialEmbedding))
Function.Bijective basis ∧
project (MulAction.stabilizer (S₃ × S₃) representative.1) = ⊤ ∧
project (MulAction.stabilizer (S₃ × S₃) representative.2) = ⊤ ∧
project (MulAction.stabilizer (S₃ × S₃) representative) = Subgroup.zpowers cycle ∧
∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R],
let rightDrawing := fun {B' : Subgroup U}
    (i j k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' S₃)
    (r : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel R (comp boundary i) (comp boundary j))
    (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel R (comp boundary i) (comp boundary k))
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel R (comp boundary k) (comp boundary j)) =>
  let ai := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up i
  let fj := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down j
  let ck := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up k
  letI : Finite (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor ai fj)).carrier :=
    Quotient.finite _
  let projectionTerms := (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms r).map
    (fun (c, d) => (c, (⟨d, fun _ => Set.toFinite _⟩ :
      MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed boundary boundary i j)))
  let lower := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection
    boundary boundary i j projectionTerms
  let middle := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp
    boundary i boundary k (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms t)
  let upper := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication
    boundary boundary k j (MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.terms s)
  let straightUp := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
    (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := R) up)
  MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal straightUp lower)
    (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate up ai fj))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal middle
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := R) fj)))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate up ck fj))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal straightUp upper))))
let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing R word word) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
    (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
(∀ x : S₃,
  evaluate
    (rightDrawing trivialEmbedding trivialEmbedding trivialEmbedding
      (Finsupp.single (trivialDot 1) (1 : R))
      (Finsupp.single (trivialDot cycle) (1 : R))
      (Finsupp.single (trivialDot 1) (1 : R)))

      Finsupp.single (basis (x * cycle)) (3 : R) +
      Finsupp.single (basis (x * cycle⁻¹)) (3 : R)) ∧
∀ [CharP R 3] {B' : Subgroup U}, parabolic B' →
  ∀ (i j k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' S₃)
    (r : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel R (comp boundary i) (comp boundary j))
    (t : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel R (comp boundary i) (comp boundary k))
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel R (comp boundary k) (comp boundary j))
    (z : X.carrier × X.carrier), z ∈ orbit →
```

## CaseSixCounterexampleWithTrivialProjectedStabilizers: A Case 6 obstruction with trivial projected stabilizers

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Take
\[
 G=A=C=\langle(12),(34)\rangle,\qquad
 D=E=\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,3,4\}),\qquad F=1
\]
with inclusion embeddings. The two boundary bases identify with
\(D\) by multiplication. The right diagram with \(B'=1\) and unit
dots fixes the basis elements of \(A\) and sends those in
\(D\setminus A\) to zero by (6.4).

Consider any left diagram with group-element dots \(r,t,s\) and
embeddings \(u,v,w\) as in Lemma~6.6.
Its lower and upper vertex conditions give
\[
 u(G)\le r v(D)r^{-1},\qquad u(G)\le s w(E)s^{-1}.
\]
The image \(u(G)\) moves four points. Both displayed overgroups are
full symmetric groups on four points, so they are the same subgroup.
Use \([1,x]_A\) and \([1,y]_C\) for the input and output.
The left-diagram equation becomes
\[
 s w(y)s^{-1}=(r v(x)r^{-1})(rts^{-1}).
\]
If \(rts^{-1}\) belongs to the common subgroup, every input has
exactly one output. Otherwise every input has zero outputs.
By linearity, the sum of the output coefficients of any finite
sum of left diagrams is constant on basis inputs. The right
diagram has coefficient sum \(1\) on \(A\) and \(0\) off \(A\),
so it has no left replacement.

[Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.6 [ex:case-six-trivial-stabilizers], p. 42](https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf)

### Alphabeta Math

No Alphabeta Math source recorded.

### Lean statement

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.6 (ex:case-six-trivial-stabilizers), p. 42, with the Case 6 crossing orders and fixed inclusion boundary from the rendered figure and TikZ for §6.3 and the projection convention of Lemma 6.6. The published PDF matches the project copy byte for byte. The coefficient field is ℂ as in the finite-parabolic bicategory of §7.5. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The 27 November 2026 owner clarification in input.request, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the Lean representation. The shared LabelledDrawing constructors give each compact crossing one mark for every finite eligible complex label, including zero and coefficient-one singletons. Projection terms carry their individual finite-fiber certificates. Each left summand can choose its own finite-parabolic middle region and admissible labels, and IndexedDrawing retains the outer weighted sum of complete left drawings. Lean elaborated the proposition and checked both three-mark planar shapes for arbitrary label lists through the shared compilation slot.
