```lean
theorem CaseSixCounterexampleWithTrivialProjectedStabilizers : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let finitary : Subgroup P := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let points : Finset Nat := {1, 2, 3, 4}
let small : Subgroup P :=
  Subgroup.closure ({Equiv.swap (1 : Nat) 2, Equiv.swap (3 : Nat) 4} : Set P)
let A : Subgroup U := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary) small
let D : Subgroup U := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary) (blockSym points)
let F : Subgroup U := ⊥
let swapInBlock := fun (S : Finset Nat) (m n : Nat) (hm : m ∈ S) (hn : n ∈ S) =>
  (show Equiv.swap m n ∈ blockSym S from
    ⟨Equiv.swap (⟨m, hm⟩ : {k : Nat // k ∈ S}) ⟨n, hn⟩,
      Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩)
let hAD : A ≤ D := by
  have hsmall : small ≤ blockSym points := by
    refine (Subgroup.closure_le (blockSym points)).2 ?_
    intro σ hσ
    change σ ∈ ({Equiv.swap (1 : Nat) 2, Equiv.swap (3 : Nat) 4} : Set P) at hσ
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hσ with hσ | hσ
    · rw [hσ]
      exact swapInBlock points 1 2 (by decide) (by decide)
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hσ]
      exact swapInBlock points 3 4 (by decide) (by decide)
  exact Subgroup.comap_mono hsmall
let parabolic := fun (B : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) B = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let incl := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
  (⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by simp⟩⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id A
let b := incl hAD
let d := incl (show F ≤ D from bot_le)
let i := incl (show F ≤ A from bot_le)
let j := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id F
let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
let straight := fun {K L : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K L) =>
  ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
let word := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up d))
let atLeft := fun {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
    {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
    {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
    (tail : MackeyDiagrams.Word L M)
    (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
  vertical (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q tail))
    (vertical (horizontal crossing (straight tail))
      (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p' q' tail)))
let left := fun {B : Subgroup U}
    (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B) (v w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
    (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b)))
    (middle : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w d)))
    (upper : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed u w a b)) =>
  vertical
    (atLeft (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b lower))
    (vertical
      (horizontal (straight (down u))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w d middle))
      (atLeft (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w a b upper)))
let IsLeft := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex word word) =>
  ∃ (B : Subgroup U), parabolic B ∧
    ∃ (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A B) (v w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b)))
      (middle : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w d)))
      (upper : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed u w a b)),
      drawing = left u v w lower middle upper
let endDot : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j) :=
  ⟨1, fun x => by
    have hx : x = 1 := Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp x.property)
    simp [hx]⟩
let right := fun
    (lower : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j))
    (middle : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp a i)))
    (upper : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp b i) (comp d j))) =>
  vertical
    (horizontal (straight (up a))
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j lower))
    (vertical
      (atLeft (down j) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i a i middle))
      (horizontal (straight (up a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication b d i j upper)))
let basis := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis word
let coordinate := fun (g : A) (x : D) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
    (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up d))) g
    (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d x)
let basisVector := fun x : D => Finsupp.single (coordinate 1 x) (1 : Complex)
let evaluate := fun (drawing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex word word) =>
  MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap
    (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing))
let coefficientSum := fun (z : Finsupp basis.carrier Complex) => Finsupp.sum z (fun _ c => c)
let projectsToTrivial := fun (S : Set (A × F)) =>
  Set.image Prod.snd S = ({1} : Set F)
let stabilizes := fun (p : basis.carrier) (k : A × F) => MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act basis k p = p
(∃ coordinates : basis.carrier ≃ D,
  ∀ (g : A) (x : D), coordinates (coordinate g x) = MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b g * x) ∧
(∀ p q : basis.carrier,
  projectsToTrivial {k | stabilizes p k} ∧
  projectsToTrivial {k | stabilizes q k} ∧
  projectsToTrivial {k | stabilizes p k ∧ stabilizes q k}) ∧
∃ (hr : ∀ z, Set.Finite {w |
    MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis b d i j endDot w = z}),
  let rightEval := evaluate
    (right [(1, ⟨endDot, hr⟩)] [(1, MackeyDiagrams.Dot.id (comp a i))] [(1, endDot)])
  (∀ x : D,
    ((x : U) ∈ A → rightEval (basisVector x) = basisVector x) ∧
    ((x : U) ∉ A → rightEval (basisVector x) = 0)) ∧
  ∀ (ι : Type) (terms : MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing Complex word word ι)
      (coefficients : ι → Complex),
    (∀ k ∈ terms.indices, IsLeft (terms.summand k)) →
    let leftEval := MackeyDiagrams.IndexedDrawing.eval
      { terms with summand := fun k =>
          MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.scale (coefficients k) (terms.summand k) }
    (∀ x y : D, coefficientSum (leftEval (basisVector x)) = coefficientSum (leftEval (basisVector y))) ∧
    leftEval ≠ rightEval
```

## ParabolicCaseSixObstructionWithTrivialProjectedStabilizer: A Case 6 obstruction with trivial projected stabilizer

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

We work in the bicategory of Section~7.5,
with \(U=S_\infty\) and all region groups finite parabolic. We use the
diagrams and labels of
Sections~4--6.

A left replacement can also fail when the projected pair stabilizer
equals the intersection of the two individual projections.

A right diagram in the finite-parabolic category can have no left
replacement even when its projected pair stabilizer and both
individual stabilizer projections are trivial.

```lean
theorem ParabolicCaseSixObstructionWithTrivialProjectedStabilizer : let P := Equiv.Perm Nat
let finitary : Subgroup P := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary
let blockSym := fun (S : Finset Nat) =>
  MonoidHom.range (Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ S))
let parabolic := fun (H : Subgroup U) =>
  ∃ (n : Nat) (blocks : Fin n → Finset Nat),
    (∀ i, Finset.Nonempty (blocks i)) ∧
    Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (blocks i) (blocks j)) ∧
    Subgroup.map (Subgroup.subtype finitary) H = iSup (fun i => blockSym (blocks i))
let up := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.up U _
let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
let straight := fun {K L : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K L) =>
  ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
let atLeft := fun {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
    {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
    {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
    (tail : MackeyDiagrams.Word L M)
    (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
  vertical (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q tail))
    (vertical (horizontal crossing (straight tail))
      (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p' q' tail)))
let ProjectionLabel := fun {K L M H : Subgroup U}
    (α : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding K M) (β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding L M)
    (η : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K) (θ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H L) =>
  List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed α β η θ)
∃ (G A D C E F B' : Subgroup U),
  parabolic G ∧ parabolic A ∧ parabolic D ∧ parabolic C ∧ parabolic E ∧ parabolic F ∧
  parabolic B' ∧
  ∃ (a : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A G) (b : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding A D)
    (d : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F D) (c : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C G)
    (e : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding C E) (f : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding F E)
    (i : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' A) (j : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' F)
    (k : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding B' C)
    (r : MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.Mixed b d i j) (t : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a i) (comp c k))
    (s : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e k) (comp f j)),
  let bottom := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up d))
  let top := tensor (up c) (tensor (down e) (up f))
  let inputBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis bottom
  let outputBasis := MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis top
  let p : inputBasis.carrier :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction a)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (down b) (up d))) 1
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair b d (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element (MackeyDiagrams.ProjectionDot.dot r)))
  let q : outputBasis.carrier :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.pair (MackeyDiagrams.Biset.induction c)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Word.basis (tensor (down e) (up f))) (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element t)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair e f (MackeyDiagrams.Dot.element s))
  let sourceStabilizer : Set (G × F) := {z | MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act inputBasis z p = p}
  let targetStabilizer : Set (G × F) := {z | MackeyDiagrams.Biset.act outputBasis z q = q}
  let projectsToTrivial := fun (S : Set (G × F)) => Set.image Prod.snd S = ({1} : Set F)
  let right : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
    vertical
      (horizontal (straight (up a)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b d i j [(1, r)]))
      (vertical (atLeft (down j) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a i c k [(1, t)]))
        (horizontal (straight (up c))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e f k j [(1, s)])))
  let left := fun {B : Subgroup U}
      (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
      (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
      (rL : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b)))
      (tL : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f)))
      (sL : ProjectionLabel u w c e) =>
    vertical
      (atLeft (up d) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication u v a b rL))
      (vertical
        (horizontal (straight (down u)) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v d w f tL))
        (atLeft (up f) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w c e sL)))
  let IsLeft := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    ∃ (B : Subgroup U), parabolic B ∧
      ∃ (u : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding G B) (v : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding D B)
        (w : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding E B)
        (rL : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b)))
        (tL : List (Complex × MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp v d) (comp w f)))
        (sL : ProjectionLabel u w c e),
        diagram = left u v w rL tL sL
  let evaluate := fun (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
    MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret diagram))
  projectsToTrivial (sourceStabilizer ∩ targetStabilizer) ∧
  projectsToTrivial sourceStabilizer ∧ projectsToTrivial targetStabilizer ∧
  ∀ (diagram : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top), IsLeft diagram →
    evaluate diagram ≠ evaluate right
```

## CaseSixReplacementThroughOverlappingBlocks: A left replacement through overlapping blocks

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Take
\(G=A=C=F=1\), \(D=\langle(12)\rangle\) and
\(E=\langle(23)\rangle\). The right diagram that sends \(r\) to
\(s\) and all other basis elements to zero has a left
replacement with middle group \(\operatorname{Sym}(\{1,2,3\})\)
and middle dot \(r^{-1}s\).

Translation source: article. Ian Xiao, Bimodule String Diagrams and the Generalized Mackey Decomposition, Example 8.7 [ex:case-six-overlap], p. 42. The published PDF is byte-identical to the project copy. The rendered figure and project TikZ give the ordered up–down–up boundaries with inclusion cosets and the crossing positions on both sides. The middle groups are the full symmetric group on {1,2,3}, acting trivially outside that block in the finitary symmetric group, and the trivial group. The right drawing acts as the matrix unit sending r to s. Its lower projection uses parameter r and trace dot r⁻¹. https://getcurious.cc/downloads/mackey-bimodules.pdf

The owner clarification of 27 November 2026 in input.request, translation recheck request f13b4bd8ba9fe139, governs the diagram syntax. Each of the six compact crossings carries one coefficient-one singleton complex label on an eligible group element. Each projection singleton carries its own finite-fiber certificate in the conclusion. Lean checked the type and the ordered three-crossing shape of each drawing through the shared compilation slot.

```lean
let finitary := Subgroup.closure {σ : P | Equiv.Perm.IsSwap σ}
let U := ↥finitary

let swap := fun (i j : Nat) (hij : i ≠ j) =>
  (⟨Equiv.swap i j, Subgroup.subset_closure ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩⟩ : U)
let swap12 := swap 1 2 (by decide)
let swap23 := swap 2 3 (by decide)
let D : Subgroup U := Subgroup.closure {swap12}
let E : Subgroup U := Subgroup.closure {swap23}
let points : Finset Nat := {1, 2, 3}
let extend := Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype (p := fun n : Nat => n ∈ points)
let B : Subgroup U := Subgroup.comap (Subgroup.subtype finitary) (MonoidHom.range extend)
let includeConj := fun {H K : Subgroup U} (h : H ≤ K) =>
  (⟨Subgroup.inclusion h, ⟨1, fun x => by simp⟩⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding H K)
let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.id T
let b := includeConj (show T ≤ D from bot_le)
let e := includeConj (show T ≤ E from bot_le)
let u := includeConj (show T ≤ B from bot_le)
let v := includeConj (show D ≤ B by
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le B).mpr
  apply Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
  change ∃ p, extend p = Equiv.swap 1 2
  exact ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨1, by decide⟩ ⟨2, by decide⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩)
let w := includeConj (show E ≤ B by
  apply (Subgroup.closure_le B).mpr
  apply Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
  change ∃ p, extend p = Equiv.swap 2 3
  exact ⟨Equiv.swap ⟨2, by decide⟩ ⟨3, by decide⟩, Equiv.Perm.ofSubtype_swap_eq _ _⟩)

let down := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.down U _
let tensor := @MackeyDiagrams.Word.tensor U _
let comp := @MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.comp U _
let vertical := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical U _ Complex _
let horizontal := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal U _ Complex _
let ordinary := @MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary U _ Complex _
let straight := fun {K L : Subgroup U} (p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K L) =>
  ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id p)
let bottom := tensor (up a) (tensor (down b) (up b))
let top := tensor (up a) (tensor (down e) (up e))
let atLeft := fun {K J J' L M : Subgroup U}
    {p : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J} {q : MackeyDiagrams.Word J L}
    {p' : MackeyDiagrams.Word K J'} {q' : MackeyDiagrams.Word J' L}
    (tail : MackeyDiagrams.Word L M)
    (crossing : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex (tensor p q) (tensor p' q')) =>
  vertical (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate p q tail))
    (vertical (horizontal crossing (straight tail))
      (ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate p' q' tail)))
let dot := fun {H : Subgroup U} {α β : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T H} (x : H) =>
  (⟨x, fun y => by
    have hy : y = 1 := Subtype.ext (Subgroup.mem_bot.mp y.property)
    simp [hy]⟩ : MackeyDiagrams.Dot α β)
let lowerLeft : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp v b) := dot 1
let upperLeft : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp u a) (comp w e) := dot 1
let middleRight : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp a a) (comp a a) := dot 1
let finiteFibers := fun {X Y : Type} (q : X → Y) => ∀ z, Set.Finite {y | q y = z}
let basisVector := fun {H : Subgroup U} (h : MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding T H) (x : H) =>

      (MackeyDiagrams.Generator.mixedPair h h x)) (1 : Complex)

  let upperRight : MackeyDiagrams.Dot (comp e a) (comp e a) := dot s

    dot ((MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom v r)⁻¹ * MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom w s)

    (hLeft : finiteFibers

    let left : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical

            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp v b w e [(1, middleLeft)]))
          (atLeft (up e) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection u w a e
            [(1, ⟨upperLeft, hLeft⟩)])))
    let right : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top :=
      vertical
        (horizontal (straight (up a))
          (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection b b a a
            [(1, ⟨lowerRight, hRight⟩)]))
        (vertical
          (atLeft (down a) (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.parallelUp a a a a
            [(1, middleRight)]))
          (horizontal (straight (up a))
            (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication e e a a
              [(1, upperRight)])))

      MackeyDiagrams.ScopedDiagram.eval (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.interpret drawing)
    evaluate left = evaluate right ∧
      ∀ x : D,
        MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (evaluate right) (basisVector b x) =
          @ite _ (x = r) (Classical.propDecidable (x = r)) (basisVector e s) 0
```

## CupCapDotSlides: Dot slides through cups and caps

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let U be an arbitrary group, H,G subgroups of U, and α,β∈U with αHα⁻¹,βHβ⁻¹⊆G. Strings are labelled by the centralizer cosets ᾱ=α C_U(H) and β̄=β C_U(H). Write I_ᾱ, D_ᾱ for the induction and restriction bimodules and similarly for β. For a finite eligible dot z=Σ_d c_d d, with every d∈G satisfying α_*(h)d=dβ_*(h) for all h∈H (equivalently d∈G∩α C_U(H)β⁻¹), define z∨=Σ_d c_d d⁻¹. This reverses the pair of embedding labels linearly, without conjugating coefficients or assuming the entire sum invertible. Put r_z(x)=xz and ℓ_z(x)=zx. The following four identities are identities of actual typed string diagrams' evaluated bimodule maps, at fixed boundary words:
(1) ε_β ∘ (r_z ⊗ id_Dβ) = ε_α ∘ (id_Iα ⊗ ℓ_z), on I_α⊗D_β → C[G].
(2) ε̃_β ∘ (ℓ_z∨ ⊗ id_Iβ) = ε̃_α ∘ (id_Dα ⊗ r_z∨), on D_α⊗I_β → C[H].
(3) (ℓ_z∨ ⊗ id_Iα) ∘ η_α = (id_Dβ ⊗ r_z∨) ∘ η_β, on C[H] → D_β⊗I_α.
(4) (r_z ⊗ id_Dα) ∘ η̃_α = (id_Iβ ⊗ ℓ_z) ∘ η̃_β, on C[G] → I_β⊗D_α.
The first three identities hold at arbitrary subgroup index. The fourth is required whenever both α_*(H) and β_*(H) have finite index in G, so both standalone reverse cups are defined. Ordinary cup η, multiplication cap ε, reverse cup η̃, and trace cap ε̃ have exactly the definitions in Section 1.2. Upward dots from α to β evaluate by right multiplication by z; the same abstract label on a downward string evaluates by left multiplication by z∨, and reversing the embedding pair uses the eligible reversed label. All finite linear labels including zero are allowed. Prove the four diagram evaluations, not an equality of shapes or arbitrary maps substituted for primitive diagrams.

```lean
    let leftZ := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing zDual
    let rightDual := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.upDrawing zDual
    let leftDual := MackeyDiagrams.DotLabel.downDrawing z
    let idUpA := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) (MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a))
    let idUpB := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary

    let idDownA := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary

    let idDownB := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary

      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal idUpA leftZ)
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.ordinary (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap a))
    let traceLeft := MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.horizontal leftDual idUpB)
```

## CupCapStraightening: Cup–cap straightening

Main result; compiled and axiom-checked.

### Article

Let U be an arbitrary group and H,G≤U. Let α,β∈U induce embeddings of H into G and let the actual string labels be the centralizer cosets ᾱ=α C_U(H), β̄=β C_U(H). Use the actual typed cup, cap, associativity and unit diagrams of Section 1.2. All parts of a continuous undotted string carry its one fixed coset label. With I=I_ᾱ and D=D_β̄, the two ordinary cup–multiplication-cap straightening identities hold without any finite-index assumption:
(1) (ε_α ⊗ id_Iα) ∘ (id_Iα ⊗ η_α) = id_Iα;
(2) (id_Dβ ⊗ ε_β) ∘ (η_β ⊗ id_Dβ) = id_Dβ.
The reverse-cup–trace-cap identities are:
(3) (id_Iα ⊗ ε̃_α) ∘ (η̃_α ⊗ id_Iα) = id_Iα for every finite-index witness for α_*(H)≤G;
(4) (ε̃_β ⊗ id_Dβ) ∘ (id_Dβ ⊗ η̃_β) = id_Dβ for every finite-index witness for β_*(H)≤G.
All four compare the actual evaluated bimodule maps of these drawn zigzags, with necessary explicit unit insertions/removals and associators. They do not identify the raw diagram syntax or shape. The first two remain unconditional at arbitrary index; the last two have separate finite-index premises, not a global finiteness hypothesis. The figures are the reverse/ordinary upward straightenings labelled ᾱ, and ordinary/reverse downward straightenings labelled β̄.

The owner’s fixed-coset convention is implemented by reusing the same ConjEmbedding label throughout each continuous undotted string.
```lean
theorem CupCapStraightening : ∀ {U : Type u} [Group U] (H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ h : H, α * (h : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G),
  let a := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let b := MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  let upA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up a
  let downA := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down a
  let upB := MackeyDiagrams.Word.up b
  let downB := MackeyDiagrams.Word.down b
  let idUp := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) upA
  let idDown := MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.id (R := Complex) downB
  let ordinaryUp :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit upA)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUp (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup a))
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate upA downA upA)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap a) idUp)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit upA))))
  let ordinaryDown :=
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit downB)
      (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.ordinaryCup b) idDown)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate downB upB downB)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDown (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.multiplicationCap b))
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit downB))))
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ordinaryUp = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idUp ∧
  MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval ordinaryDown = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idDown ∧
  (∀ finiteA : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom a)),
    let reverseUp :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertLeftUnit upA)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup a finiteA) idUp)
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.associate upA downA upA)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idUp (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap a))
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.rightUnit upA))))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval reverseUp = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idUp) ∧
  (∀ finiteB : Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (MackeyDiagrams.ConjEmbedding.toHom b)),
    let reverseDown :=
      MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.insertRightUnit downB)
        (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal idDown (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.reverseCup b finiteB))
          (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.unassociate downB upB downB)
            (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.vertical
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.horizontal (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.traceCap b) idDown)
              (MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.leftUnit downB))))
    MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval reverseDown = MackeyDiagrams.Diagram.eval idDown)
```
